Read Operation:
When operating in scatter-gather mode, the last two bits NEXT[1:0] will become reserved, and indicate the first next address of system memory.
Note 1: The descriptor table address must be word boundary.
Note 2: Before filled transfer task in the descriptor table, user must check if the descriptor table is complete.

This field indicates the offset of next descriptor table address of current execution descriptor table in system memory.
Note: write operation is useless in this field.

BitField.name: SWREQ0
BitField.description:

Set this bit to 1 to generate a software request to PDMA [n].
Note 1: User can read PDMA_TRGSTS register to know which channel is on active. Active flag may be triggered by software request or peripheral request.
Note 2: If user does not enable corresponding PDMA channel, the software request will be ignored.

Enum.description: No effect
Generate a software request

BitField.name: REQSTS0
BitField.description:
PDMA Channel Request Status (Read Only)
This flag indicates whether channel[n] have a request or not, no matter request from software or peripheral. When PDMA controller finishes channel transfer, this bit will be cleared automatically.
Note: If user pauses or resets each PDMA transfer by setting PDMA_PAUSE or PDMA_CHRST register respectively, this bit will be cleared automatically after finishing the current transfer.

Enum.description: PDMA Channel n has no request
PDMA Channel n has a request

BitField.description:

Note: If user pauses or resets each PDMA transfer by setting PDMA_PAUSE or PDMA_CHRST register respectively, this bit will be cleared automatically after finishing the current transfer.

BitField.name: ABTIF
BitField.description:
PDMA Read/Write Target Abort Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
This bit indicates that PDMA has target abort error; Software can read PDMA_ABTSTS register to find which channel has target abort error.

Enum.description: No AHB bus ERROR response received
AHB bus ERROR response received

BitField.name: TDIF
BitField.description:
Transfer Done Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
This bit indicates that PDMA controller has finished transmission; User can read PDMA_TDSTS register to indicate which channel finished transfer.

Enum.description: Not finished yet
PDMA channel has finished transmission

BitField.name: ALIGNF
BitField.description: Transfer Alignment Interrupt Flag (Read Only)

Enum.description: PDMA channel source address and destination address both follow transfer width setting
PDMA channel source address or destination address is not follow transfer width setting

BitField.name: REQTOF0
BitField.description:
Request Time-out Flag for Channel 0
This flag indicates that PDMA controller has waited peripheral request for a period defined by PDMA_TOC0, user can write 1 to clear these bits.
Note: Please disable time-out function before clear this bit.

Enum.description: No request time-out
Peripheral request time-out

BitField.name: REQTOF1
BitField.description:
Request Time-out Flag for Channel 1
This flag indicates that PDMA controller has waited peripheral request for a period defined by PDMA_TOC1, user can write 1 to clear these bits.
Note: Please disable time-out function before clear this bit.

Enum.description: No request time-out
Peripheral request time-out

BitField.name: PSC
BitField.description:
Prescale Counter
Note: Update prescale counter value will reset internal 8-bit prescale counter and 24-bit up counter value.

BitField.name: INTRGEN
BitField.description:
Inter-timer Trigger Mode Enable Bit
Setting this bit will enable the inter-timer trigger capture function.
The Timer0/2 will be in event counter mode and counting with external clock source or event.Also, Timer1/3 will be in trigger-counting mode of capture function.
Note: For Timer1/3, this bit is ignored and the read back value is always 0

Enum.description: Inter-Timer Trigger Capture mode Disabled
Inter-Timer Trigger Capture mode Enabled

BitField.name: PERIOSEL
BitField.description:
Periodic Mode Behavior Selection Enable Bit
If updated CMPDAT value CNT, CNT will be reset to default value.

Enum.description: The behavior selection in periodic mode is Disabled
The behavior selection in periodic mode is Enabled

BitField.name: TGLPINSEL
BitField.description: Toggle-output Pin Select

Enum.description: Toggle mode output to TMx (Timer Event Counter Pin)
Toggle mode output to TMx_EXT (Timer External Capture Pin)

BitField.name: CAPSRC
BitField.description: Capture Pin Source Selection

Enum.description: Capture Function source is from TMx_EXT (x= 0~3) pin
Capture Function source is from internal ACMP output signal, internal clock source (HIRC 12M, LIRC) or external clock (HXT, LXT)

BitField.name: WKEN
BitField.description:
Wake-up Function Enable Bit
If this bit is set to 1, while timer interrupt flag TIF (TIMERx_INTSTS[0]) is 1 and INTEN (TIMERx_CTL[29]) is enabled, the timer interrupt signal will generate a wake-up trigger event to CPU.

Enum.description: Wake-up function Disabled if timer interrupt signal generated
Wake-up function Enabled if timer interrupt signal generated

BitField.name: EXTCNTEN
BitField.description:
Event Counter Mode Enable Bit
This bit is for external counting pin function enabled.
Note: When timer is used as an event counter, this bit should be set to 1 and select PCLK as timer clock source.

Enum.description: Event counter mode Disabled
Event counter mode Enabled

BitField.name: ACTSTS
BitField.description:
Timer Active Status Bit (Read Only)
This bit indicates the 24-bit up counter status.
Note: This bit may active when CNT 0 transition to CNT 1.

Enum.description: 24-bit up counter is not active
24-bit up counter is active

BitField.name: CMPDAT
BitField.description:
Timer Comparator Value
CMPDAT is a 24-bit compared value register. When the internal 24-bit up counter value is equal to CMPDAT value, the TIF (TIMERx_INTSTS[0] Timer Interrupt Flag) will be set to 1.
Note 1: Never write 0x0 or 0x1 in CMPDAT field, or the core will run into unknown state.
Note 2: When timer is operating at continuous counting mode, the 24-bit up counter will keep counting continuously even if user writes a new value into CMPDAT field. But if timer is operating at other modes, the 24-bit up counter will restart counting from 0 and using newest CMPDAT value to be the timer compared value while user writes a new value into CMPDAT field.

BitField.name: TIF
BitField.description:
Timer Interrupt Flag
This bit indicates the interrupt flag status of Timer while 24-bit timer up counter CNT (TIMERx_CNT[23:0]) value reaches to CMPDAT (TIMERx_CMP[23:0]) value.
Note: This bit is cleared by writing 1 to it.

Enum.description: No effect
CNT value matches the CMPDAT value

BitField.name: TWKF

BitField.name: CNT
BitField.description:
Timer Data Register
Read operation.
Read this register to get CNT value. For example:
If EXTCNTEN (TIMERx_CTL[24]) is 0, user can read CNT value for getting current 24-bit counter value.
If EXTCNTEN (TIMERx_CTL[24]) is 1, user can read CNT value for getting current 24-bit event input counter value.
Write operation.
Writing any value to this register will reset current CNT value to 0 and reload internal 8-bit prescale counter.

BitField.name: RSTACT
BitField.description:
Timer Data Register Reset Active (Read Only)
This bit indicates if the counter reset operation active.
When user writes this CNT register, timer starts to reset its internal 24-bit timer up-counter to 0 and reload 8-bit pre-scale counter. At the same time, timer set this flag to 1 to indicate the counter reset operation is in progress. Once the counter reset operation done, timer clear this bit to 0 automatically.

Enum.description: Reset operation is done

BitField.name: CMPDAT
BitField.description:
Timer Comparator Value
CMPDAT is a 24-bit compared value register. When the internal 24-bit up counter value is equal to CMPDAT value, the TIF (TIMERx_INTSTS[0] Timer Interrupt Flag) will be set to 1.
Note 1: Never write 0x0 or 0x1 in CMPDAT field, or the core will run into unknown state.
Note 2: When timer is operating at continuous counting mode, the 24-bit up counter will keep counting continuously even if user writes a new value into CMPDAT field. But if timer is operating at other modes, the 24-bit up counter will restart counting from 0 and using newest CMPDAT value to be the timer compared value while user writes a new value into CMPDAT field.

BitField.name: TIF
BitField.description:

This bit indicates the interrupt flag status of Timer while 24-bit timer up counter CNT (TIMERx_CNT[23:0]) value reaches to CMPDAT (TIMERx_CMP[23:0]) value.

Read operation.

If EXTCNTEN (TIMERx_CTL[24]) is 0, user can read CNT value for getting current 24-bit counter value.
If EXTCNTEN (TIMERx_CTL[24]) is 1, user can read CNT value for getting current 24-bit event input counter value.
Write operation.
Writing any value to this register will reset current CNT value to 0 and reload internal 8-bit prescale counter.

BitField.name: RSTACT

This bit indicates if the counter reset operation active.
When user writes this CNT register, timer starts to reset its internal 24-bit timer up-counter to 0 and reload 8-bit pre-scale counter. At the same time, timer set this flag to 1 to indicate the counter reset operation is in progress. Once the counter reset operation done, timer clear this bit to 0 automatically.

BitField.name: ZIF
BitField.description:
PWM Zero Point Interrupt Flag
This bit is set by hardware when TIMERx_PWM counter reaches 0.
Note: This bit is cleared by writing 1 to it.

BitField.name: PIF
BitField.description:
PWM Period Point Interrupt Flag
This bit is set by hardware when TIMERx_PWM counter reaches PERIOD.
Note 1: In up-down count type, PIF flag means the center point flag of current PWM period.
Note 2: This bit is cleared by writing 1 to it.

BitField.name: CMPUIF
BitField.description:
PWM Compare Up Count Interrupt Flag
This bit is set by hardware when TIMERx_PWM counter in up count direction and reaches CMP.
Note 1: If CMP equal to PERIOD, there is no CMPUIF flag in up count type and up-down count type.
Note 2: This bit is cleared by writing 1 to it.

BitField.name: CMPDIF
BitField.description:
PWM Compare Down Count Interrupt Flag
This bit is set by hardware when TIMERx_PWM counter in down count direction and reaches CMP.
Note 1: If CMP equal to PERIOD, there is no CMPDIF flag in down count type.
Note 2: This bit is cleared by writing 1 to it.

BitField.name: BRKEIF1

PWMx_CH0 level-detect brake event happened

PWMx_CH1 level-detect brake event happened

PWMx_CH0 at level-detect brake state

BitField.name: BRKLSTS1

Setting this bit will enable the inter-timer trigger capture function.
The Timer0/2 will be in event counter mode and counting with external clock source or event.Also, Timer1/3 will be in trigger-counting mode of capture function.

24-bit up counter is active

The timer controller is operated in Periodic mode

Note: This bit is write protected. Refer to the SYS_REGLCTL register.

Enum.description: ICE debug mode acknowledgement effects TIMER counting
ICE debug mode acknowledgement Disabled

BitField.name: CMPDAT
BitField.description:
Timer Comparator Value
CMPDAT is a 24-bit compared value register. When the internal 24-bit up counter value is equal to CMPDAT value, the TIF (TIMERx_INTSTS[0] Timer Interrupt Flag) will be set to 1.
Note 1: Never write 0x0 or 0x1 in CMPDAT field, or the core will run into unknown state.
Note 2: When timer is operating at continuous counting mode, the 24-bit up counter will keep counting continuously even if user writes a new value into CMPDAT field. But if timer is operating at other modes, the 24-bit up counter will restart counting from 0 and using newest CMPDAT value to be the timer compared value while user writes a new value into CMPDAT field.

BitField.name: TIF
BitField.description:
Timer Interrupt Flag
This bit indicates the interrupt flag status of Timer while 24-bit timer up counter CNT (TIMERx_CNT[23:0]) value reaches to CMPDAT (TIMERx_CMP[23:0]) value.
Note: This bit is cleared by writing 1 to it.

Enum.description: No effect
CNT value matches the CMPDAT value

Note: This bit is cleared by writing 1 to it.

Enum.description: Timer does not cause CPU wake-up
CPU wake-up from Idle or Power-down mode if timer time-out interrupt signal generated

BitField.name: CNT
BitField.description:
Timer Data Register
Read operation.
Read this register to get CNT value. For example:
If EXTCNTEN (TIMERx_CTL[24]) is 0, user can read CNT value for getting current 24-bit counter value.
If EXTCNTEN (TIMERx_CTL[24]) is 1, user can read CNT value for getting current 24-bit event input counter value.
Write operation.
Writing any value to this register will reset current CNT value to 0 and reload internal 8-bit prescale counter.

BitField.name: RSTACT
BitField.description:
Timer Data Register Reset Active (Read Only)
This bit indicates if the counter reset operation active.
When user writes this CNT register, timer starts to reset its internal 24-bit timer up-counter to 0 and reload 8-bit pre-scale counter. At the same time, timer set this flag to 1 to indicate the counter reset operation is in progress. Once the counter reset operation done, timer clear this bit to 0 automatically.

Enum.description: Reset operation is done
Reset operation triggered by writing TIMERx_CNT is in progress

When CAPEN (TIMERx_EXTCTL[3]) bit is set, CAPFUNCS (TIMERx_EXTCTL[4]) bit is 0, and a transition on TMx_EXT pin matched the CAPEDGE (TIMERx_EXTCTL[14:12]) setting, CAPIF (TIMERx_EINTSTS[0]) will be set to 1 and the current timer counter value CNT (TIMERx_CNT[23:0]) will be auto-loaded into this CAPDAT field.

Capture event occurred when detect both rising and falling edge transfer on TMx_EXT (x= 0~3) pin, and first capture event occurred at rising edge transfer

BitField.name: PERIOD

In down count type: PWM counter counts from PERIOD to 0, and restarts from PERIOD.
In up-down count type: PWM counter counts from 0 to PERIOD, then decrements to 0 and repeats again.
In up and down count type:
Note: User should take care DIRF (TIMERx_PWMCNT[16]) bit in up/down/up-down count type to monitor current counter direction in each count type.

BitField.name: ZIF
BitField.description:
PWM Zero Point Interrupt Flag
This bit is set by hardware when TIMERx_PWM counter reaches 0.
Note: This bit is cleared by writing 1 to it.

BitField.name: PIF
BitField.description:
PWM Period Point Interrupt Flag
This bit is set by hardware when TIMERx_PWM counter reaches PERIOD.
Note 1: In up-down count type, PIF flag means the center point flag of current PWM period.
Note 2: This bit is cleared by writing 1 to it.

BitField.name: CMPUIF
BitField.description:
PWM Compare Up Count Interrupt Flag
This bit is set by hardware when TIMERx_PWM counter in up count direction and reaches CMP.
Note 1: If CMP equal to PERIOD, there is no CMPUIF flag in up count type and up-down count type.
Note 2: This bit is cleared by writing 1 to it.

BitField.name: CMPDIF
BitField.description:
PWM Compare Down Count Interrupt Flag
This bit is set by hardware when TIMERx_PWM counter in down count direction and reaches CMP.
Note 1: If CMP equal to PERIOD, there is no CMPDIF flag in down count type.
Note 2: This bit is cleared by writing 1 to it.

BitField.name: BRKEIF0
BitField.description:
Edge-detect Brake Interrupt Flag on PWMx_CH0 (Write Protect)
Note 1: This bit is cleared by writing 1 to it.
Note 2: This bit is write protected. Refer to SYS_REGLCTL register.

Enum.description: PWMx_CH0 edge-detect brake event do not happened
PWMx_CH0 edge-detect brake event happened

BitField.name: BRKEIF1
BitField.description:
Edge-detect Brake Interrupt Flag PWMx_CH1 (Write Protect)
Note 1: This bit is cleared by writing 1 to it.
Note 2: This bit is write protected. Refer to SYS_REGLCTL register.

Enum.description: PWMx_CH1 edge-detect brake event do not happened
PWMx_CH1 edge-detect brake event happened

BitField.name: BRKLIF0
BitField.description:

Note 1: This bit is cleared by writing 1 to it.
Note 2: This bit is write protected. Refer to SYS_REGLCTL register.

PWMx_CH0 level-detect brake event happened

BitField.name: BRKLIF1
BitField.description:

Note 1: This bit is cleared by writing 1 to it.
Note 2: This bit is write protected. Refer to SYS_REGLCTL register.

Enum.description: PWMx_CH1 level-detect brake event do not happened
PWMx_CH1 level-detect brake event happened

BitField.name: BRKESTS0
BitField.description:
Edge -detect Brake Status of PWMx_CH0 (Read Only)
Note: User can set BRKEIF0 1 to clear BRKEIF0 flag and PWMx_CH0 will release brake state when current PWM period finished and resume PWMx_CH0 output waveform start from next full PWM period.

Enum.description: PWMx_CH0 edge-detect brake state is released
PWMx_CH0 at edge-detect brake state

BitField.name: BRKESTS1
BitField.description:
Edge-detect Brake Status of PWMx_CH1 (Read Only)
Note: User can set BRKEIF1 1 to clear BRKEIF1 flag and PWMx_CH1 will release brake state when current PWM period finished and resume PWMx_CH1 output waveform start from next full PWM period.

Enum.description: PWMx_CH1 edge-detect brake state is released
PWMx_CH1 at edge-detect brake state

BitField.name: BRKLSTS0
BitField.description:
Level-detect Brake Status of PWMx_CH0 (Read Only)
Note: If TIMERx_PWM level-detect brake source has released, both PWMx_CH0 and PWMx_CH1 will release brake state when current PWM period finished and resume PWMx_CH0 and PWMx_CH1 output waveform start from next full PWM period.

Enum.description: PWMx_CH0 level-detect brake state is released
PWMx_CH0 at level-detect brake state

BitField.name: BRKLSTS1
BitField.description:
Level-detect Brake Status of PWMx_CH1 (Read Only)
Note: If TIMERx_PWM level-detect brake source has released, both PWMx_CH0 and PWMx_CH1 will release brake state when current PWM period finished and resume PWMx_CH0 and PWMx_CH1 output waveform start from next full PWM period.

Enum.description: PWMx_CH1 level-detect brake state is released
PWMx_CH1 at level-detect brake state

Trigger EADC conversion at compare down count point (CMPDIF)

BitField.name: SYNCMODE

PWM synchronous counter clear function Enabled

BitField.name: SYNCSRC
BitField.description:
PWM Synchronous Counter Start/Clear Source Select
Note 1: If TIMER0/1/2/3 PWM counter synchronous source are from TIMER0, TIMER0_PWMSCTL[8], TIMER1_PWMSCTL[8], TIMER2_PWMSCTL[8] and TIMER3_PWMSCTL[8] should be 0.
Note 2: If TIMER0/1/ PWM counter synchronous source are from TIMER0, TIMER0_PWMSCTL[8] and TIMER1_PWMSCTL[8] should be set 0, and TIMER2/3/ PWM counter synchronous source are from TIMER2, TIME2_PWMSCTL[8] and TIMER3_PWMSCTL[8] should be set 1.

Enum.description: Counter synchronous start/clear by trigger TIMER0_PWMSTRG STRGEN
Counter synchronous start/clear by trigger TIMER2_PWMSTRG STRGEN

BitField.name: STRGEN
BitField.description:
PWM Counter Synchronous Trigger Enable Bit (Write Only)
PMW counter synchronous function is used to make selected PWM channels (include TIMER0/1/2/3 PWM, TIMER0/1 PWM and TIMER2/3 PWM) start counting or clear counter at the same time according to TIMERx_PWMSCTL setting.
Note: This bit is only available in TIMER0 and TIMER2.

BitField.description:
PWM Counter Equal to 0xFFFF Flag
Note: This bit is cleared by writing 1 to it.

Enum.description: The PWM counter value never reached its maximum value 0xFFFF
The PWM counter value has reached its maximum value

BitField.description:
Trigger EADC Start Conversion Flag
Note: This bit is cleared by writing 1 to it.

Enum.description: PWM counter event trigger EADC start conversion is not occurred
PWM counter event trigger EADC start conversion has occurred

BitField.name: PBUF
BitField.description:
PWM Period Buffer Register (Read Only)
Used as PERIOD active register.

BitField.name: CMPBUF
BitField.description:
PWM Comparator Buffer Register (Read Only)
Used as CMP active register.

BitField.name: PSC
BitField.description:
Prescale Counter
Note: Update prescale counter value will reset internal 8-bit prescale counter and 24-bit up counter value.

BitField.name: INTRGEN
BitField.description:
Inter-timer Trigger Mode Enable Bit
Setting this bit will enable the inter-timer trigger capture function.
The Timer0/2 will be in event counter mode and counting with external clock source or event.Also, Timer1/3 will be in trigger-counting mode of capture function.
Note: For Timer1/3, this bit is ignored and the read back value is always 0

Enum.description: Inter-Timer Trigger Capture mode Disabled
Inter-Timer Trigger Capture mode Enabled

BitField.name: PERIOSEL
BitField.description:
Periodic Mode Behavior Selection Enable Bit
If updated CMPDAT value CNT, CNT will be reset to default value.

Enum.description: The behavior selection in periodic mode is Disabled
The behavior selection in periodic mode is Enabled

BitField.name: TGLPINSEL
BitField.description: Toggle-output Pin Select

Enum.description: Toggle mode output to TMx (Timer Event Counter Pin)
Toggle mode output to TMx_EXT (Timer External Capture Pin)

BitField.name: CAPSRC
BitField.description: Capture Pin Source Selection

Enum.description: Capture Function source is from TMx_EXT (x= 0~3) pin
Capture Function source is from internal ACMP output signal, internal clock source (HIRC 12M, LIRC) or external clock (HXT, LXT)

BitField.name: WKEN
BitField.description:
Wake-up Function Enable Bit
If this bit is set to 1, while timer interrupt flag TIF (TIMERx_INTSTS[0]) is 1 and INTEN (TIMERx_CTL[29]) is enabled, the timer interrupt signal will generate a wake-up trigger event to CPU.

Enum.description: Wake-up function Disabled if timer interrupt signal generated
Wake-up function Enabled if timer interrupt signal generated

BitField.name: EXTCNTEN
BitField.description:
Event Counter Mode Enable Bit
This bit is for external counting pin function enabled.
Note: When timer is used as an event counter, this bit should be set to 1 and select PCLK as timer clock source.

Enum.description: Event counter mode Disabled
Event counter mode Enabled

BitField.name: ACTSTS
BitField.description:
Timer Active Status Bit (Read Only)
This bit indicates the 24-bit up counter status.
Note: This bit may active when CNT 0 transition to CNT 1.

Enum.description: 24-bit up counter is not active
24-bit up counter is active

BitField.name: OPMODE
BitField.description: Timer Counting Mode Select

Enum.description: The timer controller is operated in One-shot mode
The timer controller is operated in Periodic mode
The timer controller is operated in Toggle-output mode
The timer controller is operated in Continuous Counting mode

BitField.name: INTEN
BitField.description:
Timer Interrupt Enable Bit
Note: If this bit is enabled, when the timer time-out interrupt flag TIF is set to 1, the timer interrupt signal is generated and inform to CPU.

Enum.description: Timer time-out interrupt Disabled
Timer time-out interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: CNTEN
BitField.description:
Timer Counting Enable Bit
Note 3: Set enable/disable this bit needs 2 * TMR_CLK period to become active, user can read ACTSTS (TIMERx_CTL[25]) to check enable/disable command is completed or not.

Enum.description: Stops/Suspends counting
Starts counting

BitField.name: ICEDEBUG
BitField.description:
ICE Debug Mode Acknowledge Disable Bit (Write Protect)
TIMER counter will keep going no matter CPU is held by ICE or not.
Note: This bit is write protected. Refer to the SYS_REGLCTL register.

Enum.description: ICE debug mode acknowledgement effects TIMER counting
ICE debug mode acknowledgement Disabled

BitField.name: CMPDAT
BitField.description:
Timer Comparator Value
CMPDAT is a 24-bit compared value register. When the internal 24-bit up counter value is equal to CMPDAT value, the TIF (TIMERx_INTSTS[0] Timer Interrupt Flag) will be set to 1.
Note 1: Never write 0x0 or 0x1 in CMPDAT field, or the core will run into unknown state.
Note 2: When timer is operating at continuous counting mode, the 24-bit up counter will keep counting continuously even if user writes a new value into CMPDAT field. But if timer is operating at other modes, the 24-bit up counter will restart counting from 0 and using newest CMPDAT value to be the timer compared value while user writes a new value into CMPDAT field.

BitField.name: TIF
BitField.description:
Timer Interrupt Flag
This bit indicates the interrupt flag status of Timer while 24-bit timer up counter CNT (TIMERx_CNT[23:0]) value reaches to CMPDAT (TIMERx_CMP[23:0]) value.
Note: This bit is cleared by writing 1 to it.

Enum.description: No effect
CNT value matches the CMPDAT value

BitField.name: TWKF
BitField.description:
Timer Wake-up Flag
This bit indicates the interrupt wake-up flag status of timer.
Note: This bit is cleared by writing 1 to it.

Enum.description: Timer does not cause CPU wake-up
CPU wake-up from Idle or Power-down mode if timer time-out interrupt signal generated

BitField.name: CNT
BitField.description:
Timer Data Register
Read operation.
Read this register to get CNT value. For example:
If EXTCNTEN (TIMERx_CTL[24]) is 0, user can read CNT value for getting current 24-bit counter value.
If EXTCNTEN (TIMERx_CTL[24]) is 1, user can read CNT value for getting current 24-bit event input counter value.
Write operation.
Writing any value to this register will reset current CNT value to 0 and reload internal 8-bit prescale counter.

BitField.name: RSTACT
BitField.description:
Timer Data Register Reset Active (Read Only)
This bit indicates if the counter reset operation active.
When user writes this CNT register, timer starts to reset its internal 24-bit timer up-counter to 0 and reload 8-bit pre-scale counter. At the same time, timer set this flag to 1 to indicate the counter reset operation is in progress. Once the counter reset operation done, timer clear this bit to 0 automatically.

Enum.description: Reset operation is done
Reset operation triggered by writing TIMERx_CNT is in progress

BitField.name: CAPDAT
BitField.description:
Timer Capture Data Register
When CAPEN (TIMERx_EXTCTL[3]) bit is set, CAPFUNCS (TIMERx_EXTCTL[4]) bit is 0, and a transition on TMx_EXT pin matched the CAPEDGE (TIMERx_EXTCTL[14:12]) setting, CAPIF (TIMERx_EINTSTS[0]) will be set to 1 and the current timer counter value CNT (TIMERx_CNT[23:0]) will be auto-loaded into this CAPDAT field.

A rising edge of external counting pin will be counted

TMx_EXT (x= 0~3) pin detection Interrupt Enabled

Enum.description: TMx_EXT (x= 0~3) pin de-bounce or ACMP output de-bounce Disabled
TMx_EXT (x= 0~3) pin de-bounce or ACMP output de-bounce Enabled

BitField.name: CNTDBEN

Timer Counter Pin De-bounce Enable Bit
Note: If this bit is enabled, the edge detection of TMx pin is detected with de-bounce circuit.

Enum.description: TMx (x= 0~3) pin de-bounce Disabled
TMx (x= 0~3) pin de-bounce Enabled

BitField.name: ICAPSEL

Internal Capture Source Select
Note:These bits only available when CAPSRC (TIMERx_CTL[22]) is 1.

Enum.description: Capture Function source is from internal ACMP0 output signal
Capture Function source is from internal ACMP1 output signal
Capture Function source is from HXT
Capture Function source is from LXT
Capture Function source is from HIRC
Capture Function source is from LIRC

BitField.name: CAPEDGE
BitField.description:
Timer External Capture Pin Edge Detect
When first capture event is generated, the CNT (TIMERx_CNT[23:0]) will be reset to 0 and first CAPDAT (TIMERx_CAP[23:0]) should be to 0.

BitField.name: PERIOD

In down count type: PWM counter counts from PERIOD to 0, and restarts from PERIOD.
In up-down count type: PWM counter counts from 0 to PERIOD, then decrements to 0 and repeats again.
In up and down count type:
Note: User should take care DIRF (TIMERx_PWMCNT[16]) bit in up/down/up-down count type to monitor current counter direction in each count type.

BitField.name: CMPDIF

Note 2: This bit is cleared by writing 1 to it.

BitField.description:
WDT Time-out Wake-up Function Control (Write Protect)
If this bit is set to 1, while WDT time-out interrupt flag IF (WDT_CTL[3]) is generated to 1 and interrupt enable bit INTEN (WDT_CTL[6]) is enabled, the WDT time-out interrupt signal will generate a wake-up trigger event to chip.
Note 1: This bit is write protected. Refer to the SYS_REGLCTL register.
Note 2: Chip can be woken up by WDT time-out interrupt signal generated only if WDT clock source is selected to 10 kHz internal low speed RC oscillator (LIRC) or LXT.

Enum.description: Wake-up trigger event Disabled if WDT time-out interrupt signal generated
Wake-up trigger event Enabled if WDT time-out interrupt signal generated

BitField.name: WKF
BitField.description:
WDT Time-out Wake-up Flag (Write Protect)
This bit indicates the interrupt wake-up flag status of WDT
Note 1: This bit is write protected. Refer to the SYS_REGLCTL register.
Note 2: This bit is cleared by writing 1 to it.

Enum.description: WDT does not cause chip wake-up
Chip wake-up from Idle or Power-down mode if WDT time-out interrupt signal generated

BitField.name: INTEN
BitField.description:
WDT Time-out Interrupt Enable Bit (Write Protect)
If this bit is enabled, the WDT time-out interrupt signal is generated and inform to CPU.
Note: This bit is write protected. Refer to the SYS_REGLCTL register.

Enum.description: WDT time-out interrupt Disabled
WDT time-out interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: WDTEN
BitField.description:
WDT Enable Bit (Write Protect)
Note 1: This bit is write protected. Refer to the SYS_REGLCTL register.
Note 2: If CWDTEN[2:0] (combined by Config0[31] and Config0[4:3]) bits is not configured to 111, this bit is forced as 1 and user cannot change this bit to 0.

Enum.description: WDT Disabled (This action will reset the internal up counter value)
WDT Enabled

BitField.name: TOUTSEL
BitField.description:
WDT Time-out Interval Selection (Write Protect)
These three bits select the time-out interval period for the WDT.
Note: This bit is write protected. Refer to the SYS_REGLCTL register.

Enum.description: 24 * WDT_CLK
26 * WDT_CLK
28 * WDT_CLK
210 * WDT_CLK
212 * WDT_CLK
214 * WDT_CLK
216 * WDT_CLK
218 * WDT_CLK

BitField.name: SYNC
BitField.description:
WDT Enable Control SYNC Flag Indicator (Read Only)
If user executes enable/disable WDTEN (WDT_CTL[7]), this flag can be indicated enable/disable WDTEN function is completed or not.
Note: Performing enable or disable WDTEN bit needs 2 * WDT_CLK period to become active.

Enum.description: Set WDTEN bit is completed
Set WDTEN bit is synchronizing and not become active yet

BitField.name: ICEDEBUG
BitField.description:
ICE Debug Mode Acknowledge Disable Bit (Write Protect)
WDT up counter will keep going no matter CPU is held by ICE or not.
Note: This bit is write protected. Refer to the SYS_REGLCTL register.

Enum.description: ICE debug mode acknowledgement affects WDT counting
ICE debug mode acknowledgement Disabled

BitField.name: RSTDSEL
BitField.description:
WDT Reset Delay Selection (Write Protect)
When WDT time-out happened, user has a time named WDT Reset Delay Period to clear WDT counter by setting RSTCNT (WDT_CTL[0]) to prevent WDT time-out reset happened. User can select a suitable setting of RSTDSEL for different WDT Reset Delay Period.
Note 1: This bit is write protected. Refer to the SYS_REGLCTL register.
Note 2: This register will be reset to 0 if WDT time-out reset happened.

Enum.description: WDT Reset Delay Period is 1026 * WDT_CLK
WDT Reset Delay Period is 130 * WDT_CLK
WDT Reset Delay Period is 18 * WDT_CLK
WDT Reset Delay Period is 3 * WDT_CLK

BitField.name: RSTCNT
BitField.description:
WDT Reset Counter Register
Writing 0x00005AA5 to this field will reset the internal 18-bit WDT up counter value to 0.
Note 1: Performing RSTCNT to reset counter needs 2 * WDT_CLK period to become active.
Note 2: RSTCNT (WDT_CTL[0]) bit is a write protected bit. RSTCNT (WDT_RSTCNT[31:0]) bits are not write protected.

BitField.name: RLDCNT
BitField.description:
WWDT Reload Counter Register
Writing 0x00005AA5 to this register will reload the WWDT counter value to 0x3F.
Note: User can only write WWDT_RLDCNT register to reload WWDT counter value when current WWDT counter value between 0 and CMPDAT (WWDT_CTL[21:16]). If user writes WWDT_RLDCNT when current WWDT counter value is larger than CMPDAT, WWDT reset signal will be generated immediately.

When RTC block is powered on, RTC is at reset state. User has to write a number (0x a5eb1357) to INIT to make RTC leave reset state. Once the INIT is written as 0xa5eb1357, the RTC will be in un-reset state permanently.
The INIT is a write-only field and read value will be always 0.

When low speed 32 kHz oscillator is disabled, PF.4 pin (X32KO pin) can be used as GPIO function. User can program CTLSEL0 to decide PF.4 I/O function is controlled by system power domain GPIO module or VBAT power domain RTC_GPIOCTL0 control register.
PF.4 pin function and I/O status are controlled by OPMODE0[1:0] and DOUT0 after CTLSEL0 is set to 1.

BitField.name: CMP
BitField.description:
EPWM Comparator Register
CMP is used to compare with CNT (EPWM_CNTn[15:0]) bits to generate EPWM waveform, interrupt and trigger EADC/DAC.
In complementary mode, EPWM_CMPDAT0, EPWM_CMPDAT 2, EPWM_CMPDAT4 denote as first compared point, and EPWM_CMPDAT1, EPWM_CMPDAT3, EPWM_CMPDAT5 denote as second compared point for the corresponding 3 complementary pairs EPWM_CH0 and EPWM_CH1, EPWM_CH2 and EPWM_CH3, EPWM_CH4 and EPWM_CH5.

BitField.name: DTEN
BitField.description:
Enable Dead-time Insertion for EPWM Pair (EPWM_CH0, EPWM_CH1) (EPWM_CH2, EPWM_CH3) (EPWM_CH4, EPWM_CH5) (Write Protect)
Dead-time insertion is only active when this pair of complementary EPWM is enabled. If dead- time insertion is inactive, the outputs of pin pair are complementary without any delay.

BitField.name: CNTSEN
BitField.description:
EPWM Counter Synchronous Start Enable (Write Only)
PMW counter synchronous enable function is used to make selected EPWM channels (include EPWM0_CHx and EPWM1_CHx) start counting at the same time.
Writing this bit to 1 will also set the counter enable bit (CNTENn, n denotes channel 0 to 5) if correlated EPWM channel counter synchronous start function is enabled.

BitField.name: TRMSKCNT
BitField.description:
Transition Mask Counter
The fault detect result will be masked before counter count from 0 to TRMSKCNT.

FDCKS is set to 0:
Mask time is EPWMx_CLK * (2^FDCKSEL) * (TRMSKCNT+2)
FDCKS is set to 1:
Mask time EPWMx_CLK * CLKPSC * (2^FDCKSEL) * (TRMSKCNT+2)

Note:
CLKPSC (EPWM_CLKPSCn_m[11:0]) is 0:

BitField.name: FDMSKEN
BitField.description: Fault Detect Mask Enable Bit

Enum.description: Fault detect mask function Disable
Fault detect mask function Enable

BitField.name: DGSMPCYC
BitField.description:
Deglitch Sampling Cycle
FDCKS is set to 0:
Sampling detect signal each EPWMx_CLK * (2^FDCKSEL) period and detect DGSMPCYC+1 times
FDCKS is set to 1:
Sampling detect signal each EPWMx_CLK * CLKPSC * (2^FDCKSEL) period and detect DGSMPCYC+1 times

Note:
CLKPSC (EPWM_CLKPSCn_m[11:0]) is 0:

BitField.name: CMP
BitField.description:
EPWM Comparator Register
CMP is used to compare with CNT (EPWM_CNTn[15:0]) bits to generate EPWM waveform, interrupt and trigger EADC/DAC.
In complementary mode, EPWM_CMPDAT0, EPWM_CMPDAT 2, EPWM_CMPDAT4 denote as first compared point, and EPWM_CMPDAT1, EPWM_CMPDAT3, EPWM_CMPDAT5 denote as second compared point for the corresponding 3 complementary pairs EPWM_CH0 and EPWM_CH1, EPWM_CH2 and EPWM_CH3, EPWM_CH4 and EPWM_CH5.

BitField.name: BRKESTS0
BitField.description:

Note: This bit is read only and auto cleared by hardware. When edge-detect brake interrupt flag is cleared, EPWM will release brake state until current EPWM period finished. The EPWM waveform will start output from next full EPWM period.

EPWM Compare Down Count Point Trigger DAC Enable Bits
EPWM can trigger DAC to start action when EPWM counter down count to CMP if this bit is set to1.
Note1: This bit should keep at 0 when EPWM counter operating in up counter type.
Note2: In complementary mode, CDTRGEN1, 3, 5 is used as another CDTRGEN for channel 0, 2, 4.

Enum.description: EPWM Compare Down count point trigger DAC function Disabled
EPWM Compare Down count point trigger DAC function Enabled

BitField.name: CNTSEN
BitField.description:
EPWM Counter Synchronous Start Enable (Write Only)
PMW counter synchronous enable function is used to make selected EPWM channels (include EPWM0_CHx and EPWM1_CHx) start counting at the same time.
Writing this bit to 1 will also set the counter enable bit (CNTENn, n denotes channel 0 to 5) if correlated EPWM channel counter synchronous start function is enabled.

BitField.name: IFACNT
BitField.description:
EPWM_CHn Interrupt Flag Counter
The register sets the count number which defines (IFACNT+1) times of EPWM_CHn period occurs to set bit IFAIFn to request the EPWM period interrupt.
EPWM flag will be set in every IFACNT[15:0] times of EPWM period.

BitField.name: TRMSKCNT
BitField.description:
Transition Mask Counter
The fault detect result will be masked before counter count from 0 to TRMSKCNT.

FDCKS is set to 0:
Mask time is EPWMx_CLK * (2^FDCKSEL) * (TRMSKCNT+2)
FDCKS is set to 1:
Mask time EPWMx_CLK * CLKPSC * (2^FDCKSEL) * (TRMSKCNT+2)

Note:
CLKPSC (EPWM_CLKPSCn_m[11:0]) is 0:

BitField.name: FDMSKEN
BitField.description: Fault Detect Mask Enable Bit

Enum.description: Fault detect mask function Disable
Fault detect mask function Enable

BitField.name: DGSMPCYC
BitField.description:
Deglitch Sampling Cycle
FDCKS is set to 0:
Sampling detect signal each EPWMx_CLK * (2^FDCKSEL) period and detect DGSMPCYC+1 times
FDCKS is set to 1:
Sampling detect signal each EPWMx_CLK * CLKPSC * (2^FDCKSEL) period and detect DGSMPCYC+1 times

Note:
CLKPSC (EPWM_CLKPSCn_m[11:0]) is 0:

In up-down counter type, PERIOD will load to PBUF at the end point of each period. CMPDAT will load to CMPBUF at the center point of a period.

BitField.name: DBGHALT
BitField.description:
ICE Debug Mode Counter Halt (Write Protect)
If counter halt is enabled, BPWM all counters will keep current value until exit ICE debug mode.
Note: This bit is write protected. Refer to SYS_REGLCTL register.

Enum.description: ICE debug mode counter halt Disabled
ICE debug mode counter halt Enabled

BitField.name: DBGTRIOFF
BitField.description:
ICE Debug Mode Acknowledge Disable (Write Protect)
BPWM pin will keep output no matter ICE debug mode acknowledged or not.
Note: This bit is write protected. Refer to SYS_REGLCTL register.

Enum.description: ICE debug mode acknowledgement effects BPWM output
ICE debug mode acknowledgement Disabled

BitField.name: CNTTYPE0

Enum.description: Up counter type (supports in capture mode)

Up-down counter type

BitField.name: ECLKSRC0

BitField.name: CLKPSC
BitField.description:
BPWM Counter Clock Prescale
The clock of BPWM counter is decided by clock prescaler. Each BPWM pair share one BPWM counter clock prescaler. The clock of BPWM counter is divided by (CLKPSC+ 1).

BitField.name: CNTEN0
BitField.description: BPWM Counter 0 Enable Bit

Enum.description: BPWM Counter and clock prescaler stop running
BPWM Counter and clock prescaler start running

BitField.name: CNTCLR0
BitField.description:
Clear BPWM Counter Control Bit 0
It is automatically cleared by hardware.

Enum.description: No effect
Clear 16-bit BPWM counter to 0000H

BitField.name: PERIOD
BitField.description:
BPWM Period Register
Up-Count mode: In this mode, BPWM counter counts from 0 to PERIOD, and restarts from 0.
Down-Count mode: In this mode, BPWM counter counts from PERIOD to 0, and restarts from PERIOD.

BitField.name: CMPDAT
BitField.description:
BPWM Comparator Register
CMPDAT use to compare with CNT to generate BPWM waveform, interrupt and trigger EADC0/1.
In independent mode, CMPDAT0~5 denote as 6 independent BPWM_CH0~5 compared point.

BitField.name: ZIF0

This bit is set by hardware when BPWM_CH0 counter reaches 0, software can write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

BitField.name: PIF0

This bit is set by hardware when BPWM_CH0 counter reaches BPWM_PERIOD0, software can write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

BitField.name: CMPUIF0

BitField.name: CNTSEN
BitField.description:
BPWM Counter Synchronous Start Enable Bit(Write Only)
BPMW counter synchronous enable function is used to make PWM or BPWM channels start counting at the same time.
Writing this bit to 1 will also set the counter enable bit if correlated BPWM channel counter synchronous start function is enabled.

BitField.name: DBGHALT
BitField.description:
ICE Debug Mode Counter Halt (Write Protect)
If counter halt is enabled, BPWM all counters will keep current value until exit ICE debug mode.
Note: This bit is write protected. Refer to SYS_REGLCTL register.

Enum.description: ICE debug mode counter halt Disabled
ICE debug mode counter halt Enabled

BitField.name: DBGTRIOFF
BitField.description:
ICE Debug Mode Acknowledge Disable (Write Protect)
BPWM pin will keep output no matter ICE debug mode acknowledged or not.
Note: This bit is write protected. Refer to SYS_REGLCTL register.

Enum.description: ICE debug mode acknowledgement effects BPWM output
ICE debug mode acknowledgement Disabled

BitField.name: CLKPSC
BitField.description:
BPWM Counter Clock Prescale
The clock of BPWM counter is decided by clock prescaler. Each BPWM pair share one BPWM counter clock prescaler. The clock of BPWM counter is divided by (CLKPSC+ 1).

BitField.name: PERIOD
BitField.description:
BPWM Period Register
Up-Count mode: In this mode, BPWM counter counts from 0 to PERIOD, and restarts from 0.
Down-Count mode: In this mode, BPWM counter counts from PERIOD to 0, and restarts from PERIOD.

BitField.name: ZIF0
BitField.description:
BPWM Zero Point Interrupt Flag 0
This bit is set by hardware when BPWM_CH0 counter reaches 0, software can write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

BitField.name: PIF0
BitField.description:
BPWM Period Point Interrupt Flag 0
This bit is set by hardware when BPWM_CH0 counter reaches BPWM_PERIOD0, software can write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

BitField.name: CMPUIF0
BitField.description:
BPWM Compare Up Count Interrupt Flag
Flag is set by hardware when BPWM counter up count and reaches BPWM_CMPDATn, software can clear this bit by writing 1 to it. Each bit n controls the corresponding BPWM channel n.
Note: If CMPDAT equal to PERIOD, this flag is not working in up counter type selection.

BitField.name: SSEN0
BitField.description:
BPWM Synchronous Start Function 0 Enable Bit
When synchronous start function is enabled, the BPWM_CH0 counter enable bit (CNTEN0) can be enabled by writing BPWM synchronous start trigger bit (CNTSEN).

Enum.description: BPWM synchronous start function Disabled
BPWM synchronous start function Enabled

BitField.name: SSRC
BitField.description: BPWM Synchronous Start Source Select

Enum.description: Synchronous start source come from PWM0

Synchronous start source come from BPWM1

BitField.name: CNTSEN
BitField.description:
BPWM Counter Synchronous Start Enable Bit(Write Only)
BPMW counter synchronous enable function is used to make PWM or BPWM channels start counting at the same time.
Writing this bit to 1 will also set the counter enable bit if correlated BPWM channel counter synchronous start function is enabled.

BitField.name: CNT
BitField.description:
Quadrature Encoder Interface Counter
A 32-bit up/down counter. When an effective phase pulse is detected, this counter is increased by one if the bit DIRF (QEI_STATUS[8]) is one or decreased by one if the bit DIRF(QEI_STATUS[8]) is 0. This register performs an integrator which count value is proportional to the encoder position. The pulse counter may be initialized to a predetermined value by one of three events occurs:

BitField.name: CNTHOLD
BitField.description:
Quadrature Encoder Interface Counter Hold
When the bit HOLDCNT (QEI_CTL[24]) goes from low to high, the CNT(QEI_CNT[31:0]) is copied into CNTHOLD (QEI_CNTHOLD[31:0]) register.

BitField.name: CNTLATCH
BitField.description:
Quadrature Encoder Interface Counter Index Latch
When the IDXF (QEI_STATUS[0]) bit is set, the CNT(QEI_CNT[31:0]) is copied into CNTLATCH (QEI_CNTLATCH[31:0]) register.

BitField.name: CNTCMP
BitField.description: Quadrature Encoder Interface Counter Compare

BitField.name: CNTMAX
BitField.description:
Quadrature Encoder Interface Preset Maximum Count
This register value determined by user stores the maximum value which may be the number of the QEI counter for the QEI controller compare-counting mode.

BitField.name: NFCLKSEL
BitField.description:
Noise Filter Clock Pre-divide Selection
To determine the sampling frequency of the Noise Filter clock .

A rising edge of bit TIF (TIMER1_INTSTS[0]) in timer 1 sets HOLDCNT to 1

BitField.name: HOLDTMR2
BitField.description: Hold QEI_CNT by Timer 2

A rising edge of bit TIF(TIMER2_INTSTS[0]) in timer 2 sets HOLDCNT to 1

BitField.name: HOLDCNT
BitField.description:
Hold QEI_CNT Control
When this bit is set from low to high, the CNT(QEI_CNT[31:0]) is copied into CNTHOLD(QEI_CNTHOLD[31:0]). This bit may be set by writing 1 to it or Timer0~Timer3 interrupt flag TIF (TIMERx_INTSTS[0]).
Note: This bit is automatically cleared after QEI_CNTHOLD holds QEI_CNT value.

Enum.description: No operation
QEI_CNT content is captured and stored in CNTHOLD(QEI_CNTHOLD[31:0])

BitField.name: IDXLATEN
BitField.description:
Index Latch QEI_CNT Enable Bit
If this bit is set to high, the CNT(QEI_CNT[31:0]) content will be latched into CNTLATCH (QEI_CNTLATCH[31:0]) at every rising on signal CHX.

Enum.description: The index signal latch QEI counter function Disabled
The index signal latch QEI counter function Enabled

BitField.name: IDXRLDEN
BitField.description: Index Trigger QEI_CNT Reload Enable Bit

Enum.description: Reload function Disabled
QEI_CNT re-initialized by Index signal Enabled

BitField.name: CMPEN
BitField.description:
The Compare Function Enable Bit
The compare function in QEI controller is to compare the dynamic counting QEI_CNT with the compare register CNTCMP( QEI_CNTCMP[31:0]), if CNT(QEI_CNT[31:0]) reaches CNTCMP( QEI_CNTCMP[31:0]), the flag CMPF will be set.

Enum.description: Compare function Disabled
Compare function Enabled

BitField.name: QEIEN
BitField.description: Quadrature Encoder Interface Controller Enable Bit

Enum.description: QEI controller function Disabled
QEI controller function Enabled

BitField.name: IDXF
BitField.description:
IDX Detected Flag
When the QEI controller detects a rising edge on signal CHX it will set flag IDXF to high.
Note: This bit is only cleared by writing 1 to it.

Enum.description: No rising edge detected on signal CHX
A rising edge occurs on signal CHX

BitField.name: CMPF
BitField.description:
Compare-match Flag
If the QEI compare function is enabled, the flag is set by hardware while QEI counter up or down counts and reach to the CNTCMP(QEI_CNTCMP[31:0]).
Note: This bit is only cleared by writing 1 to it.

Enum.description: QEI counter does not match with CNTCMP(QEI_CNTCMP[31:0])
QEI counter counts to the same as CNTCMP(QEI_CNTCMP[31:0])

BitField.name: OVUNF
BitField.description:
QEI Counter Overflow or Underflow Flag
Flag is set by hardware while CNT(QEI_CNT[31:0]) overflows from 0xFFFF_FFFF to 0 in free-counting mode or from the CNTMAX (QEI_CNTMAX[31:0]) to 0 in compare-counting mode. Similarly, the flag is set while QEI counter underflows from 0 to 0xFFFF_FFFF or CNTMAX (QEI_CNTMAX[31:0]).
Note: This bit is only cleared by writing 1 to it.

Enum.description: No overflow or underflow occurs in QEI counter
QEI counter occurs counting overflow or underflow

BitField.name: DIRCHGF
BitField.description:
Direction Change Flag
Flag is set by hardware while QEI counter counting direction is changed. Software can clear this bit by writing 1 to it.
Note: This bit is only cleared by writing 1 to it.

Enum.description: No change in QEI counter counting direction
QEI counter counting direction is changed

BitField.name: DIRF
BitField.description:
QEI Counter Counting Direction Indication
Note: This bit is set/reset by hardware according to the phase detection between CHA and CHB.

Enum.description: QEI Counter is in down-counting
QEI Counter is in up-counting

BitField.name: DAT
BitField.description:
Data Receive/Transmit Buffer
Write Operation:
By writing one byte to this register, the data byte will be stored in transmitter FIFO. The UART controller will send out the data stored in transmitter FIFO top location through the UART_TXD.
Read Operation:
By reading this register, the UART controller will return an 8-bit data received from receiver FIFO.

BitField.name: PARITY
BitField.description:
PARITY Bit Receive/Transmit Buffer
Write Operation:
By writing to this bit, the PARITY bit will be stored in transmitter FIFO. If PBE (UART_LINE[3]) and PSS (UART_LINE[7]) are set, the UART controller will send out this bit follow the DAT (UART_DAT[7:0]) through the UART_TXD.
Read Operation:
If PBE (UART_LINE[3]) and PSS (UART_LINE[7]) are enabled, the PARITY bit can be read by this bit.
Note: This bit has effect only when PBE (UART_LINE[3]) and PSS (UART_LINE[7]) are set.

nRTS Auto-flow Control Enable Bit
Note: When nRTS auto-flow is enabled, if the number of bytes in the RX FIFO equals the RTSTRGLV (UART_FIFO[19:16]), the UART will de-assert nRTS signal.

Enum.description: nRTS auto-flow control Disabled

BitField.name: ATOCTSEN
BitField.description:

BitField.name: TXPDMAEN
BitField.description:
TX PDMA Enable Bit
Note: If RLSIEN (UART_INTEN[2]) is enabled and HWRLSINT (UART_INTSTS[26]) is set to 1, the RLS (Receive Line Status) Interrupt is caused. If RLS interrupt is caused by Break Error Flag BIF(UART_FIFOSTS[6]), Frame Error Flag FEF(UART_FIFO[5]) or Parity Error Flag PEF(UART_FIFOSTS[4]), UART PDMA transmit request operation is stopped. Clear Break Error Flag BIF or Frame Error Flag FEF or Parity Error Flag PEF by writing '1' to corresponding BIF, FEF and PEF to make UART PDMA transmit request operation continue.

Enum.description: TX PDMA Disabled
TX PDMA Enabled

BitField.name: RXPDMAEN
BitField.description:
RX PDMA Enable Bit
This bit can enable or disable RX PDMA service.
Note: If RLSIEN (UART_INTEN[2]) is enabled and HWRLSINT (UART_INTSTS[26]) is set to 1, the RLS (Receive Line Status) Interrupt is caused. If RLS interrupt is caused by Break Error Flag BIF(UART_FIFOSTS[6]), Frame Error Flag FEF(UART_FIFO[5]) or Parity Error Flag PEF(UART_FIFOSTS[4]), UART PDMA receive request operation is stopped. Clear Break Error Flag BIF or Frame Error Flag FEF or Parity Error Flag PEF by writing '1' to corresponding BIF, FEF and PEF to make UART PDMA receive request operation continue.

Enum.description: RX PDMA Disabled
RX PDMA Enabled

BitField.name: SWBEIEN
BitField.description:
Single-wire Bit Error Detection Interrupt Enable Bit
Set this bit, the Single-wire Half Duplex Bit Error Detection Interrupt SWBEINT(UART_INTSTS[24]) is generated when Single-wire Bit Error Detection SWBEIF(UART_INTSTS[16]) is set.
Note: This bit is valid when FUNCSEL (UART_FUNCSEL[2:0]) is select UART Single-wire mode.

Enum.description: Single-wire Bit Error Detect Inerrupt Disabled
Single-wire Bit Error Detect Inerrupt Enabled

BitField.name: ABRIEN
BitField.description: Auto-baud Rate Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: Auto-baud rate interrupt Disabled
Auto-baud rate interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: TXENDIEN
BitField.description:
Transmitter Empty Interrupt Enable Bit
If TXENDIEN (UART_INTEN[22]) is enabled, the Transmitter Empty interrupt TXENDINT (UART_INTSTS[30]) will be generated when TXENDIF (UART_INTSTS[22]) is set (TX FIFO (UART_DAT) is empty and the STOP bit of the last byte has been transmitted).

Enum.description: Transmitter empty interrupt Disabled
Transmitter empty interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: RXRST
BitField.description:
RX Field Software Reset
When RXRST (UART_FIFO[1]) is set, all the byte in the receiver FIFO and RX internal state machine are cleared.
Note 1: This bit will automatically clear at least 3 UART peripheral clock cycles.
Note 2: Before setting this bit, it should wait for the RXIDLE (UART_FIFOSTS[29]) be set.

Enum.description: No effect
Reset the RX internal state machine and pointers

BitField.name: TXRST
BitField.description:
TX Field Software Reset
When TXRST (UART_FIFO[2]) is set, all the byte in the transmit FIFO and TX internal state machine are cleared.
Note 1: This bit will automatically clear at least 3 UART peripheral clock cycles.
Note 2: Before setting this bit, it should wait for the TXEMPTYF (UART_FIFOSTS[28]) be set.

Enum.description: No effect
Reset the TX internal state machine and pointers

BitField.name: RFITL
BitField.description:
RX FIFO Interrupt Trigger Level
When the number of bytes in the receive FIFO equals the RFITL, the RDAIF (UART_INTSTS[0]) will be set (if RDAIEN (UART_INTEN [0]) enabled, and an interrupt will be generated).

Enum.description: RX FIFO Interrupt Trigger Level is 1 byte
RX FIFO Interrupt Trigger Level is 4 bytes
RX FIFO Interrupt Trigger Level is 8 bytes
RX FIFO Interrupt Trigger Level is 14 bytes

BitField.name: RXOFF
BitField.description:
Receiver Disable Bit
The receiver is disabled or not (set 1 to disable receiver).
Note: This bit is used for RS-485 Normal Multi-drop mode. It should be programmed before RS485NMM (UART_ALTCTL [8]) is programmed.

Enum.description: Receiver Enabled
Receiver Disabled

BitField.name: RTSTRGLV
