Enum.description: The LIN header includes 'break field'
The LIN header includes 'break field' and 'sync field'
The LIN header includes 'break field', 'sync field' and 'frame ID field'

BitField.name: PID
BitField.description:
LIN PID Bits
If the parity generated by hardware, user fill ID0~ID5 (PID [29:24]), hardware will calculate P0 (PID[30]) and P1 (PID[31]), otherwise user must filled frame ID and parity in this field.
Note 1: User can fill any 8-bit value to this field and the bit 24 indicates ID0 (LSB first).
Note 2: This field can be used for LIN master mode or slave mode.

BitField.name: SLVHDETF
BitField.description:
LIN Slave Header Detection Flag
This bit is set by hardware when a LIN header is detected in LIN slave mode and be cleared by writing 1 to it.
Note 3: When enable ID parity check IDPEN (UART_LINCTL [9]), if hardware detect complete header ('break + sync + frame ID'), the SLVHDETF will be set whether the frame ID correct or not.

Enum.description: LIN header not detected
LIN header detected (break + sync + frame ID)

BitField.name: SLVHEF
BitField.description:
LIN Slave Header Error Flag
This bit is set by hardware when a LIN header error is detected in LIN slave mode and be cleared by writing 1 to it. The header errors include 'break delimiter is too short (less than 0.5 bit time)', 'frame error in sync field or Identifier field', 'sync field data is not 0x55 in Non-Automatic Resynchronization mode', 'sync field deviation error with Automatic Resynchronization mode', 'sync field measure time-out with Automatic Resynchronization mode' and 'LIN header reception time-out'.

Enum.description: LIN header error not detected
LIN header error detected

BitField.name: SLVIDPEF
BitField.description:
LIN Slave ID Parity Error Flag
This bit is set by hardware when receipted frame ID parity is not correct.

Enum.description: No active
Receipted frame ID parity is not correct

BitField.name: SLVSYNCF
BitField.description:
LIN Slave Sync Field
This bit indicates that the LIN sync field is being analyzed in Automatic Resynchronization mode. When the receiver header have some error been detect, user must reset the internal circuit to re-search new frame header by writing 1 to this bit.
Note 2: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.
Note 3: When writing 1 to it, hardware will reload the initial baud rate and re-search a new frame header.

Enum.description: The current character is not at LIN sync state
The current character is at LIN sync state

BitField.name: BRKDETF
BitField.description:
LIN Break Detection Flag
This bit is set by hardware when a break is detected and be cleared by writing 1 to it through software.

Enum.description: LIN break not detected
LIN break detected

BitField.name: BITEF
BitField.description:
Bit Error Detect Status Flag
At TX transfer state, hardware will monitor the bus state, if the input pin (UART_RXD) state not equals to the output pin (UART_TXD) state, BITEF (UART_LINSTS[9]) will be set.

Enum.description: Bit error not detected
Bit error detected

BitField.name: BRCOMP
BitField.description:
Baud Rate Compensation Patten
These 9-bits are used to define the relative bit is compensated or not.
BRCOMP[7:0] is used to define the compensation of UART_DAT[7:0] and BRCOM[8] is used to define the PARITY bit.

BitField.name: BRCOMPDEC
BitField.description: Baud Rate Compensation Decrease

Enum.description: Positive (increase one module clock) compensation for each compensated bit
Negative (decrease one module clock) compensation for each compensated bit

BitField.name: WKCTSEN
BitField.description:
nCTS Wake-up Enable Bit
Note:When the system is in Power-down mode, an external.nCTS change will wake up system from Power-down mode.

Enum.description: nCTS Wake-up system function Disabled
nCTS Wake-up system function Enabled

BitField.name: WKDATEN
BitField.description:
Incoming Data Wake-up Enable Bit
Note:When the system is in Power-down mode, incoming data will wake-up system from Power-down mode.

Enum.description: Incoming data wake-up system function Disabled
Incoming data wake-up system function Enabled

BitField.name: WKRFRTEN
BitField.description:
Received Data FIFO Reached Threshold Wake-up Enable Bit
Note: When the system is in Power-down mode, Received Data FIFO reached threshold will wake-up system from Power-down mode.

Enum.description: Received Data FIFO reached threshold wake-up system function Disabled
Received Data FIFO reached threshold wake-up system function Enabled

BitField.name: WKRS485EN
BitField.description:
RS-485 Address Match (AAD Mode) Wake-up Enable Bit
Note 1: When the system is in.Power-down mode, RS-485 Address Match will wake-up system from Power-down mode.
Note 2: This bit is used for RS-485 Auto Address Detection (AAD) mode in RS-485 function mode and ADDRDEN (UART_ALTCTL[15]) is set to 1.

Enum.description: RS-485 Address Match (AAD mode) wake-up system function Disabled
RS-485 Address Match (AAD mode) wake-up system function Enabled

BitField.name: WKTOUTEN
BitField.description:
Received Data FIFO Reached Threshold Time-out Wake-up Enable Bit
Note 1: When the system is in Power-down mode, Received Data FIFO reached threshold time-out will wake up system from Power-down mode.
Note 2: It is suggested the function is enabled when the WKRFRTEN (UART_WKCTL[2]) is set to 1.

Enum.description: Received Data FIFO reached threshold time-out wake-up system function Disabled
Received Data FIFO reached threshold time-out wake-up system function Enabled

BitField.name: CTSWKF
BitField.description:
nCTS Wake-up Flag
This bit is set if chip wake-up from power-down state by nCTS wake-up.
Note 1: If WKCTSEN (UART_WKCTL[0]) is enabled, the nCTS wake-up cause this bit is set to '1'.
Note 2: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: Chip stays in power-down state
Chip wake-up from power-down state by nCTS wake-up

BitField.name: DATWKF
BitField.description:
Incoming Data Wake-up Flag
This bit is set if chip wake-up from power-down state by data wake-up.
Note 1: If WKDATEN (UART_WKCTL[1]) is enabled, the Incoming Data wake-up cause this bit is set to '1'.
Note 2: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: Chip stays in power-down state
Chip wake-up from power-down state by Incoming Data wake-up

BitField.name: RFRTWKF
BitField.description:
Received Data FIFO Reached Threshold Wake-up Flag
This bit is set if chip wake-up from power-down state by Received Data FIFO reached threshold wake-up.
Note 1: If WKRFRTEN (UART_WKCTL[2]) is enabled, the Received Data FIFO Reached Threshold wake-up cause this bit is set to '1'.
Note 2: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: Chip stays in power-down state
Chip wake-up from power-down state by Received Data FIFO Reached Threshold wake-up

BitField.name: RS485WKF
BitField.description:
RS-485 Address Match (AAD Mode) Wake-up Flag
This bit is set if chip wake-up from power-down state by RS-485 Address Match (AAD mode).
Note 1: If WKRS485EN (UART_WKCTL[3]) is enabled, the RS-485 Address Match (AAD mode) wake-up cause this bit is set to '1'.
Note 2: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: Chip stays in power-down state
Chip wake-up from power-down state by RS-485 Address Match (AAD mode) wake-up

BitField.name: TOUTWKF
BitField.description:
Received Data FIFO Threshold Time-out Wake-up Flag
This bit is set if chip wake-up from power-down state by Received Data FIFO Threshold Time-out
wake-up.
Note 1: If WKTOUTEN (UART_WKCTL[4]) is enabled, the Received Data FIFO reached threshold time-out wake-up cause this bit is set to '1'.
Note 2: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: Chip stays in power-down state
Chip wake-up from power-down state by Received Data FIFO reached threshold time-out

Register.name: UART_DWKCOMP
Register.description: UART Incoming Data Wake-up Compensation Register

BitField.name: STCOMP
BitField.description:
START Bit Compensation Value
These bits field indicate how many clock cycle selected by UART_CLK do the UART controller can get the 1st bit (START bit) when the device is wake-up from Power-down mode.
Note: It is valid only when WKDATEN (UART_WKCTL[1]) is set.

BitField.name: DAT
BitField.description:
Data Receive/Transmit Buffer
Write Operation:
By writing one byte to this register, the data byte will be stored in transmitter FIFO. The UART controller will send out the data stored in transmitter FIFO top location through the UART_TXD.
Read Operation:
By reading this register, the UART controller will return an 8-bit data received from receiver FIFO.

BitField.name: PARITY
BitField.description:
PARITY Bit Receive/Transmit Buffer
Write Operation:
By writing to this bit, the PARITY bit will be stored in transmitter FIFO. If PBE (UART_LINE[3]) and PSS (UART_LINE[7]) are set, the UART controller will send out this bit follow the DAT (UART_DAT[7:0]) through the UART_TXD.
Read Operation:
If PBE (UART_LINE[3]) and PSS (UART_LINE[7]) are enabled, the PARITY bit can be read by this bit.
Note: This bit has effect only when PBE (UART_LINE[3]) and PSS (UART_LINE[7]) are set.

BitField.name: RDAIEN
BitField.description: Receive Data Available Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: Receive data available interrupt Disabled
Receive data available interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: THREIEN
BitField.description: Transmit Holding Register Empty Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: Transmit holding register empty interrupt Disabled
Transmit holding register empty interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: RLSIEN
BitField.description: Receive Line Status Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: Receive Line Status interrupt Disabled
Receive Line Status interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: MODEMIEN
BitField.description: Modem Status Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: Modem status interrupt Disabled
Modem status interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: RXTOIEN
BitField.description: RX Time-out Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: RX time-out interrupt Disabled
RX time-out interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: BUFERRIEN
BitField.description: Buffer Error Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: Buffer error interrupt Disabled
Buffer error interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: WKIEN
BitField.description: Wake-up Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: Wake-up Interrupt Disabled
Wake-up Interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: LINIEN
BitField.description:
LIN Bus Interrupt Enable Bit
Note: This bit is used for LIN function mode.

Enum.description: LIN bus interrupt Disabled
LIN bus interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: TOCNTEN
BitField.description: Receive Buffer Time-out Counter Enable Bit

Enum.description: Receive Buffer Time-out counter Disabled
Receive Buffer Time-out counter Enabled

BitField.name: ATORTSEN
BitField.description:
nRTS Auto-flow Control Enable Bit
Note: When nRTS auto-flow is enabled, if the number of bytes in the RX FIFO equals the RTSTRGLV (UART_FIFO[19:16]), the UART will de-assert nRTS signal.

Enum.description: nRTS auto-flow control Disabled
nRTS auto-flow control Enabled

BitField.name: ATOCTSEN
BitField.description:
nCTS Auto-flow Control Enable Bit
Note: When nCTS auto-flow is enabled, the UART will send data to external device if nCTS input assert (UART will not send data to device until nCTS is asserted).

Enum.description: nCTS auto-flow control Disabled
nCTS auto-flow control Enabled

BitField.name: TXPDMAEN
BitField.description:
TX PDMA Enable Bit
Note: If RLSIEN (UART_INTEN[2]) is enabled and HWRLSINT (UART_INTSTS[26]) is set to 1, the RLS (Receive Line Status) Interrupt is caused. If RLS interrupt is caused by Break Error Flag BIF(UART_FIFOSTS[6]), Frame Error Flag FEF(UART_FIFO[5]) or Parity Error Flag PEF(UART_FIFOSTS[4]), UART PDMA transmit request operation is stopped. Clear Break Error Flag BIF or Frame Error Flag FEF or Parity Error Flag PEF by writing '1' to corresponding BIF, FEF and PEF to make UART PDMA transmit request operation continue.

Enum.description: TX PDMA Disabled
TX PDMA Enabled

BitField.name: RXPDMAEN
BitField.description:
RX PDMA Enable Bit
This bit can enable or disable RX PDMA service.
Note: If RLSIEN (UART_INTEN[2]) is enabled and HWRLSINT (UART_INTSTS[26]) is set to 1, the RLS (Receive Line Status) Interrupt is caused. If RLS interrupt is caused by Break Error Flag BIF(UART_FIFOSTS[6]), Frame Error Flag FEF(UART_FIFO[5]) or Parity Error Flag PEF(UART_FIFOSTS[4]), UART PDMA receive request operation is stopped. Clear Break Error Flag BIF or Frame Error Flag FEF or Parity Error Flag PEF by writing '1' to corresponding BIF, FEF and PEF to make UART PDMA receive request operation continue.

Enum.description: RX PDMA Disabled
RX PDMA Enabled

BitField.name: SWBEIEN
BitField.description:
Single-wire Bit Error Detection Interrupt Enable Bit
Set this bit, the Single-wire Half Duplex Bit Error Detection Interrupt SWBEINT(UART_INTSTS[24]) is generated when Single-wire Bit Error Detection SWBEIF(UART_INTSTS[16]) is set.
Note: This bit is valid when FUNCSEL (UART_FUNCSEL[2:0]) is select UART Single-wire mode.

Enum.description: Single-wire Bit Error Detect Inerrupt Disabled
Single-wire Bit Error Detect Inerrupt Enabled

BitField.name: ABRIEN
BitField.description: Auto-baud Rate Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: Auto-baud rate interrupt Disabled
Auto-baud rate interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: TXENDIEN
BitField.description:
Transmitter Empty Interrupt Enable Bit
If TXENDIEN (UART_INTEN[22]) is enabled, the Transmitter Empty interrupt TXENDINT (UART_INTSTS[30]) will be generated when TXENDIF (UART_INTSTS[22]) is set (TX FIFO (UART_DAT) is empty and the STOP bit of the last byte has been transmitted).

Enum.description: Transmitter empty interrupt Disabled
Transmitter empty interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: RXRST
BitField.description:
RX Field Software Reset
When RXRST (UART_FIFO[1]) is set, all the byte in the receiver FIFO and RX internal state machine are cleared.
Note 1: This bit will automatically clear at least 3 UART peripheral clock cycles.
Note 2: Before setting this bit, it should wait for the RXIDLE (UART_FIFOSTS[29]) be set.

Enum.description: No effect
Reset the RX internal state machine and pointers

BitField.name: TXRST
BitField.description:
TX Field Software Reset
When TXRST (UART_FIFO[2]) is set, all the byte in the transmit FIFO and TX internal state machine are cleared.
Note 1: This bit will automatically clear at least 3 UART peripheral clock cycles.
Note 2: Before setting this bit, it should wait for the TXEMPTYF (UART_FIFOSTS[28]) be set.

Enum.description: No effect
Reset the TX internal state machine and pointers

BitField.name: RFITL
BitField.description:
RX FIFO Interrupt Trigger Level
When the number of bytes in the receive FIFO equals the RFITL, the RDAIF (UART_INTSTS[0]) will be set (if RDAIEN (UART_INTEN [0]) enabled, and an interrupt will be generated).

Enum.description: RX FIFO Interrupt Trigger Level is 1 byte
RX FIFO Interrupt Trigger Level is 4 bytes
RX FIFO Interrupt Trigger Level is 8 bytes
RX FIFO Interrupt Trigger Level is 14 bytes

BitField.name: RXOFF
BitField.description:
Receiver Disable Bit
The receiver is disabled or not (set 1 to disable receiver).
Note: This bit is used for RS-485 Normal Multi-drop mode. It should be programmed before RS485NMM (UART_ALTCTL [8]) is programmed.

Enum.description: Receiver Enabled
Receiver Disabled

BitField.name: RTSTRGLV
BitField.description:
nRTS Trigger Level for Auto-flow Control
Note: This field is used for auto nRTS flow control.

Enum.description: nRTS Trigger Level is 1 byte
nRTS Trigger Level is 4 bytes
nRTS Trigger Level is 8 bytes
nRTS Trigger Level is 14 bytes

BitField.name: WLS
BitField.description:
Word Length Selection
This field sets UART word length.

Enum.description: 5 bits
6 bits
7 bits
8 bits

BitField.name: NSB
BitField.description: Number of 'STOP Bit'

Enum.description: One 'STOP bit' is generated in the transmitted data
When select 5-bit word length, 1.5 'STOP bit' is generated in the transmitted data. When select 6-, 7- and 8-bit word length, 2 'STOP bit' is generated in the transmitted data

BitField.name: PBE
BitField.description:
PARITY Bit Enable Bit
Note: PARITY bit is generated on each outgoing character and is checked on each incoming data.

Enum.description: PARITY bit generated Disabled
PARITY bit generated Enabled

BitField.name: EPE
BitField.description:
Even Parity Enable Bit
Note: This bit has effect only when PBE (UART_LINE[3]) is set.

Enum.description: Odd number of logic 1's is transmitted and checked in each word
Even number of logic 1's is transmitted and checked in each word

BitField.name: SPE
BitField.description:
Stick Parity Enable Bit
Note: If PBE (UART_LINE[3]) and EPE (UART_LINE[4]) are logic 1, the PARITY bit is transmitted and checked as logic 0. If PBE (UART_LINE[3]) is 1 and EPE (UART_LINE[4]) is 0 then the PARITY bit is transmitted and checked as 1.

Enum.description: Stick parity Disabled
Stick parity Enabled

BitField.name: BCB
BitField.description:
Break Control Bit
Note: When this bit is set to logic 1, the transmitted serial data output (TX) is forced to the Spacing State (logic 0). This bit acts only on TX line and has no effect on the transmitter logic.

Enum.description: Break Control Disabled
Break Control Enabled

BitField.name: PSS
BitField.description:
PARITY Bit Source Selection
The PARITY bit can be selected to be generated and checked automatically or by software.
Note 1: This bit has effect only when PBE (UART_LINE[3]) is set.
Note 2: If PSS is 0, the PARITY bit is transmitted and checked automatically. If PSS is 1, the transmitted PARITY bit value can be determined by writing PARITY (UART_DAT[8]) and the PARITY bit can be read by reading PARITY (UART_DAT[8]).

Enum.description: PARITY bit is generated by EPE (UART_LINE[4]) and SPE (UART_LINE[5]) setting and checked automatically
PARITY bit generated and checked by software

BitField.name: TXDINV
BitField.description:
TX Data Inverted
Note 1: Before setting this bit, TXRXDIS (UART_FUNCSEL[3]) should be set then waited for TXRXACT (UART_FIFOSTS[31]) is cleared. When the configuration is done, cleared TXRXDIS (UART_FUNCSEL[3]) to activate UART controller.
Note 2: This bit is valid when FUNCSEL (UART_FUNCSEL[1:0]) is select UART, LIN or RS485 function.

Enum.description: Transmitted data signal inverted Disabled
Transmitted data signal inverted Enabled

BitField.name: RXDINV
BitField.description:
RX Data Inverted
Note 1: Before setting this bit, TXRXDIS (UART_FUNCSEL[3]) should be set then waited for TXRXACT (UART_FIFOSTS[31]) is cleared. When the configuration is done, cleared TXRXDIS (UART_FUNCSEL[3]) to activate UART controller.
Note 2: This bit is valid when FUNCSEL (UART_FUNCSEL[1:0]) is select UART, LIN or RS485 function.

Enum.description: Received data signal inverted Disabled
Received data signal inverted Enabled

BitField.name: RTS
BitField.description:
nRTS (Request-to-send) Signal Control
This bit is direct control internal nRTS signal active or not, and then drive the nRTS pin output with RTSACTLV bit configuration.
Note 1: The nRTS signal control bit is not effective when nRTS auto-flow control is enabled in UART function mode.
Note 2: The nRTS signal control bit is not effective when RS-485 auto direction mode (AUD) is enabled in RS-485 function mode.
Note 3: Single-wire mode is support this feature.

Enum.description: nRTS signal is active
nRTS signal is inactive

BitField.name: RTSACTLV
BitField.description:
nRTS Pin Active Level
This bit defines the active level state of nRTS pin output.
Note 1: Refer to Figure 6.1613 and Figure 6.1614 for UART function mode.
Note 2: Refer to Figure 6.1624 and Figure 6.1625 for RS-485 function mode.
Note 3: Before setting this bit, TXRXDIS (UART_FUNCSEL[3]) should be set then waited for TXRXACT (UART_FIFOSTS[31]) is cleared. When the configuration is done, cleared TXRXDIS (UART_FUNCSEL[3]) to activate UART controller.

Enum.description: nRTS pin output is high level active
nRTS pin output is low level active. (Default)

BitField.name: RTSSTS
BitField.description:
nRTS Pin Status (Read Only)
This bit mirror from nRTS pin output of voltage logic status.

Enum.description: nRTS pin output is low level voltage logic state
nRTS pin output is high level voltage logic state

BitField.name: CTSDETF
BitField.description:
Detect nCTS State Change Flag
This bit is set whenever nCTS input has change state, and it will generate Modem interrupt to CPU when MODEMIEN (UART_INTEN [3]) is set to 1.
Note: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: nCTS input has not change state
nCTS input has change state

BitField.name: CTSSTS
BitField.description:
nCTS Pin Status (Read Only)
This bit mirror from nCTS pin input of voltage logic status.
Note: This bit echoes when UART controller peripheral clock is enabled, and nCTS multi-function port is selected.

Enum.description: nCTS pin input is low level voltage logic state
nCTS pin input is high level voltage logic state

BitField.name: CTSACTLV
BitField.description:
nCTS Pin Active Level
This bit defines the active level state of nCTS pin input.
Note: Before setting this bit, TXRXDIS (UART_FUNCSEL[3]) should be set then waited for TXRXACT (UART_FIFOSTS[31]) is cleared. When the configuration is done, cleared TXRXDIS (UART_FUNCSEL[3]) to activate UART controller.

Enum.description: nCTS pin input is high level active
nCTS pin input is low level active. (Default)

BitField.name: RXOVIF
BitField.description:
RX Overflow Error Interrupt Flag
This bit is set when RX FIFO overflow.
If the number of bytes of received data is greater than RX_FIFO (UART_DAT) size 16 bytes, this bit will be set.
Note: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: RX FIFO is not overflow
RX FIFO is overflow

BitField.name: ABRDIF
BitField.description:
Auto-baud Rate Detect Interrupt Flag
This bit is set to logic '1' when auto-baud rate detect function is finished.
Note: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: Auto-baud rate detect function is not finished
Auto-baud rate detect function is finished

BitField.name: ABRDTOIF
BitField.description:
Auto-baud Rate Detect Time-out Interrupt Flag
This bit is set to logic '1' in Auto-baud Rate Detect mode when the baud rate counter is overflow.
Note: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: Auto-baud rate counter is underflow
Auto-baud rate counter is overflow

BitField.name: ADDRDETF
BitField.description:
RS-485 Address Byte Detect Flag
Note 1: This field is used for RS-485 function mode and ADDRDEN (UART_ALTCTL[15]) is set to 1 to enable Address detection mode.
Note 2: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: Receiver detects a data that is not an address bit (bit 9 ='0')
Receiver detects a data that is an address bit (bit 9 ='1')

BitField.name: PEF
BitField.description:
Parity Error Flag
This bit is set to logic 1 whenever the received character does not have a valid 'PARITY bit'.
Note: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: No parity error is generated
Parity error is generated

BitField.name: FEF
BitField.description:
Framing Error Flag
This bit is set to logic 1 whenever the received character does not have a valid 'STOP bit' (that is, the STOP bit following the last data bit or PARITY bit is detected as logic 0).
Note: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: No framing error is generated
Framing error is generated

BitField.name: BIF
BitField.description:
Break Interrupt Flag
This bit is set to logic 1 whenever the received data input (RX) is held in the 'spacing state' (logic 0) for longer than a full word transmission time (that is, the total time of 'START bit' + data bits + parity + STOP bits).
Note: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: No Break interrupt is generated
Break interrupt is generated

BitField.name: RXPTR
BitField.description:
RX FIFO Pointer (Read Only)
This field indicates the RX FIFO Buffer Pointer. When UART receives one byte from external device, RXPTR increases one. When one byte of RX FIFO is read by CPU, RXPTR decreases one.
The Maximum value shown in RXPTR is 15. When the using level of RX FIFO Buffer equal to 16, the RXFULL bit is set to 1 and RXPTR will show 0. As one byte of RX FIFO is read by CPU, the RXFULL bit is cleared to 0 and RXPTR will show 15.

BitField.name: RXEMPTY
BitField.description:
Receiver FIFO Empty (Read Only)
This bit initiate RX FIFO empty or not.
Note: When the last byte of RX FIFO has been read by CPU, hardware sets this bit high. It will be cleared when UART receives any new data.

Enum.description: RX FIFO is not empty
RX FIFO is empty

BitField.name: RXFULL
BitField.description:
Receiver FIFO Full (Read Only)
This bit initiates RX FIFO full or not.
Note: This bit is set when the number of usage in RX FIFO Buffer is equal to 16, otherwise it is cleared by hardware.

Enum.description: RX FIFO is not full
RX FIFO is full

BitField.name: TXPTR
BitField.description:
TX FIFO Pointer (Read Only)
This field indicates the TX FIFO Buffer Pointer. When CPU writes one byte into UART_DAT, TXPTR increases one. When one byte of TX FIFO is transferred to Transmitter Shift Register, TXPTR decreases one.
The Maximum value shown in TXPTR is 15. When the using level of TX FIFO Buffer equal to 16, the TXFULL bit is set to 1 and TXPTR will show 0. As one byte of TX FIFO is transferred to Transmitter Shift Register, the TXFULL bit is cleared to 0 and TXPTR will show 15.

BitField.name: TXEMPTY
BitField.description:
Transmitter FIFO Empty (Read Only)
This bit indicates TX FIFO empty or not.
Note: When the last byte of TX FIFO has been transferred to Transmitter Shift Register, hardware sets this bit high. It will be cleared when writing data into UART_DAT (TX FIFO not empty).

Enum.description: TX FIFO is not empty
TX FIFO is empty

BitField.name: TXFULL
BitField.description:
Transmitter FIFO Full (Read Only)
This bit indicates TX FIFO full or not.
Note: This bit is set when the number of usage in TX FIFO Buffer is equal to 16, otherwise it is cleared by hardware.

Enum.description: TX FIFO is not full
TX FIFO is full

BitField.name: TXOVIF
BitField.description:
TX Overflow Error Interrupt Flag
If TX FIFO (UART_DAT) is full, an additional write to UART_DAT will cause this bit to logic 1.
Note: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: TX FIFO is not overflow
TX FIFO is overflow

BitField.name: TXEMPTYF
BitField.description:
Transmitter Empty Flag (Read Only)
This bit is set by hardware when TX FIFO (UART_DAT) is empty and the STOP bit of the last byte has been transmitted.
Note: This bit is cleared automatically when TX FIFO is not empty or the last byte transmission has not completed.

Enum.description: TX FIFO is not empty or the STOP bit of the last byte has been not transmitted
TX FIFO is empty and the STOP bit of the last byte has been transmitted

BitField.name: RXIDLE
BitField.description:
RX Idle Status (Read Only)
This bit is set by hardware when RX is idle.

Enum.description: RX is busy
RX is idle. (Default)

BitField.name: TXRXACT
BitField.description:
TX and RX Active Status (Read Only)
This bit indicates TX and RX are active or inactive.
Note: When TXRXDIS (UART_FUNCSEL[3]) is set and both TX and RX are in idle state, this bit is cleared. The UART controller can not transmit or receive data at this moment. Otherwise this bit is set.

Enum.description: TX and RX are inactive
TX and RX are active. (Default)

BitField.name: RDAIF
BitField.description:
Receive Data Available Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
When the number of bytes in the RX FIFO equals the RFITL then the RDAIF(UART_INTSTS[0]) will be set. If RDAIEN (UART_INTEN [0]) is enabled, the RDA interrupt will be generated.
Note: This bit is read only and will be cleared when the number of unread bytes of RX FIFO drops below the threshold level (RFITL(UART_FIFO[7:4]).

Enum.description: No RDA interrupt flag is generated
RDA interrupt flag is generated

BitField.name: THREIF
BitField.description:
Transmit Holding Register Empty Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
This bit is set when the last data of TX FIFO is transferred to Transmitter Shift Register. If THREIEN (UART_INTEN[1]) is enabled, the THRE interrupt will be generated.
Note: This bit is read only and will be cleared when writing data into UART_DAT (TX FIFO is not empty).

Enum.description: No THRE interrupt flag is generated
THRE interrupt flag is generated

BitField.name: RLSIF
BitField.description:
Receive Line Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
This bit is set when the RX receive data have parity error, frame error or break error (at least one of 3 bits, BIF(UART_FIFOSTS[6]), FEF(UART_FIFOSTS[5]) and PEF(UART_FIFOSTS[4]), is set). If RLSIEN (UART_INTEN [2]) is enabled, the RLS interrupt will be generated.
Note 2: This bit is read only and reset to 0 when all bits of BIF (UART_FIFOSTS[6]), FEF(UART_FIFOSTS[5]) and PEF(UART_FIFOSTS[4]) are cleared.
Note 3: In RS-485 function mode, this bit is read only and reset to 0 when all bits of BIF (UART_FIFOSTS[6]), FEF(UART_FIFOSTS[5]), PEF(UART_FIFOSTS[4]) and ADDRDETF (UART_FIFOSTS[3]) are cleared.

Enum.description: No RLS interrupt flag is generated
RLS interrupt flag is generated

BitField.name: MODEMIF

Enum.description: No Modem interrupt flag is generated
Modem interrupt flag is generated

BitField.name: RXTOIF
BitField.description:
RX Time-out Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
This bit is set when the RX FIFO is not empty and no activities occurred in the RX FIFO and the time-out counter equal to TOIC (UART_TOUT[7:0]). If RXTOIEN (UART_INTEN [4]) is enabled, the RX time-out interrupt will be generated.
Note: This bit is read only and user can read UART_DAT (RX is in active) to clear it.

Enum.description: No RX time-out interrupt flag is generated
RX time-out interrupt flag is generated

BitField.name: BUFERRIF

Note: This bit is cleared if both of RXOVIF(UART_FIFOSTS[0]) and TXOVIF(UART_FIFOSTS[24]) are cleared to 0 by writing 1 to RXOVIF(UART_FIFOSTS[0]) and TXOVIF(UART_FIFOSTS[24]).

Enum.description: No buffer error interrupt flag is generated
Buffer error interrupt flag is generated

BitField.name: WKIF

BitField.name: BRD

The field indicates the baud rate divider. This filed is used in baud rate calculation. The detail description is shown in Table 6.164.

BitField.name: EDIVM1

BitField.name: BAUDM0
BitField.description:
BAUD Rate Mode Selection Bit 0
This bit is baud rate mode selection bit 0. UART provides three baud rate calculation modes. This bit combines with BAUDM1 (UART_BAUD[29]) to select baud rate calculation mode. The detail description is shown in Table 6.164.

BitField.name: BAUDM1
BitField.description:
BAUD Rate Mode Selection Bit 1
This bit is baud rate mode selection bit 1. UART provides three baud rate calculation modes. This bit combines with BAUDM0 (UART_BAUD[28]) to select baud rate calculation mode. The detail description is shown in Table 6.164.
Note: In IrDA mode must be operated in mode 0.

Register.name: UART_DWKCOMP
Register.description: UART Incoming Data Wake-up Compensation Register

BitField.name: STCOMP
BitField.description:
START Bit Compensation Value
These bits field indicate how many clock cycle selected by UART_CLK do the UART controller can get the 1st bit (START bit) when the device is wake-up from Power-down mode.
Note: It is valid only when WKDATEN (UART_WKCTL[1]) is set.

BitField.name: DAT
BitField.description:
Data Receive/Transmit Buffer
Write Operation:
By writing one byte to this register, the data byte will be stored in transmitter FIFO. The UART controller will send out the data stored in transmitter FIFO top location through the UART_TXD.
Read Operation:
By reading this register, the UART controller will return an 8-bit data received from receiver FIFO.

BitField.name: PARITY
BitField.description:
PARITY Bit Receive/Transmit Buffer
Write Operation:
By writing to this bit, the PARITY bit will be stored in transmitter FIFO. If PBE (UART_LINE[3]) and PSS (UART_LINE[7]) are set, the UART controller will send out this bit follow the DAT (UART_DAT[7:0]) through the UART_TXD.
Read Operation:
If PBE (UART_LINE[3]) and PSS (UART_LINE[7]) are enabled, the PARITY bit can be read by this bit.
Note: This bit has effect only when PBE (UART_LINE[3]) and PSS (UART_LINE[7]) are set.

BitField.name: TXPDMAEN
BitField.description:
TX PDMA Enable Bit
Note: If RLSIEN (UART_INTEN[2]) is enabled and HWRLSINT (UART_INTSTS[26]) is set to 1, the RLS (Receive Line Status) Interrupt is caused. If RLS interrupt is caused by Break Error Flag BIF(UART_FIFOSTS[6]), Frame Error Flag FEF(UART_FIFO[5]) or Parity Error Flag PEF(UART_FIFOSTS[4]), UART PDMA transmit request operation is stopped. Clear Break Error Flag BIF or Frame Error Flag FEF or Parity Error Flag PEF by writing '1' to corresponding BIF, FEF and PEF to make UART PDMA transmit request operation continue.

Enum.description: TX PDMA Disabled
TX PDMA Enabled

BitField.name: RXPDMAEN
BitField.description:
RX PDMA Enable Bit
This bit can enable or disable RX PDMA service.
Note: If RLSIEN (UART_INTEN[2]) is enabled and HWRLSINT (UART_INTSTS[26]) is set to 1, the RLS (Receive Line Status) Interrupt is caused. If RLS interrupt is caused by Break Error Flag BIF(UART_FIFOSTS[6]), Frame Error Flag FEF(UART_FIFO[5]) or Parity Error Flag PEF(UART_FIFOSTS[4]), UART PDMA receive request operation is stopped. Clear Break Error Flag BIF or Frame Error Flag FEF or Parity Error Flag PEF by writing '1' to corresponding BIF, FEF and PEF to make UART PDMA receive request operation continue.

Enum.description: RX PDMA Disabled
RX PDMA Enabled

BitField.name: SWBEIEN
BitField.description:
Single-wire Bit Error Detection Interrupt Enable Bit
Set this bit, the Single-wire Half Duplex Bit Error Detection Interrupt SWBEINT(UART_INTSTS[24]) is generated when Single-wire Bit Error Detection SWBEIF(UART_INTSTS[16]) is set.
Note: This bit is valid when FUNCSEL (UART_FUNCSEL[2:0]) is select UART Single-wire mode.

Enum.description: Single-wire Bit Error Detect Inerrupt Disabled
Single-wire Bit Error Detect Inerrupt Enabled

BitField.name: ABRIEN
BitField.description: Auto-baud Rate Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: Auto-baud rate interrupt Disabled
Auto-baud rate interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: TXENDIEN
BitField.description:
Transmitter Empty Interrupt Enable Bit
If TXENDIEN (UART_INTEN[22]) is enabled, the Transmitter Empty interrupt TXENDINT (UART_INTSTS[30]) will be generated when TXENDIF (UART_INTSTS[22]) is set (TX FIFO (UART_DAT) is empty and the STOP bit of the last byte has been transmitted).

Enum.description: Transmitter empty interrupt Disabled
Transmitter empty interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: RXRST
BitField.description:
RX Field Software Reset
When RXRST (UART_FIFO[1]) is set, all the byte in the receiver FIFO and RX internal state machine are cleared.
Note 1: This bit will automatically clear at least 3 UART peripheral clock cycles.
Note 2: Before setting this bit, it should wait for the RXIDLE (UART_FIFOSTS[29]) be set.

Enum.description: No effect
Reset the RX internal state machine and pointers

BitField.name: TXRST
BitField.description:
TX Field Software Reset
When TXRST (UART_FIFO[2]) is set, all the byte in the transmit FIFO and TX internal state machine are cleared.
Note 1: This bit will automatically clear at least 3 UART peripheral clock cycles.
Note 2: Before setting this bit, it should wait for the TXEMPTYF (UART_FIFOSTS[28]) be set.

Enum.description: No effect
Reset the TX internal state machine and pointers

BitField.name: RFITL
BitField.description:
RX FIFO Interrupt Trigger Level
When the number of bytes in the receive FIFO equals the RFITL, the RDAIF (UART_INTSTS[0]) will be set (if RDAIEN (UART_INTEN [0]) enabled, and an interrupt will be generated).

Enum.description: RX FIFO Interrupt Trigger Level is 1 byte
RX FIFO Interrupt Trigger Level is 4 bytes
RX FIFO Interrupt Trigger Level is 8 bytes
RX FIFO Interrupt Trigger Level is 14 bytes

BitField.name: RXOFF
BitField.description:
Receiver Disable Bit
The receiver is disabled or not (set 1 to disable receiver).
Note: This bit is used for RS-485 Normal Multi-drop mode. It should be programmed before RS485NMM (UART_ALTCTL [8]) is programmed.

Enum.description: Receiver Enabled
Receiver Disabled

BitField.name: RTSTRGLV
BitField.description:
nRTS Trigger Level for Auto-flow Control
Note: This field is used for auto nRTS flow control.

Enum.description: nRTS Trigger Level is 1 byte
nRTS Trigger Level is 4 bytes
nRTS Trigger Level is 8 bytes
nRTS Trigger Level is 14 bytes

BitField.name: WLS
BitField.description:
Word Length Selection
This field sets UART word length.

Enum.description: 5 bits
6 bits
7 bits
8 bits

BitField.name: NSB
BitField.description: Number of 'STOP Bit'

Enum.description: One 'STOP bit' is generated in the transmitted data
When select 5-bit word length, 1.5 'STOP bit' is generated in the transmitted data. When select 6-, 7- and 8-bit word length, 2 'STOP bit' is generated in the transmitted data

BitField.name: PBE
BitField.description:
PARITY Bit Enable Bit
Note: PARITY bit is generated on each outgoing character and is checked on each incoming data.

Enum.description: PARITY bit generated Disabled
PARITY bit generated Enabled

BitField.name: EPE
BitField.description:
Even Parity Enable Bit
Note: This bit has effect only when PBE (UART_LINE[3]) is set.

Enum.description: Odd number of logic 1's is transmitted and checked in each word
Even number of logic 1's is transmitted and checked in each word

BitField.name: SPE
BitField.description:
Stick Parity Enable Bit
Note: If PBE (UART_LINE[3]) and EPE (UART_LINE[4]) are logic 1, the PARITY bit is transmitted and checked as logic 0. If PBE (UART_LINE[3]) is 1 and EPE (UART_LINE[4]) is 0 then the PARITY bit is transmitted and checked as 1.

Enum.description: Stick parity Disabled
Stick parity Enabled

BitField.name: BCB
BitField.description:
Break Control Bit
Note: When this bit is set to logic 1, the transmitted serial data output (TX) is forced to the Spacing State (logic 0). This bit acts only on TX line and has no effect on the transmitter logic.

Enum.description: Break Control Disabled
Break Control Enabled

BitField.name: PSS
BitField.description:
PARITY Bit Source Selection
The PARITY bit can be selected to be generated and checked automatically or by software.
Note 1: This bit has effect only when PBE (UART_LINE[3]) is set.
Note 2: If PSS is 0, the PARITY bit is transmitted and checked automatically. If PSS is 1, the transmitted PARITY bit value can be determined by writing PARITY (UART_DAT[8]) and the PARITY bit can be read by reading PARITY (UART_DAT[8]).

Enum.description: PARITY bit is generated by EPE (UART_LINE[4]) and SPE (UART_LINE[5]) setting and checked automatically
PARITY bit generated and checked by software

BitField.name: TXDINV
BitField.description:
TX Data Inverted
Note 1: Before setting this bit, TXRXDIS (UART_FUNCSEL[3]) should be set then waited for TXRXACT (UART_FIFOSTS[31]) is cleared. When the configuration is done, cleared TXRXDIS (UART_FUNCSEL[3]) to activate UART controller.
Note 2: This bit is valid when FUNCSEL (UART_FUNCSEL[1:0]) is select UART, LIN or RS485 function.

Enum.description: Transmitted data signal inverted Disabled
Transmitted data signal inverted Enabled

BitField.name: RXDINV
BitField.description:
RX Data Inverted
Note 1: Before setting this bit, TXRXDIS (UART_FUNCSEL[3]) should be set then waited for TXRXACT (UART_FIFOSTS[31]) is cleared. When the configuration is done, cleared TXRXDIS (UART_FUNCSEL[3]) to activate UART controller.
Note 2: This bit is valid when FUNCSEL (UART_FUNCSEL[1:0]) is select UART, LIN or RS485 function.

Enum.description: Received data signal inverted Disabled
Received data signal inverted Enabled

BitField.name: RTS
BitField.description:
nRTS (Request-to-send) Signal Control
This bit is direct control internal nRTS signal active or not, and then drive the nRTS pin output with RTSACTLV bit configuration.
Note 1: The nRTS signal control bit is not effective when nRTS auto-flow control is enabled in UART function mode.
Note 2: The nRTS signal control bit is not effective when RS-485 auto direction mode (AUD) is enabled in RS-485 function mode.
Note 3: Single-wire mode is support this feature.

Enum.description: nRTS signal is active
nRTS signal is inactive

BitField.name: RTSACTLV
BitField.description:
nRTS Pin Active Level
This bit defines the active level state of nRTS pin output.
Note 1: Refer to Figure 6.1613 and Figure 6.1614 for UART function mode.
Note 2: Refer to Figure 6.1624 and Figure 6.1625 for RS-485 function mode.
Note 3: Before setting this bit, TXRXDIS (UART_FUNCSEL[3]) should be set then waited for TXRXACT (UART_FIFOSTS[31]) is cleared. When the configuration is done, cleared TXRXDIS (UART_FUNCSEL[3]) to activate UART controller.

Enum.description: nRTS pin output is high level active
nRTS pin output is low level active. (Default)

BitField.name: RTSSTS
BitField.description:
nRTS Pin Status (Read Only)
This bit mirror from nRTS pin output of voltage logic status.

Enum.description: nRTS pin output is low level voltage logic state
nRTS pin output is high level voltage logic state

BitField.name: CTSDETF
BitField.description:
Detect nCTS State Change Flag
This bit is set whenever nCTS input has change state, and it will generate Modem interrupt to CPU when MODEMIEN (UART_INTEN [3]) is set to 1.
Note: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: nCTS input has not change state
nCTS input has change state

BitField.name: CTSSTS
BitField.description:
nCTS Pin Status (Read Only)
This bit mirror from nCTS pin input of voltage logic status.
Note: This bit echoes when UART controller peripheral clock is enabled, and nCTS multi-function port is selected.

Enum.description: nCTS pin input is low level voltage logic state
nCTS pin input is high level voltage logic state

BitField.name: CTSACTLV
BitField.description:
nCTS Pin Active Level
This bit defines the active level state of nCTS pin input.
Note: Before setting this bit, TXRXDIS (UART_FUNCSEL[3]) should be set then waited for TXRXACT (UART_FIFOSTS[31]) is cleared. When the configuration is done, cleared TXRXDIS (UART_FUNCSEL[3]) to activate UART controller.

Enum.description: nCTS pin input is high level active
nCTS pin input is low level active. (Default)

BitField.name: RXOVIF
BitField.description:
RX Overflow Error Interrupt Flag
This bit is set when RX FIFO overflow.
If the number of bytes of received data is greater than RX_FIFO (UART_DAT) size 16 bytes, this bit will be set.
Note: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: RX FIFO is not overflow
RX FIFO is overflow

BitField.name: ABRDIF
BitField.description:
Auto-baud Rate Detect Interrupt Flag
This bit is set to logic '1' when auto-baud rate detect function is finished.
Note: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: Auto-baud rate detect function is not finished
Auto-baud rate detect function is finished

BitField.name: ABRDTOIF
BitField.description:
Auto-baud Rate Detect Time-out Interrupt Flag
This bit is set to logic '1' in Auto-baud Rate Detect mode when the baud rate counter is overflow.
Note: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: Auto-baud rate counter is underflow
Auto-baud rate counter is overflow

BitField.name: ADDRDETF
BitField.description:
RS-485 Address Byte Detect Flag
Note 1: This field is used for RS-485 function mode and ADDRDEN (UART_ALTCTL[15]) is set to 1 to enable Address detection mode.
Note 2: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: Receiver detects a data that is not an address bit (bit 9 ='0')
Receiver detects a data that is an address bit (bit 9 ='1')

BitField.name: PEF
BitField.description:
Parity Error Flag
This bit is set to logic 1 whenever the received character does not have a valid 'PARITY bit'.
Note: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: No parity error is generated
Parity error is generated

BitField.name: FEF
BitField.description:
Framing Error Flag
This bit is set to logic 1 whenever the received character does not have a valid 'STOP bit' (that is, the STOP bit following the last data bit or PARITY bit is detected as logic 0).
Note: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: No framing error is generated
Framing error is generated

BitField.name: BIF
BitField.description:
Break Interrupt Flag
This bit is set to logic 1 whenever the received data input (RX) is held in the 'spacing state' (logic 0) for longer than a full word transmission time (that is, the total time of 'START bit' + data bits + parity + STOP bits).
Note: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: No Break interrupt is generated
Break interrupt is generated

BitField.name: RXPTR
BitField.description:
RX FIFO Pointer (Read Only)
This field indicates the RX FIFO Buffer Pointer. When UART receives one byte from external device, RXPTR increases one. When one byte of RX FIFO is read by CPU, RXPTR decreases one.
The Maximum value shown in RXPTR is 15. When the using level of RX FIFO Buffer equal to 16, the RXFULL bit is set to 1 and RXPTR will show 0. As one byte of RX FIFO is read by CPU, the RXFULL bit is cleared to 0 and RXPTR will show 15.

BitField.name: RXEMPTY
BitField.description:
Receiver FIFO Empty (Read Only)
This bit initiate RX FIFO empty or not.
Note: When the last byte of RX FIFO has been read by CPU, hardware sets this bit high. It will be cleared when UART receives any new data.

Enum.description: RX FIFO is not empty
RX FIFO is empty

BitField.name: RXFULL
BitField.description:
Receiver FIFO Full (Read Only)
This bit initiates RX FIFO full or not.
Note: This bit is set when the number of usage in RX FIFO Buffer is equal to 16, otherwise it is cleared by hardware.

Enum.description: RX FIFO is not full
RX FIFO is full

BitField.name: TXPTR
BitField.description:
TX FIFO Pointer (Read Only)
This field indicates the TX FIFO Buffer Pointer. When CPU writes one byte into UART_DAT, TXPTR increases one. When one byte of TX FIFO is transferred to Transmitter Shift Register, TXPTR decreases one.
The Maximum value shown in TXPTR is 15. When the using level of TX FIFO Buffer equal to 16, the TXFULL bit is set to 1 and TXPTR will show 0. As one byte of TX FIFO is transferred to Transmitter Shift Register, the TXFULL bit is cleared to 0 and TXPTR will show 15.

BitField.name: TXEMPTY
BitField.description:
Transmitter FIFO Empty (Read Only)
This bit indicates TX FIFO empty or not.
Note: When the last byte of TX FIFO has been transferred to Transmitter Shift Register, hardware sets this bit high. It will be cleared when writing data into UART_DAT (TX FIFO not empty).

Enum.description: TX FIFO is not empty
TX FIFO is empty

BitField.name: TXFULL
BitField.description:
Transmitter FIFO Full (Read Only)
This bit indicates TX FIFO full or not.
Note: This bit is set when the number of usage in TX FIFO Buffer is equal to 16, otherwise it is cleared by hardware.

Enum.description: TX FIFO is not full
TX FIFO is full

BitField.name: TXOVIF
BitField.description:
TX Overflow Error Interrupt Flag
If TX FIFO (UART_DAT) is full, an additional write to UART_DAT will cause this bit to logic 1.
Note: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: TX FIFO is not overflow
TX FIFO is overflow

BitField.name: TXEMPTYF
BitField.description:
Transmitter Empty Flag (Read Only)
This bit is set by hardware when TX FIFO (UART_DAT) is empty and the STOP bit of the last byte has been transmitted.
Note: This bit is cleared automatically when TX FIFO is not empty or the last byte transmission has not completed.

Enum.description: TX FIFO is not empty or the STOP bit of the last byte has been not transmitted
TX FIFO is empty and the STOP bit of the last byte has been transmitted

BitField.name: RXIDLE
BitField.description:
RX Idle Status (Read Only)
This bit is set by hardware when RX is idle.

Enum.description: RX is busy
RX is idle. (Default)

BitField.name: TXRXACT
BitField.description:
TX and RX Active Status (Read Only)
This bit indicates TX and RX are active or inactive.
Note: When TXRXDIS (UART_FUNCSEL[3]) is set and both TX and RX are in idle state, this bit is cleared. The UART controller can not transmit or receive data at this moment. Otherwise this bit is set.

Enum.description: TX and RX are inactive
TX and RX are active. (Default)

BitField.name: RDAIF
BitField.description:
Receive Data Available Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
When the number of bytes in the RX FIFO equals the RFITL then the RDAIF(UART_INTSTS[0]) will be set. If RDAIEN (UART_INTEN [0]) is enabled, the RDA interrupt will be generated.
Note: This bit is read only and will be cleared when the number of unread bytes of RX FIFO drops below the threshold level (RFITL(UART_FIFO[7:4]).

Enum.description: No RDA interrupt flag is generated
RDA interrupt flag is generated

BitField.name: THREIF
BitField.description:
Transmit Holding Register Empty Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
This bit is set when the last data of TX FIFO is transferred to Transmitter Shift Register. If THREIEN (UART_INTEN[1]) is enabled, the THRE interrupt will be generated.
Note: This bit is read only and will be cleared when writing data into UART_DAT (TX FIFO is not empty).

Enum.description: No THRE interrupt flag is generated
THRE interrupt flag is generated

BitField.name: RLSIF
BitField.description:
Receive Line Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
This bit is set when the RX receive data have parity error, frame error or break error (at least one of 3 bits, BIF(UART_FIFOSTS[6]), FEF(UART_FIFOSTS[5]) and PEF(UART_FIFOSTS[4]), is set). If RLSIEN (UART_INTEN [2]) is enabled, the RLS interrupt will be generated.
Note 2: This bit is read only and reset to 0 when all bits of BIF (UART_FIFOSTS[6]), FEF(UART_FIFOSTS[5]) and PEF(UART_FIFOSTS[4]) are cleared.
Note 3: In RS-485 function mode, this bit is read only and reset to 0 when all bits of BIF (UART_FIFOSTS[6]), FEF(UART_FIFOSTS[5]), PEF(UART_FIFOSTS[4]) and ADDRDETF (UART_FIFOSTS[3]) are cleared.

Enum.description: No RLS interrupt flag is generated
RLS interrupt flag is generated

BitField.name: MODEMIF
BitField.description:
MODEM Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
Note: This bit is read only and reset to 0 when bit CTSDETF is cleared by a write 1 on CTSDETF(UART_MODEMSTS[0]).

Enum.description: No Modem interrupt flag is generated
Modem interrupt flag is generated

BitField.name: RXTOIF
BitField.description:
RX Time-out Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
This bit is set when the RX FIFO is not empty and no activities occurred in the RX FIFO and the time-out counter equal to TOIC (UART_TOUT[7:0]). If RXTOIEN (UART_INTEN [4]) is enabled, the RX time-out interrupt will be generated.
Note: This bit is read only and user can read UART_DAT (RX is in active) to clear it.

Enum.description: No RX time-out interrupt flag is generated
RX time-out interrupt flag is generated

BitField.name: BUFERRIF
BitField.description:
Buffer Error Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
This bit is set when the TX FIFO or RX FIFO overflows (TXOVIF (UART_FIFOSTS[24]) or RXOVIF (UART_FIFOSTS[0]) is set). When BUFERRIF (UART_INTSTS[5]) is set, the transfer is not correct. If BUFERRIEN (UART_INTEN [5]) is enabled, the buffer error interrupt will be generated.
Note: This bit is cleared if both of RXOVIF(UART_FIFOSTS[0]) and TXOVIF(UART_FIFOSTS[24]) are cleared to 0 by writing 1 to RXOVIF(UART_FIFOSTS[0]) and TXOVIF(UART_FIFOSTS[24]).

Enum.description: No buffer error interrupt flag is generated
Buffer error interrupt flag is generated

BitField.name: WKIF
BitField.description:
UART Wake-up Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
This bit is set when TOUTWKF (UART_WKSTS[4]), RS485WKF (UART_WKSTS[3]), RFRTWKF (UART_WKSTS[2]), DATWKF (UART_WKSTS[1]) or CTSWKF(UART_WKSTS[0]) is set to 1.
Note: This bit is cleared if all of TOUTWKF, RS485WKF, RFRTWKF, DATWKF and CTSWKF are cleared to 0 by writing 1 to the corresponding interrupt flag.

Enum.description: No UART wake-up interrupt flag is generated
UART wake-up interrupt flag is generated

BitField.name: LINIF
BitField.description:
LIN Bus Interrupt Flag
Note: This bit is cleared when SLVHDETF(UART_LINSTS[0]), BRKDETF(UART_LINSTS[8]), BITEF(UART_LINSTS[9]), SLVIDPEF (UART_LINSTS[2]) and SLVHEF(UART_LINSTS[1]) all are cleared and software writing '1' to LINIF(UART_INTSTS[7]).

Enum.description: None of SLVHDETF, BRKDETF, BITEF, SLVIDPEF and SLVHEF is generated
At least one of SLVHDETF, BRKDETF, BITEF, SLVIDPEF and SLVHEF is generated

BitField.name: RDAINT
BitField.description:
Receive Data Available Interrupt Indicator (Read Only)
This bit is set if RDAIEN (UART_INTEN[0]) and RDAIF (UART_INTSTS[0]) are both set to 1.

Enum.description: No RDA interrupt is generated
RDA interrupt is generated

BitField.name: THREINT
BitField.description:
Transmit Holding Register Empty Interrupt Indicator (Read Only)
This bit is set if THREIEN (UART_INTEN[1]) and THREIF(UART_INTSTS[1]) are both set to 1.

Enum.description: No THRE interrupt is generated
THRE interrupt is generated

BitField.name: RLSINT
BitField.description:
Receive Line Status Interrupt Indicator (Read Only)
This bit is set if RLSIEN (UART_INTEN[2]) and RLSIF(UART_INTSTS[2]) are both set to 1.

Enum.description: No RLS interrupt is generated
RLS interrupt is generated

BitField.name: MODEMINT
BitField.description:
MODEM Status Interrupt Indicator (Read Only)
This bit is set if MODEMIEN(UART_INTEN[3]) and MODEMIF(UART_INTSTS[3]) are both set to 1

Enum.description: No Modem interrupt is generated
Modem interrupt is generated

BitField.name: RXTOINT
BitField.description:
RX Time-out Interrupt Indicator (Read Only)
This bit is set if RXTOIEN (UART_INTEN[4]) and RXTOIF(UART_INTSTS[4]) are both set to 1.

Enum.description: No RX time-out interrupt is generated
RX time-out interrupt is generated

BitField.name: BUFERRINT
BitField.description:
Buffer Error Interrupt Indicator (Read Only)
This bit is set if BUFERRIEN(UART_INTEN[5]) and BUFERRIF(UART_ INTSTS[5]) are both set to 1.

Enum.description: No buffer error interrupt is generated
Buffer error interrupt is generated

BitField.name: WKINT
BitField.description:
UART Wake-up Interrupt Indicator (Read Only)
This bit is set if WKIEN (UART_INTEN[6]) and WKIF (UART_INTSTS[6]) are both set to 1.

Enum.description: No UART wake-up interrupt is generated
UART wake-up interrupt is generated

BitField.name: LININT
BitField.description:
LIN Bus Interrupt Indicator (Read Only)
This bit is set if LINIEN (UART_INTEN[8]) and LINIF(UART_INTSTS[7]) are both set to 1.

Enum.description: No LIN Bus interrupt is generated
The LIN Bus interrupt is generated

BitField.name: SBEIF
BitField.description:
Single-wire Bit Error Detection Interrupt Flag
This bit is set when the single wire bus state not equals to UART controller TX state in Single-wire mode.
Note 1: This bit is active when FUNCSEL (UART_FUNCSEL[2:0]) is select UART Single-wire mode.
Note 2: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: No single-wire bit error detection interrupt flag is generated
Single-wire bit error detection interrupt flag is generated

BitField.name: HWRLSIF
BitField.description:
PDMA Mode Receive Line Status Flag (Read Only)
This bit is set when the RX receive data have parity error, frame error or break error (at least one of 3 bits, BIF (UART_FIFOSTS[6]), FEF (UART_FIFOSTS[5]) and PEF (UART_FIFOSTS[4]) is set). If RLSIEN (UART_INTEN [2]) is enabled, the RLS interrupt will be generated.
Note 2: In UART function mode, this bit is read only and reset to 0 when all bits of BIF(UART_FIFOSTS[6]), FEF(UART_FIFOSTS[5]) and PEF(UART_FIFOSTS[4]) are cleared.
Note 3: In RS-485 function mode, this bit is read only and reset to 0 when all bits of BIF(UART_FIFOSTS[6]), FEF(UART_FIFOSTS[5]), PEF(UART_FIFOSTS[4]) and ADDRDETF (UART_FIFOSTS[3]) are cleared.

Enum.description: No RLS interrupt flag is generated in PDMA mode
RLS interrupt flag is generated in PDMA mode

BitField.name: HWMODIF
BitField.description:
PDMA Mode MODEM Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
Note: This bit is read only and reset to 0 when the bit CTSDETF (UART_MODEMSTS[0]) is cleared by writing 1 on CTSDETF (UART_MODEMSTS [0]).

Enum.description: No Modem interrupt flag is generated in PDMA mode
Modem interrupt flag is generated in PDMA mode

BitField.name: HWTOIF
BitField.description:
PDMA Mode RX Time-out Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
This bit is set when the RX FIFO is not empty and no activities occurred in the RX FIFO and the time-out counter equal to TOIC (UART_TOUT[7:0]). If RXTOIEN (UART_INTEN [4]) is enabled, the RX time-out interrupt will be generated.
Note: This bit is read only and user can read UART_DAT (RX is in active) to clear it.

Enum.description: No RX time-out interrupt flag is generated in PDMA mode
RX time-out interrupt flag is generated in PDMA mode

BitField.name: HWBUFEIF
BitField.description:
PDMA Mode Buffer Error Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
This bit is set when the TX or RX FIFO overflows (TXOVIF (UART_FIFOSTS [24]) or RXOVIF (UART_FIFOSTS[0]) is set). When BUFERRIF (UART_INTSTS[5]) is set, the transfer maybe is not correct. If BUFERRIEN (UART_INTEN [5]) is enabled, the buffer error interrupt will be generated.
Note: This bit is cleared when both TXOVIF (UART_FIFOSTS[24]]) and RXOVIF (UART_FIFOSTS[0]) are cleared.

Enum.description: No buffer error interrupt flag is generated in PDMA mode
Buffer error interrupt flag is generated in PDMA mode

BitField.name: TXENDIF
BitField.description:
Transmitter Empty Interrupt Flag
This bit is set when TX FIFO (UART_DAT) is empty and the STOP bit of the last byte has been transmitted (TXEMPTYF (UART_FIFOSTS[28]) is set). If TXENDIEN (UART_INTEN[22]) is enabled, the Transmitter Empty interrupt will be generated.
Note: This bit is cleared automatically when TX FIFO is not empty or the last byte transmission has not completed.

Enum.description: No transmitter empty interrupt flag is generated
Transmitter empty interrupt flag is generated

BitField.name: SWBEINT
BitField.description:
Single-wire Bit Error Detect Interrupt Indicator (Read Only)
This bit is set if SWBEIEN (UART_INTEN[16]) and SWBEIF (UART_INTSTS[16]) are both set to 1.

Enum.description: No Single-wire Bit Error Detection Interrupt generated
Single-wire Bit Error Detection Interrupt generated

BitField.name: HWRLSINT
BitField.description:
PDMA Mode Receive Line Status Interrupt Indicator (Read Only)
This bit is set if RLSIEN (UART_INTEN[2]) and HWRLSIF(UART_INTSTS[18]) are both set to 1.

Enum.description: No RLS interrupt is generated in PDMA mode
RLS interrupt is generated in PDMA mode

BitField.name: HWMODINT
BitField.description:
PDMA Mode MODEM Status Interrupt Indicator (Read Only)
This bit is set if MODEMIEN (UART_INTEN[3]) and HWMODIF(UART_INTSTS[19]) are both set to 1.

Enum.description: No Modem interrupt is generated in PDMA mode
Modem interrupt is generated in PDMA mode

BitField.name: HWTOINT
BitField.description:
PDMA Mode RX Time-out Interrupt Indicator (Read Only)
This bit is set if RXTOIEN (UART_INTEN[4]) and HWTOIF(UART_INTSTS[20]) are both set to 1.

Enum.description: No RX time-out interrupt is generated in PDMA mode
RX time-out interrupt is generated in PDMA mode

BitField.name: HWBUFEINT
BitField.description:
PDMA Mode Buffer Error Interrupt Indicator (Read Only)
This bit is set if BUFERRIEN (UART_INTEN[5]) and HWBUFEIF (UART_INTSTS[21]) are both set to 1.

Enum.description: No buffer error interrupt is generated in PDMA mode
Buffer error interrupt is generated in PDMA mode

BitField.name: TXENDINT
BitField.description:
Transmitter Empty Interrupt Indicator (Read Only)
This bit is set if TXENDIEN (UART_INTEN[22]) and TXENDIF(UART_INTSTS[22]) are both set to 1.

Enum.description: No Transmitter Empty interrupt is generated
Transmitter Empty interrupt is generated

BitField.name: ABRINT
BitField.description:
Auto-baud Rate Interrupt Indicator (Read Only)
This bit is set if ABRIEN (UART_INTEN[18]) and ABRIF (UART_ALTCTL[17]) are both set to 1.

Enum.description: No Auto-baud Rate interrupt is generated
The Auto-baud Rate interrupt is generated

BitField.name: TOIC
BitField.description: Time-out Interrupt Comparator

BitField.name: DLY
BitField.description:
TX Delay Time Value
This field is used to program the transfer delay time between the last STOP bit and next START bit. The unit is bit time.

BitField.name: BRD
BitField.description:
Baud Rate Divider
The field indicates the baud rate divider. This filed is used in baud rate calculation. The detail description is shown in Table 6.164.

BitField.name: EDIVM1
BitField.description:
Extra Divider for BAUD Rate Mode 1
This field is used for baud rate calculation in mode 1 and has no effect for baud rate calculation in mode 0 and mode 2. The detail description is shown in Table 6.164.

BitField.name: BAUDM0
BitField.description:
BAUD Rate Mode Selection Bit 0
This bit is baud rate mode selection bit 0. UART provides three baud rate calculation modes. This bit combines with BAUDM1 (UART_BAUD[29]) to select baud rate calculation mode. The detail description is shown in Table 6.164.

BitField.name: BAUDM1
BitField.description:
BAUD Rate Mode Selection Bit 1
This bit is baud rate mode selection bit 1. UART provides three baud rate calculation modes. This bit combines with BAUDM0 (UART_BAUD[28]) to select baud rate calculation mode. The detail description is shown in Table 6.164.
Note: In IrDA mode must be operated in mode 0.

BitField.name: TXEN
BitField.description: IrDA Receiver/Transmitter Selection Enable Bit

Enum.description: IrDA Transmitter Disabled and Receiver Enabled. (Default)
IrDA Transmitter Enabled and Receiver Disabled

BitField.name: TXINV
BitField.description:
IrDA Inverse Transmitting Output Signal
Note 1: Before setting this bit, TXRXDIS (UART_FUNCSEL[3]) should be set then waited for TXRXACT (UART_FIFOSTS[31]) is cleared. When the configuration is done, cleared TXRXDIS (UART_FUNCSEL[3]) to activate UART controller.
Note 2: This bit is valid when FUNCSEL (UART_FUNCSEL[1:0]) is select IrDA function.

Enum.description: None inverse transmitting signal. (Default)
Inverse transmitting output signal

BitField.name: RXINV
BitField.description:
IrDA Inverse Receive Input Signal
Note 1: Before setting this bit, TXRXDIS (UART_FUNCSEL[3]) should be set then waited for TXRXACT (UART_FIFOSTS[31]) is cleared. When the configuration is done, cleared TXRXDIS (UART_FUNCSEL[3]) to activate UART controller.
Note 2: This bit is valid when FUNCSEL (UART_FUNCSEL[1:0]) is select IrDA function.

Enum.description: None inverse receiving input signal
Inverse receiving input signal. (Default)

BitField.name: BRKFL
BitField.description:
UART LIN Break Field Length
This field indicates a 4-bit LIN TX break field count.
Note 1: This break field length is BRKFL + 1.

BitField.name: LINRXEN
BitField.description: LIN RX Enable Bit

Enum.description: LIN RX mode Disabled
LIN RX mode Enabled

BitField.name: LINTXEN
BitField.description:
LIN TX Break Mode Enable Bit
Note: When TX break field transfer operation finished, this bit will be cleared automatically.

Enum.description: LIN TX Break mode Disabled
LIN TX Break mode Enabled

BitField.name: RS485NMM
BitField.description:
RS-485 Normal Multi-drop Operation Mode (NMM)
Note: It cannot be active with RS-485_AAD operation mode.

Enum.description: RS-485 Normal Multi-drop Operation mode (NMM) Disabled
RS-485 Normal Multi-drop Operation mode (NMM) Enabled

BitField.name: RS485AAD
BitField.description:
RS-485 Auto Address Detection Operation Mode (AAD)
Note: It cannot be active with RS-485_NMM operation mode.

Enum.description: RS-485 Auto Address Detection Operation mode (AAD) Disabled
RS-485 Auto Address Detection Operation mode (AAD) Enabled

BitField.name: RS485AUD
BitField.description:
RS-485 Auto Direction Function (AUD)
Note: It can be active with RS-485_AAD or RS-485_NMM operation mode.

Enum.description: RS-485 Auto Direction Operation function (AUD) Disabled
RS-485 Auto Direction Operation function (AUD) Enabled

BitField.name: ADDRDEN
BitField.description:
RS-485 Address Detection Enable Bit
This bit is used to enable RS-485 Address Detection mode.
Note: This bit is used for RS-485 any operation mode.

Enum.description: Address detection mode Disabled
Address detection mode Enabled

BitField.name: ABRIF
BitField.description:
Auto-baud Rate Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
This bit is set when auto-baud rate detection function finished or the auto-baud rate counter was overflow and if ABRIEN(UART_INTEN [18]) is set then the auto-baud rate interrupt will be generated.
Note: This bit is read only, but it can be cleared by writing '1' to ABRDTOIF (UART_FIFOSTS[2]) and ABRDIF(UART_FIFOSTS[1]).

Enum.description: No auto-baud rate interrupt flag is generated
Auto-baud rate interrupt flag is generated

BitField.name: ABRDEN
BitField.description:
Auto-baud Rate Detect Enable Bit
Note : This bit is cleared automatically after auto-baud detection is finished.

Enum.description: Auto-baud rate detect function Disabled
Auto-baud rate detect function Enabled

BitField.name: ABRDBITS
BitField.description:
Auto-baud Rate Detect Bit Length
Note : The calculation of bit number includes the START bit.

Enum.description: 1-bit time from START bit to the 1st rising edge. The input pattern shall be 0x01
2-bit time from START bit to the 1st rising edge. The input pattern shall be 0x02
4-bit time from START bit to the 1st rising edge. The input pattern shall be 0x08
8-bit time from START bit to the 1st rising edge. The input pattern shall be 0x80

BitField.name: ADDRMV
BitField.description:
Address Match Value
This field contains the RS-485 address match values.
Note: This field is used for RS-485 auto address detection mode.

BitField.name: FUNCSEL
BitField.description: Function Select

Enum.description: UART function
LIN function
IrDA function
RS-485 function
UART Single-wire function

BitField.name: TXRXDIS
BitField.description:
TX and RX Disable Bit
Setting this bit can disable TX and RX.
Note: The TX and RX will not disable immediately when this bit is set. The TX and RX compelet current task before disable TX and RX. When TX and RX disable, the TXRXACT (UART_FIFOSTS[31]) is cleared.

Enum.description: TX and RX Enabled
TX and RX Disabled

BitField.name: BRCOMP
BitField.description:
Baud Rate Compensation Patten
These 9-bits are used to define the relative bit is compensated or not.
BRCOMP[7:0] is used to define the compensation of UART_DAT[7:0] and BRCOM[8] is used to define the PARITY bit.

BitField.name: BRCOMPDEC
BitField.description: Baud Rate Compensation Decrease

Enum.description: Positive (increase one module clock) compensation for each compensated bit
Negative (decrease one module clock) compensation for each compensated bit

BitField.name: WKCTSEN
BitField.description:
nCTS Wake-up Enable Bit
Note:When the system is in Power-down mode, an external.nCTS change will wake up system from Power-down mode.

Enum.description: nCTS Wake-up system function Disabled
nCTS Wake-up system function Enabled

BitField.name: WKDATEN
BitField.description:
Incoming Data Wake-up Enable Bit
Note:When the system is in Power-down mode, incoming data will wake-up system from Power-down mode.

Enum.description: Incoming data wake-up system function Disabled
Incoming data wake-up system function Enabled

BitField.name: WKRFRTEN
BitField.description:
Received Data FIFO Reached Threshold Wake-up Enable Bit
Note: When the system is in Power-down mode, Received Data FIFO reached threshold will wake-up system from Power-down mode.

Enum.description: Received Data FIFO reached threshold wake-up system function Disabled
Received Data FIFO reached threshold wake-up system function Enabled

BitField.name: WKRS485EN
BitField.description:
RS-485 Address Match (AAD Mode) Wake-up Enable Bit
Note 1: When the system is in.Power-down mode, RS-485 Address Match will wake-up system from Power-down mode.
Note 2: This bit is used for RS-485 Auto Address Detection (AAD) mode in RS-485 function mode and ADDRDEN (UART_ALTCTL[15]) is set to 1.

Enum.description: RS-485 Address Match (AAD mode) wake-up system function Disabled
RS-485 Address Match (AAD mode) wake-up system function Enabled

BitField.name: WKTOUTEN
BitField.description:
Received Data FIFO Reached Threshold Time-out Wake-up Enable Bit
Note 1: When the system is in Power-down mode, Received Data FIFO reached threshold time-out will wake up system from Power-down mode.
Note 2: It is suggested the function is enabled when the WKRFRTEN (UART_WKCTL[2]) is set to 1.

Enum.description: Received Data FIFO reached threshold time-out wake-up system function Disabled
Received Data FIFO reached threshold time-out wake-up system function Enabled

BitField.name: CTSWKF
BitField.description:
nCTS Wake-up Flag
This bit is set if chip wake-up from power-down state by nCTS wake-up.
Note 1: If WKCTSEN (UART_WKCTL[0]) is enabled, the nCTS wake-up cause this bit is set to '1'.
Note 2: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: Chip stays in power-down state
Chip wake-up from power-down state by nCTS wake-up

BitField.name: DATWKF
BitField.description:
Incoming Data Wake-up Flag
This bit is set if chip wake-up from power-down state by data wake-up.
Note 1: If WKDATEN (UART_WKCTL[1]) is enabled, the Incoming Data wake-up cause this bit is set to '1'.
Note 2: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: Chip stays in power-down state
Chip wake-up from power-down state by Incoming Data wake-up

BitField.name: RFRTWKF
BitField.description:
Received Data FIFO Reached Threshold Wake-up Flag
This bit is set if chip wake-up from power-down state by Received Data FIFO reached threshold wake-up.
Note 1: If WKRFRTEN (UART_WKCTL[2]) is enabled, the Received Data FIFO Reached Threshold wake-up cause this bit is set to '1'.
Note 2: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: Chip stays in power-down state
Chip wake-up from power-down state by Received Data FIFO Reached Threshold wake-up

BitField.name: RS485WKF
BitField.description:
RS-485 Address Match (AAD Mode) Wake-up Flag
This bit is set if chip wake-up from power-down state by RS-485 Address Match (AAD mode).
Note 1: If WKRS485EN (UART_WKCTL[3]) is enabled, the RS-485 Address Match (AAD mode) wake-up cause this bit is set to '1'.
Note 2: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: Chip stays in power-down state
Chip wake-up from power-down state by RS-485 Address Match (AAD mode) wake-up

BitField.name: TOUTWKF
BitField.description:
Received Data FIFO Threshold Time-out Wake-up Flag
This bit is set if chip wake-up from power-down state by Received Data FIFO Threshold Time-out
wake-up.
Note 1: If WKTOUTEN (UART_WKCTL[4]) is enabled, the Received Data FIFO reached threshold time-out wake-up cause this bit is set to '1'.
Note 2: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: Chip stays in power-down state
Chip wake-up from power-down state by Received Data FIFO reached threshold time-out

Register.name: UART_DWKCOMP
Register.description: UART Incoming Data Wake-up Compensation Register

BitField.name: STCOMP
BitField.description:
START Bit Compensation Value
These bits field indicate how many clock cycle selected by UART_CLK do the UART controller can get the 1st bit (START bit) when the device is wake-up from Power-down mode.
Note: It is valid only when WKDATEN (UART_WKCTL[1]) is set.

BitField.name: AUP
BitField.description:
Accept Unicast Packet
The AUP controls the unicast packet reception. If AUP is enabled, EMAC receives all incoming packet its destination MAC address is a unicast address.

Enum.description: EMAC receives packet depends on the CAM comparison result
EMAC receives all unicast packets

BitField.name: AMP
BitField.description:
Accept Multicast Packet
The AMP controls the multicast packet reception. If AMP is enabled, EMAC receives all incoming packet its destination MAC address is a multicast address.

Enum.description: EMAC receives packet depends on the CAM comparison result
EMAC receives all multicast packets

BitField.name: ABP
BitField.description:
Accept Broadcast Packet
The ABP controls the broadcast packet reception. If ABP is enabled, EMAC receives all incoming packet its destination MAC address is a broadcast address.

Enum.description: EMAC receives packet depends on the CAM comparison result
EMAC receives all broadcast packets

BitField.name: COMPEN
BitField.description:
Complement CAM Comparison Enable Bit
The COMPEN controls the complement of the CAM comparison result. If the CMPEN and COMPEN are both enabled, the incoming packet with specific destination MAC address configured in CAM entry will be dropped. And the incoming packet with destination MAC address does not configured in any CAM entry will be received.

Enum.description: Complement CAM comparison result Disabled
Complement CAM comparison result Enabled

BitField.name: CMPEN
BitField.description:
CAM Compare Enable Bit
The CMPEN controls the enable of CAM comparison function for destination MAC address recognition. If software wants to receive a packet with specific destination MAC address, configures the MAC address into CAM 12~0, then enables that CAM entry and set CMPEN to 1.

Enum.description: CAM comparison function for destination MAC address recognition Disabled
CAM comparison function for destination MAC address recognition Enabled

BitField.name: CAMxEN
BitField.description:
CAM Entry x Enable Bit
The CAMxEN controls the validation of CAM entry x.
The CAM entry 13, 14 and 15 are for PAUSE control frame transmission. If software wants to transmit a PAUSE control frame out to network, the enable bits of these three CAM entries all must be enabled first.

Enum.description: CAM entry x Disabled
CAM entry x Enabled

BitField.description: MAC Address Byte 3

BitField.name: MACADDR4
BitField.description: MAC Address Byte 4

BitField.name: MACADDR5
BitField.description:
MAC Address Byte 5
The CAMxM keeps the bit 47~16 of MAC address. The x can be the 0~14. The register pair {EMAC_CAMxM, EMAC_CAMxL} represents a CAM entry and keeps a MAC address.
For example, if the MAC address 00-50-BA-33-BA-44 kept in CAM entry 1, the register EMAC_CAM1M is 0x0050_BA33 and EMAC_CAM1L is 0xBA44_0000.

For example, if the MAC address 00-50-BA-33-BA-44 kept in CAM entry 1, the register EMAC_CAM1M is 0x0050_BA33 and EMAC_CAM1L is 0xBA44_0000.

BitField.name: OPCODE
BitField.description:
OP Code Field of PAUSE Control Frame
In the PAUSE control frame, an op code field defined and is 0x0001.

BitField.name: LENGTH
BitField.description:
LENGTH Field of PAUSE Control Frame
In the PAUSE control frame, a LENGTH field defined and is 0x8808.

BitField.name: OPERAND
BitField.description:
Pause Parameter
In the PAUSE control frame, an OPERAND field defined and controls how much time the destination Ethernet MAC Controller paused. The unit of the OPERAND is a slot time, the 512-bit time.

Register.name: EMAC_TXDSA
Register.description: Transmit Descriptor Link List Start Address Register

BitField.name: TXDSA
BitField.description:
Transmit Descriptor Link-list Start Address
The TXDSA keeps the start address of transmit descriptor link-list. If the software enables the bit TXON (EMAC_CTL[8]), the content of TXDSA will be loaded into the current transmit descriptor start address register (EMAC_CTXDSA). The TXDSA does not be updated by EMAC. During the operation, EMAC will ignore the bits [1:0] of TXDSA. This means that TX descriptors must locate at word boundary memory address.

Register.name: EMAC_RXDSA
Register.description: Receive Descriptor Link List Start Address Register

BitField.name: RXDSA
BitField.description:
Receive Descriptor Link-list Start Address
The RXDSA keeps the start address of receive descriptor link-list. If the S/W enables the bit RXON (EMAC_CTL[0]), the content of RXDSA will be loaded into the current receive descriptor start address register (EMAC_CRXDSA). The RXDSA does not be updated by EMAC. During the operation, EMAC will ignore the bits [1:0] of RXDSA. This means that RX descriptors must locate at word boundary memory address.

BitField.name: RXON
BitField.description:
Frame Reception ON
The RXON controls the normal packet reception of EMAC. If the RXON is set to high, the EMAC starts the packet reception process, including the RX descriptor fetching, packet reception and RX descriptor modification.
It is necessary to finish EMAC initial sequence before enable RXON. Otherwise, the EMAC operation is undefined.
If the RXON is disabled during EMAC is receiving an incoming packet, the EMAC stops the packet reception process after the current packet reception finished.

Enum.description: Packet reception process stopped
Packet reception process started

BitField.name: ALP
BitField.description:
Accept Long Packet
The ALP controls the long packet, which packet length is greater than 1518 bytes, reception. If the ALP is set to high, the EMAC will accept the long packet.
Otherwise, the long packet will be dropped.

Enum.description: Ethernet MAC controller dropped the long packet
Ethernet MAC controller received the long packet

BitField.name: ARP
BitField.description:
Accept Runt Packet
The ARP controls the runt packet, which length is less than 64 bytes, reception. If the ARP is set to high, the EMAC will accept the runt packet.
Otherwise, the runt packet will be dropped.

Enum.description: Ethernet MAC controller dropped the runt packet
Ethernet MAC controller received the runt packet

BitField.name: ACP
BitField.description:
Accept Control Packet
The ACP controls the control frame reception. If the ACP is set to high, the EMAC will accept the control frame. Otherwise, the control frame will be dropped. It is recommended that S/W only enable ACP while EMAC is operating on full duplex mode.

Enum.description: Ethernet MAC controller dropped the control frame
Ethernet MAC controller received the control frame

BitField.name: AEP
BitField.description:
Accept CRC Error Packet
The AEP controls the EMAC accepts or drops the CRC error packet. If the AEP is set to high, the incoming packet with CRC error will be received by EMAC as a good packet.

Enum.description: Ethernet MAC controller dropped the CRC error packet
Ethernet MAC controller received the CRC error packet

BitField.name: STRIPCRC
BitField.description:
Strip CRC Checksum
The STRIPCRC controls if the length of incoming packet is calculated with 4 bytes CRC checksum. If the STRIPCRC is set to high, 4 bytes CRC checksum is excluded from length calculation of incoming packet.

Enum.description: The 4 bytes CRC checksum is included in packet length calculation
The 4 bytes CRC checksum is excluded in packet length calculation

BitField.name: WOLEN
BitField.description:
Wake on LAN Enable Bit
The WOLEN high enables the functionality that Ethernet MAC controller checked if the incoming packet is Magic Packet and wakeup system from Power-down mode.
If incoming packet was a Magic Packet and the system was in Power-down, the Ethernet MAC controller would generate a wakeup event to wake system up from Power-down mode.

Enum.description: Wake-up by Magic Packet function Disabled
Wake-up by Magic Packet function Enabled

BitField.name: TXON
BitField.description:
Frame Transmission ON
The TXON controls the normal packet transmission of EMAC. If the TXON is set to high, the EMAC starts the packet transmission process, including the TX descriptor fetching, packet transmission and TX descriptor modification.
It is must to finish EMAC initial sequence before enable TXON. Otherwise, the EMAC operation is undefined.
