If the TXON is disabled during EMAC is transmitting a packet out, the EMAC stops the packet transmission process after the current packet transmission finished.

Enum.description: Packet transmission process stopped
Packet transmission process started

BitField.name: NODEF
BitField.description:
No Deferral
The NODEF controls the enable of deferral exceed counter. If NODEF is set to high, the deferral exceed counter is disabled. The NODEF is only useful while EMAC is operating on half duplex mode.

Enum.description: The deferral exceed counter Enabled
The deferral exceed counter Disabled

BitField.name: SDPZ
BitField.description:
Send PAUSE Frame
The SDPZ controls the PAUSE control frame transmission.
If S/W wants to send a PAUSE control frame out, the CAM entry 13, 14 and 15 must be configured first and the corresponding CAM enable bit of CAMEN register also must be set. Then, set SDPZ to 1 enables the PAUSE control frame transmission.
The SDPZ is a self-clear bit. This means after the PAUSE control frame transmission has completed, the SDPZ will be cleared automatically.
It is recommended that only enabling SNDPAUSE while EMAC is operating in Full Duplex mode.

Enum.description: PAUSE control frame transmission completed
PAUSE control frame transmission Enabled

BitField.name: SQECHKEN
BitField.description:
SQE Checking Enable Bit
The SQECHKEN controls the enable of SQE checking. The SQE checking is only available while EMAC is operating on 10M bps and half duplex mode. In other words, the SQECHKEN cannot affect EMAC operation, if the EMAC is operating on 100M bps or full duplex mode.

Enum.description: SQE checking Disabled while EMAC is operating in 10Mbps and Half Duplex mode
SQE checking Enabled while EMAC is operating in 10Mbps and Half Duplex mode

BitField.name: FUDUP
BitField.description:
Full Duplex Mode Selection
The FUDUP controls that if EMAC is operating on full or half duplex mode.

Enum.description: EMAC operates in half duplex mode
EMAC operates in full duplex mode

BitField.name: RMIIRXCTL
BitField.description:
RMII RX Control
The RMIIRXCTL control the receive data sample in RMII mode. It's necessary to set this bit high when RMIIEN (EMAC_CTL[ [22]) is high.

Enum.description: RMII RX control Disabled
RMII RX control Enabled

BitField.name: OPMODE
BitField.description:
Operation Mode Selection
The OPMODE defines that if the EMAC is operating on 10M or 100M bps mode. The RST (EMAC_CTL[24]) would not affect OPMODE value.

Enum.description: EMAC operates in 10Mbps mode
EMAC operates in 100Mbps mode

BitField.name: RMIIEN
BitField.description:
RMII Mode Enable Bit
This bit controls if Ethernet MAC controller connected with off-chip Ethernet PHY by MII interface or RMII interface. The RST (EMAC_CTL[24]) would not affect RMIIEN value.
Note: This field must keep 1.

Enum.description: Ethernet MAC controller RMII mode Disabled
Ethernet MAC controller RMII mode Enabled

BitField.name: RST
BitField.description:
Software Reset
The RST implements a reset function to make the EMAC return default state. The RST is a self-clear bit. This means after the software reset finished, the RST will be cleared automatically. Enable RST can also reset all control and status registers, exclusive of the control bits RMIIEN (EMAC_CTL[22]), and OPMODE (EMAC_CTL[20]).
The EMAC re-initial is necessary after the software reset completed.

Enum.description: Software reset completed
Software reset Enabled

BitField.name: DATA
BitField.description:
MII Management Data
The DATA is the 16 bits data that will be written into the registers of external PHY for MII Management write command or the data from the registers of external PHY for MII Management read command.

Register.name: EMAC_MIIMCTL
Register.description: MII Management Control and Address Register

BitField.name: PHYREG
BitField.description:
PHY Register Address
The PHYREG keeps the address to indicate which register of external PHY is the target of the MII management command.

BitField.name: PHYADDR
BitField.description:
PHY Address
The PHYADDR keeps the address to differentiate which external PHY is the target of the MII management command.

BitField.name: WRITE
BitField.description:
Write Command
The Write defines the MII management command is a read or write.

Enum.description: MII management command is a read command
MII management command is a write command

BitField.name: BUSY
BitField.description:
Busy Bit
The BUSY controls the enable of the MII management frame generation. If S/W wants to access registers of external PHY, it set BUSY to high and EMAC generates the MII management frame to external PHY through MII Management I/F. The BUSY is a self-clear bit. This means the BUSY will be cleared automatically after the MII management command finished.

Enum.description: MII management command generation finished
MII management command generation Enabled

BitField.name: PREAMSP
BitField.description:
Preamble Suppress
The PREAMSP controls the preamble field generation of MII management frame. If the PREAMSP is set to high, the preamble field generation of MII management frame is skipped.

Enum.description: Preamble field generation of MII management frame not skipped
Preamble field generation of MII management frame skipped

BitField.name: MDCON
BitField.description:
MDC Clock ON
The MDC controls the MDC clock generation. If the MDCON is set to high, the MDC clock is turned on.

Enum.description: MDC clock off
MDC clock on

BitField.name: RXFIFOTH
BitField.description:
RXFIFO Low Threshold
The RXFIFOTH controls when RXDMA requests internal arbiter for data transfer between RXFIFO and system memory. The RXFIFOTH defines not only the high threshold of RXFIFO, but also the low threshold. The low threshold is the half of high threshold always. During the packet reception, if the RXFIFO reaches the high threshold, the RXDMA starts to transfer frame data from RXFIFO to system memory. If the frame data in RXFIFO is less than low threshold, RXDMA stops to transfer the frame data to system memory.

Enum.description: Depend on the burst length setting. If the burst length is 8 words, high threshold is 8 words, too
RXFIFO high threshold is 64B and low threshold is 32B
RXFIFO high threshold is 128B and low threshold is 64B
RXFIFO high threshold is 192B and low threshold is 96B

BitField.name: TXFIFOTH
BitField.description:
TXFIFO Low Threshold
The TXFIFOTH controls when TXDMA requests internal arbiter for data transfer between system memory and TXFIFO. The TXFIFOTH defines not only the low threshold of TXFIFO, but also the high threshold. The high threshold is the twice of low threshold always. During the packet transmission, if the TXFIFO reaches the high threshold, the TXDMA stops generate request to transfer frame data from system memory to TXFIFO. If the frame data in TXFIFO is less than low threshold, TXDMA starts to transfer frame data from system memory to TXFIFO.
The TXFIFOTH also defines when the TXMAC starts to transmit frame out to network. The TXMAC starts to transmit the frame out while the TXFIFO first time reaches the high threshold during the transmission of the frame. If the frame data length is less than TXFIFO high threshold, the TXMAC starts to transmit the frame out after the frame data are all inside the TXFIFO.

Enum.description: TXFIFO low threshold is 64B and high threshold is 128B
TXFIFO low threshold is 80B and high threshold is 160B
TXFIFO low threshold is 96B and high threshold is 192B

BitField.name: BURSTLEN
BitField.description:
DMA Burst Length
This defines the burst length of AHB bus cycle while EMAC accesses system memory.

Enum.description: 4 words
8 words
16 words
16 words

BitField.name: TXST
BitField.description:
Transmit Start Demand
If the TX descriptor is not available for use of TXDMA after the TXON (EMAC_CTL[8]) is enabled, the FSM (Finite State Machine) of TXDMA enters the Halt state and the frame transmission is halted. After the S/W has prepared the new TX descriptor for frame transmission, it must issue a write command to EMAC_TXST register to make TXDMA to leave Halt state and continue the frame transmission.
The EMAC_TXST is a write only register and read from this register is undefined.
The write to EMAC_TXST register takes effect only when TXDMA stayed at Halt state.

BitField.name: RXST
BitField.description:
Receive Start Demand
If the RX descriptor is not available for use of RXDMA after the RXON (EMAC_CTL[0]) is enabled, the FSM (Finite State Machine) of RXDMA enters the Halt state and the frame reception is halted. After the S/W has prepared the new RX descriptor for frame reception, it must issue a write command to EMAC_RXST register to make RXDMA to leave Halt state and continue the frame reception.
The EMAC_RXST is a write only register and read from this register is undefined.
The write to EMAC_RXST register take effect only when RXDMA stayed at Halt state.

BitField.name: MRFL
BitField.description:
Maximum Receive Frame Length
The MRFL defines the maximum frame length for received frame. If the frame length of received frame is greater than MRFL, and bit MFLEIEN (EMAC_INTEN[8]) is also enabled, the bit MFLEIF (EMAC_INTSTS[8]) is set and the RX interrupt is triggered.
It is recommended that only use MRFL to qualify the length of received frame while S/W wants to receive a frame which length is greater than 1518 bytes.

BitField.name: RXIEN
BitField.description:
Receive Interrupt Enable Bit
The RXIEN controls the RX interrupt generation.
If RXIEN is enabled and RXIF (EMAC_INTSTS[0]) is high, EMAC generates the RX interrupt to CPU. If RXIEN is disabled, no RX interrupt is generated to CPU even any status bit EMAC_INTSTS[15:1] is set and the corresponding bit of EMAC_INTEN is enabled. In other words, if S/W wants to receive RX interrupt from EMAC, this bit must be enabled. And, if S/W doesn't want to receive any RX interrupt from EMAC, disables this bit.

Enum.description: RXIF (EMAC_INTSTS[0]) is masked and RX interrupt generation Disabled
RXIF (EMAC_INTSTS[0]) is not masked and RX interrupt generation Enabled

BitField.name: CRCEIEN
BitField.description:
CRC Error Interrupt Enable Bit
The CRCEIEN controls the CRCEIF (EMAC_INTSTS[1]) interrupt generation. If CRCEIF (EMAC_INTSTS[1]) is set, and both CRCEIEN and RXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[0]) are enabled, the EMAC generates the RX interrupt to CPU. If CRCEIEN or RXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[0]) is disabled, no RX interrupt is generated to CPU even the CRCEIF (EMAC_INTSTS[1]) is set.

Enum.description: CRCEIF (EMAC_INTSTS[1]) trigger RX interrupt Disabled
CRCEIF (EMAC_INTSTS[1]) trigger RX interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: RXOVIEN
BitField.description:
Receive FIFO Overflow Interrupt Enable Bit
The RXOVIEN controls the RXOVIF (EMAC_INTSTS[2]) interrupt generation. If RXOVIF (EMAC_INTSTS[2]) is set, and both RXOVIEN and RXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[0]) are enabled, the EMAC generates the RX interrupt to CPU. If RXOVIEN or RXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[0]) is disabled, no RX interrupt is generated to CPU even the RXOVIF (EMAC_INTSTS[2]) is set.

Enum.description: RXOVIF (EMAC_INTSTS[2]) trigger RX interrupt Disabled
RXOVIF (EMAC_INTSTS[2]) trigger RX interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: LPIEN
BitField.description:
Long Packet Interrupt Enable Bit
The LPIEN controls the LPIF (EMAC_INTSTS[3]) interrupt generation. If LPIF (EMAC_INTSTS[3]) is set, and both LPIEN and RXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[0]) are enabled, the EMAC generates the RX interrupt to CPU. If LPIEN or RXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[0]) is disabled, no RX interrupt is generated to CPU even the LPIF (EMAC_INTSTS[3]) is set.

Enum.description: LPIF (EMAC_INTSTS[3]) trigger RX interrupt Disabled
LPIF (EMAC_INTSTS[3]) trigger RX interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: RXGDIEN
BitField.description:
Receive Good Interrupt Enable Bit
The RXGDIEN controls the RXGDIF (EMAC_INTSTS[4]) interrupt generation. If RXGDIF (EMAC_INTSTS[4]) is set, and both RXGDIEN and RXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[0]) are enabled, the EMAC generates the RX interrupt to CPU. If RXGDIEN or RXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[0]) is disabled, no RX interrupt is generated to CPU even the RXGDIF (EMAC_INTSTS[4]) is set.

Enum.description: RXGDIF (EMAC_INTSTS[4]) trigger RX interrupt Disabled
RXGDIF (EMAC_INTSTS[4]) trigger RX interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: ALIEIEN
BitField.description:
Alignment Error Interrupt Enable Bit
The ALIEIEN controls the ALIEIF (EMAC_INTSTS[5]) interrupt generation. If ALIEIF (EMAC_INTSTS[5]) is set, and both ALIEIEN and RXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[0]) are enabled, the EMAC generates the RX interrupt to CPU. If ALIEIEN or RXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[0]) is disabled, no RX interrupt is generated to CPU even the ALIEIF (EMAC_INTSTS[5]) is set.

Enum.description: ALIEIF (EMAC_INTSTS[5]) trigger RX interrupt Disabled
ALIEIF (EMAC_INTSTS[5]) trigger RX interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: RPIEN
BitField.description:
Runt Packet Interrupt Enable Bit
The RPIEN controls the RPIF (EMAC_INTSTS[6]) interrupt generation. If RPIF (EMAC_INTSTS[6]) is set, and both RPIEN and RXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[0]) are enabled, the EMAC generates the RX interrupt to CPU. If RPIEN or RXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[0]) is disabled, no RX interrupt is generated to CPU even the RPIF (EMAC_INTSTS[6]) is set.

Enum.description: RPIF (EMAC_INTSTS[6]) trigger RX interrupt Disabled
RPIF (EMAC_INTSTS[6]) trigger RX interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: MPCOVIEN
BitField.description:
Miss Packet Counter Overrun Interrupt Enable Bit
The MPCOVIEN controls the MPCOVIF (EMAC_INTSTS[7]) interrupt generation. If MPCOVIF (EMAC_INTSTS[7]) is set, and both MPCOVIEN and RXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[0]) are enabled, the EMAC generates the RX interrupt to CPU. If MPCOVIEN or RXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[0]) is disabled, no RX interrupt is generated to CPU even the MPCOVIF (EMAC_INTSTS[7]) is set.

Enum.description: MPCOVIF (EMAC_INTSTS[7]) trigger RX interrupt Disabled
MPCOVIF (EMAC_INTSTS[7]) trigger RX interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: MFLEIEN
BitField.description:
Maximum Frame Length Exceed Interrupt Enable Bit
The MFLEIEN controls the MFLEIF (EMAC_INTSTS[8]) interrupt generation. If MFLEIF (EMAC_INTSTS[8]) is set, and both MFLEIEN and RXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[0]) are enabled, the EMAC generates the RX interrupt to CPU. If MFLEIEN or RXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[0]) is disabled, no RX interrupt is generated to CPU even the MFLEIF (EMAC_INTSTS[8]) is set.

Enum.description: MFLEIF (EMAC_INTSTS[8]) trigger RX interrupt Disabled
MFLEIF (EMAC_INTSTS[8]) trigger RX interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: DENIEN
BitField.description:
DMA Early Notification Interrupt Enable Bit
The DENIEN controls the DENIF (EMAC_INTSTS[9]) interrupt generation. If DENIF (EMAC_INTSTS[9]) is set, and both DENIEN and RXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[0]) are enabled, the EMAC generates the RX interrupt to CPU. If DENIEN or RXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[0]) is disabled, no RX interrupt is generated to CPU even the DENIF (EMAC_INTSTS[9]) is set.

Enum.description: TDENIF (EMAC_INTSTS[9]) trigger RX interrupt Disabled
TDENIF (EMAC_INTSTS[9]) trigger RX interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: RDUIEN
BitField.description:
Receive Descriptor Unavailable Interrupt Enable Bit
The RDUIEN controls the RDUIF (EMAC_INTSTS[10]) interrupt generation. If RDUIF (EMAC_INTSTS[10]) is set, and both RDUIEN and RXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[0]) are enabled, the EMAC generates the RX interrupt to CPU. If RDUIEN or RXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[0]) is disabled, no RX interrupt is generated to CPU even the RDUIF (EMAC_MIOSTA[10]) register is set.

Enum.description: RDUIF (EMAC_INTSTS[10]) trigger RX interrupt Disabled
RDUIF (EMAC_INTSTS[10]) trigger RX interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: RXBEIEN
BitField.description:
Receive Bus Error Interrupt Enable Bit
The RXBEIEN controls the RXBEIF (EMAC_INTSTS[11]) interrupt generation. If RXBEIF (EMAC_INTSTS[11]) is set, and both RXBEIEN and RXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[0]) are enabled, the EMAC generates the RX interrupt to CPU. If RXBEIEN or RXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[0]) is disabled, no RX interrupt is generated to CPU even the RXBEIF (EMAC_INTSTS[11]) is set.

Enum.description: RXBEIF (EMAC_INTSTS[11]) trigger RX interrupt Disabled
RXBEIF (EMAC_INTSTS[11]) trigger RX interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: CFRIEN
BitField.description:
Control Frame Receive Interrupt Enable Bit
The CFRIEN controls the CFRIF (EMAC_INTSTS[14]) interrupt generation. If CFRIF (EMAC_INTSTS[14]) is set, and both CFRIEN and RXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[0]) are enabled, the EMAC generates the RX interrupt to CPU. If CFRIEN or RXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[0]) is disabled, no RX interrupt is generated to CPU even the CFRIF (EMAC_INTSTS[14]) register is set.

Enum.description: CFRIF (EMAC_INTSTS[14]) trigger RX interrupt Disabled
CFRIF (EMAC_INTSTS[14]) trigger RX interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: WOLIEN
BitField.description:
Wake on LAN Interrupt Enable Bit
The WOLIEN controls the WOLIF (EMAC_INTSTS[15]) interrupt generation. If WOLIF (EMAC_INTSTS[15]) is set, and both WOLIEN and RXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[0]) are enabled, the EMAC generates the RX interrupt to CPU. If WOLIEN or RXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[0]) is disabled, no RX interrupt is generated to CPU even the WOLIF (EMAC_INTSTS[15]) is set.

Enum.description: WOLIF (EMAC_INTSTS[15]) trigger RX interrupt Disabled
WOLIF (EMAC_INTSTS[15]) trigger RX interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: TXIEN
BitField.description:
Transmit Interrupt Enable Bit
The TXIEN controls the TX interrupt generation.
If TXIEN is enabled and TXIF (EMAC_INTSTS[16]) is high, EMAC generates the TX interrupt to CPU. If TXIEN is disabled, no TX interrupt is generated to CPU even any status bit of EMAC_INTSTS[24:17] set and the corresponding bit of EMAC_INTEN is enabled. In other words, if S/W wants to receive TX interrupt from EMAC, this bit must be enabled. And, if S/W doesn't want to receive any TX interrupt from EMAC, disables this bit.

Enum.description: TXIF (EMAC_INTSTS[16]) is masked and TX interrupt generation Disabled
TXIF (EMAC_INTSTS[16]) is not masked and TX interrupt generation Enabled

BitField.name: TXUDIEN
BitField.description:
Transmit FIFO Underflow Interrupt Enable Bit
The TXUDIEN controls the TXUDIF (EMAC_INTSTS[17]) interrupt generation. If TXUDIF (EMAC_INTSTS[17]) is set, and both TXUDIEN and TXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[16]) are enabled, the EMAC generates the TX interrupt to CPU. If TXUDIEN or TXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[16]) is disabled, no TX interrupt is generated to CPU even the TXUDIF (EMAC_INTSTS[17]) is set.

Enum.description: TXUDIF (EMAC_INTSTS[17]) TX interrupt Disabled
TXUDIF (EMAC_INTSTS[17]) TX interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: TXCPIEN
BitField.description:
Transmit Completion Interrupt Enable Bit
The TXCPIEN controls the TXCPIF (EMAC_INTSTS[18]) interrupt generation. If TXCPIF (EMAC_INTSTS[18]) is set, and both TXCPIEN and TXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[16]) are enabled, the EMAC generates the TX interrupt to CPU. If TXCPIEN or TXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[16]) is disabled, no TX interrupt is generated to CPU even the TXCPIF (EMAC_INTSTS[18]) is set.

Enum.description: TXCPIF (EMAC_INTSTS[18]) trigger TX interrupt Disabled
TXCPIF (EMAC_INTSTS[18]) trigger TX interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: EXDEFIEN
BitField.description:
Defer Exceed Interrupt Enable Bit
The EXDEFIEN controls the EXDEFIF (EMAC_INTSTS[19]) interrupt generation. If EXDEFIF (EMAC_INTSTS[19]) is set, and both EXDEFIEN and TXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[16]) are enabled, the EMAC generates the TX interrupt to CPU. If EXDEFIEN or TXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[16]) is disabled, no TX interrupt is generated to CPU even the EXDEFIF (EMAC_INTSTS[19]) is set.

Enum.description: EXDEFIF (EMAC_INTSTS[19]) trigger TX interrupt Disabled
EXDEFIF (EMAC_INTSTS[19]) trigger TX interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: NCSIEN
BitField.description:
No Carrier Sense Interrupt Enable Bit
The NCSIEN controls the NCSIF (EMAC_INTSTS[20]) interrupt generation. If NCSIF (EMAC_INTSTS[20]) is set, and both NCSIEN and TXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[16]) are enabled, the EMAC generates the TX interrupt to CPU. If NCSIEN or TXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[16]) is disabled, no TX interrupt is generated to CPU even the NCSIF (EMAC_INTSTS[20]) is set.

Enum.description: NCSIF (EMAC_INTSTS[20]) trigger TX interrupt Disabled
NCSIF (EMAC_INTSTS[20]) trigger TX interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: TXABTIEN
BitField.description:
Transmit Abort Interrupt Enable Bit
The TXABTIEN controls the TXABTIF (EMAC_INTSTS[21]) interrupt generation. If TXABTIF (EMAC_INTSTS[21]) is set, and both TXABTIEN and TXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[16]) are enabled, the EMAC generates the TX interrupt to CPU. If TXABTIEN or TXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[16]) is disabled, no TX interrupt is generated to CPU even the TXABTIF (EMAC_INTSTS[21]) is set.

Enum.description: TXABTIF (EMAC_INTSTS[21]) trigger TX interrupt Disabled
TXABTIF (EMAC_INTSTS[21]) trigger TX interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: LCIEN
BitField.description:
Late Collision Interrupt Enable Bit
The LCIEN controls the LCIF (EMAC_INTSTS[22]) interrupt generation. If LCIF (EMAC_INTSTS[22]) is set, and both LCIEN and TXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[16]) are enabled, the EMAC generates the TX interrupt to CPU. If LCIEN or TXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[16]) is disabled, no TX interrupt is generated to CPU even the LCIF (EMAC_INTSTS[22]) is set.

Enum.description: LCIF (EMAC_INTSTS[22]) trigger TX interrupt Disabled
LCIF (EMAC_INTSTS[22]) trigger TX interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: TDUIEN
BitField.description:
Transmit Descriptor Unavailable Interrupt Enable Bit
The TDUIEN controls the TDUIF (EMAC_INTSTS[23]) interrupt generation. If TDUIF (EMAC_INTSTS[23]) is set, and both TDUIEN and TXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[16]) are enabled, the EMAC generates the TX interrupt to CPU. If TDUIEN or TXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[16]) is disabled, no TX interrupt is generated to CPU even the TDUIF (EMAC_INTSTS[23]) is set.

Enum.description: TDUIF (EMAC_INTSTS[23]) trigger TX interrupt Disabled
TDUIF (EMAC_INTSTS[23]) trigger TX interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: TXBEIEN
BitField.description:
Transmit Bus Error Interrupt Enable Bit
The TXBEIEN controls the TXBEIF (EMAC_INTSTS[24]) interrupt generation. If TXBEIF (EMAC_INTSTS[24]) is set, and both TXBEIEN and TXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[16]) are enabled, the EMAC generates the TX interrupt to CPU. If TXBEIEN or TXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[16]) is disabled, no TX interrupt is generated to CPU even the TXBEIF (EMAC_INTSTS[24]) is set.

Enum.description: TXBEIF (EMAC_INTSTS[24]) trigger TX interrupt Disabled
TXBEIF (EMAC_INTSTS[24]) trigger TX interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: TSALMIEN
BitField.description:
Time Stamp Alarm Interrupt Enable Bit
The TSALMIEN controls the TSALMIF (EMAC_INTSTS[28]) interrupt generation. If TSALMIF (EMAC_INTSTS[28]) is set, and both TSALMIEN and TXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[16]) enabled, the EMAC generates the TX interrupt to CPU. If TSALMIEN or TXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[16]) disabled, no TX interrupt generated to CPU even the TXTSALMIF (EMAC_INTEN[28]) is set.

Enum.description: TXTSALMIF (EMAC_INTSTS[28]) trigger TX interrupt Disabled
TXTSALMIF (EMAC_INTSTS[28]) trigger TX interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: RXIF
BitField.description:
Receive Interrupt
The RXIF indicates the RX interrupt status.
If RXIF high and its corresponding enable bit, RXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[0]), is also high indicates the EMAC generates RX interrupt to CPU. If RXIF is high but RXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[0]) is disabled, no RX interrupt is generated.
The RXIF is logic OR result of bit logic AND result of EMAC_INTSTS[15:1] and EMAC_INTEN[15:1]. In other words, if any bit of EMAC_INTSTS[15:1] is high and its corresponding enable bit in EMAC_INTEN[15:1] is also enabled, the RXIF will be high.
Because the RXIF is a logic OR result, clears EMAC_INTSTS[15:1] makes RXIF be cleared, too.

Enum.description: No status bit in EMAC_INTSTS[15:1] is set or no enable bit in EMAC_INTEN[15:1] is enabled
At least one status in EMAC_INTSTS[15:1] is set and its corresponding enable bit in EMAC_INTEN[15:1] is enabled, too

BitField.name: CRCEIF
BitField.description:
CRC Error Interrupt
The CRCEIF high indicates the incoming packet incurred the CRC error and the packet is dropped. If the AEP (EMAC_CTL[4]) is set, the CRC error packet will be regarded as a good packet and CRCEIF will not be set.
If the CRCEIF is high and CRCEIEN (EMAC_INTEN[1]) is enabled, the RXIF will be high. Write 1 to this bit clears the CRCEIF status.

Enum.description: The frame does not incur CRC error
The frame incurred CRC error

BitField.name: RXOVIF
BitField.description:
Receive FIFO Overflow Interrupt
The RXOVIF high indicates the RXFIFO overflow occurred during packet reception. While the RXFIFO overflow occurred, the EMAC drops the current receiving packer. If the RXFIFO overflow occurred often, it is recommended that modify RXFIFO threshold control, the RXFIFOTH of FFTCR register, to higher level.
If the RXOVIF is high and RXOVIEN (EMAC_INTEN[2]) is enabled, the RXIF will be high. Write 1 to this bit clears the RXOVIF status.

Enum.description: No RXFIFO overflow occurred during packet reception
RXFIFO overflow occurred during packet reception

BitField.name: LPIF
BitField.description:
Long Packet Interrupt Flag
The LPIF high indicates the length of the incoming packet is greater than 1518 bytes and the incoming packet is dropped. If the ALP (EMAC_CTL[1]) is set, the long packet will be regarded as a good packet and LPIF will not be set.
If the LPIF is high and LPIEN (EMAC_INTEN[3]) is enabled, the RXIF will be high. Write 1 to this bit clears the LPIF status.

Enum.description: The incoming frame is not a long frame or S/W wants to receive a long frame
The incoming frame is a long frame and dropped

BitField.name: RXGDIF
BitField.description:
Receive Good Interrupt
The RXGDIF high indicates the frame reception has completed.
If the RXGDIF is high and RXGDIEN (EAMC_MIEN[4]) is enabled, the RXIF will be high. Write 1 to this bit clears the RXGDIF status.

Enum.description: The frame reception has not complete yet
The frame reception has completed

BitField.name: ALIEIF
BitField.description:
Alignment Error Interrupt
The ALIEIF high indicates the length of the incoming frame is not a multiple of byte. If the ALIEIF is high and ALIEIEN (EMAC_INTEN[5]) is enabled, the RXIF will be high. Write 1 to this bit clears the ALIEIF status.

Enum.description: The frame length is a multiple of byte
The frame length is not a multiple of byte

BitField.name: RPIF
BitField.description:
Runt Packet Interrupt
The RPIF high indicates the length of the incoming packet is less than 64 bytes and the packet is dropped. If the ARP (EMAC_CTL[2]) is set, the short packet is regarded as a good packet and RPIF will not be set.
If the RPIF is high and RPIEN (EMAC_INTEN[6]) is enabled, the RXIF will be high. Write 1 to this bit clears the RPIF status.

Enum.description: The incoming frame is not a short frame or S/W wants to receive a short frame
The incoming frame is a short frame and dropped

BitField.name: MPCOVIF
BitField.description:
Missed Packet Counter Overrun Interrupt Flag
The MPCOVIF high indicates the MPCNT, Missed Packet Count, has overflow. If the MPCOVIF is high and MPCOVIEN (EMAC_INTEN[7]) is enabled, the RXIF will be high. Write 1 to this bit clears the MPCOVIF status.

Enum.description: The MPCNT has not rolled over yet
The MPCNT has rolled over yet

BitField.name: MFLEIF
BitField.description:
Maximum Frame Length Exceed Interrupt Flag
The MFLEIF high indicates the length of the incoming packet has exceeded the length limitation configured in DMARFC register and the incoming packet is dropped. If the MFLEIF is high and MFLEIEN (EMAC_INTEN[8]) is enabled, the RXIF will be high. Write 1 to this bit clears the MFLEIF status.

Enum.description: The length of the incoming packet does not exceed the length limitation configured in DMARFC
The length of the incoming packet has exceeded the length limitation configured in DMARFC

BitField.name: DENIF
BitField.description:
DMA Early Notification Interrupt
The DENIF high indicates the EMAC has received the LENGTH field of the incoming packet.
If the DENIF is high and DENIENI (EMAC_INTEN[9]) is enabled, the RXIF will be high. Write 1 to this bit clears the DENIF status.

Enum.description: The LENGTH field of incoming packet has not received yet
The LENGTH field of incoming packet has received

BitField.name: RDUIF
BitField.description:
Receive Descriptor Unavailable Interrupt
The RDUIF high indicates that there is no available RX descriptor for packet reception and RXDMA will stay at Halt state. Once, the RXDMA enters the Halt state, S/W must issues a write command to RSDR register to make RXDMA leave Halt state while new RX descriptor is available.
If the RDUIF is high and RDUIEN (EMAC_INTEN[10]) is enabled, the RXIF will be high. Write 1 to this bit clears the RDUIF status.

Enum.description: RX descriptor is available
RX descriptor is unavailable

BitField.name: RXBEIF
BitField.description:
Receive Bus Error Interrupt
The RXBEIF high indicates the memory controller replies ERROR response while EMAC access system memory through RXDMA during packet reception process. Reset EMAC is recommended while RXBEIF status is high.
If the RXBEIF is high and RXBEIEN (EMAC_INTEN[11]) is enabled, the RXIF will be high. Write 1 to this bit clears the RXBEIF status.

Enum.description: No ERROR response is received
ERROR response is received

BitField.name: CFRIF
BitField.description:
Control Frame Receive Interrupt
The CFRIF high indicates EMAC receives a flow control frame. The CFRIF only available while EMAC is operating on full duplex mode.
If the CFRIF is high and CFRIEN (EMAC_INTEN[14]) is enabled, the RXIF will be high. Write 1 to this bit clears the CFRIF status.

Enum.description: The EMAC does not receive the flow control frame
The EMAC receives a flow control frame

BitField.name: WOLIF
BitField.description:
Wake on LAN Interrupt Flag
The WOLIF high indicates EMAC receives a Magic Packet. The CFRIF only available while system is in Power-down mode and WOLEN is set high.
If the WOLIF is high and WOLIEN (EMAC_INTEN[15]) is enabled, the RXIF will be high. Write 1 to this bit clears the WOLIF status.

Enum.description: The EMAC does not receive the Magic Packet
The EMAC receives a Magic Packet

BitField.name: TXIF
BitField.description:
Transmit Interrupt
The TXIF indicates the TX interrupt status.
If TXIF high and its corresponding enable bit, TXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[16]), is also high indicates the EMAC generates TX interrupt to CPU. If TXIF is high but TXIEN (EMAC_INTEN[16]) is disabled, no TX interrupt is generated.
The TXIF is logic OR result of bit logic AND result of EMAC_INTSTS[28:17] and EMAC_INTEN[28:17]. In other words, if any bit of EMAC_INTSTS[28:17] is high and its corresponding enable bit in EMAC_INTEN[28:17] is also enabled, the TXIF will be high. Because the TXIF is a logic OR result, clears EMAC_INTSTS[28:17] makes TXIF be cleared, too.

Enum.description: No status bit in EMAC_INTSTS[28:17] is set or no enable bit in EMAC_INTEN[28:17] is enabled
At least one status in EMAC_INTSTS[28:17] is set and its corresponding enable bit in EMAC_INTEN[28:17] is enabled, too

BitField.name: TXUDIF
BitField.description:
Transmit FIFO Underflow Interrupt
The TXUDIF high indicates the TXFIFO underflow occurred during packet transmission. While the TXFIFO underflow occurred, the EMAC will retransmit the packet automatically without S/W intervention. If the TXFIFO underflow occurred often, it is recommended that modify TXFIFO threshold control, the TXFIFOTH of FFTCR register, to higher level.
If the TXUDIF is high and TXUDIEN (EMAC_INTEN[17]) is enabled, the TXIF will be high. Write 1 to this bit clears the TXUDIF status.

Enum.description: No TXFIFO underflow occurred during packet transmission
TXFIFO underflow occurred during packet transmission

BitField.name: TXCPIF
BitField.description:
Transmit Completion Interrupt
The TXCPIF indicates the packet transmission has completed correctly.
If the TXCPIF is high and TXCPIEN (EMAC_INTEN[18]) is enabled, the TXIF will be high. Write 1 to this bit clears the TXCPIF status.

Enum.description: The packet transmission not completed
The packet transmission has completed

BitField.name: EXDEFIF
BitField.description:
Defer Exceed Interrupt
The EXDEFIF high indicates the frame waiting for transmission has deferred over 0.32768ms on 100Mbps mode, or 3.2768ms on 10Mbps mode. The deferral exceed check will only be done while bit NODEF of MCMDR is disabled, and EMAC is operating on half-duplex mode.
If the EXDEFIF is high and EXDEFIEN (EMAC_INTEN[19]) is enabled, the TXIF will be high. Write 1 to this bit clears the EXDEFIF status.

Enum.description: Frame waiting for transmission has not deferred over 0.32768ms (100Mbps) or 3.2768ms (10Mbps)
Frame waiting for transmission has deferred over 0.32768ms (100Mbps) or 3.2768ms (10Mbps)

BitField.name: NCSIF
BitField.description:
No Carrier Sense Interrupt
The NCSIF high indicates the MII I/F signal CRS does not active at the start of or during the packet transmission. The NCSIF is only available while EMAC is operating on half-duplex mode. If the NCSIF is high and NCSIEN (EMAC_INTEN[20]) is enabled, the TXIF will be high. Write 1 to this bit clears the NCSIF status.

Enum.description: CRS signal actives correctly
CRS signal does not active at the start of or during the packet transmission

BitField.name: TXABTIF
BitField.description:
Transmit Abort Interrupt
The TXABTIF high indicates the packet incurred 16 consecutive collisions during transmission, and then the transmission process for this packet is aborted. The transmission abort is only available while EMAC is operating on half-duplex mode.
If the TXABTIF is high and TXABTIEN (EMAC_INTEN[21]) is enabled, the TXIF will be high. Write 1 to this bit clears the TXABTIF status.

Enum.description: Packet does not incur 16 consecutive collisions during transmission
Packet incurred 16 consecutive collisions during transmission

BitField.name: LCIF
BitField.description:
Late Collision Interrupt
The LCIF high indicates the collision occurred in the outside of 64 bytes collision window. This means after the 64 bytes of a frame has been transmitted out to the network, the collision still occurred. The late collision check will only be done while EMAC is operating on half-duplex mode. If the LCIF is high and LCIEN (EMAC_INTEN[22]) is enabled, the TXIF will be high. Write 1 to this bit clears the LCIF status.

Enum.description: No collision occurred in the outside of 64 bytes collision window
Collision occurred in the outside of 64 bytes collision window

BitField.name: TDUIF
BitField.description:
Transmit Descriptor Unavailable Interrupt
The TDUIF high indicates that there is no available TX descriptor for packet transmission and TXDMA will stay at Halt state. Once, the TXDMA enters the Halt state, S/W must issues a write command to TSDR register to make TXDMA leave Halt state while new TX descriptor is available.
If the TDUIF is high and TDUIEN (EMAC_INTEN[23]) is enabled, the TXIF will be high. Write 1 to this bit clears the TDUIF status.

Enum.description: TX descriptor is available
TX descriptor is unavailable

BitField.name: TXBEIF
BitField.description:
Transmit Bus Error Interrupt
The TXBEIF high indicates the memory controller replies ERROR response while EMAC access system memory through TXDMA during packet transmission process. Reset EMAC is recommended while TXBEIF status is high.
If the TXBEIF is high and TXBEIEN (EMAC_INTEN[24]) is enabled, the TXIF will be high. Write 1 to this bit clears the TXBEIF status.

Enum.description: No ERROR response is received
ERROR response is received

BitField.name: TSALMIF
BitField.description:
Time Stamp Alarm Interrupt
The TSALMIF high indicates the EMAC_TSSEC register value equals to EMAC_ALMSEC register and EMAC_TSSUBSEC register value equals to register EMAC_ALMSUBSEC.
If TSALMIF is high and TSALMIEN (EMAC_INTEN[28]) enabled, the TXIF will be high. Write 1 to this bit clears the TSALMIF status.

Enum.description: EMAC_TSSEC did not equal EMAC_ALMSEC or EMAC_TSSUBSEC did not equal EMAC_ALMSUBSEC
EMAC_TSSEC equals EMAC_ALMSEC and EMAC_TSSUBSEC equals EMAC_ALMSUBSEC

BitField.name: CFR
BitField.description:
Control Frame Received
The CFRIF high indicates EMAC receives a flow control frame. The CFRIF only available while EMAC is operating on full duplex mode.

Enum.description: The EMAC does not receive the flow control frame
The EMAC receives a flow control frame

BitField.name: RXHALT
BitField.description:
Receive Halted
The RXHALT high indicates the next normal packet reception process will be halted because the bit RXON of MCMDR is disabled be S/W.

Enum.description: Next normal packet reception process will go on
Next normal packet reception process will be halted

BitField.name: RXFFULL
BitField.description:
RXFIFO Full
The RXFFULL indicates the RXFIFO is full due to four 64-byte packets are kept in RXFIFO and the following incoming packet will be dropped.

Enum.description: The RXFIFO is not full
The RXFIFO is full and the following incoming packet will be dropped

BitField.name: COLCNT
BitField.description:
Collision Count
The COLCNT indicates that how many collisions occurred consecutively during a packet transmission. If the packet incurred 16 consecutive collisions during transmission, the COLCNT will be 4h0 and bit TXABTIF will be set to 1.

BitField.name: DEF
BitField.description:
Deferred Transmission
The DEF high indicates the packet transmission has deferred once. The DEF is only available while EMAC is operating on half-duplex mode.

Enum.description: Packet transmission does not defer
Packet transmission has deferred once

BitField.name: TXPAUSED
BitField.description:
Transmission Paused
The TXPAUSED high indicates the next normal packet transmission process will be paused temporally because EMAC received a PAUSE control frame.

Enum.description: Next normal packet transmission process will go on
Next normal packet transmission process will be paused

BitField.name: SQE
BitField.description:
Signal Quality Error
The SQE high indicates the SQE error found at end of packet transmission on 10Mbps half-duplex mode. The SQE error check will only be done while both bit SQECHKEN (EMAC_CTL[17]) is enabled and EMAC is operating on 10Mbps half-duplex mode.

Enum.description: No SQE error found at end of packet transmission
SQE error found at end of packet transmission

BitField.name: TXHALT
BitField.description:
Transmission Halted
The TXHALT high indicates the next normal packet transmission process will be halted because the bit TXON (EMAC_CTL[8]) is disabled be S/W.

Enum.description: Next normal packet transmission process will go on
Next normal packet transmission process will be halted

BitField.name: RPSTS
BitField.description:
Remote Pause Status
The RPSTS indicates that remote pause counter down counting actives.
After Ethernet MAC controller sent PAUSE frame out successfully, it starts the remote pause counter down counting. When this bit high, it's predictable that remote Ethernet MAC controller wouldn't start the packet transmission until the down counting done.

Enum.description: Remote pause counter down counting done
Remote pause counter down counting actives

BitField.name: MPCNT
BitField.description:
Miss Packet Count
The MPCNT indicates the number of packets that were dropped due to various types of receive errors. The following type of receiving error makes missed packet counter increase:
Incoming packet is incurred RXFIFO overflow.
Incoming packet is dropped due to RXON is disabled.
Incoming packet is incurred CRC error.

BitField.name: RPCNT
BitField.description:
MAC Receive Pause Count
The RPCNT keeps the OPERAND field of the PAUSE control frame. It indicates how many slot time (512-bit time) the TX of EMAC will be paused.

BitField.name: RXFLT
BitField.description:
Receive Frame LENGTH
The RXFLT keeps the LENGTH field of each incoming Ethernet packet. If the bit DENIEN (EMAC_INTEN[9]) is enabled and the LENGTH field of incoming packet has received, the bit DENIF (EMAC_INTSTS[9]) will be set and trigger interrupt. And, the content of LENGTH field will be stored in RXFLT.

Register.name: EMAC_CTXDSA
Register.description: Current Transmit Descriptor Start Address Register

BitField.name: CTXDSA
BitField.description:
Current Transmit Descriptor Start Address
The CTXDSA keeps the start address of TX descriptor that is used by TXDMA currently. The CTXDSA is read only and write to this register has no effect.

Register.name: EMAC_CTXBSA
Register.description: Current Transmit Buffer Start Address Register

BitField.name: CTXBSA
BitField.description:
Current Transmit Buffer Start Address
The CTXDSA keeps the start address of TX frame buffer that is used by TXDMA currently. The CTXBSA is read only and write to this register has no effect.

Register.name: EMAC_CRXDSA
Register.description: Current Receive Descriptor Start Address Register

BitField.name: CRXDSA
BitField.description:
Current Receive Descriptor Start Address
The CRXDSA keeps the start address of RX descriptor that is used by RXDMA currently. The CRXDSA is read only and write to this register has no effect.

Register.name: EMAC_CRXBSA
Register.description: Current Receive Buffer Start Address Register

BitField.name: CRXBSA
BitField.description:
Current Receive Buffer Start Address
The CRXBSA keeps the start address of RX frame buffer that is used by RXDMA currently. The CRXBSA is read only and write to this register has no effect.

BitField.name: TSEN
BitField.description:
Time Stamp Function Enable Bit
This bit controls if the IEEE 1588 PTP time stamp function is enabled or not.
Set this bit high to enable IEEE 1588 PTP time stamp function while set this bit low to disable IEEE 1588 PTP time stamp function.

Enum.description: I EEE 1588 PTP time stamp function Disabled
IEEE 1588 PTP time stamp function Enabled

BitField.name: TSIEN
BitField.description:
Time Stamp Counter Initialization Enable Bit
Set this bit high enables Ethernet MAC controller to load value of register EMAC_UPDSEC and EMAC_UPDSUBSEC to PTP time stampe counter.
After the load operation finished, Ethernet MAC controller clear this bit to low automatically.

Enum.description: Time stamp counter initialization done
Time stamp counter initialization Enabled

BitField.name: TSMODE
BitField.description:
Time Stamp Fine Update Enable Bit
This bit chooses the time stamp counter update mode.

Enum.description: Time stamp counter is in coarse update mode
Time stamp counter is in fine update mode

BitField.name: TSUPDATE
BitField.description:
Time Stamp Counter Time Update Enable Bit
Set this bit high enables Ethernet MAC controller to add value of register EMAC_UPDSEC and EMAC_UPDSUBSEC to PTP time stamp counter.
After the add operation finished, Ethernet MAC controller clear this bit to low automatically.

Enum.description: No action
EMAC_UPDSEC updated to EMAC_TSSEC and EMAC_UPDSUBSEC updated to EMAC_TSSUBSEC

BitField.name: TSALMEN
BitField.description:
Time Stamp Alarm Enable Bit
Set this bit high enable Ethernet MAC controller to set TSALMIF (EMAC_INTSTS[28]) high when EMAC_TSSEC equals to EMAC_ALMSEC and EMAC_TSSUBSEC equals to EMAC_ALMSUBSEC.

Enum.description: Alarm disabled when EMAC_TSSEC equals to EMAC_ALMSEC and EMAC_TSSUBSEC equals to EMAC_ALMSUBSEC
Alarm enabled when EMAC_TSSEC equals to EMAC_ALMSEC and EMAC_TSSUBSEC equals to EMAC_ALMSUBSEC

BitField.name: SEC
BitField.description:
Time Stamp Counter Second
This register reflects the bit [63:32] value of 64-bit reference timing counter. This 32-bit value is used as the second part of time stamp when TSEN (EMAC_TSCTL[0]) is high.

Register.name: EMAC_TSSUBSEC
Register.description: Time Stamp Counter Sub Second Register

BitField.name: SUBSEC
BitField.description:
Time Stamp Counter Sub-second
This register reflects the bit [31:0] value of 64-bit reference timing counter. This 32-bit value is used as the sub-second part of time stamp when TSEN (EMAC_TSCTL[0]) is high.

BitField.name: CNTINC
BitField.description:
Time Stamp Counter Increment
Time stamp counter increment value.
If TSEN (EMAC_TSCTL[0]) is high, EMAC adds EMAC_TSSUBSEC with this 8-bit value every time when it wants to increase the EMAC_TSSUBSEC value.

BitField.name: ADDEND
BitField.description:
Time Stamp Counter Addend
This register keeps a 32-bit value for accumulator to enable increment of EMAC_TSSUBSEC.
If TSEN (EMAC_TSCTL[0]) and TSMODE (EMAC_TSCTL[2]) are both high, the EMAC increases accumulator with this 32-bit value in each HCLK. Once the accumulator is overflow, it generates a enable to increase EMAC_TSSUBSEC with an 8-bit value kept in register EMAC_TSINC.

BitField.name: SEC
BitField.description:
Time Stamp Counter Second Update
When TSIEN (EMAC_TSCTL[1]) is high, EMAC loads this 32-bit value to EMAC_TSSEC directly. When TSUPDATE (EMAC_TSCTL[3]) is high, the EMAC increases EMAC_TSSEC with this 32-bit value.

Register.name: EMAC_UPDSUBSEC
Register.description: Time Stamp Update Sub Second Register

BitField.name: SUBSEC
BitField.description:
Time Stamp Counter Sub-second Update
When TSIEN (EMAC_TSCTL[1]) is high, EMAC loads this 32-bit value to EMAC_TSSUBSEC directly. When TSUPDATE (EMAC_TSCTL[3]) is high, the EMAC increases EMAC_TSSUBSEC with this 32-bit value.

BitField.name: SEC
BitField.description:
Time Stamp Counter Second Alarm
Time stamp counter second part alarm value.
This value is only useful when ALMEN (EMAC_TSCTL[5]) is high. If ALMEN (EMAC_TSCTL[5]) is high, EMAC_TSSEC equals to EMAC_ALMSEC and EMAC_TSSUBSEC equals to EMAC_ALMSUBSEC, the Ethernet MAC controller sets TSALMIF (EMAC_INTSTS[28]) high.

Register.name: EMAC_ALMSUBSEC
Register.description: Time Stamp Alarm Sub Second Register

BitField.name: SUBSEC
BitField.description:
Time Stamp Counter Sub-second Alarm
Time stamp counter sub-second part alarm value.
This value is only useful when ALMEN (EMAC_TSCTL[5]) is high. If ALMEN (EMAC_TSCTL[5]) is high, EMAC_TSSEC equals to EMAC_ALMSEC and EMAC_TSSUBSEC equals to EMAC_ALMSUBSEC, the Ethernet MAC controller sets TSALMIF (EMAC_INTSTS[28]) high.

BitField.name: DAT
BitField.description:
Receive/Transmit Holding Buffer
Write Operation:
By writing data to DAT, the SC will send out an 8-bit data.
Note: If SCEN (SCn_CTL[0]) is not enabled, DAT cannot be programmed.
Read Operation:
By reading DAT, the SC will return an 8-bit received data.

BitField.name: SCEN
BitField.description:
SC Controller Enable Bit
Set this bit to 1 to enable SC operation. If this bit is cleared,
Note: SCEN must be set to 1 before filling in other SC registers, or smart card will not work properly.

Enum.description: SC will force all transition to IDLE state
SC controller is enabled and all function can work correctly

BitField.name: RXOFF
BitField.description:
RX Transition Disable Control Bit
This bit is used for disable Rx transition function.
Note: If AUTOCEN (SCn_CTL[3]) is enabled, this field is ignored.

Enum.description: The receiver Enabled
The receiver Disabled

BitField.name: TXOFF
BitField.description:
TX Transition Disable Control Bit
This bit is used for disable Tx transition function.

Enum.description: The transceiver Enabled
The transceiver Disabled

BitField.name: AUTOCEN
BitField.description:
Auto Convention Enable Bit
This bit is used for enable auto convention function.
If user enables auto convention function, the setting step must be done before Answer to Reset (ATR) state and the first data must be 0x3B or 0x3F. After hardware received first data and stored it at buffer, hardware will decided the convention and change the CONSEL (SCn_CTL[5:4]) bits automatically when received first data is 0x3B or 0x3F. If received first byte is 0x3B, TS is direct convention, CONSEL (SCn_CTL[5:4]) will be set to 00 automatically, otherwise the TS is inverse convention, and CONSEL (SCn_CTL[5:4]) will be set to 11.
If the first data is not 0x3B or 0x3F, hardware will set ACERRIF (SCn_INTSTS[10]) and generate an interrupt to CPU when ACERRIEN (SCn_INTEN[10]) is enabled.

Enum.description: Auto-convention Disabled
Auto-convention Enabled

BitField.name: CONSEL
BitField.description:
Convention Selection
Note: If AUTOCEN (SCn_CTL[3]) is enabled, this field is ignored.

Enum.description: Direct convention
Inverse convention

BitField.name: RXTRGLV
BitField.description:
Rx Buffer Trigger Level
When the number of bytes in the receiving buffer equals the RXTRGLV, the RDAIF will be set. If RDAIEN (SCn_INTEN[0]) is enabled, an interrupt will be generated to CPU.

Enum.description: Rx Buffer Trigger Level with 01 bytes
Rx Buffer Trigger Level with 02 bytes
Rx Buffer Trigger Level with 03 bytes

BitField.name: BGT
BitField.description:
Block Guard Time (BGT)
Note: The real block guard time is BGT + 1

BitField.name: TMRSEL
BitField.description:
Timer Channel Selection
Other configurations are reserved

Enum.description: All internal timer function Disabled
Internal 24 bit timer and two 8 bit timers Enabled. User can configure them by setting SCn_TMRCTL0[23:0], SCn_TMRCTL1[7:0] and SCn_TMRCTL2[7:0]

BitField.name: NSB
BitField.description:
Stop Bit Length
This field indicates the length of stop bit.
Note 1: The default stop bit length is 2. SC and UART adopts NSB to program the stop bit length.
Note 2: In UART mode, RX can receive the data sequence in 1 stop bit or 2 stop bits with NSB is set to 0.

Enum.description: The stop bit length is 2 ETU
The stop bit length is 1 ETU

BitField.name: RXRTY
BitField.description:
RX Error Retry Count Number
This field indicates the maximum number of receiver retries that are allowed when parity error has occurred
Note 1: The real retry number is RXRTY + 1, so 8 is the maximum retry number.
Note 2: This field cannot be changed when RXRTYEN enabled. The change flow is to disable RXRTYEN first and then fill in new retry value.

BitField.name: RXRTYEN
BitField.description:
RX Error Retry Enable Bit
This bit enables receiver retry function when parity error has occurred.
Note: User must fill in the RXRTY value before enabling this bit.

Enum.description: RX error retry function Disabled
RX error retry function Enabled

BitField.name: TXRTY
BitField.description:
TX Error Retry Count Number
This field indicates the maximum number of transmitter retries that are allowed when parity error has occurred.
Note 1: The real retry number is TXRTY + 1, so 8 is the maximum retry number.
Note 2: This field cannot be changed when TXRTYEN enabled. The change flow is to disable TXRTYEN first and then fill in new retry value.

BitField.name: TXRTYEN
BitField.description:
TX Error Retry Enable Bit
This bit enables transmitter retry function when parity error has occurred.

Enum.description: TX error retry function Disabled
TX error retry function Enabled

BitField.name: CDDBSEL
BitField.description:
Card Detect De-bounce Selection
This field indicates the card detect de-bounce selection.
Other configurations are reserved.

Enum.description: De-bounce sample card insert once per 384 (128 * 3) SC module clocks and de-bounce sample card removal once per 128 SC module clocks

BitField.name: CDLV
BitField.description:
Card Detect Level Selection
Note: User must select card detect level before Smart Card controller enabled.

Enum.description: When hardware detects the card detect pin (SCn_CD) from high to low, it indicates a card is detected
When hardware detects the card detect pin (SCn_CD) from low to high, it indicates a card is detected

BitField.name: SYNC
BitField.description:
SYNC Flag Indicator (Read Only)
Due to synchronization, user should check this bit before writing a new value to RXRTY and TXRTY fields.

Enum.description: Synchronizing is completion, user can write new data to RXRTY and TXRTY
Last value is synchronizing

BitField.name: TXRST
BitField.description:
TX Software Reset
When TXRST is set, all the bytes in the transmit buffer and TX internal state machine will be cleared.
Note: This bit will be auto cleared after reset is complete.

Enum.description: No effect
Reset the TX internal state machine and pointers

BitField.name: RXRST
BitField.description:
Rx Software Reset
When RXRST is set, all the bytes in the receive buffer and Rx internal state machine will be cleared.
Note: This bit will be auto cleared after reset is complete.

Enum.description: No effect
Reset the Rx internal state machine and pointers

BitField.name: DACTEN
BitField.description:
Deactivation Sequence Generator Enable Bit
This bit enables SC controller to initiate the card by deactivation sequence.
Note 1: When the deactivation sequence completed, this bit will be cleared automatically and the INITIF (SCn_INTSTS[8]) will be set to 1.
Note 2: This field will be cleared by TXRST (SCn_ALTCTL[0]) and RXRST (SCn_ALTCTL[1]). Thus, do not fill in this bit DACTEN, TXRST and RXRST at the same time.
Note 3: If SCEN (SCn_CTL[0]) is not enabled, this filed cannot be programmed.

Enum.description: No effect
Deactivation sequence generator Enabled

BitField.name: ACTEN
BitField.description:
Activation Sequence Generator Enable Bit
This bit enables SC controller to initiate the card by activation sequence.
Note 1: When the activation sequence completed, this bit will be cleared automatically and the INITIF (SCn_INTSTS[8]) will be set to 1.
Note 2: This field will be cleared by TXRST (SCn_ALTCTL[0]) and RXRST (SCn_ALTCTL[1]). Thus, do not fill in this bit ACTEN, TXRST and RXRST at the same time.
Note 3: If SCEN (SCn_CTL[0]) is not enabled, this filed cannot be programmed.
Note 4: During the activation sequence, RX is disabled automatically and can not receive data. After the activation sequence completion, RXOFF (SCn_CTL[1]) keeps the state before hardware activation.

Enum.description: No effect
Activation sequence generator Enabled

BitField.name: WARSTEN
BitField.description:
Warm Reset Sequence Generator Enable Bit
This bit enables SC controller to initiate the card by warm reset sequence.
Note 1: When the warm reset sequence completed, this bit will be cleared automatically and the INITIF (SCn_INTSTS[8]) will be set to 1.
Note 2: This field will be cleared by TXRST (SCn_ALTCTL[0]) and RXRST (SCn_ALTCTL[1]). Thus, do not fill in this bit WARSTEN, TXRST and RXRST at the same time.
Note 3: If SCEN (SCn_CTL[0]) is not enabled, this filed cannot be programmed.
Note 4: During the warm reset sequence, RX is disabled automatically and can not receive data. After the warm reset sequence completion, RXOFF (SCn_CTL[1]) keeps the state before perform warm reset sequence.

Enum.description: No effect
Warm reset sequence generator Enabled

BitField.name: CNTEN0
BitField.description:
Internal Timer0 Start Enable Bit
This bit enables Timer 0 to start counting. User can fill 0 to stop it and set 1 to reload and count. The counter unit is ETU base.
Note 3: If SCEN (SCn_CTL[0]) is not enabled, this filed cannot be programmed.

Enum.description: Stops counting
Start counting

BitField.name: CNTEN1
BitField.description:
Internal Timer1 Start Enable Bit
This bit enables Timer 1 to start counting. User can fill 0 to stop it and set 1 to reload and count. The counter unit is ETU base.
Note 3: If SCEN (SCn_CTL[0]) is not enabled, this filed cannot be programmed.

Enum.description: Stops counting
Start counting

BitField.name: CNTEN2
BitField.description:
Internal Timer2 Start Enable Bit
This bit enables Timer 2 to start counting. User can fill 0 to stop it and set 1 to reload and count. The counter unit is ETU base.
Note 3: If SCEN (SCn_CTL[0]) is not enabled, this filed cannot be programmed.

Enum.description: Stops counting
Start counting

BitField.name: INITSEL
BitField.description:
Initial Timing Selection
This fields indicates the initial timing of hardware activation, warm-reset or deactivation.
The unit of initial timing is SC module clock.
Activation: refer to SC Activation Sequence in Figure 6.1854.
Warm-reset: refer to Warm-Reset Sequence in Figure 6.185.
Deactivation: refer to Deactivation Sequence in Figure 6.1856.
Note: When set activation and warm reset in Timer0 operation mode 0011, it may have deviation at most 128 SC module clock cycles.

BitField.name: ADACEN
BitField.description:
Auto Deactivation When Card Removal
This bit is used for enable hardware auto deactivation when smart card is removed.
Note: When the card is removed, hardware will stop any process and then do deactivation sequence if this bit is set. If auto deactivation process completes, hardware will set INITIF (SCn_INTSTS[8]) also.

Enum.description: Auto deactivation Disabled
Auto deactivation Enabled

BitField.name: RXBGTEN
BitField.description:
Receiver Block Guard Time Function Enable Bit
This bit enables the receiver block guard time function.

Enum.description: Receiver block guard time function Disabled
Receiver block guard time function Enabled

BitField.name: ACTSTS0
BitField.description:
Internal Timer0 Active Status (Read Only)
This bit indicates the timer counter status of timer0.
Note: Timer0 is active does not always mean timer0 is counting the CNT (SCn_TMRCTL0[23:0]).

Enum.description: Timer0 is not active
Timer0 is active

BitField.name: ACTSTS1
BitField.description:
Internal Timer1 Active Status (Read Only)
This bit indicates the timer counter status of timer1.
Note: Timer1 is active does not always mean timer1 is counting the CNT (SCn_TMRCTL1[7:0]).

Enum.description: Timer1 is not active
Timer1 is active

BitField.name: ACTSTS2
BitField.description:
Internal Timer2 Active Status (Read Only)
This bit indicates the timer counter status of timer2.
Note: Timer2 is active does not always mean timer2 is counting the CNT (SCn_TMRCTL2[7:0]).

Enum.description: Timer2 is not active
Timer2 is active

BitField.name: SYNC
BitField.description:
SYNC Flag Indicator (Read Only)
Due to synchronization, user should check this bit when writing a new value to SCn_ALTCTL register.

Enum.description: Synchronizing is completion, user can write new data to SCn_ALTCTL register
Last value is synchronizing

BitField.name: EGT
BitField.description:
Extra Guard Time
This field indicates the extra guard time value.
Note: The extra guard time unit is ETU base.

Register.name: SC_RXTOUT
Register.description: SC Receive Buffer Time-out Counter Register

BitField.name: RFTM
BitField.description:
SC Receiver FIFO Time-out Counter
The time-out down counter resets and starts counting whenever the RX buffer received a new data. Once the counter decrease to 1 and no new data is received or CPU does not read data by reading SCn_DAT, a receiver time-out flag RXTOIF (SCn_INTSTS[9]) will be set, and hardware will generate an interrupt to CPU when RXTOIEN (SCn_INTEN[9]) is enabled.
Note 1: The counter unit is ETU based and the interval of time-out is RFTM + 0.5.
Note 2: Filling in all 0 to this field indicates to disable this function.

Register.name: SC_ETUCTL
Register.description: SC Element Time Unit Control Register

BitField.name: ETURDIV
BitField.description:
ETU Rate Divider
The field is used for ETU clock rate divider.
The real ETU is ETURDIV + 1.
Note: User can configure this field, but this field must be greater than 0x04.

BitField.name: RDAIEN
BitField.description:
Receive Data Reach Interrupt Enable Bit
This field is used to enable received data reaching trigger level RXTRGLV (SCn_CTL[7:6]) interrupt.

Enum.description: Receive data reach trigger level interrupt Disabled
Receive data reach trigger level interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: TBEIEN
BitField.description:
Transmit Buffer Empty Interrupt Enable Bit
This field is used to enable transmit buffer empty interrupt.

Enum.description: Transmit buffer empty interrupt Disabled
Transmit buffer empty interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: TERRIEN
BitField.description:
Transfer Error Interrupt Enable Bit
This field is used to enable transfer error interrupt. The transfer error states is at SCn_STATUS register which includes receiver break error BEF (SCn_STATUS[6]), frame error FEF (SCn_STATUS[5]), parity error PEF (SCn_STATUS[4]), receive buffer overflow error RXOV (SCn_STATUS[0]), transmit buffer overflow error TXOV (SCn_STATUS[8]), receiver retry over limit error RXOVERR (SCn_STATUS[22]) and transmitter retry over limit error TXOVERR (SCn_STATUS[30]).

Enum.description: Transfer error interrupt Disabled
Transfer error interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: TMR0IEN
BitField.description:
Timer0 Interrupt Enable Bit
This field is used to enable Timer0 interrupt function.

Enum.description: Timer0 interrupt Disabled
Timer0 interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: TMR1IEN
BitField.description:
Timer1 Interrupt Enable Bit
This field is used to enable the Timer1 interrupt function.

Enum.description: Timer1 interrupt Disabled
Timer1 interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: TMR2IEN
BitField.description:
Timer2 Interrupt Enable Bit
This field is used to enable Timer2 interrupt function.

Enum.description: Timer2 interrupt Disabled
Timer2 interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: BGTIEN
BitField.description:
Block Guard Time Interrupt Enable Bit
This field is used to enable block guard time interrupt in receive direction.
Note: This bit is valid only for receive direction block guard time.

Enum.description: Block guard time interrupt Disabled
Block guard time interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: CDIEN
BitField.description:
Card Detect Interrupt Enable Bit
This field is used to enable card detect interrupt. The card detect status is CDPINSTS (SCn_STATUS[13]).

Enum.description: Card detect interrupt Disabled
Card detect interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: INITIEN
BitField.description: Initial End Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: Initial end interrupt Disabled
Initial end interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: RXTOIEN
BitField.description:
Receiver Buffer Time-out Interrupt Enable Bit
This field is used to enable receiver buffer time-out interrupt.

Enum.description: Receiver buffer time-out interrupt Disabled
Receiver buffer time-out interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: ACERRIEN
BitField.description:
Auto Convention Error Interrupt Enable Bit
This field is used to enable auto-convention error interrupt.

Enum.description: Auto-convention error interrupt Disabled
Auto-convention error interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: RDAIF
BitField.description:
Receive Data Reach Interrupt Status Flag (Read Only)
This field is used for received data reaching trigger level RXTRGLV (SCn_CTL[7:6]) interrupt status flag.
Note: This bit is read only. If user reads data from SCn_DAT and receiver buffer data byte number is less than RXTRGLV, this bit will be cleared automatically.

Enum.description: Number of receive buffer is less than RXTRGLV setting
Number of receive buffer data equals the RXTRGLV setting

BitField.name: TBEIF
BitField.description:
Transmit Buffer Empty Interrupt Status Flag (Read Only)
This field is used for transmit buffer empty interrupt status flag.
Note: This bit is read only. If user wants to clear this bit, user must write data to DAT (SCn_DAT[7:0]) and then this bit will be cleared automatically.

Enum.description: Transmit buffer is not empty
Transmit buffer is empty

BitField.name: TERRIF
BitField.description:
Transfer Error Interrupt Status Flag
This field is used for transfer error interrupt status flag. The transfer error states is at SCn_STATUS register which includes receiver break error BEF (SCn_STATUS[6]), frame error FEF (SCn_STATUS[5], parity error PEF (SCn_STATUS[4] and receive buffer overflow error RXOV (SCn_STATUS[0]), transmit buffer overflow error TXOV (SCn_STATUS[8]), receiver retry over limit error RXOVERR (SCn_STATUS[22] or transmitter retry over limit error TXOVERR (SCn_STATUS[30]).
Note 1: This field is the status flag of BEF, FEF, PEF, RXOV, TXOV, RXOVERR or TXOVERR.
Note 2: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.

Enum.description: Transfer error interrupt did not occur
Transfer error interrupt occurred

BitField.name: TMR0IF
BitField.description:
Timer0 Interrupt Status Flag
This field is used for Timer0 interrupt status flag.
Note: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.

Enum.description: Timer0 interrupt did not occur
Timer0 interrupt occurred

BitField.name: TMR1IF
BitField.description:
Timer1 Interrupt Status Flag
This field is used for Timer1 interrupt status flag.
Note: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.

Enum.description: Timer1 interrupt did not occur
Timer1 interrupt occurred

BitField.name: TMR2IF
BitField.description:
Timer2 Interrupt Status Flag
This field is used for Timer2 interrupt status flag.
Note: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.

Enum.description: Timer2 interrupt did not occur
Timer2 interrupt occurred

BitField.name: BGTIF
BitField.description:
Block Guard Time Interrupt Status Flag
This field is used for indicate block guard time interrupt status flag in receive direction.
Note 1: This bit is valid only when RXBGTEN (SCn_ALTCTL[12]) is enabled.
Note 2: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.

Enum.description: Block guard time interrupt did not occur
Block guard time interrupt occurred

BitField.name: CDIF
BitField.description:
Card Detect Interrupt Status Flag (Read Only)
This field is used for card detect interrupt status flag. The card detect status is CINSERT (SCn_STATUS[12]) and CREMOVE (SCn_STATUS[11]).
Note: This bit is read only, user must to clear CINSERT or CREMOVE status to clear it.

Enum.description: Card detect event did not occur
Card detect event occurred

BitField.name: INITIF
BitField.description:
Initial End Interrupt Status Flag
This field is used for activation (ACTEN (SCn_ALTCTL[3])), deactivation (DACTEN (SCn_ALTCTL[2])) and warm reset (WARSTEN (SCn_ALTCTL[4])) sequence interrupt status flag.
Note: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.

Enum.description: Initial sequence is not complete
Initial sequence is completed

BitField.name: RXTOIF
BitField.description:
Receive Buffer Time-out Interrupt Status Flag (Read Only)
This field is used for indicate receive buffer time-out interrupt status flag.
Note: This bit is read only, user must read all receive buffer remaining data by reading SCn_DAT register to clear it.

Enum.description: Receive buffer time-out interrupt did not occur
Receive buffer time-out interrupt occurred

BitField.name: ACERRIF
BitField.description:
Auto Convention Error Interrupt Status Flag
This field indicates auto convention sequence error.
Note: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.

Enum.description: Received TS at ATR state is 0x3B or 0x3F
Received TS at ATR state is neither 0x3B nor 0x3F

BitField.name: RXOV
BitField.description:
Receive Overflow Error Status Flag
This bit is set when Rx buffer overflow.
Note: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.

Enum.description: Rx buffer is not overflow
Rx buffer is overflow when the number of received bytes is greater than Rx buffer size (4 bytes)

BitField.name: RXEMPTY
BitField.description:
Receive Buffer Empty Status Flag (Read Only)
This bit indicates Rx buffer empty or not.

Enum.description: Rx buffer is not empty
Rx buffer is empty, it means the last byte of Rx buffer has read from DAT (SCn_DAT[7:0]) by CPU

BitField.name: RXFULL
BitField.description:
Receive Buffer Full Status Flag (Read Only)
This bit indicates Rx buffer full or not.

Enum.description: Rx buffer count is less than 4
Rx buffer count equals to 4

BitField.name: PEF
BitField.description:
Receiver Parity Error Status Flag
This bit is set to logic 1 whenever the received character does not have a valid parity bit.
Note 1: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.
Note 2: If CPU sets receiver retries function by setting RXRTYEN (SCn_CTL[19]), hardware will not set this flag.

Enum.description: Receiver parity error flag did not occur
Receiver parity error flag occurred

BitField.name: FEF
BitField.description:
Receiver Frame Error Status Flag
This bit is set to logic 1 whenever the received character does not have a valid stop bit (that is, the stop bit following the last data bit or parity bit is detected as logic 0).
Note 1: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.
Note 2: If CPU sets receiver retries function by setting RXRTYEN (SCn_CTL[19]), hardware will not set this flag.

Enum.description: Receiver frame error flag did not occur
Receiver frame error flag occurred

BitField.name: BEF
BitField.description:
Receiver Break Error Status Flag
This bit is set to logic 1 whenever the received data input (Rx) held in the spacing state (logic 0) is longer than a full word transmission time (that is, the total time of 'start bit' + 'data bits' + 'parity bit' + 'stop bits').
Note 1: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.
Note 2: If CPU sets receiver retries function by setting RXRTYEN (SCn_CTL[19]), hardware will not set this flag.

Enum.description: Receiver break error flag did not occur
Receiver break error flag occurred

BitField.name: TXOV
BitField.description:
Transmit Overflow Error Interrupt Status Flag
This bit is set when Tx buffer overflow.
Note: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.

Enum.description: Tx buffer is not overflow
Tx buffer is overflow when Tx buffer is full and an additional write operation to DAT (SCn_DAT[7:0])

BitField.name: TXEMPTY
BitField.description:
Transmit Buffer Empty Status Flag (Read Only)
This bit indicates TX buffer empty or not.
Note: This bit will be cleared when writing data into DAT (SCn_DAT[7:0]).

Enum.description: Tx buffer is not empty
Tx buffer is empty, it means the last byte of Tx buffer has been transferred to Transmitter Shift Register

BitField.name: TXFULL
BitField.description:
Transmit Buffer Full Status Flag (Read Only)
This bit indicates Tx buffer full or not.

Enum.description: Tx buffer count is less than 4
Tx buffer count equals to 4

BitField.name: CREMOVE
BitField.description:
Card Removal Status of SCn_CD Pin
This bit is set whenever card has been removal.
Note 1: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.
Note 2: Card detect function will start after SCEN (SCn_CTL[0]) set.

Enum.description: No effect
Card removed

BitField.name: CINSERT
BitField.description:
Card Insert Status of SCn_CD Pin
This bit is set whenever card has been inserted.
Note 1: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.
Note 2: The card detect function will start after SCEN (SCn_CTL[0]) set.

Enum.description: No effect
Card insert

BitField.name: CDPINSTS
BitField.description:
Card Detect Pin Status (Read Only)
This bit is the pin status of SCn_CD.

Enum.description: The SCn_CD pin state at low
The SCn_CD pin state at high

BitField.name: RXPOINT
BitField.description:
Receive Buffer Pointer Status (Read Only)
This field indicates the Rx buffer pointer status. When SC controller receives one byte from external device, RXPOINT increases one. When one byte of Rx buffer is read by CPU, RXPOINT decreases one.

BitField.name: RXRERR
BitField.description:
Receiver Retry Error
This bit is used for receiver error retry and set by hardware.
Note 1: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.
Note 2 This bit is a flag and cannot generate any interrupt to CPU.
Note 3: If CPU enables receiver retries function by setting RXRTYEN (SCn_CTL[19]), hardware will not set this flag.

Enum.description: No Rx retry transfer
Rx has any error and retries transfer

BitField.name: RXOVERR
BitField.description:
Receiver over Retry Error
This bit is used for receiver retry counts over than retry number limitation.
Note 1: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.
Note 2: If CPU enables receiver retries function by setting RXRTYEN (SCn_CTL[19]), hardware will not set this flag.

Enum.description: Receiver retries counts is less than RXRTY (SCn_CTL[18:16]) + 1
Receiver retries counts is equal or over than RXRTY (SCn_CTL[18:16]) + 1

BitField.name: RXACT
BitField.description:
Receiver in Active Status Flag (Read Only)
This bit indicates Rx transfer status.

Enum.description: This bit is cleared automatically when Rx transfer is finished
This bit is set by hardware when Rx transfer is in active

BitField.name: TXPOINT
BitField.description:
Transmit Buffer Pointer Status (Read Only)
This field indicates the Tx buffer pointer status. When CPU writes data into SCn_DAT, TXPOINT increases one. When one byte of Tx buffer is transferred to transmitter shift register, TXPOINT decreases one.

BitField.name: TXRERR
BitField.description:
Transmitter Retry Error
This bit is used for indicate transmitter error retry and set by hardware..
Note 1: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.
Note 2: This bit is a flag and cannot generate any interrupt to CPU.

Enum.description: No Tx retry transfer
Tx has any error and retries transfer

BitField.name: TXOVERR
BitField.description:
Transmitter over Retry Error
This bit is used for transmitter retry counts over than retry number limitation.
Note: This bit can be cleared by writing 1 to it.

Enum.description: Transmitter retries counts is less than TXRTY (SCn_CTL[22:20]) + 1
Transmitter retries counts is equal or over to TXRTY (SCn_CTL[22:20]) + 1

BitField.name: TXACT
BitField.description:
Transmit in Active Status Flag (Read Only)
This bit indicates Tx transmit status.

Enum.description: This bit is cleared automatically when Tx transfer is finished or the last byte transmission has completed
Transmit is active and this bit is set by hardware when Tx transfer is in active and the STOP bit of the last byte has not been transmitted

BitField.name: PWREN
BitField.description:
SCn_PWR Pin Signal
User can set PWRINV (SCn_PINCTL[11]) and PWREN (SCn_PINCTL[0]) to decide SCn_PWR pin is in high or low level.
Write this field to drive SCn_PWR pin
Refer PWRINV (SCn_PINCTL[11]) description for programming SCn_PWR pin voltage level.
Read this field to get SCn_PWR signal status.
Note: When operating at activation, warm reset or deactivation mode, this bit will be changed automatically. Thus, do not fill in this field when operating in these modes.

Enum.description: SCn_PWR signal status is low
SCn_PWR signal status is high

BitField.name: RSTEN
BitField.description:
SCn_RST Pin Signal
User can set RSTEN (SCn_PINCTL[1]) to decide SCn_RST pin is in high or low level.
Write this field to drive SCn_RST pin.
Note: When operating at activation, warm reset or deactivation mode, this bit will be changed automatically. Thus, do not fill in this field when operating in these modes.

Enum.description:
Drive SCn_RST pin to low.
SCn_RST signal status is low

Drive SCn_RST pin to high.
SCn_RST signal status is high

BitField.name: CLKKEEP
BitField.description:
SC Clock Enable Bit
Note: When operating in activation, warm reset or deactivation mode, this bit will be changed automatically. Thus, do not fill in this field when operating in these modes.

Enum.description: SC clock generation Disabled
SC clock always keeps free running

BitField.name: SCDATA
BitField.description:
SCn_DATA Pin Signal
This bit is the signal status of SCn_DATA but user can drive SCn_DATA pin to high or low by setting this bit.
Note: When SC is at activation, warm reset or deactivation mode, this bit will be changed automatically. Thus, do not fill in this field when SC is in these modes.

Enum.description:
Drive SCn_DATA pin to low.
SCn_DATA signal status is low

Drive SCn_DATA pin to high.
SCn_DATA signal status is high

BitField.name: PWRINV
BitField.description:
SCn_PWR Pin Inverse
This bit is used for inverse the SCn_PWR pin.
There are four kinds of combination for SCn_PWR pin setting by PWRINV (SCn_PINCTL[11]) and PWREN (SCn_PINCTL[0]).
PWRINV (SCn_PINCTL[11]) is bit 1 and PWREN (SCn_PINCTL[0]) is bit 0 and all conditions as below list,
Note: User must select PWRINV (SCn_PINCTL[11]) before smart card is enabled by SCEN (SCn_CTL[0]).

Enum.description: SCn_PWR pin is 0
SCn_PWR pin is 1
SCn_PWR pin is 1
SCn_PWR pin is 0

BitField.name: DATASTS
BitField.description:
SCn_DATA Pin Status (Read Only)
This bit is the pin status of SCn_DATA.

Enum.description: The SCn_DATA pin status is low
The SCn_DATA pin status is high

BitField.name: PWRSTS
BitField.description:
SCn_PWR Pin Status (Read Only)
This bit is the pin status of SCn_PWR.

Enum.description: SCn_PWR pin to low
SCn_PWR pin to high

BitField.name: RSTSTS
BitField.description:
SCn_RST Pin Status (Read Only)
This bit is the pin status of SCn_RST.

Enum.description: SCn_RST pin is low
SCn_RST pin is high

BitField.name: SYNC
BitField.description:
SYNC Flag Indicator (Read Only)
Due to synchronization, user should check this bit when writing a new value to SCn_PINCTL register.

Enum.description: Synchronizing is completion, user can write new data to SCn_PINCTL register
Last value is synchronizing

BitField.name: CNT
BitField.description:
Timer0 Counter Value
This field indicates the internal Timer0 counter values.
Note: Unit of Timer0 counter is ETU base.

BitField.name: OPMODE
BitField.description:
Timer0 Operation Mode Selection
This field indicates the internal 24-bit Timer0 operation selection.
Refer to Table 6.183 for programming Timer0.

BitField.name: SYNC
BitField.description:
SYNC Flag Indicator (Read Only)
Due to synchronization, user should check this bit when writing a new value to the SCn_TMRCTL0 register.

Enum.description: Synchronizing is completion, user can write new data to SCn_TMRCTL0 register
Last value is synchronizing

BitField.name: CNT
BitField.description:
Timer 1 Counter Value
This field indicates the internal Timer1 counter values.
Note: Unit of Timer1 counter is ETU base.

BitField.name: OPMODE
BitField.description:
Timer 1 Operation Mode Selection
This field indicates the internal 8-bit Timer1 operation selection.
Refer to Table 6.183 for programming Timer1.

BitField.name: SYNC
BitField.description:
SYNC Flag Indicator (Read Only)
Due to synchronization, software should check this bit when writing a new value to SCn_TMRCTL1 register.

Enum.description: Synchronizing is completion, user can write new data to SCn_TMRCTL1 register
Last value is synchronizing

BitField.name: CNT
BitField.description:
Timer 2 Counter Value
This field indicates the internal Timer2 counter values.
Note: Unit of Timer2 counter is ETU base.

BitField.name: OPMODE
BitField.description:
Timer 2 Operation Mode Selection
This field indicates the internal 8-bit Timer2 operation selection
Refer to Table 6.183 for programming Timer2.

BitField.name: SYNC
BitField.description:
SYNC Flag Indicator (Read Only)
Due to synchronization, user should check this bit when writing a new value to SCn_TMRCTL2 register.

Enum.description: Synchronizing is completion, user can write new data to SCn_TMRCTL2 register
Last value is synchronizing

BitField.name: UARTEN
BitField.description:
UART Mode Enable Bit
Sets this bit to enable UART mode function.
Note 3: When UART mode is enabled, hardware will generate a reset to reset FIFO and internal state machine.

Enum.description: Smart Card mode
UART mode

BitField.name: WLS
BitField.description:
Word Length Selection
This field is used for select UART data length.
Note: In smart card mode, this WLS must be 00.

Enum.description: Word length is 8 bits
Word length is 7 bits
Word length is 6 bits
Word length is 5 bits

BitField.name: PBOFF
BitField.description:
Parity Bit Disable Bit
Sets this bit is used for disable parity check function.
Note: In smart card mode, this field must be 0 (default setting is with parity bit).

Enum.description: Parity bit is generated or checked between the 'last data word bit' and 'stop bit' of the serial data
Parity bit is not generated (transmitting data) or checked (receiving data) during transfer

BitField.name: OPE
BitField.description:
Odd Parity Enable Bit
This is used for odd/even parity selection.
Note: This bit has effect only when PBOFF bit is 0.

Enum.description: Even number of logic 1 are transmitted or check the data word and parity bits in receiving mode
Odd number of logic 1 are transmitted or check the data word and parity bits in receiving mode

BitField.name: T1EXT
BitField.description:
T1 Extend Time of Hardware Activation
This field provide the configurable cycles to extend the activation time T1 period.
The cycle scaling factor is 2048.
Note: Setting 0 to this field conforms to the protocol ISO/IEC 7816-3

BitField.name: DAT
BitField.description:
Receive/Transmit Holding Buffer
Write Operation:
