Note: This bit is cleared to 0 when all data in transmit FIFO and shift buffer is shifted out. And set to 1 when 1st data is load to shift buffer.

BitField.name: SUSPITV
BitField.description:
Suspend Interval (Master Only)
The four bits provide configurable suspend interval between two successive transmit/receive transaction in a transfer. The definition of the suspend interval is the interval between the last clock edge of the preceding transaction word and the first clock edge of the following transaction word. The default value is 0x3. The period of the suspend interval is obtained according to the following equation.
(SUSPITV + 0.5) * period of SPICLK clock cycle

BitField.name: DWIDTH
BitField.description:
Data Width
This field specifies how many bits can be transmitted / received in one transaction. The minimum bit length is 8 bits and can up to 32 bits.
Note: This bit field will decide the depth of TX/RX FIFO configuration in SPI mode. Therefore, changing this bit field will clear TX/RX FIFO by hardware automatically.

The LSB, bit 0 of the SPI TX register, is sent first to the SPI data output pin, and the first bit received from the SPI data input pin will be put in the LSB position of the RX register (bit 0 of SPI_RX)

BitField.name: TX
BitField.description:
Data Transmit Register
The data transmit registers pass through the transmitted data into the 4-level transmit FIFO buffers. The number of valid bits depends on the setting of DWIDTH (SPIx_CTL[12:8]) in SPI mode or WDWIDTH (SPIx_I2SCTL[5:4]) in I2S mode.
In SPI mode, if DWIDTH is set to 0x08, the bits TX[7:0] will be transmitted. If DWIDTH is set to 0x00, the SPI controller will perform a 32-bit transfer.
In I2S mode, if WDWIDTH (SPIx_I2SCTL[5:4]) is set to 0x2, the data width of audio channel is 24-bit and corresponding to TX[23:0]. If WDWIDTH is set as 0x0, 0x1, or 0x3, all bits of this field are valid and referred to the data arrangement in I2S mode FIFO operation section
Note: In Master mode, SPI controller will start to transfer the SPI bus clock after 1 APB clock and 6 peripheral clock cycles after user writes to this register.

BitField.name: RX
BitField.description:
Data Receive Register (Read Only)
There are 4-level FIFO buffers in this controller. The data receive register holds the data received from SPI data input pin. If the RXEMPTY (SPIx_STATUS[8] or SPIx_I2SSTS[8]) is not set to 1, the receive FIFO buffers can be accessed through software by reading this register.

(SUSPITV + 0.5) * period of SPICLK clock cycle

BitField.name: TX
BitField.description:
Data Transmit Register
The data transmit registers pass through the transmitted data into the 4-level transmit FIFO buffers. The number of valid bits depends on the setting of DWIDTH (SPIx_CTL[12:8]) in SPI mode or WDWIDTH (SPIx_I2SCTL[5:4]) in I2S mode.
In SPI mode, if DWIDTH is set to 0x08, the bits TX[7:0] will be transmitted. If DWIDTH is set to 0x00, the SPI controller will perform a 32-bit transfer.
In I2S mode, if WDWIDTH (SPIx_I2SCTL[5:4]) is set to 0x2, the data width of audio channel is 24-bit and corresponding to TX[23:0]. If WDWIDTH is set as 0x0, 0x1, or 0x3, all bits of this field are valid and referred to the data arrangement in I2S mode FIFO operation section
Note: In Master mode, SPI controller will start to transfer the SPI bus clock after 1 APB clock and 6 peripheral clock cycles after user writes to this register.

BitField.name: RX
BitField.description:
Data Receive Register (Read Only)
There are 4-level FIFO buffers in this controller. The data receive register holds the data received from SPI data input pin. If the RXEMPTY (SPIx_STATUS[8] or SPIx_I2SSTS[8]) is not set to 1, the receive FIFO buffers can be accessed through software by reading this register.

Note: This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.

Enum.description: No receive FIFO time-out event

Receive FIFO buffer is not empty and no read operation on receive FIFO buffer over 64 SPI peripheral clock period in Master mode or over 576 SPI peripheral clock period in Slave mode. When the received FIFO buffer is read by software, the time-out status will be cleared automatically

BitField.name: I2SENSTS
BitField.description:
I2S Enable Status (Read Only)
Note: The SPI peripheral clock is asynchronous with the system clock. In order to make sure the SPI/I2S control logic is disabled, this bit indicates the real status of SPI/I2S control logic for user.

Enum.description: The SPI/I2S control logic is disabled
The SPI/I2S control logic is enabled

BitField.name: TXEMPTY
BitField.description: Transmit FIFO Buffer Empty Indicator (Read Only)

Enum.description: Transmit FIFO buffer is not empty
Transmit FIFO buffer is empty

BitField.name: TXFULL
BitField.description: Transmit FIFO Buffer Full Indicator (Read Only)

Enum.description: Transmit FIFO buffer is not full
Transmit FIFO buffer is full

BitField.name: TXTHIF
BitField.description: Transmit FIFO Threshold Interrupt Flag (Read Only)

Enum.description: The valid data count within the transmit FIFO buffer is larger than the setting value of TXTH
The valid data count within the transmit FIFO buffer is less than or equal to the setting value of TXTH

BitField.name: TXUFIF
BitField.description:
Transmit FIFO Underflow Interrupt Flag
When the transmit FIFO buffer is empty and there is no datum written into the FIFO buffer, if there is more bus clock input, this bit will be set to 1.
Note: This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.

BitField.name: RZCIF
BitField.description: Right Channel Zero Cross Interrupt Flag

Enum.description: No zero cross event occurred on right channel
Zero cross event occurred on right channel

BitField.name: LZCIF
BitField.description: Left Channel Zero Cross Interrupt Flag

Enum.description: No zero cross event occurred on left channel
Zero cross event occurred on left channel

BitField.name: SLVERRIF
BitField.description:
Bit Clock Loss Interrupt Flag for Slave Mode
Note: This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.

Enum.description: No bit clock loss event occurred
Bit clock loss event occurred

BitField.name: TXRXRST
BitField.description:
TX or RX Reset Status (Read Only)
Note: Both the reset operations of TXRST and RXRST need 3 system clock cycles + 2 peripheral clock cycles. User can check the status of this bit to monitor the reset function is doing or done.

Enum.description: The reset function of TXRST or RXRST is done
Doing the reset function of TXRST or RXRST

BitField.name: RXCNT
BitField.description:
Receive FIFO Data Count (Read Only)
This bit field indicates the valid data count of receive FIFO buffer.

BitField.name: TXCNT
BitField.description:
Transmit FIFO Data Count (Read Only)
This bit field indicates the valid data count of transmit FIFO buffer.

BitField.name: SPIEN
BitField.description:
QSPI Transfer Control Enable Bit
In Master mode, the transfer will start when there is data in the FIFO buffer after this bit is set to 1. In Slave mode, this device is ready to receive data when this bit is set to 1.
Note: Before changing the configurations of QSPIx_CTL, QSPIx_CLKDIV, QSPIx_SSCTL and QSPIx_FIFOCTL registers, user shall clear the SPIEN (QSPIx_CTL[0]) and confirm the SPIENSTS (QSPIx_STATUS[15]) is 0.

Enum.description: Transfer control Disabled
Transfer control Enabled

BitField.name: RXNEG
BitField.description: Receive on Negative Edge

Enum.description: Received data input signal is latched on the rising edge of QSPI bus clock
Received data input signal is latched on the falling edge of QSPI bus clock

BitField.name: TXNEG
BitField.description:
Transmit on Negative Edge
Note: In TX DTR mode, TXNEG equals to CLKPOL (QSPI_CTL[3]).

Enum.description: Transmitted data output signal is changed on the rising edge of QSPI bus clock
Transmitted data output signal is changed on the falling edge of QSPI bus clock

BitField.name: CLKPOL
BitField.description: Clock Polarity

Enum.description: QSPI bus clock is idle low
QSPI bus clock is idle high

BitField.name: SUSPITV
BitField.description:
Suspend Interval (Master Only)
The four bits provide configurable suspend interval between two successive transmit/receive transaction in a transfer. The definition of the suspend interval is the interval between the last clock edge of the preceding transaction word and the first clock edge of the following transaction word. The default value is 0x3. The period of the suspend interval is obtained according to the following equation.
(SUSPITV + 0.5) * period of QSPICLK clock cycle
Example:
Note: In TX DTR mode, SUSPITV equals to 0x0.

BitField.name: DWIDTH
BitField.description:
Data Width
This field specifies how many bits can be transmitted / received in one transaction. The minimum bit length is 8 bits and can up to 32 bits.

BitField.name: LSB
BitField.description: Send LSB First

Enum.description: The MSB, which bit of transmit/receive register depends on the setting of DWIDTH, is transmitted/received first

The LSB, bit 0 of the QSPIx TX register, is sent first to the QSPI data output pin, and the first bit received from the QSPI data input pin will be put in the LSB position of the RX register (bit 0 of QSPIx_RX)

BitField.name: HALFDPX
BitField.description:
QSPI Half-duplex Transfer Enable Bit
This bit is used to select full-duplex or half-duplex for QSPI transfer. The bit field DATDIR (QSPIx_CTL[20]) can be used to set the data direction in half-duplex transfer.

Enum.description: QSPI operates in full-duplex transfer
QSPI operates in half-duplex transfer

BitField.name: RXONLY
BitField.description:
Receive-only Mode Enable Bit (Master Only)
This bit field is only available in Master mode. In receive-only mode, QSPI Master will generate QSPI bus clock continuously for receiving data bit from SPI slave device and assert the BUSY status.

Enum.description: Receive-only mode Disabled
Receive-only mode Enabled

BitField.name: TWOBIT
BitField.description:
2-bit Transfer Mode Enable Bit
Note: When 2-bit Transfer mode is enabled, the first serial transmitted bit data is from the first FIFO buffer data, and the 2nd serial transmitted bit data is from the second FIFO buffer data. As the same as transmitted function, the first received bit data is stored into the first FIFO buffer and the 2nd received bit data is stored into the second FIFO buffer at the same time.

Enum.description: 2-bit Transfer mode Disabled
2-bit Transfer mode Enabled

BitField.name: UNITIEN
BitField.description: Unit Transfer Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: QSPI unit transfer interrupt Disabled
QSPI unit transfer interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: SLAVE
BitField.description: Slave Mode Control

Enum.description: Master mode
Slave mode

BitField.name: REORDER
BitField.description:
Byte Reorder Function Enable Bit
Note: Byte Reorder function is only available if DWIDTH is defined as 16, 24, and 32 bits.

Enum.description: Byte Reorder function Disabled
Byte Reorder function Enabled. A byte suspend interval will be inserted among each byte. The period of the byte suspend interval depends on the setting of SUSPITV

BitField.name: DATDIR
BitField.description:
Data Port Direction Control
This bit is used to select the data input/output direction in half-duplex transfer and Dual/Quad transfer

Enum.description: QSPI data is input direction
QSPI data is output direction

BitField.name: DUALIOEN
BitField.description: Dual I/O Mode Enable Bit

Enum.description: Dual I/O mode Disabled
Dual I/O mode Enabled

BitField.name: QUADIOEN
BitField.description: Quad I/O Mode Enable Bit

Enum.description: Quad I/O mode Disabled
Quad I/O mode Enabled

BitField.name: TXDTR_EN
BitField.description:
TX DTR (Transmit Double Transfer Rate) Mode Enable Bit (Master Only)
Note: QSPI master mode supports TXDTR mode, and QSPI slave mode does not support this mode.

Enum.description: TX DTR mode Disabled
TX DTR mode Enabled

BitField.name: DIVIDER
BitField.description:
Clock Divider
The value in this field is the frequency divider for generating the peripheral clock, fspi_eclk, and the QSPI bus clock of QSPI Master. The frequency is obtained according to the following equation.

where
is the peripheral clock source, which is defined in the clock control register, CLK_CLKSEL2.
Note: The time interval must be larger than or equal to 8 peripheral clock cycles between releasing QSPI IP software reset and setting this clock divider register.

BitField.name: SS
BitField.description:
Slave Selection Control (Master Only)
If AUTOSS bit is cleared to 0,

Enum.description:
set the QSPIx_SS line to inactive state.
Keep the QSPIx_SS line at inactive state

set the QSPIx_SS line to active state.
QSPIx_SS line will be automatically driven to active state for the duration of data transfer, and will be driven to inactive state for the rest of the time. The active state of QSPIx_SS is specified in SSACTPOL (QSPIx_SSCTL[2])

BitField.name: SSACTPOL
BitField.description:
Slave Selection Active Polarity
This bit defines the active polarity of slave selection signal (QSPIx_SS).

Enum.description: The slave selection signal QSPIx_SS is active low
The slave selection signal QSPIx_SS is active high

BitField.name: AUTOSS
BitField.description: Automatic Slave Selection Function Enable Bit (Master Only)

Enum.description: Automatic slave selection function Disabled. Slave selection signal will be asserted/de-asserted according to SS (QSPIx_SSCTL[0])
Automatic slave selection function Enabled

BitField.name: SLV3WIRE
BitField.description:
Slave 3-wire Mode Enable Bit
In Slave 3-wire mode, the QSPI controller can work with 3-wire interface including QSPIx_CLK, QSPIx_MISO and SPIx_MOSI pins.

Enum.description: 4-wire bi-direction interface
3-wire bi-direction interface

BitField.name: SLVTOIEN
BitField.description: Slave Mode Time-out Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: Slave mode time-out interrupt Disabled
Slave mode time-out interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: SLVTORST
BitField.description: Slave Mode Time-out Reset Control

Enum.description: When Slave mode time-out event occurs, the TX and RX control circuit will not be reset
When Slave mode time-out event occurs, the TX and RX control circuit will be reset by hardware

BitField.name: SLVBEIEN
BitField.description: Slave Mode Bit Count Error Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: Slave mode bit count error interrupt Disabled
Slave mode bit count error interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: SLVURIEN
BitField.description: Slave Mode TX Under Run Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: Slave mode TX under run interrupt Disabled
Slave mode TX under run interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: SSACTIEN
BitField.description: Slave Select Active Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: Slave select active interrupt Disabled
Slave select active interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: SSINAIEN
BitField.description: Slave Select Inactive Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: Slave select inactive interrupt Disabled
Slave select inactive interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: SLVTOCNT
BitField.description:
Slave Mode Time-out Period
In Slave mode, these bits indicate the time-out period when there is bus clock input during slave select active. The clock source of the time-out counter is Slave peripheral clock. If the value is 0, it indicates the slave mode time-out function is disabled.

BitField.name: TXPDMAEN
BitField.description:
Transmit PDMA Enable Bit
Note: In QSPI Master mode with full duplex transfer, if both TX and RX PDMA functions are enabled, RX PDMA function cannot be enabled prior to TX PDMA function. User can enable TX PDMA function firstly or enable both functions simultaneously.

Enum.description: Transmit PDMA function Disabled
Transmit PDMA function Enabled

BitField.name: RXPDMAEN
BitField.description: Receive PDMA Enable Bit

Enum.description: Receive PDMA function Disabled
Receive PDMA function Enabled

BitField.name: PDMARST
BitField.description: PDMA Reset

Enum.description: No effect
Reset the PDMA control logic of the QSPI controller. This bit will be automatically cleared to 0

BitField.name: RXRST
BitField.description: Receive Reset

Enum.description: No effect

Reset receive FIFO pointer and receive circuit. The RXFULL bit will be cleared to 0 and the RXEMPTY bit will be set to 1. This bit will be cleared to 0 by hardware about 3 system clock cycles + 2 peripheral clock cycles after it is set to 1. User can read TXRXRST (QSPIx_STATUS[23]) to check if reset is accomplished or not

BitField.name: TXRST
BitField.description:
Transmit Reset
Note: If TX underflow event occurs in QSPI Slave mode, this bit can be used to make QSPI return to idle state.

Enum.description: No effect

Reset transmit FIFO pointer and transmit circuit. The TXFULL bit will be cleared to 0 and the TXEMPTY bit will be set to 1. This bit will be cleared to 0 by hardware about 3 system clock cycles + 2 peripheral clock cycles after it is set to 1. User can read TXRXRST (QSPIx_STATUS[23]) to check if reset is accomplished or not

BitField.name: RXTHIEN
BitField.description: Receive FIFO Threshold Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: RX FIFO threshold interrupt Disabled
RX FIFO threshold interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: TXTHIEN
BitField.description: Transmit FIFO Threshold Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: TX FIFO threshold interrupt Disabled
TX FIFO threshold interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: RXTOIEN
BitField.description: Receive Time-out Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: Receive time-out interrupt Disabled
Receive time-out interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: RXOVIEN
BitField.description: Receive FIFO Overrun Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: Receive FIFO overrun interrupt Disabled
Receive FIFO overrun interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: TXUFPOL
BitField.description:
TX Underflow Data Polarity
Note 1: The TX underflow event occurs if there is no any data in TX FIFO when the slave selection signal is active.
Note 2: When TX underflow event occurs, QSPIx_MISO pin state will be determined by this setting even though TX FIFO is not empty afterward. Data stored in TX FIFO will be sent through QSPIx_MISO pin in the next transfer frame.

Enum.description: The QSPI data out is keep 0 if there is TX underflow event in Slave mode
The QSPI data out is keep 1 if there is TX underflow event in Slave mode

BitField.name: TXUFIEN
BitField.description:
TX Underflow Interrupt Enable Bit
When TX underflow event occurs in Slave mode, TXUFIF (QSPIx_STATUS[19]) will be set to 1. This bit is used to enable the TX underflow interrupt.

Enum.description: Slave TX underflow interrupt Disabled
Slave TX underflow interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: RXFBCLR
BitField.description:
Receive FIFO Buffer Clear
Note: The RX shift register will not be cleared.

Enum.description: No effect
Clear receive FIFO pointer. The RXFULL bit will be cleared to 0 and the RXEMPTY bit will be set to 1. This bit will be cleared to 0 by hardware about 1 system clock after it is set to 1

BitField.name: TXFBCLR
BitField.description:
Transmit FIFO Buffer Clear
Note: The TX shift register will not be cleared.

Enum.description: No effect
Clear transmit FIFO pointer. The TXFULL bit will be cleared to 0 and the TXEMPTY bit will be set to 1. This bit will be cleared to 0 by hardware about 1 system clock after it is set to 1

BitField.name: RXTH
BitField.description:
Receive FIFO Threshold
If the valid data count of the receive FIFO buffer is larger than the RXTH setting, the RXTHIF bit will be set to 1, else the RXTHIF bit will be cleared to 0.

BitField.name: TXTH
BitField.description:
Transmit FIFO Threshold
If the valid data count of the transmit FIFO buffer is less than or equal to the TXTH setting, the TXTHIF bit will be set to 1, else the TXTHIF bit will be cleared to 0.

BitField.name: BUSY
BitField.description: Busy Status (Read Only)

Enum.description: QSPI controller is in idle state
QSPI controller is in busy state

BitField.name: UNITIF
BitField.description:
Unit Transfer Interrupt Flag
Note: This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.

Enum.description: No transaction has been finished since this bit was cleared to 0
QSPI controller has finished one unit transfer

BitField.name: SSACTIF
BitField.description:
Slave Select Active Interrupt Flag
Note: Only available in Slave mode. This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.

Enum.description: Slave select active interrupt was cleared or not occurred
Slave select active interrupt event occurred

BitField.name: SSINAIF
BitField.description:
Slave Select Inactive Interrupt Flag
Note: Only available in Slave mode. This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.

Enum.description: Slave select inactive interrupt was cleared or not occurred
Slave select inactive interrupt event occurred

BitField.name: SSLINE
BitField.description:
Slave Select Line Bus Status (Read Only)
Note: This bit is only available in Slave mode. If SSACTPOL (QSPIx_SSCTL[2]) is set 0, and the SSLINE is 1, the QSPI slave select is in inactive status.

Enum.description: The slave select line status is 0
The slave select line status is 1

BitField.name: SLVTOIF
BitField.description:
Slave Time-out Interrupt Flag
When the slave select is active and the value of SLVTOCNT is not 0, if the bus clock is detected, the slave time-out counter in QSPI controller logic will be started. When the value of time-out counter is greater than or equal to the value of SLVTOCNT (QSPIx_SSCTL[31:16]) before one transaction is done, the slave time-out interrupt event will be asserted.
Note: This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.

Enum.description: Slave time-out is not active
Slave time-out is active

BitField.name: SLVBEIF
BitField.description:
Slave Mode Bit Count Error Interrupt Flag
In Slave mode, when the slave select line goes to inactive state, if bit counter is mismatch with DWIDTH, this interrupt flag will be set to 1.
Note: If the slave select active but there is no any bus clock input, the SLVBEIF also active when the slave select goes to inactive state. This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it

Enum.description: No Slave mode bit count error event
Slave mode bit count error event occurred

BitField.name: SLVURIF
BitField.description:
Slave Mode TX Under Run Interrupt Flag
In Slave mode, if TX underflow event occurs and the slave select line goes to inactive state, this interrupt flag will be set to 1.
Note: This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.

Enum.description: No Slave TX under run event
Slave TX under run event occurred

BitField.name: RXEMPTY
BitField.description: Receive FIFO Buffer Empty Indicator (Read Only)

Enum.description: Receive FIFO buffer is not empty
Receive FIFO buffer is empty

BitField.name: RXFULL
BitField.description: Receive FIFO Buffer Full Indicator (Read Only)

Enum.description: Receive FIFO buffer is not full
Receive FIFO buffer is full

BitField.name: RXTHIF
BitField.description: Receive FIFO Threshold Interrupt Flag (Read Only)

Enum.description: The valid data count within the receive FIFO buffer is smaller than or equal to the setting value of RXTH
The valid data count within the receive FIFO buffer is larger than the setting value of RXTH

BitField.name: RXOVIF
BitField.description:
Receive FIFO Overrun Interrupt Flag
When the receive FIFO buffer is full, the follow-up data will be dropped and this bit will be set to 1.
Note: This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.

Enum.description: No FIFO is overrun
Receive FIFO is overrun

BitField.name: RXTOIF
BitField.description:
Receive Time-out Interrupt Flag
Note: This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.

Enum.description: No receive FIFO time-out event

Receive FIFO buffer is not empty and no read operation on receive FIFO buffer over 64 QSPI peripheral clock periods in Master mode or over 576 QSPI peripheral clock periods in Slave mode. When the received FIFO buffer is read by software, the time-out status will be cleared automatically

BitField.name: SPIENSTS
BitField.description:
QSPI Enable Status (Read Only)
Note: The QSPI peripheral clock is asynchronous with the system clock. In order to make sure the QSPI control logic is disabled, this bit indicates the real status of QSPI controller.

Enum.description: QSPI controller Disabled
QSPI controller Enabled

BitField.name: TXEMPTY
BitField.description: Transmit FIFO Buffer Empty Indicator (Read Only)

Enum.description: Transmit FIFO buffer is not empty
Transmit FIFO buffer is empty

BitField.name: TXFULL
BitField.description: Transmit FIFO Buffer Full Indicator (Read Only)

Enum.description: Transmit FIFO buffer is not full
Transmit FIFO buffer is full

BitField.name: TXTHIF
BitField.description: Transmit FIFO Threshold Interrupt Flag (Read Only)

Enum.description: The valid data count within the transmit FIFO buffer is larger than the setting value of TXTH
The valid data count within the transmit FIFO buffer is less than or equal to the setting value of TXTH

BitField.name: TXUFIF
BitField.description:
TX Underflow Interrupt Flag
When the TX underflow event occurs, this bit will be set to 1, the state of data output pin depends on the setting of TXUFPOL.
Note 1: This bit will be cleared by writing 1 to it.
Note 2: If reset slave's transmission circuit when slave selection signal is active, this flag will be set to 1 after 2 peripheral clock cycles + 3 system clock cycles since the reset operation is done.

Enum.description: No effect
No data in Transmit FIFO and TX shift register when the slave selection signal is active

BitField.name: TXRXRST
BitField.description:
TX or RX Reset Status (Read Only)
Note: Both the reset operations of TXRST and RXRST need 3 system clock cycles + 2 peripheral clock cycles. User can check the status of this bit to monitor the reset function is doing or done.

Enum.description: The reset function of TXRST or RXRST is done

BitField.name: RXCNT
BitField.description:
Receive FIFO Data Count (Read Only)
This bit field indicates the valid data count of receive FIFO buffer.

BitField.name: TXCNT
BitField.description:
Transmit FIFO Data Count (Read Only)
This bit field indicates the valid data count of transmit FIFO buffer.

BitField.name: TX
BitField.description:
Data Transmit Register
The data transmit registers pass through the transmitted data into the 8-level transmit FIFO buffers. The number of valid bits depends on the setting of DWIDTH (QSPIx_CTL[12:8]) in QSPI mode.
In QSPI mode, if DWIDTH is set to 0x08, the bits TX[7:0] will be transmitted. If DWIDTH is set to 0x00, the QSPI controller will perform a 32-bit transfer.
Note: In Master mode, QSPI controller will start to transfer the QSPI bus clock after 1 APB clock and 6 peripheral clock cycles after user writes to this register.

BitField.name: RX
BitField.description:
Data Receive Register (Read Only)
There are 8-level FIFO buffers in this controller. The data receive register holds the data received from QSPI data input pin. If the RXEMPTY (QSPIx_STATUS[8) is not set to 1, the receive FIFO buffers can be accessed through software by reading this register.

BitField.name: TXTH

BitField.name: SLVTOIF

When the value of time-out counter is greater than or equal to the value of SLVTOCNT (QSPIx_SSCTL[31:16]) before one transaction is done, the slave time-out interrupt event will be asserted.

BitField.name: TX
BitField.description:
Data Transmit Register
The data transmit registers pass through the transmitted data into the 8-level transmit FIFO buffers. The number of valid bits depends on the setting of DWIDTH (QSPIx_CTL[12:8]) in QSPI mode.
In QSPI mode, if DWIDTH is set to 0x08, the bits TX[7:0] will be transmitted. If DWIDTH is set to 0x00, the QSPI controller will perform a 32-bit transfer.
Note: In Master mode, QSPI controller will start to transfer the QSPI bus clock after 1 APB clock and 6 peripheral clock cycles after user writes to this register.

BitField.name: RX
BitField.description:
Data Receive Register (Read Only)
There are 8-level FIFO buffers in this controller. The data receive register holds the data received from QSPI data input pin. If the RXEMPTY (QSPIx_STATUS[8) is not set to 1, the receive FIFO buffers can be accessed through software by reading this register.

BitField.name: OPMODE
BitField.description:
SPI Function Operation Mode
Note1: After using Normal I/O mode of SPI Flash controller to program the content of external SPI Flash, please set CDINVAL(SPIM_CTL1[3]) to 0x1 (Set all cache data to be invalid).
Note2: In DMA write mode, hardware will send just one page program command per operation. Users must take care of cross-page cases. After using DMA write mode of SPI Flash controller to program the content of external SPI Flash, please set CDINVAL(SPIM_CTL1[3]) to 0x1 (Set all cache data to be invalid).
Note3: For external SPI Flash with 32 Mbytes, access address range of external SPI Flash address is from 0x00000000 to 0x01FFFFFF when using Normal I/O mode, DMA write mode, and DMA read mode to write/read external SPI Flash data. Please user check size of used SPI Flash component to know access address range of external SPI Flash.
Note4: For external SPI Flash with 32 Mbytes, access address range of external SPI Flash address is from 0x08000000 to 0x09FFFFFF when using Direct Memory mapping mode (DMM mode) to read external SPI Flash data. Please user check size of used SPI Flash component to know access address range of external SPI Flash.

Enum.description: Normal I/O mode. (Note1) (Note3)
DMA write mode. (Note2) (Note3)
DMA read mode. (Note3)
Direct Memory Mapping mode (DMM mode) (Default). (Note4)

BitField.name: CMDCODE
BitField.description:
Page Program Command Code (Note4)
The Others command codes are Reserved.
The DTR/DDR read commands '0x0D,0xBD,0xED' improves throughput by transferring address and data on both the falling and rising edge of SPI Flash clock (SPIM_CLK). It is similar to those commands '0x0B, 0xBB, 0xEB' but allows transfer of address and data on rising edge and falling edge of SPI Flash output clock. (Note2)
Note1: Quad mode of SPI Flash must be enabled first by normal I/O mode before using quad page program/quad read commands.
Note2: See SPI Flash specifications for support items.
Note3: For TYPE_1, TYPE_2, and TYPE_3 of page program command code, refer to Figure 6.223, Figure 6.224, and Figure 6.225.
Note4: Please disable 'continuous read mode' and 'burst wrap mode' before DMA write mode of SPI Flash controller is used to program data of external SPI Flash. After using DMA write mode of SPI Flash controller to program the content of external SPI Flash, please set CDINVAL(SPIM_CTL1[3]) to 0x1 (Set all cache data to be invalid).

Enum.description: Page program (Used for DMA Write mode)
Standard Read (Used for DMA Read/DMM mode)
Fast Read (Used for DMA Read/DMM mode)
DTR/DDR Fast read (Used for DMA Read/DMM mode)
Quad page program with TYPE_1 program flow (Used for DMA Write mode). (Note3)
Quad page program with TYPE_2 program flow (Used for DMA Write mode). (Note3)
Fast Read Dual Output (Used for DMA Read/DMM mode)
Quad page program with TYPE_3 program flow (Used for DMA Write mode). (Note3)
Fast Read Dual I/O (Used for DMA Read/DMM mode)
DTR/DDR dual read (Used for DMA Read/DMM mode)
Word quad read (Used for DMA Read/DMM mode)
Fast quad read (Used for DMA Read/DMM mode)
DTR/DDR quad read (Used for DMA Read/DMM mode)

BitField.name: CCMEN

Note1: When CCM mode is enabled, the cache function will be disable by hardware automatically. When CCM mode is disabled, the cache function can be enabled or disabled by user.
Note2: When CCM mode is disabled, user accesses the core coupled memory by bus master. In this case, the SPI Flash controller will send error response via HRESP bus signal to bus master.
Note3: When CCM mode needs to be enabled, user sets CCMEN to 1 and needs to read this register to show the current hardware status. When reading data of CCMEN is 1, MCU can start to read data from CCM memory space or write data to CCM memory space.

BitField.name: IDLETIME

BitField.name: DIVIDER
BitField.description:
Clock Divider Register
The value in this field is the frequency divider of the AHB clock (HCLK) to generate the serial SPI output clock 'SCLK' on the output SPIM_CLK pin. The desired frequency is obtained according to the following equation:

Note1: When set DIVIDER to zero, the frequency of SPIM_CLK will be equal to the frequency of HCLK.
Note2: SCLK is serial SPI output clock.
Note3: Please check the specification of the used SPI Flash component to decide the frequency of SPI Flash clock.
Note4: For DTR/DDR read commands '0x0D, 0xBD, 0xED', the setting values of DIVIDER are only all multiples of 2. For example, 1,2,4,8,16,32,...

BitField.name: DWDELSEL
BitField.description:
SPI Flash Deselect Time Interval of DMA Write Mode (for DMA Write Mode Only)
The bits set the deselect time interval of SPI Flash (i.e. time interval of inactive level of SPIM_SS) when SPI Flash controller operates on DMA write mode. (Note1)

BitField.name: PHDELSEL
BitField.description:
SPI Flash Phase Delay Time (for DMA Write Mode, DMA Read Mode)
The bits set phase delay time between command data phase, address data phase, and dummy cycle phase, where SPI Flash controller will send those phase data to external SPI Flash.

BitField.name: RDDLYSEL
BitField.description:
Sampling Clock Delay Selection for Received Data (for Normal I/O Mode, DMA Rread Mode, DMA Write Mode, and Direct Memory Mapping Mode)
Determine the number of inserted delay cycles. Used to adjust the sampling clock of received data to latch the correct data.
0x0: No delay. (Default)
0x1: Delay 1 SPI Flash clock.
0x2: Delay 2 SPI Flash clocks.
0x3: Delay 3 SPI Flash clocks.
...
0x7: Delay 7 SPI Flash clocks
Note: The manufacturer or device ID of external SPI Flash component can be used to determine the correct setting value of RDDLYSEL. An example is given as follows.
For example, the manufacturer ID and device ID of external SPI Flash for some vendor are 0xEF and 0x1234 separately. First, set RDDLYSEL to 0x0, and use read manufacturer id/device id command to read the manufacturer id of external SPI Flash by using normal I/O mode (the manufacturer id is 0xEF (1110_1111) in this example).
If the manufacturer ID which reads from external SPI Flash is 0xF7 (1111_0111), it denotes that manufacturer id is shifted the right by 1 bit and most significant bit (MSB) of manufacturer id is assigned to 1. According to manufacturer id reads from external SPI Flash, RDDLYSEL needs to be set to 0x1 to receive SPI Flash data correctly.

BitField.name: RDEDGE
BitField.description: Sampling Clock Edge Selection for Received Data (for Normal I/O Mode, DMA Read Mode, DMA Write Mode, and Direct Memory Mapping Mode)

Enum.description: Use SPI input clock rising edge to sample received data. (Default)
Use SPI input clock falling edge to sample received data

For DMA Read mode, this is the destination address for DMA transfer.

Note: This address must be word-aligned.

BitField.name: DMACNT
BitField.description:
DMA Transfer Byte Count Register
It indicates the transfer length for DMA process.
Note1: The unit for counting is byte.
Note2: The number must be the multiple of 4.
Note3: Please check specification of used SPI Flash to know maximum byte length of page program.

BitField.name: ADDR
BitField.description:
SPI Flash Address Register
For DMA Read mode, this is the source address for DMA transfer.
For DMA Write mode, this is the destination address for DMA transfer.
Note1: This address must be word-aligned.
Note2: For external SPI Flash with 32 Mbytes, the value of this SPI Flash address register 'ADDR' is from 0x00000000 to 0x01FFFFFF when using DMA write mode and DMA read mode to write/read external SPI Flash data. Please user check size of used SPI Flash component to know access address range of external SPI Flash.

BitField.name: KEY1
BitField.description:
Cipher Key1 Register
This is the KEY1 data for cipher function.
Note1: If there is not any KEY1(SPIM_KEY1[31:0]) or KEY2(SPIM_KEY2[31:0]) (KEY1 is 0x0000_0000 or KEY2 is 0x0000_0000), the cipher function will be disabled automatically.
Note2: When CIPHOFF(SPIM_CTL0[0]) is 0, both of KEY1(SPIM_KEY1[31:0]) and KEY2(SPIM_KEY2[31:0]) do not equal to 0x0000_0000 (i.e. KEY1 0x0000_0000 and KEY20x0000_0000), cipher encryption/decryption is enabled.

BitField.name: KEY2
BitField.description:
Cipher Key2 Register
This is the KEY2 data for cipher function.
Note1: If there is not any KEY1(SPIM_KEY1[31:0]) or KEY2(SPIM_KEY2[31:0]) (KEY1 is 0x0000_0000 or KEY2 is 0x0000_0000), the cipher function will be disabled automatically.
Note2: When CIPHOFF(SPIM_CTL0[0]) is 0, both of KEY1(SPIM_KEY1[31:0]) and KEY2(SPIM_KEY2[31:0]) do not equal to 0x0000_0000 (i.e. KEY1 0x0000_0000 and KEY20x0000_0000), cipher encryption/decryption is enabled.

Register.name: SPIM_DMMCTL
Register.description: Direct Memory Mapping Mode Control Register

BitField.name: CRMDAT
BitField.description:
Mode Bits Data for Continuous Read Mode (or Performance Enhance Mode) (Only for Direct Memory Mapping Mode)
Set the mode bits data for continuous read mode (or performance enhance mode).
When setting this mode bits currently (Note1) and set CREN(SPIM_DMMCTL[25]), this reduces the command phase by eight clocks and allows the read address to be immediately entered after SPIM_SS asserted to active. (Note1)
Note1: Please check the used SPI Flash specification to know the setting value of this mode bits data, and different SPI Flash vendor may use different setting values.
Note2: CRMDAT needs to be used with CREN(SPIM_DMMCTL[25]).

BitField.name: DESELTIM
BitField.description:
SPI Flash Deselect Time (Only for Direct Memory Mapping Mode)
Set the minimum time width of SPI Flash deselect time (i.e. Minimum SPIM_SS deselect time), as shown in Figure 6.2211.
(1) Cache function disable:
Note3: Please check the used SPI Flash specification to know the setting value of this register, and different SPI Flash vendor may use different setting values.

BitField.name: BWEN
BitField.description:
16 Bytes Burst Wrap Mode Enable Bit (Only for Direct Memory Mapping Mode, Cache Enable, and Read Command Code '0xEB, and 0xE7')
In direct memory mapping mode, both of quad read commands '0xEB' and '0xE7' support burst wrap mode for cache application and performance enhance. For cache application, the burst wrap mode can be used to fill the cache line quickly (In this SPI Flash controller, use cache data line with 16 bytes size). For performance enhance with direct memory mapping mode and cache enable, when cache data is miss, the burst wrap mode can let MCU get the required SPI Flash data quickly.

Enum.description: Burst Wrap Mode Disabled. (Default)
Burst Wrap Mode Enabled

BitField.name: CREN
BitField.description:
Continuous Read Mode Enable Bit (Only for Direct Memory Mapping Mode, Read Command Codes 0xBB, 0xEB, 0xE7, 0x0D, 0xBD, 0xED)
For read operations of SPI Flash, commands of fast read quad I/O (0xEB), word read quad I/O (0xE7), fast read dual I/O (0xBB), DTR/DDR fast read (0x0D), DTR/DDR fast read dual I/O (0xBD), and DTR/DDR fast read quad I/O (0xED) can further reduce command overhead through setting the 'continuous read mode' bits (8 bits) after the input address data.
Note: When using function of continuous read mode and setting USETEN (SPIM_CTL2[16]) to 1, CRMDAT(SPIM_DMMCTL[15:8]) must be set by used SPI Flash specifications. When using function of continuous read mode and setting USETEN(SPIM_CTL2[16]) to 0, CRMDAT(SPIM_DMMCTL[15:8]) is set to value 0x20.

Enum.description: Continuous Read Mode Disabled. (Default)
Continuous Read Mode Enabled

BitField.name: UACTSCLK
BitField.description:
User Sets SPI Flash Active SCLK Time (Only for Direct Memory Mapping Mode, DMA Write Mode, and DMA Read Mode)
Note: When user wants to set ACTSCLKT(SPIM_DMMCTL[31:28]) manually, please set UACTSCLK to 1.

Enum.description: According to DIVIDER(SPIM_CTL1[31:16]), ACTSCLKT(SPIM_DMMCTL[31:28]) is set by hardware automatically. (Default)
Set ACTSCLKT(SPIM_DMMCTL[31:28]) by user manually

BitField.name: ACTSCLKT
BitField.description:
SPI Flash Active SCLK Time (Only for Direct Memory Mapping Mode, DMA Write Mode, and DMA Read Mode)
The bits set time interval between SPIM SS active edge and the position edge of the first serial SPI output clock, as shown in Figure 6.2211..
Note2: SCLK is SPI output clock
Note3: Please check the used SPI Flash specification to know the setting value of this register, and different SPI Flash vendor may use different setting values.

BitField.name: USETEN
BitField.description:
User Set Value Enable Bit (Only for Direct Memory Mapping Mode and DMA Read Mode with Read Commands 0x03,0x0B,0x3B,0xBB,0xEB,0xE7)
For DTR/DDR command codes 0x0D, 0xBD, and 0xED, please set USETEN to 0x1.

Enum.description: Hardware circuit of SPI Flash controller will use the following default values of DCNUM(SPIM_CTL2[28:24]) and CRMDAT(SPIM_DMMCTL[15:8]) to configure SPI Flash operations automatically

If DCNUM(SPIM_CTL2[28:24]) and CRMDAT(SPIM_DMMCTL[15:8]) are not set as above default values, user must set USETEN to 0x1, DCNUM(SPIM_CTL2[28:24]) and CRMDAT(SPIM_DMMCTL[15:8]) to configure SPI Flash operations manually

BitField.name: DTRMPOFF
BitField.description:
Mode Phase OFF for DTR/DDR Command Codes 0x0D, 0xBD, and 0xED (Only for Direct Memory Mapping Mode and DMA Read Mode)
Note: Please check the used SPI Flash specification to know the mode cycle number (or performance enhance cycle number) for DTR/DDR command codes 0x0D, 0xBD, and 0xED.

Enum.description: Mode cycle number (or performance enhance cycle number) does not equal to 0x0 in DTR/DDR read command codes 0x0D, 0xBD, and 0xED
mode cycle number (or performance enhance cycle number) equals to 0x0 in DTR/DDR read command codes 0x0D, 0xBD, and 0xED

BitField.name: DCNUM
BitField.description:
Dummy Cycle Number (Only for Direct Memory Mapping Mode and DMA Read Mode)
Set number of dummy cycles
(1) For non-DTR/non-DDR command codes 0x03, 0x0B, 0x3B, 0xBB, 0xEB, and 0xE7:
For command codes 0x0B, 0x3B, 0xEB, and 0xE7, user only set DCNUM to dummy cycle number by used SPI Flash specification.

(2) For DTR/DDR command codes 0x0D, 0xBD, and 0xED:
user sets DCNUM to dummy cycle number and DTRMPOFF(SPIM_CTL2[20]) by used SPI Flash specification.
Note: Number of dummy cycles depends on the frequency of SPI output clock, SPI Flash vendor, and read command types. Please check the used SPI Flash specification to know the setting value of this number of dummy cycles.

BitField.name: SI

BitField.name: STA

Setting STA to logic 1 to enter Master mode, the I2C hardware sends a START or repeat START condition to bus when the bus is free.

BitField.name: ADDRMSK
BitField.description:
I2C Address Mask
I2C bus controllers support multiple address recognition with four address mask register. When the bit in the address mask register is set to one, it means the received corresponding address bit is don't-care. If the bit is set to zero, that means the received corresponding register bit should be exact the same as address register.
Note: The wake-up function can not use address mask.

Enum.description: Mask Disabled (the received corresponding register bit should be exact the same as address register.)

BitField.name: ADDR
BitField.description:
I2C Address
The content of this register is irrelevant when I2C is in Master mode. In the slave mode, the seven most significant bits must be loaded with the chip's own address. The I2C hardware will react if either of the address is matched.
Note: When software set 10'h000, the address can not be used.

BitField.name: DAT
BitField.description:
I2C Data
Bit [7:0] is located with the 8-bit transferred/received data of I2C serial port.

BitField.name: STATUS
BitField.description: I2C Status

BitField.name: DIVIDER
BitField.description:
I2C Clock Divided
Note: The minimum value of I2C_CLKDIV is 4.

BitField.name: TOIF
BitField.description:
Time-out Flag
This bit is set by hardware when I2C time-out happened and it can interrupt CPU if I2C interrupt enable bit (INTEN) is set to 1.
Note: Software can write 1 to clear this bit.

BitField.name: TOCDIV4
BitField.description:
Time-out Counter Input Clock Divided by 4
When enabled, the time-out period is extended 4 times.

Enum.description: Time-out period is extend 4 times Disabled
Time-out period is extend 4 times Enabled

BitField.name: TOCEN
BitField.description:
Time-out Counter Enable Bit
When enabled, the 14-bit time-out counter will start counting when SI is cleared. Setting flag SI to '1' will reset counter and re-start up counting after SI is cleared.

Enum.description: Time-out counter Disabled
Time-out counter Enabled

BitField.name: GC
BitField.description: General Call Function

Enum.description: General Call Function Disabled
General Call Function Enabled

BitField.name: ADDRMSK
BitField.description:
I2C Address Mask
I2C bus controllers support multiple address recognition with four address mask register. When the bit in the address mask register is set to one, it means the received corresponding address bit is don't-care. If the bit is set to zero, that means the received corresponding register bit should be exact the same as address register.
Note: The wake-up function can not use address mask.

Enum.description: Mask Disabled (the received corresponding register bit should be exact the same as address register.)
Mask Enabled (the received corresponding address bit is don't care.)

BitField.name: WKEN
BitField.description: I2C Wake-up Enable Bit

Enum.description: I2C wake-up function Disabled
I2C wake-up function Enabled

BitField.name: NHDBUSEN
BitField.description:
I2C No Hold BUS Enable Bit
Note: The I2C controller could respond when WKIF event is not clear, it may cause error data transmitted or received. If data transmitted or received when WKIF event is not clear, user must reset I2C controller and execute the original operation again.

Enum.description: I2C hold bus after wake-up
I2C don't hold bus after wake-up

BitField.name: WKIF
BitField.description:
I2C Wake-up Flag
When chip is woken up from Power-down mode by I2C, this bit is set to 1. Software can write 1 to clear this bit.

BitField.name: WKAKDONE
BitField.description:
Wakeup Address Frame Acknowledge Bit Done
Note: This bit can't release WKIF. Software can write 1 to clear this bit.

Enum.description: The ACK bit cycle of address match frame isn't done
The ACK bit cycle of address match frame is done in power-down

BitField.name: WRSTSWK
BitField.description:
Read/Write Status Bit in Address Wakeup Frame
Note: This bit will be cleared when software can write 1 to WKAKDONE bit.

Enum.description: Write command be record on the address match wakeup frame
Read command be record on the address match wakeup frame

BitField.name: TXPDMAEN
BitField.description: PDMA Transmit Channel Available

Enum.description: Transmit PDMA function Disabled
Transmit PDMA function Enabled

BitField.name: RXPDMAEN
BitField.description: PDMA Receive Channel Available

Enum.description: Receive PDMA function Disabled
Receive PDMA function Enabled

BitField.name: PDMARST
BitField.description: PDMA Reset

Enum.description: No effect
Reset the I2C request to PDMA

BitField.name: PDMASTR
BitField.description: PDMA Stretch Bit

Enum.description: I2C send STOP automatically after PDMA transfer done. (only master TX)
I2C SCL bus is stretched by hardware after PDMA transfer done if the SI is not cleared. (only master TX)

BitField.name: ADDR10EN
BitField.description: Address 10-bit Function Enable Bit

Enum.description: Address match 10-bit function Disabled
Address match 10-bit function Enabled

BitField.name: ADMAT0
BitField.description:
I2C Address 0 Match Status
When address 0 is matched, hardware will inform which address used. This bit will set to 1, and software can write 1 to clear this bit.

BitField.name: ADMAT1
BitField.description:
I2C Address 1 Match Status
When address 1 is matched, hardware will inform which address used. This bit will set to 1, and software can write 1 to clear this bit.

BitField.name: ADMAT2
BitField.description:
I2C Address 2 Match Status
When address 2 is matched, hardware will inform which address used. This bit will set to 1, and software can write 1 to clear this bit.

BitField.name: ADMAT3
BitField.description:
I2C Address 3 Match Status
When address 3 is matched, hardware will inform which address used. This bit will set to 1, and software can write 1 to clear this bit.

BitField.name: ONBUSY
BitField.description:
On Bus Busy (Read Only)
Indicates that a communication is in progress on the bus. It is set by hardware when a START condition is detected. It is cleared by hardware when a STOP condition is detected.

Enum.description: The bus is IDLE (both SCLK and SDA High)
The bus is busy

BitField.name: STCTL
BitField.description:
Setup Time Configure Control
This field is used to generate a delay timing between SDA falling edge and SCL rising edge in transmission mode.
Note: Setup time setting should not make SCL output less than three PCLKs.

BitField.name: HTCTL
BitField.description:
Hold Time Configure Control
This field is used to generate the delay timing between SCL falling edge and SDA rising edge in transmission mode.

BitField.name: ACKMEN
BitField.description:
Acknowledge Control by Manual
In order to allow ACK control in slave reception including the command and data, slave byte control mode must be enabled by setting the ACKMEN bit.

Enum.description: Slave byte control Disabled
Slave byte control Enabled. The 9th bit can response the ACK or NACK according the received data by user. When the byte is received, stretching the SCLK signal low between the 8th and 9th SCLK pulse

BitField.name: PECEN
BitField.description:
Packet Error Checking Calculation Enable Bit
Note: When I2C enter powerdown mode, the bit should be enabled after wake-up if needed PEC calculation.

Enum.description: Packet Error Checking Calculation Disabled
Packet Error Checking Calculation Enabled

BitField.name: BMDEN
BitField.description: Bus Management Device Default Address Enable Bit

Enum.description: Device default address Disable. When the address 0'b1100001x coming and the both of BMDEN and ACKMEN are enabled, the device responses NACKed
Device default address Enabled. When the address 0'b1100001x coming and the both of BMDEN and ACKMEN are enabled, the device responses ACKed

BitField.name: BMHEN
BitField.description: Bus Management Host Enable Bit

Enum.description: Host function Disabled
Host function Enabled

BitField.name: ALERTEN
BitField.description: Bus Management Alert Enable Bit

Enum.description:
Release the BM_ALERT pin high and Alert Response Header disabled: 0001100x followed by NACK if both of BMDEN and ACKMEN are enabled.
BM_ALERT pin not supported

Drive BM_ALERT pin low and Alert Response Address Header enables: 0001100x followed by ACK if both of BMDEN and ACKMEN are enabled.
BM_ALERT pin supported

BitField.name: SCTLOSTS
BitField.description: Suspend/Control Data Output Status

Enum.description: The output of SUSCON pin is low
The output of SUSCON pin is high

BitField.name: SCTLOEN
BitField.description: Suspend or Control Pin Output Enable Bit

Enum.description: The SUSCON pin in input
The output enable is active on the SUSCON pin

BitField.name: BUSEN
BitField.description:
BUS Enable Bit
Note: When the bit is enabled, the internal 14-bit counter is used to calculate the time out event of clock low condition.

Enum.description: The system management function Disabled
The system management function Enabled

BitField.name: PECTXEN
BitField.description: Packet Error Checking Byte Transmission/Reception

Enum.description: No PEC transfer
PEC transmission is requested

BitField.name: TIDLE
BitField.description:
Timer Check in Idle State
The BUSTOUT is used to calculate the time-out of clock low in bus active and the idle period in bus Idle. This bit is used to define which condition is enabled.
Note: The BUSY (I2C_BUSSTS[0]) indicate the current bus state.

Enum.description: BUSTOUT is used to calculate the clock low period in bus active
BUSTOUT is used to calculate the IDLE period in bus Idle

BitField.name: PECCLR
BitField.description:
PEC Clear at Repeat Start
The calculation of PEC starts when PECEN is set to 1 and it is cleared when the STA or STO bit is detected. This PECCLR bit is used to enable the condition of REPEAT START can clear the PEC calculation.

Enum.description: PEC calculation is cleared by 'Repeat Start' function Disabled
PEC calculation is cleared by 'Repeat Start' function Enabled

BitField.name: ACKM9SI
BitField.description: Acknowledge Manual Enable Extra SI Interrupt

Enum.description: There is no SI interrupt in the 9th clock cycle when the BUSEN =1 and ACKMEN =1
There is SI interrupt in the 9th clock cycle when the BUSEN =1 and ACKMEN =1

BitField.name: BCDIEN
BitField.description: Packet Error Checking Byte Count Done Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: Byte count done interrupt Disabled
Byte count done interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: PECDIEN
BitField.description: Packet Error Checking Byte Transfer Done Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: PEC transfer done interrupt Disabled
PEC transfer done interrupt Enabled

Register.name: I2C_BUSTCTL
Register.description: I2C Bus Management Timer Control Register

BitField.name: BUSTOEN
BitField.description: Bus Time Out Enable Bit

Enum.description: Bus clock low time-out detection Disabled
Bus clock low time-out detection Enabled (bus clock is low for more than TTime-out (in BIDLE=0) or high more than TTime-out(in BIDLE =1)

BitField.name: CLKTOEN
BitField.description:
Cumulative Clock Low Time Out Enable Bit
For Master, it calculates the period from START to ACK
For Slave, it calculates the period from START to STOP

Enum.description: Cumulative clock low time-out detection Disabled
Cumulative clock low time-out detection Enabled

BitField.name: BUSTOIEN
BitField.description: Time-out Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description:
SCLK low time-out interrupt Disabled.
Bus IDLE time-out interrupt Disabled

SCLK low time-out interrupt Enabled.
Bus IDLE time-out interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: CLKTOIEN
BitField.description: Extended Clock Time Out Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: Clock time out interrupt Disabled
Clock time out interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: TORSTEN
BitField.description: Time Out Reset Enable Bit

Enum.description: I2C state machine reset Disabled
I2C state machine reset Enabled. (The clock and data bus will be released to high)

BitField.name: BUSY
BitField.description:
Bus Busy
Indicates that a communication is in progress on the bus. It is set by hardware when a START condition is detected. It is cleared by hardware when a STOP condition is detected

Enum.description: Bus is IDLE (both SCLK and SDA High)
Bus is busy

BitField.name: BCDONE
BitField.description:
Byte Count Transmission/Receive Done
Note: Software can write 1 to clear this bit.

Enum.description: Byte count transmission/ receive is not finished when the PECEN is set
Byte count transmission/ receive is finished when the PECEN is set

BitField.name: PECERR
BitField.description:
PEC Error in Reception
Note: Software can write 1 to clear this bit.

Enum.description: PEC value equal the received PEC data packet
PEC value doesn't match the receive PEC data packet

BitField.name: ALERT
BitField.description:
SMBus Alert Status
Note: 1. The SMBALERT pin is an open-drain pin, the pull-high resistor is must in the system. 2. Software can write 1 to clear this bit.

Enum.description:
SMBALERT pin state is low.
No SMBALERT event

SMBALERT pin state is high.
There is SMBALERT event (falling edge) is detected in SMALERT pin when the BMHEN = 1 (SMBus host configuration) and the ALERTEN = 1

BitField.name: SCTLDIN
BitField.description: Bus Suspend or Control Signal Input Status

Enum.description: The input status of SUSCON pin is 0
The input status of SUSCON pin is 1

BitField.name: BUSTO
BitField.description:
Bus Time-out Status
In bus busy, the bit indicates the total clock low time-out event occurred; otherwise, it indicates the bus idle time-out event occurred.
Note: Software can write 1 to clear this bit.

Enum.description: There is no any time-out or external clock time-out
A time-out or external clock time-out occurred

BitField.name: CLKTO
BitField.description:
Clock Low Cumulate Time-out Status
Note: Software can write 1 to clear this bit.

Enum.description: Cumulative clock low is no any time-out
Cumulative clock low time-out occurred

BitField.name: PECDONE
BitField.description:
PEC Byte Transmission/Receive Done
Note: Software can write 1 to clear this bit.

Enum.description: PEC transmission/ receive is not finished when the PECEN is set
PEC transmission/ receive is finished when the PECEN is set

Register.name: I2C_PKTSIZE
Register.description: I2C Packet Error Checking Byte Number Register

BitField.name: PLDSIZE
BitField.description:
Transfer Byte Number
The transmission or receive byte number in one transaction when the PECEN is set. The maximum transaction or receive byte is 256 Bytes.
Note: The byte number counting includes address, command code, and data frame.

Register.name: I2C_PKTCRC
Register.description: I2C Packet Error Checking Byte Value Register

BitField.name: PECCRC
BitField.description: Packet Error Checking Byte Value

BitField.name: BUSTO
BitField.description:
Bus Management Time-out Value
Indicates the bus time-out value in bus is IDLE or SCLK low.
Note: If the user wants to revise the value of BUSTOUT, the TORSTEN (I2C_BUSTCTL[4]) bit shall be set to 1 and cleared to 0 first when the BUSEN(I2C_BUSCTL[7]) is set.

Register.name: I2C_CLKTOUT
Register.description: I2C Bus Management Clock Low Timer Register

BitField.name: CLKTO
BitField.description:
Bus Clock Low Timer
The field is used to configure the cumulative clock extension time-out.
Note: If the user wants to revise the value of CLKLTOUT, the TORSTEN bit shall be set to 1 and cleared to 0 first when the BUSEN is set.

BitField.name: AA
BitField.description: Assert Acknowledge Control

BitField.name: SI
BitField.description:
I2C Interrupt Flag
When a new I2C state is present in the I2C_STATUS0 register, the SI flag is set by hardware. If bit INTEN (I2C_CTL0 [7]) is set, the I2C interrupt is requested. SI must be cleared by software. Clear SI by writing 1 to this bit.
For ACKMEN is set in slave read mode, the SI flag is set in 8th clock period for user to confirm the acknowledge bit and 9th clock period for user to read the data in the data buffer.

BitField.name: STO
BitField.description:
I2C STOP Control
In Master mode, setting STO to transmit a STOP condition to bus then I2C controller will check the bus condition if a STOP condition is detected. This bit will be cleared by hardware automatically.

BitField.name: STA
BitField.description:
I2C START Control
Setting STA to logic 1 to enter Master mode, the I2C hardware sends a START or repeat START condition to bus when the bus is free.
