Device default address Enabled. When the address 0'b1100001x coming and the both of BMDEN and ACKMEN are enabled, the device responses ACKed

BitField.name: BMHEN
BitField.description: Bus Management Host Enable Bit

Enum.description: Host function Disabled
Host function Enabled

BitField.name: ALERTEN
BitField.description: Bus Management Alert Enable Bit

Enum.description:
Release the BM_ALERT pin high and Alert Response Header disabled: 0001100x followed by NACK if both of BMDEN and ACKMEN are enabled.
BM_ALERT pin not supported

Drive BM_ALERT pin low and Alert Response Address Header enables: 0001100x followed by ACK if both of BMDEN and ACKMEN are enabled.
BM_ALERT pin supported

BitField.name: SCTLOSTS
BitField.description: Suspend/Control Data Output Status

Enum.description: The output of SUSCON pin is low
The output of SUSCON pin is high

BitField.name: SCTLOEN
BitField.description: Suspend or Control Pin Output Enable Bit

Enum.description: The SUSCON pin in input
The output enable is active on the SUSCON pin

BitField.name: BUSEN
BitField.description:
BUS Enable Bit
Note: When the bit is enabled, the internal 14-bit counter is used to calculate the time out event of clock low condition.

Enum.description: The system management function Disabled
The system management function Enabled

BitField.name: PECTXEN
BitField.description: Packet Error Checking Byte Transmission/Reception

Enum.description: No PEC transfer
PEC transmission is requested

BitField.name: TIDLE
BitField.description:
Timer Check in Idle State
The BUSTOUT is used to calculate the time-out of clock low in bus active and the idle period in bus Idle. This bit is used to define which condition is enabled.
Note: The BUSY (I2C_BUSSTS[0]) indicate the current bus state.

Enum.description: BUSTOUT is used to calculate the clock low period in bus active
BUSTOUT is used to calculate the IDLE period in bus Idle

BitField.name: PECCLR
BitField.description:
PEC Clear at Repeat Start
The calculation of PEC starts when PECEN is set to 1 and it is cleared when the STA or STO bit is detected. This PECCLR bit is used to enable the condition of REPEAT START can clear the PEC calculation.

Enum.description: PEC calculation is cleared by 'Repeat Start' function Disabled
PEC calculation is cleared by 'Repeat Start' function Enabled

BitField.name: ACKM9SI
BitField.description: Acknowledge Manual Enable Extra SI Interrupt

Enum.description: There is no SI interrupt in the 9th clock cycle when the BUSEN =1 and ACKMEN =1
There is SI interrupt in the 9th clock cycle when the BUSEN =1 and ACKMEN =1

BitField.name: BCDIEN
BitField.description: Packet Error Checking Byte Count Done Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: Byte count done interrupt Disabled
Byte count done interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: PECDIEN
BitField.description: Packet Error Checking Byte Transfer Done Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: PEC transfer done interrupt Disabled
PEC transfer done interrupt Enabled

Register.name: I2C_BUSTCTL
Register.description: I2C Bus Management Timer Control Register

BitField.name: BUSTOEN
BitField.description: Bus Time Out Enable Bit

Enum.description: Bus clock low time-out detection Disabled
Bus clock low time-out detection Enabled (bus clock is low for more than TTime-out (in BIDLE=0) or high more than TTime-out(in BIDLE =1)

BitField.name: CLKTOEN
BitField.description:
Cumulative Clock Low Time Out Enable Bit
For Master, it calculates the period from START to ACK
For Slave, it calculates the period from START to STOP

Enum.description: Cumulative clock low time-out detection Disabled
Cumulative clock low time-out detection Enabled

BitField.name: BUSTOIEN
BitField.description: Time-out Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description:
SCLK low time-out interrupt Disabled.
Bus IDLE time-out interrupt Disabled

SCLK low time-out interrupt Enabled.
Bus IDLE time-out interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: CLKTOIEN
BitField.description: Extended Clock Time Out Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: Clock time out interrupt Disabled
Clock time out interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: TORSTEN
BitField.description: Time Out Reset Enable Bit

Enum.description: I2C state machine reset Disabled
I2C state machine reset Enabled. (The clock and data bus will be released to high)

BitField.name: BUSY
BitField.description:
Bus Busy
Indicates that a communication is in progress on the bus. It is set by hardware when a START condition is detected. It is cleared by hardware when a STOP condition is detected

Enum.description: Bus is IDLE (both SCLK and SDA High)
Bus is busy

BitField.name: BCDONE
BitField.description:
Byte Count Transmission/Receive Done
Note: Software can write 1 to clear this bit.

Enum.description: Byte count transmission/ receive is not finished when the PECEN is set
Byte count transmission/ receive is finished when the PECEN is set

BitField.name: PECERR
BitField.description:
PEC Error in Reception
Note: Software can write 1 to clear this bit.

Enum.description: PEC value equal the received PEC data packet
PEC value doesn't match the receive PEC data packet

BitField.name: ALERT
BitField.description:
SMBus Alert Status
Note: 1. The SMBALERT pin is an open-drain pin, the pull-high resistor is must in the system. 2. Software can write 1 to clear this bit.

Enum.description:
SMBALERT pin state is low.
No SMBALERT event

SMBALERT pin state is high.
There is SMBALERT event (falling edge) is detected in SMALERT pin when the BMHEN = 1 (SMBus host configuration) and the ALERTEN = 1

BitField.name: SCTLDIN
BitField.description: Bus Suspend or Control Signal Input Status

Enum.description: The input status of SUSCON pin is 0
The input status of SUSCON pin is 1

BitField.name: BUSTO
BitField.description:
Bus Time-out Status
In bus busy, the bit indicates the total clock low time-out event occurred; otherwise, it indicates the bus idle time-out event occurred.
Note: Software can write 1 to clear this bit.

Enum.description: There is no any time-out or external clock time-out
A time-out or external clock time-out occurred

BitField.name: CLKTO
BitField.description:
Clock Low Cumulate Time-out Status
Note: Software can write 1 to clear this bit.

Enum.description: Cumulative clock low is no any time-out
Cumulative clock low time-out occurred

BitField.name: PECDONE
BitField.description:
PEC Byte Transmission/Receive Done
Note: Software can write 1 to clear this bit.

Enum.description: PEC transmission/ receive is not finished when the PECEN is set
PEC transmission/ receive is finished when the PECEN is set

Register.name: I2C_PKTSIZE
Register.description: I2C Packet Error Checking Byte Number Register

BitField.name: PLDSIZE
BitField.description:
Transfer Byte Number
The transmission or receive byte number in one transaction when the PECEN is set. The maximum transaction or receive byte is 256 Bytes.
Note: The byte number counting includes address, command code, and data frame.

Register.name: I2C_PKTCRC
Register.description: I2C Packet Error Checking Byte Value Register

BitField.name: PECCRC
BitField.description: Packet Error Checking Byte Value

BitField.name: BUSTO
BitField.description:
Bus Management Time-out Value
Indicates the bus time-out value in bus is IDLE or SCLK low.
Note: If the user wants to revise the value of BUSTOUT, the TORSTEN (I2C_BUSTCTL[4]) bit shall be set to 1 and cleared to 0 first when the BUSEN(I2C_BUSCTL[7]) is set.

Register.name: I2C_CLKTOUT
Register.description: I2C Bus Management Clock Low Timer Register

BitField.name: CLKTO
BitField.description:
Bus Clock Low Timer
The field is used to configure the cumulative clock extension time-out.
Note: If the user wants to revise the value of CLKLTOUT, the TORSTEN bit shall be set to 1 and cleared to 0 first when the BUSEN is set.

BitField.name: FUNMODE
BitField.description:
Function Mode
This bit field selects the protocol for this USCI controller. Selecting a protocol that is not available or a reserved combination disables the USCI. When switching between two protocols, the USCI has to be disabled before selecting a new protocol. Simultaneously, the USCI will be reset when user write 000 to FUNMODE.
Note: Other bit combinations are reserved.

Enum.description: The USCI is disabled. All protocol related state machines are set to idle state
The SPI protocol is selected
The UART protocol is selected
The I2C protocol is selected

BitField.name: TXSTIEN
BitField.description:
Transmit Start Interrupt Enable Bit
This bit enables the interrupt generation in case of a transmit start event.

Enum.description: The transmit start interrupt Disabled
The transmit start interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: TXENDIEN
BitField.description:
Transmit End Interrupt Enable Bit
This bit enables the interrupt generation in case of a transmit finish event.

Enum.description: The transmit finish interrupt Disabled
The transmit finish interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: RXSTIEN
BitField.description:
Receive Start Interrupt Enable BIt
This bit enables the interrupt generation in case of a receive start event.

Enum.description: The receive start interrupt Disabled
The receive start interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: RXENDIEN
BitField.description:
Receive End Interrupt Enable Bit
This bit enables the interrupt generation in case of a receive finish event.

Enum.description: The receive end interrupt Disabled
The receive end interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: RCLKSEL
BitField.description:
Reference Clock Source Selection
This bit selects the source signal of reference clock (fREF_CLK).

Enum.description: Peripheral device clock fPCLK

BitField.name: PTCLKSEL
BitField.description:
Protocol Clock Source Selection
This bit selects the source signal of protocol clock (fPROT_CLK).

Enum.description: Reference clock fREF_CLK
fREF_CLK2 (its frequency is half of fREF_CLK)

BitField.name: SPCLKSEL
BitField.description:
Sample Clock Source Selection
This bit field used for the clock source selection of a sample clock (fSAMP_CLK) for the protocol processor.

Enum.description: fSAMP_CLK = fDIV_CLK
fSAMP_CLK = fPROT_CLK
fSAMP_CLK = fSCLK
fSAMP_CLK = fREF_CLK

BitField.name: TMCNTEN
BitField.description:
Timing Measurement Counter Enable Bit
This bit enables the 10-bit timing measurement counter.

Enum.description: Timing measurement counter is Disabled
Timing measurement counter is Enabled

BitField.name: TMCNTSRC
BitField.description: Timing Measurement Counter Clock Source Selection

Enum.description: Timing measurement counter with fPROT_CLK
Timing measurement counter with fDIV_CLK

BitField.name: PDSCNT
BitField.description: Pre-divider for Sample Counter

BitField.name: DSCNT
BitField.description:
Denominator for Sample Counter
This bit field defines the divide ratio of the sample clock fSAMP_CLK.
Note: The maximum value of DSCNT is 0xF on UART mode and suggest to set over 4 to confirm the receiver data is sampled in right value.

BitField.name: CLKDIV
BitField.description:
Clock Divider
Note: In UART function, it can be updated by hardware in the 4th falling edge of the input data 0x55 when the auto baud rate function (ABREN(UUART_PROTCTL[6])) is enabled. The revised value is the average bit time between bit 5 and bit 6. The user can use revised CLKDIV and new BRDETITV (UUART_PROTCTL[24:16]) to calculate the precise baud rate.

Register.name: UUART_DATIN0
Register.description: USCI Input Data Signal Configuration Register 0

BitField.name: SYNCSEL
BitField.description:
Input Signal Synchronization Selection
This bit selects if the un-synchronized input signal (with optionally inverted) or the synchronized (and optionally filtered) signal can be used as input for the data shift unit.

Enum.description: The un-synchronized signal can be taken as input for the data shift unit
The synchronized signal can be taken as input for the data shift unit

BitField.name: ININV
BitField.description:
Input Signal Inverse Selection
This bit defines the inverter enable of the input asynchronous signal.

Enum.description: The un-synchronized input signal will not be inverted
The un-synchronized input signal will be inverted

BitField.name: EDGEDET
BitField.description:
Input Signal Edge Detection Mode
This bit field selects which edge actives the trigger event of input data signal.
Note: In UART function mode, it is suggested to set this bit field as 10.

Enum.description: The trigger event activation is disabled
A rising edge activates the trigger event of input data signal
A falling edge activates the trigger event of input data signal
Both edges activate the trigger event of input data signal

Register.name: UUART_CTLIN0
Register.description: USCI Input Control Signal Configuration Register 0

BitField.name: SYNCSEL
BitField.description:
Input Synchronization Signal Selection
This bit selects if the un-synchronized input signal (with optionally inverted) or the synchronized (and optionally filtered) signal can be used as input for the data shift unit.

Enum.description: The un-synchronized signal can be taken as input for the data shift unit
The synchronized signal can be taken as input for the data shift unit

BitField.name: ININV
BitField.description:
Input Signal Inverse Selection
This bit defines the inverter enable of the input asynchronous signal.

Enum.description: The un-synchronized input signal will not be inverted
The un-synchronized input signal will be inverted

Register.name: UUART_CLKIN
Register.description: USCI Input Clock Signal Configuration Register

BitField.name: SYNCSEL
BitField.description:
Input Synchronization Signal Selection
This bit selects if the un-synchronized input signal or the synchronized (and optionally filtered) signal can be used as input for the data shift unit.

Enum.description: The un-synchronized signal can be taken as input for the data shift unit
The synchronized signal can be taken as input for the data shift unit

BitField.name: LSB
BitField.description: LSB First Transmission Selection

Enum.description: The MSB, which bit of transmit/receive data buffer depends on the setting of DWIDTH, is transmitted/received first
The LSB, the bit 0 of data buffer, will be transmitted/received first

BitField.name: DATOINV
BitField.description:
Data Output Inverse Selection
This bit defines the relation between the internal shift data value and the output data signal of USCIx_DAT1 pin.

Enum.description: The value of USCIx_DAT1 is equal to the data shift register
The value of USCIx_DAT1 is the inversion of data shift register

BitField.name: CTLOINV
BitField.description:
Control Signal Output Inverse Selection
This bit defines the relation between the internal control signal and the output control signal.
Note: In UART protocol, the control signal means nRTS signal.

Enum.description: No effect
The control signal will be inverted before its output

BitField.name: DWIDTH
BitField.description:
Word Length of Transmission
This bit field defines the data word length (amount of bits) for reception and transmission. The data word is always right-aligned in the data buffer. USCI support word length from 4 to 16 bits.
0x0: The data word contains 16 bits located at bit positions [15:0].
0x1: Reserved.
0x2: Reserved.
0x3: Reserved.
0x4: The data word contains 4 bits located at bit positions [3:0].
0x5: The data word contains 5 bits located at bit positions [4:0].
...
0xF: The data word contains 15 bits located at bit positions [14:0].
Note: In UART protocol, the length can be configured as 6~13 bits.

BitField.name: TXDAT
BitField.description:
Transmit Data
Software can use this bit field to write 16-bit transmit data for transmission.

BitField.name: RXDAT
BitField.description:
Received Data
This bit field monitors the received data which stored in receive data buffer.
Note: RXDAT[15:13] indicate the same frame status of BREAK, FRMERR and PARITYERR (UUART_PROTSTS[7:5]).

BitField.name: TXCLR
BitField.description:
Clear Transmit Buffer
Note: It is cleared automatically after one PCLK cycle.

Enum.description: No effect
The transmit buffer is cleared (filling level is cleared and output pointer is set to input pointer value). Should only be used while the buffer is not taking part in data traffic

BitField.name: RXOVIEN
BitField.description: Receive Buffer Overrun Error Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: Receive overrun interrupt Disabled
Receive overrun interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: RXCLR
BitField.description:
Clear Receive Buffer
Note: It is cleared automatically after one PCLK cycle.

Enum.description: No effect
The receive buffer is cleared (filling level is cleared and output pointer is set to input pointer value). Should only be used while the buffer is not taking part in data traffic

BitField.name: TXRST
BitField.description:
Transmit Reset
Note: It is cleared automatically after one PCLK cycle.

Enum.description: No effect
Reset the transmit-related counters, state machine, and the content of transmit shift register and data buffer

BitField.name: RXRST
BitField.description:
Receive Reset
Note 1: It is cleared automatically after one PCLK cycle.
Note 2: It is suggested to check the RXBUSY (UUART_PROTSTS[10]) before this bit will be set to 1.

Enum.description: No effect
Reset the receive-related counters, state machine, and the content of receive shift register and data buffer

BitField.name: RXEMPTY
BitField.description: Receive Buffer Empty Indicator

Enum.description: Receive buffer is not empty
Receive buffer is empty

BitField.name: RXFULL
BitField.description: Receive Buffer Full Indicator

Enum.description: Receive buffer is not full
Receive buffer is full

BitField.name: RXOVIF
BitField.description:
Receive Buffer Over-run Error Interrupt Status
This bit indicates that a receive buffer overrun error event has been detected. If RXOVIEN (UUART_BUFCTL[14]) is enabled, the corresponding interrupt request is activated. It is cleared by software writes 1 to this bit.

Enum.description: A receive buffer overrun error event has not been detected
A receive buffer overrun error event has been detected

BitField.name: TXEMPTY
BitField.description: Transmit Buffer Empty Indicator

Enum.description: Transmit buffer is not empty
Transmit buffer is empty

BitField.name: TXFULL
BitField.description: Transmit Buffer Full Indicator

Enum.description: Transmit buffer is not full
Transmit buffer is full

BitField.name: PDMARST
BitField.description: PDMA Reset

Enum.description: No effect
Reset the USCI's PDMA control logic. This bit will be cleared to 0 automatically

BitField.name: TXPDMAEN
BitField.description: PDMA Transmit Channel Available

Enum.description: Transmit PDMA function Disabled
Transmit PDMA function Enabled

BitField.name: RXPDMAEN
BitField.description: PDMA Receive Channel Available

Enum.description: Receive PDMA function Disabled
Receive PDMA function Enabled

BitField.name: PDMAEN
BitField.description: PDMA Mode Enable Bit

Enum.description: PDMA function Disabled
PDMA function Enabled

BitField.name: WKEN
BitField.description: Wake-up Enable Bit

Enum.description: Wake-up function Disabled
Wake-up function Enabled

BitField.name: PDBOPT
BitField.description: Power Down Blocking Option

Enum.description: If user attempts to enter Power-down mode by executing WFI while the protocol is in transferring, MCU will stop the transfer and enter Power-down mode immediately
If user attempts to enter Power-down mode by executing WFI while the protocol is in transferring, the on-going transfer will not be stopped and MCU will enter idle mode immediately

BitField.name: WKF
BitField.description:
Wake-up Flag
When chip is woken up from Power-down mode, this bit is set to 1. Software can write 1 to clear this bit.

BitField.name: STOPB
BitField.description:
STOP Bits
This bit defines the number of STOP bits in an UART frame.

Enum.description: The number of STOP bits is 1
The number of STOP bits is 2

BitField.name: PARITYEN
BitField.description:
Parity Enable Bit
This bit defines the PARITY bit is enabled in an UART frame.

Enum.description: The PARITY bit Disabled
The PARITY bit Enabled

BitField.name: EVENPARITY
BitField.description:
Even Parity Enable Bit
Note: This bit has effect only when PARITYEN is set.

Enum.description: Odd number of logic 1's is transmitted and checked in each word
Even number of logic 1's is transmitted and checked in each word

BitField.name: RTSAUTOEN
BitField.description:
nRTS Auto-flow Control Enable Bit
Note: This bit has effect only when the RTSAUDIREN is not set.

Enum.description: nRTS auto-flow control Disabled
nRTS auto-flow control Enabled

BitField.name: CTSAUTOEN
BitField.description:
nCTS Auto-flow Control Enable Bit
When nCTS auto-flow is enabled, the UART will send data to external device when nCTS input assert (UART will not send data to device if nCTS input is dis-asserted).

Enum.description: nCTS auto-flow control Disabled
nCTS auto-flow control Enabled

BitField.name: RTSAUDIREN
BitField.description:
nRTS Auto Direction Enable Bit
When nRTS auto direction is enabled, if the transmitted bytes in the TX buffer is empty, the UART asserted nRTS signal automatically.
Note 1: This bit is used for nRTS auto direction control for RS485.
Note 2: This bit has effect only when the RTSAUTOEN is not set.

Enum.description: nRTS auto direction control Disabled
nRTS auto direction control Enabled

BitField.name: ABREN
BitField.description:
Auto-baud Rate Detect Enable Bit
Note: When the auto - baud rate detect operation finishes, hardware will clear this bit. The associated interrupt ABRDETIF (UUART_PROTST[9]) will be generated (If ARBIEN (UUART_PROTIEN [1]) is enabled).

Enum.description: Auto-baud rate detect function Disabled
Auto-baud rate detect function Enabled

BitField.name: DATWKEN
BitField.description: Data Wake-up Mode Enable Bit

Enum.description: Data wake-up mode Disabled
Data wake-up mode Enabled

BitField.name: CTSWKEN
BitField.description: nCTS Wake-up Mode Enable Bit

Enum.description: nCTS wake-up mode Disabled
nCTS wake-up mode Enabled

BitField.name: WAKECNT
BitField.description:
Wake-up Counter
These bits field indicate how many clock cycle selected by fPDS_CNT do the slave can get the 1st bit (START bit) when the device is wake-up from Power-down mode.

BitField.name: BRDETITV
BitField.description:
Baud Rate Detection Interval
This bit fields indicate how many clock cycle selected by TMCNTSRC (UUART_BRGEN [5]) does the slave calculates the baud rate in one bits. The order of the bus shall be 1 and 0 step by step (e.g. the input data pattern shall be 0x55). The user can read the value to know the current input baud rate of the bus whenever the ABRDETIF (UUART_PROTCTL[9]) is set.
Note: This bit can be cleared to 0 by software writing '0' to the BRDETITV.

BitField.name: STICKEN
BitField.description:
Stick Parity Enable Bit
Note: Refer to RS-485 Support section for detailed information.

Enum.description: Stick parity Disabled
Stick parity Enabled

BitField.name: BCEN
BitField.description:
Transmit Break Control Enable Bit
Note: When this bit is set to logic 1, the serial data output (TX) is forced to the Spacing State (logic 0). This bit acts only on TX line and has no effect on the transmitter logic.

Enum.description: Transmit Break Control Disabled
Transmit Break Control Enabled

BitField.name: PROTEN
BitField.description: UART Protocol Enable Bit

Enum.description: UART Protocol Disabled
UART Protocol Enabled

BitField.name: ABRIEN
BitField.description: Auto-baud Rate Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: Auto-baud rate interrupt Disabled
Auto-baud rate interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: RLSIEN
BitField.description:
Receive Line Status Interrupt Enable Bit
Note: UUART_PROTSTS[7:5] indicates the current interrupt event for receive line status interrupt.

Enum.description: Receive line status interrupt Disabled
Receive line status interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: TXSTIF
BitField.description:
Transmit Start Interrupt Flag
Note 1: It is cleared by software writing one into this bit.
Note 2: Used for user to load next transmit data when there is no data in transmit buffer.

Enum.description: A transmit start interrupt status has not occurred
A transmit start interrupt status has occurred

BitField.name: TXENDIF
BitField.description:
Transmit End Interrupt Flag
Note: It is cleared by software writing 1 into this bit.

Enum.description: A transmit end interrupt status has not occurred
A transmit end interrupt status has occurred

BitField.name: RXSTIF
BitField.description:
Receive Start Interrupt Flag
Note: It is cleared by software writing 1 into this bit.

Enum.description: A receive start interrupt status has not occurred
A receive start interrupt status has occurred

BitField.name: RXENDIF
BitField.description:
Receive End Interrupt Flag
Note: It is cleared by software writing 1 into this bit.

Enum.description: A receive finish interrupt status has not occurred
A receive finish interrupt status has occurred

BitField.name: PARITYERR
BitField.description:
Parity Error Flag
This bit is set to logic 1 whenever the received character does not have a valid 'PARITY bit'.
Note: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' among the BREAK, FRMERR and PARITYERR bits.

Enum.description: No parity error is generated
Parity error is generated

BitField.name: FRMERR
BitField.description:
Framing Error Flag
This bit is set to logic 1 whenever the received character does not have a valid 'STOP bit' (that is, the STOP bit following the last data bit or PARITY bit is detected as logic 0).
Note: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' among the BREAK, FRMERR and PARITYERR bits.

Enum.description: No framing error is generated
Framing error is generated

BitField.name: BREAK
BitField.description:
Break Flag
This bit is set to logic 1 whenever the received data input (RX) is held in the 'spacing state' (logic 0) for longer than a full word transmission time (that is, the total time of 'START bit' + data bits + parity + STOP bits).
Note: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' among the BREAK, FRMERR and PARITYERR bits.

Enum.description: No Break is generated
Break is generated in the receiver bus

BitField.name: ABRDETIF
BitField.description:
Auto-baud Rate Interrupt Flag
This bit is set when auto-baud rate detection is done among the falling edge of the input data. If the ABRIEN (UUART_PROTCTL[6]) is set, the auto-baud rate interrupt will be generated. This bit can be set 4 times when the input data pattern is 0x55 and it is cleared before the next falling edge of the input bus.
Note: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: Auto-baud rate detect function is not done
One Bit auto-baud rate detect function is done

BitField.name: RXBUSY
BitField.description:
RX Bus Status Flag (Read Only)
This bit indicates the busy status of the receiver.

Enum.description: The receiver is Idle
The receiver is BUSY

BitField.name: ABERRSTS
BitField.description:
Auto-baud Rate Error Status
This bit is set when auto-baud rate detection counter overrun. When the auto-baud rate counter overrun, the user shall revise the CLKDIV (UUART_BRGEN[25:16]) value and enable ABREN (UUART_PROTCTL[6]) to detect the correct baud rate again.
Note 1: This bit is set at the same time of ABRDETIF.
Note 2: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to ABRDETIF or ABERRSTS.

Enum.description: Auto-baud rate detect counter is not overrun
Auto-baud rate detect counter is overrun

BitField.name: CTSSYNCLV
BitField.description:
nCTS Synchronized Level Status (Read Only)
This bit used to indicate the current status of the internal synchronized nCTS signal.

Enum.description: The internal synchronized nCTS is low
The internal synchronized nCTS is high

BitField.name: CTSLV
BitField.description:
nCTS Pin Status (Read Only)
This bit used to monitor the current status of nCTS pin input.

Enum.description: nCTS pin input is low level voltage logic state
nCTS pin input is high level voltage logic state

This bit field selects the protocol for this USCI controller. Selecting a protocol that is not available or a reserved combination disables the USCI. When switching between two protocols, the USCI has to be disabled before selecting a new protocol. Simultaneously, the USCI will be reset when user write 000 to FUNMODE.
Note: Other bit combinations are reserved.

Enum.description: The USCI is disabled. All protocol related state machines are set to idle state
The SPI protocol is selected
The UART protocol is selected
The I2C protocol is selected

Enum.description: The receive start interrupt Disabled
The receive start interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: RXENDIEN
BitField.description:

Note: In UART function, it can be updated by hardware in the 4th falling edge of the input data 0x55 when the auto baud rate function (ABREN(UUART_PROTCTL[6])) is enabled. The revised value is the average bit time between bit 5 and bit 6. The user can use revised CLKDIV and new BRDETITV (UUART_PROTCTL[24:16]) to calculate the precise baud rate.

BitField.name: DWIDTH
BitField.description:
Word Length of Transmission
This bit field defines the data word length (amount of bits) for reception and transmission. The data word is always right-aligned in the data buffer. USCI support word length from 4 to 16 bits.
0x0: The data word contains 16 bits located at bit positions [15:0].
0x1: Reserved.
0x2: Reserved.
0x3: Reserved.
0x4: The data word contains 4 bits located at bit positions [3:0].
0x5: The data word contains 5 bits located at bit positions [4:0].
...
0xF: The data word contains 15 bits located at bit positions [14:0].
Note: In UART protocol, the length can be configured as 6~13 bits.

Note: RXDAT[15:13] indicate the same frame status of BREAK, FRMERR and PARITYERR (UUART_PROTSTS[7:5]).

Wake-up Flag

nRTS auto-flow control Enabled

BitField.name: CTSAUTOEN
BitField.description:
nCTS Auto-flow Control Enable Bit
When nCTS auto-flow is enabled, the UART will send data to external device when nCTS input assert (UART will not send data to device if nCTS input is dis-asserted).

Enum.description: nCTS auto-flow control Disabled
nCTS auto-flow control Enabled

BitField.name: RTSAUDIREN
BitField.description:
nRTS Auto Direction Enable Bit
When nRTS auto direction is enabled, if the transmitted bytes in the TX buffer is empty, the UART asserted nRTS signal automatically.
Note 1: This bit is used for nRTS auto direction control for RS485.
Note 2: This bit has effect only when the RTSAUTOEN is not set.

Enum.description: nRTS auto direction control Disabled
nRTS auto direction control Enabled

BitField.name: ABREN
BitField.description:
Auto-baud Rate Detect Enable Bit
Note: When the auto - baud rate detect operation finishes, hardware will clear this bit. The associated interrupt ABRDETIF (UUART_PROTST[9]) will be generated (If ARBIEN (UUART_PROTIEN [1]) is enabled).

Enum.description: Auto-baud rate detect function Disabled
Auto-baud rate detect function Enabled

BitField.name: DATWKEN

Data wake-up mode Enabled

BitField.name: CTSWKEN

nCTS wake-up mode Enabled

BitField.name: WAKECNT
BitField.description:
Wake-up Counter
These bits field indicate how many clock cycle selected by fPDS_CNT do the slave can get the 1st bit (START bit) when the device is wake-up from Power-down mode.

BitField.name: BRDETITV
BitField.description:
Baud Rate Detection Interval
This bit fields indicate how many clock cycle selected by TMCNTSRC (UUART_BRGEN [5]) does the slave calculates the baud rate in one bits. The order of the bus shall be 1 and 0 step by step (e.g. the input data pattern shall be 0x55). The user can read the value to know the current input baud rate of the bus whenever the ABRDETIF (UUART_PROTCTL[9]) is set.
Note: This bit can be cleared to 0 by software writing '0' to the BRDETITV.

BitField.name: STICKEN
BitField.description:

Note: Refer to RS-485 Support section for detailed information.

Enum.description: Stick parity Disabled
Stick parity Enabled

BitField.name: BCEN
BitField.description:

Note: When this bit is set to logic 1, the serial data output (TX) is forced to the Spacing State (logic 0). This bit acts only on TX line and has no effect on the transmitter logic.

Enum.description: Transmit Break Control Disabled
Transmit Break Control Enabled

BitField.name: PROTEN
BitField.description: UART Protocol Enable Bit

Enum.description: UART Protocol Disabled
UART Protocol Enabled

BitField.name: ABRIEN
BitField.description: Auto-baud Rate Interrupt Enable Bit

BitField.name: TXSTIF

Note 2: Used for user to load next transmit data when there is no data in transmit buffer.

Enum.description: A transmit start interrupt status has not occurred
A transmit start interrupt status has occurred

BitField.name: TXENDIF
BitField.description:
Transmit End Interrupt Flag
Note: It is cleared by software writing 1 into this bit.

Enum.description: A transmit end interrupt status has not occurred
A transmit end interrupt status has occurred

BitField.name: RXSTIF
BitField.description:

Note: It is cleared by software writing 1 into this bit.

Enum.description: A receive finish interrupt status has not occurred
A receive finish interrupt status has occurred

BitField.name: PARITYERR
BitField.description:
Parity Error Flag
This bit is set to logic 1 whenever the received character does not have a valid 'PARITY bit'.
Note: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' among the BREAK, FRMERR and PARITYERR bits.

Enum.description: No parity error is generated
Parity error is generated

BitField.name: FRMERR
BitField.description:
Framing Error Flag
This bit is set to logic 1 whenever the received character does not have a valid 'STOP bit' (that is, the STOP bit following the last data bit or PARITY bit is detected as logic 0).
Note: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' among the BREAK, FRMERR and PARITYERR bits.

Enum.description: No framing error is generated
Framing error is generated

BitField.name: BREAK
BitField.description:
Break Flag
This bit is set to logic 1 whenever the received data input (RX) is held in the 'spacing state' (logic 0) for longer than a full word transmission time (that is, the total time of 'START bit' + data bits + parity + STOP bits).
Note: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' among the BREAK, FRMERR and PARITYERR bits.

Enum.description: No Break is generated
Break is generated in the receiver bus

BitField.name: ABRDETIF
BitField.description:
Auto-baud Rate Interrupt Flag
This bit is set when auto-baud rate detection is done among the falling edge of the input data. If the ABRIEN (UUART_PROTCTL[6]) is set, the auto-baud rate interrupt will be generated. This bit can be set 4 times when the input data pattern is 0x55 and it is cleared before the next falling edge of the input bus.
Note: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: Auto-baud rate detect function is not done
One Bit auto-baud rate detect function is done

BitField.name: RXBUSY
BitField.description:
RX Bus Status Flag (Read Only)
This bit indicates the busy status of the receiver.

Enum.description: The receiver is Idle
The receiver is BUSY

BitField.name: ABERRSTS
BitField.description:
Auto-baud Rate Error Status
This bit is set when auto-baud rate detection counter overrun. When the auto-baud rate counter overrun, the user shall revise the CLKDIV (UUART_BRGEN[25:16]) value and enable ABREN (UUART_PROTCTL[6]) to detect the correct baud rate again.
Note 1: This bit is set at the same time of ABRDETIF.
Note 2: This bit can be cleared by writing '1' to ABRDETIF or ABERRSTS.

Enum.description: Auto-baud rate detect counter is not overrun
Auto-baud rate detect counter is overrun

BitField.name: CTSSYNCLV
BitField.description:
nCTS Synchronized Level Status (Read Only)
This bit used to indicate the current status of the internal synchronized nCTS signal.

Enum.description: The internal synchronized nCTS is low
The internal synchronized nCTS is high

BitField.name: CTSLV
BitField.description:

This bit used to monitor the current status of nCTS pin input.

Enum.description: nCTS pin input is low level voltage logic state
nCTS pin input is high level voltage logic state

BitField.name: FUNMODE
BitField.description:

This bit field selects the protocol for this USCI controller. Selecting a protocol that is not available or a reserved combination disables the USCI. When switching between two protocols, the USCI has to be disabled before selecting a new protocol. Simultaneously, the USCI will be reset when user write 000 to FUNMODE.
Note: Other bit combinations are reserved.

Enum.description: The USCI is disabled. All protocol related state machines are set to idle state

The I2C protocol is selected

BitField.name: SS

BitField.name: SCLKMODE

This bit field defines the SCLK idle status, data transmit, and data receive edge.

BitField.name: SUSPITV
BitField.description:
Suspend Interval (Master Only)
This bit field provides the configurable suspend interval between two successive transmit/receive transaction in a transfer. The definition of the suspend interval is the interval between the last clock edge of the preceding transaction word and the first clock edge of the following transaction word. The default value is 0x3. The period of the suspend interval is obtained according to the following equation.
(SUSPITV[3:0] + 0.5) * period of SPI_CLK clock cycle

BitField.name: TSMSEL
BitField.description:
Transmit Data Mode Selection
This bit field describes how receive and transmit data is shifted in and out.
Other values are reserved.
Note: Changing the value of this bit field will produce the TXRST and RXRST to clear the TX/RX data buffer automatically.

BitField.name: SLVTOCNT
BitField.description:
Slave Mode Time-out Period (Slave Only)
In Slave mode, this bit field is used for Slave time-out period. This bit field indicates how many clock periods (selected by TMCNTSRC, USPI_BRGEN[5]) between the two edges of input SCLK will assert the Slave time-out event. Writing 0x0 into this bit field will disable the Slave time-out function.
Example: Assume SLVTOCNT is 0x0A and TMCNTSRC (USPI_BRGEN[5]) is 1, it means the time-out event will occur if the state of SPI bus clock pin is not changed more than (10+1) periods of fDIV_CLK.

BitField.name: DWIDTH
BitField.description:
Word Length of Transmission
This bit field defines the data word length (amount of bits) for reception and transmission. The data word is always right-aligned in the data buffer. USCI support word length from 4 to 16 bits.
0x0: The data word contains 16 bits located at bit positions [15:0].
0x1: Reserved.
0x2: Reserved.
0x3: Reserved.
0x4: The data word contains 4 bits located at bit positions [3:0].
0x5: The data word contains 5 bits located at bit positions [4:0].
...
0xF: The data word contains 15 bits located at bit positions [14:0].

BitField.name: DEVADDR
BitField.description:
Device Address
In I2C protocol, this bit field contains the programmed slave address. If the first received address byte are 1111 0AAXB, the AA bits are compared to the bits DEVADDR[9:8] to check for address match, where the X is R/W bit. Then the second address byte is also compared to DEVADDR[7:0].
Note 1: The DEVADDR [9:7] must be set 3'b000 when I2C operating in 7-bit address mode.
Note 2: When software set 10'h000, the address can not be used.

BitField.description:
USCI Device Address Mask
USCI support multiple address recognition with two address mask register. When the bit in the address mask register is set to one, it means the received corresponding address bit is don't-care. If the bit is set to zero, that means the received corresponding register bit should be exact the same as address register.
Note: The wake-up function can not use address mask.

Enum.description: Mask Disabled (the received corresponding register bit should be exact the same as address register.)
Mask Enabled (the received corresponding address bit is don't care.)

BitField.name: ADDRMSK
BitField.description:
USCI Device Address Mask
USCI support multiple address recognition with two address mask register. When the bit in the address mask register is set to one, it means the received corresponding address bit is don't-care. If the bit is set to zero, that means the received corresponding register bit should be exact the same as address register.
Note: The wake-up function can not use address mask.

Enum.description: Mask Disabled (the received corresponding register bit should be exact the same as address register.)
Mask Enabled (the received corresponding address bit is don't care.)

BitField.name: WKEN
BitField.description: Wake-up Enable Bit

Enum.description: Wake-up function Disabled
Wake-up function Enabled

BitField.name: WKADDREN
BitField.description: Wake-up Address Match Enable Bit

Enum.description: The chip is woken up according to START signal
The chip is woken up according to address match

BitField.name: WKF
BitField.description:
Wake-up Flag
When chip is woken up from Power-down mode, this bit is set to 1. Software can write 1 to clear this bit.

BitField.name: GCFUNC
BitField.description:
General Call Function
Note: When ADDR10EN (UI2C_PROTCTL [4]) is set, don't set this bit.

Enum.description: General Call Function Disabled
General Call Function Enabled

BitField.name: AA
BitField.description: Assert Acknowledge Control

BitField.name: STO
BitField.description: I2C STOP Control

BitField.name: STA
BitField.description:
I2C START Control
Setting STA to logic 1 to enter Master mode, the I2C hardware sends a START or repeat START condition to bus when the bus is free.

BitField.name: ADDR10EN
BitField.description: Address 10-bit Function Enable Bit

Enum.description: Address match 10 bit function Disabled
Address match 10 bit function Enabled

BitField.name: PTRG
BitField.description:
I2C Protocol Trigger (Write Only)
When a new state is present in the UI2C_PROTSTS register, if the related interrupt enable bits are set, the I2C interrupt is requested. It must write one by software to this bit after the related interrupt flags are set to 1 and the I2C protocol function will go ahead until the STOP is active or the PROTEN is disabled.

Enum.description: I2C's stretch disabled and the I2C protocol function will go ahead
I2C's stretch is active

BitField.name: SCLOUTEN
BitField.description:
SCL Output Enable Bit
This bit enables monitor pulling SCL to low. This monitor will pull SCL to low until it has had time to respond to an I2C interrupt.

Enum.description: SCL output will be forced high due to open drain mechanism
I2C module may act as a slave peripheral just like in normal operation, the I2C holds the clock line low until it has had time to clear I2C interrupt

BitField.name: MONEN
BitField.description:
Monitor Mode Enable Bit
This bit enables monitor mode. In monitor mode the SDA output will be put in high impedance mode. This prevents the I2C module from outputting data of any kind (including ACK) onto the I2C data bus.
Note: Depending on the state of the SCLOUTEN bit, the SCL output may be also forced high, preventing the module from having control over the I2C clock line.

Enum.description: The monitor mode Disabled
The monitor mode Enabled

BitField.name: TOCNT
BitField.description:
Time-out Clock Cycle
This bit field indicates how many clock cycle selected by TMCNTSRC (UI2C_BRGEN [5]) when each interrupt flags are clear. The time-out is enable when TOCNT bigger than 0.
Note: The TMCNTSRC (UI2C_BRGEN [5]) must be set zero on I2C mode.

BitField.name: PROTEN
BitField.description: I2C Protocol Enable Bit

Enum.description: I2C Protocol Disabled
I2C Protocol Enabled

BitField.name: TOIEN
BitField.description:
Time-out Interrupt Enable Bit
In I2C protocol, this bit enables the interrupt generation in case of a time-out event.

Enum.description: The time-out interrupt Disabled
The time-out interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: STARIEN
BitField.description:
START Condition Received Interrupt Enable Bit
This bit enables the generation of a protocol interrupt if a START condition is detected.

Enum.description: The start condition interrupt Disabled
The start condition interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: STORIEN
BitField.description:
STOP Condition Received Interrupt Enable Bit
This bit enables the generation of a protocol interrupt if a STOP condition is detected.

Enum.description: The stop condition interrupt Disabled
The stop condition interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: NACKIEN
BitField.description:
Non - Acknowledge Interrupt Enable Bit
This bit enables the generation of a protocol interrupt if a Non - acknowledge is detected by a master.

Enum.description: The non - acknowledge interrupt Disabled
The non - acknowledge interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: ARBLOIEN
BitField.description:
Arbitration Lost Interrupt Enable Bit
This bit enables the generation of a protocol interrupt if an arbitration lost event is detected.

Enum.description: The arbitration lost interrupt Disabled
The arbitration lost interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: ERRIEN
BitField.description:
Error Interrupt Enable Bit
This bit enables the generation of a protocol interrupt if an I2C error condition is detected (indicated by ERR (UI2C_PROTSTS [16])).

Enum.description: The error interrupt Disabled
The error interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: ACKIEN
BitField.description:
Acknowledge Interrupt Enable Bit
This bit enables the generation of a protocol interrupt if an acknowledge is detected by a master.

Enum.description: The acknowledge interrupt Disabled
The acknowledge interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: TOIF
BitField.description:
Time-out Interrupt Flag
Note: This bit is cleared by software writing 1 into this bit.

Enum.description: A time-out interrupt status has not occurred
A time-out interrupt status has occurred

BitField.name: ONBUSY
BitField.description:
On Bus Busy
Indicates that a communication is in progress on the bus. It is set by hardware when a START condition is detected. It is cleared by hardware when a STOP condition is detected

Enum.description: The bus is IDLE (both SCLK and SDA High)
The bus is busy

BitField.name: STARIF
BitField.description:
Start Condition Received Interrupt Flag
This bit indicates that a start condition or repeated start condition has been detected on master mode. However, this bit also indicates that a repeated start condition has been detected on slave mode.
Note: This bit is cleared by software writing 1 into this bit

Enum.description: A start condition has not yet been detected
A start condition has been detected

BitField.name: STORIF
BitField.description:
Stop Condition Received Interrupt Flag
Note: This bit is cleared by software writing 1 into this bit.

Enum.description: A stop condition has not yet been detected
A stop condition has been detected

BitField.name: NACKIF
BitField.description:
Non - Acknowledge Received Interrupt Flag
Note: This bit is cleared by software writing 1 into this bit.

Enum.description: A non - acknowledge has not been received
A non - acknowledge has been received

BitField.name: ARBLOIF
BitField.description:
Arbitration Lost Interrupt Flag
Note: This bit is cleared by software writing 1 into this bit.

Enum.description: An arbitration has not been lost
An arbitration has been lost

BitField.name: ERRIF
BitField.description:
Error Interrupt Flag
Note 1: This bit is cleared by software writing 1 into this bit.
Note 2: This bit is set for slave mode, and user must write 1 into STO register to the defined 'not addressed' slave mode.

Enum.description: An I2C error has not been detected
An I2C error has been detected

BitField.name: ACKIF
BitField.description:
Acknowledge Received Interrupt Flag
Note: This bit is cleared by software writing 1 into this bit

Enum.description: An acknowledge has not been received
An acknowledge has been received

BitField.name: SLASEL
BitField.description:
Slave Select Status
This bit indicates that this device has been selected as slave.
Note: This bit has no interrupt signal, and it will be cleared automatically by hardware.

Enum.description: The device is not selected as slave
The device is selected as slave

BitField.name: SLAREAD
BitField.description:
Slave Read Request Status
This bit indicates that a slave read request has been detected.
Note: This bit has no interrupt signal, and it will be cleared automatically by hardware.

Enum.description: A slave R/W bit is 1 has not been detected
A slave R/W bit is 1 has been detected

BitField.name: WKAKDONE
BitField.description:
Wake-up Address Frame Acknowledge Bit Done
Note: This bit can't release when WKUPIF is set.

Enum.description: The ACK bit cycle of address match frame isn't done
The ACK bit cycle of address match frame is done in power-down

BitField.name: WRSTSWK
BitField.description: Read/Write Status Bit in Address Wake-up Frame

Enum.description: Write command be record on the address match wake-up frame
Read command be record on the address match wake-up frame

BitField.name: BUSHANG
BitField.description:
Bus Hang-up
This bit indicates bus hang-up status. There is 4-bit counter count when SCL hold high and refer fSAMP_CLK. The hang-up counter will count to overflow and set this bit when SDA is low. The counter will be reset by falling edge of SCL signal.
Note: This bit has no interrupt signal, and it will be cleared automatically by hardware when a START condition is present.

Enum.description: The bus is normal status for transmission
The bus is hang-up status for transmission

BitField.name: ERRARBLO
BitField.description:
Error Arbitration Lost
This bit indicates bus arbitration lost due to bigger noise which is can't be filtered by input processor. The I2C can send start condition when ERRARBLO is set. Thus this bit doesn't be cared on slave mode.
Note: This bit has no interrupt signal, and it will be cleared automatically by hardware when a START condition is present.

Enum.description: The bus is normal status for transmission
The bus is error arbitration lost status for transmission

BitField.name: STCTL
BitField.description:
Setup Time Configure Control
This field is used to generate a delay timing between SDA edge and SCL rising edge in transmission mode..

BitField.name: HTCTL
BitField.description:
Hold Time Configure Control
This field is used to generate the delay timing between SCL falling edge SDA edge in
transmission mode.

BitField.name: FUNMODE
BitField.description:
Function Mode
This bit field selects the protocol for this USCI controller. Selecting a protocol that is not available or a reserved combination disables the USCI. When switching between two protocols, the USCI has to be disabled before selecting a new protocol. Simultaneously, the USCI will be reset when user write 000 to FUNMODE.
Note: Other bit combinations are reserved.

Enum.description: The USCI is disabled. All protocol related state machines are set to idle state
The SPI protocol is selected
The UART protocol is selected
The I2C protocol is selected

BitField.name: RCLKSEL
BitField.description:
Reference Clock Source Selection
This bit selects the source signal of reference clock (fREF_CLK).

Enum.description: Peripheral device clock fPCLK

BitField.name: PTCLKSEL
BitField.description:
Protocol Clock Source Selection
This bit selects the source signal of protocol clock (fPROT_CLK).

Enum.description: Reference clock fREF_CLK
fREF_CLK2 (its frequency is half of fREF_CLK)

BitField.name: SPCLKSEL
BitField.description:
Sample Clock Source Selection
This bit field used for the clock source selection of a sample clock (fSAMP_CLK) for the protocol processor.

Enum.description: fSAMP_CLK = fDIV_CLK
fSAMP_CLK = fPROT_CLK
fSAMP_CLK = fSCLK
fSAMP_CLK = fREF_CLK

BitField.name: TMCNTEN
BitField.description:
Time Measurement Counter Enable Bit
This bit enables the 10-bit timing measurement counter.

Enum.description: Time measurement counter is Disabled
Time measurement counter is Enabled

BitField.name: TMCNTSRC
BitField.description: Time Measurement Counter Clock Source Selection

Enum.description: Time measurement counter with fPROT_CLK
Time measurement counter with fDIV_CLK

BitField.name: PDSCNT
BitField.description: Pre-divider for Sample Counter

BitField.name: DSCNT
BitField.description:
Denominator for Sample Counter
This bit field defines the divide ratio of the sample clock fSAMP_CLK.
Note: The maximum value of DSCNT is 0xF on UART mode and suggest to set over 4 to confirm the receiver data is sampled in right value.

BitField.name: CLKDIV
BitField.description: Clock Divider

BitField.name: LSB
BitField.description: LSB First Transmission Selection

Enum.description: The MSB, which bit of transmit/receive data buffer depends on the setting of DWIDTH, is transmitted/received first
The LSB, the bit 0 of data buffer, will be transmitted/received first

BitField.name: DWIDTH
BitField.description:
Word Length of Transmission
This bit field defines the data word length (amount of bits) for reception and transmission. The data word is always right-aligned in the data buffer. USCI support word length from 4 to 16 bits.
0x0: The data word contains 16 bits located at bit positions [15:0].
0x1: Reserved.
0x2: Reserved.
0x3: Reserved.
0x4: The data word contains 4 bits located at bit positions [3:0].
0x5: The data word contains 5 bits located at bit positions [4:0].
...
0xF: The data word contains 15 bits located at bit positions [14:0].

BitField.name: TXDAT
BitField.description:
Transmit Data
Software can use this bit field to write 16-bit transmit data for transmission.

BitField.name: RXDAT
BitField.description:
Received Data
This bit field monitors the received data which stored in receive data buffer.
Note: In I2C protocol, RXDAT[12:8] indicate the different transmission conditions which defined in I2C.

BitField.name: DEVADDR
BitField.description:
Device Address
In I2C protocol, this bit field contains the programmed slave address. If the first received address byte are 1111 0AAXB, the AA bits are compared to the bits DEVADDR[9:8] to check for address match, where the X is R/W bit. Then the second address byte is also compared to DEVADDR[7:0].
Note 1: The DEVADDR [9:7] must be set 3'b000 when I2C operating in 7-bit address mode.
Note 2: When software set 10'h000, the address can not be used.

BitField.name: DMAEN
BitField.description:
DMA Engine Enable Bit
Note 1: If this bit is cleared, DMA will ignore all requests from SD host and force bus master into IDLE state.
Note 2: If target abort occurred, DMAEN will be cleared.

Enum.description: DMA Disabled
DMA Enabled

BitField.name: DMARST
BitField.description:
Software Engine Reset
Note: The software reset DMA related registers.

Enum.description: No effect
Reset internal state machine and pointers. The contents of control register will not be cleared. This bit will auto be cleared after few clock cycles

BitField.name: SGEN
BitField.description: Scatter-gather Function Enable Bit

Enum.description: Scatter-gather function Disabled (DMA will treat the starting address in DMASAR as starting pointer of a single block memory)
Scatter-gather function Enabled (DMA will treat the starting address in DMASAR as a starting address of Physical Address Descriptor (PAD) table. The format of these Pads' will be described later)

BitField.name: DMABUSY
BitField.description:
DMA Transfer Is in Progress
This bit indicates if SD Host is granted and doing DMA transfer or not.

Enum.description: DMA transfer is not in progress
DMA transfer is in progress

BitField.name: ORDER
BitField.description: Determined to the PAD Table Fetching Is in Order or Out of Order

Enum.description: PAD table is fetched in order
PAD table is fetched out of order

BitField.name: DMASA
BitField.description:
DMA Transfer Starting Address
This field pads 0 as least significant bit indicates a 32-bit starting address of system memory (SRAM) for DMA to retrieve or fill in data.
If DMA is not in normal mode, this field will be interpreted as a starting address of Physical Address Descriptor (PAD) table.
Note: Starting address of the SRAM must be word aligned, for example, 0x0000_0000, 0x0000_0004.

BitField.name: BCNT
BitField.description:
DMA Transfer Byte Count (Read Only)
This field indicates the remained byte count of DMA transfer. The value of this field is valid only when DMA is busy; otherwise, it is 0.

BitField.name: ABORTIEN
BitField.description: DMA Read/Write Target Abort Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: Target abort interrupt generation Disabled during DMA transfer
Target abort interrupt generation Enabled during DMA transfer

BitField.name: WEOTIEN
BitField.description: Wrong EOT Encountered Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: Interrupt generation Disabled when wrong EOT is encountered
Interrupt generation Enabled when wrong EOT is encountered

BitField.name: ABORTIF
BitField.description:
DMA Read/Write Target Abort Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
Note 1: This bit is read only, but can be cleared by writing '1' to it.
Note 2: When DMA's bus master received ERROR response, it means that target abort is happened. DMA will stop transfer and respond this event and then go to IDLE state. When target abort occurred or WEOTIF is set, software must reset DMA and SD host, and then transfer those data again.

Enum.description: No bus ERROR response received
Bus ERROR response received

BitField.name: WEOTIF
BitField.description:
Wrong EOT Encountered Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
When DMA Scatter-Gather function is enabled, and EOT of the descriptor is encountered before DMA transfer finished (that means the total sector count of all PAD is less than the sector count of SD host), this bit will be set.
Note: This bit is read only, but can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: No EOT encountered before DMA transfer finished
EOT encountered before DMA transfer finished

BitField.name: GCTLRST
BitField.description: Software Engine Reset

Enum.description: No effect
Reset SD host. The contents of control register will not be cleared. This bit will auto cleared after reset complete

BitField.name: SDEN
BitField.description: Secure Digital Functionality Enable Bit

Enum.description: SD functionality Disabled
SD functionality Enabled

BitField.name: DTAIEN
BitField.description: DMA READ/WRITE Target Abort Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: DMA READ/WRITE target abort interrupt generation Disabled
DMA READ/WRITE target abort interrupt generation Enabled

BitField.name: DTAIF
BitField.description:
DMA READ/WRITE Target Abort Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
This bit indicates DMA received an ERROR response from internal AHB bus during DMA read/write operation. When Target Abort is occurred, please reset all engine.
Note: This bit is read only, but can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: No bus ERROR response received
Bus ERROR response received

BitField.name: COEN
BitField.description:
Command Output Enable Bit
Note: When operation is finished, this bit will be cleared automatically, so don't write 0 to this bit (the controller will be abnormal).

Enum.description: No effect. (Please use DMARST (SDH_CTL [0]) to clear this bit.)
Enabled. The SD host will output a command to SD card

BitField.name: RIEN
BitField.description:
Response Input Enable Bit
Note: When operation is finished, this bit will be cleared automatically, so don't write 0 to this bit (the controller will be abnormal).

Enum.description: No effect. (Please use DMARST (SDH_CTL [0]) to clear this bit.)
Enabled. The SD host will wait to receive a response from SD card

BitField.name: DIEN
BitField.description:
Data Input Enable Bit
Note: When operation is finished, this bit will be cleared automatically, so don't write 0 to this bit (the controller will be abnormal).

Enum.description: No effect. (Please use DMARST (SDH_CTL [0]) to clear this bit.)
Enabled. The SD host will wait to receive block data and the CRC16 value from SD card

BitField.name: DOEN
BitField.description:
Data Output Enable Bit
Note: When operation is finished, this bit will be cleared automatically, so don't write 0 to this bit (the controller will be abnormal).

Enum.description: No effect. (Please use DMARST (SDH_CTL [0]) to clear this bit.)
Enabled. The SD host will transfer block data and the CRC16 value to SD card

BitField.name: R2EN
BitField.description:
Response R2 Input Enable Bit
Note: When operation is finished, this bit will be cleared automatically, so don't write 0 to this bit (the controller will be abnormal).

Enum.description: No effect. (Please use DMARST (SDH_CTL [0]) to clear this bit.)
Enabled. The SD host will wait to receive a response R2 from SD card and store the response data into DMC's Flash buffer (exclude CRC7)

BitField.name: CLK74OEN
BitField.description:
Initial 74 Clock Cycles Output Enable Bit
Note: When operation is finished, this bit will be cleared automatically, so don't write 0 to this bit (the controller will be abnormal).

Enum.description: No effect. (Please use DMARST (SDH_CTL [0]) to clear this bit.)
Enabled. The SD host will output 74 clock cycles to SD card

BitField.name: CLK8OEN
BitField.description:
Generating 8 Clock Cycles Output Enable Bit
Note: When operation is finished, this bit will be cleared automatically, so don't write 0 to this bit (the controller will be abnormal).

Enum.description: No effect. (Please use DMARST (SDH_CTL [0]) to clear this bit.)
Enabled. The SD host will output 8 clock cycles

BitField.name: CLKKEEP
BitField.description: SD Clock Enable Control

Enum.description: SD host decided when to output clock and when to disable clock output automatically
SD clock always keeps free running

BitField.name: CMDCODE
BitField.description:
SD Command Code
The bits contain the SD command code (0x00 - 0x3F).

BitField.name: CTLRST
BitField.description: Software Engine Reset

Enum.description: No effect

Reset the internal state machine and counters. The contents of control register will not be cleared (but RIEN, DIEN, DOEN and R2_EN will be cleared). This bit will be auto cleared after few clock cycles

BitField.name: DBW
BitField.description: SD Data Bus Width (for 1-bit / 4-bit Selection)

Enum.description: Data bus width is 1-bit
Data bus width is 4-bit

BitField.name: BLKCNT
BitField.description:
Block Counts to Be Transferred or Received
This field contains the block counts for data-in and data-out transfer. For READ_MULTIPLE_BLOCK and WRITE_MULTIPLE_BLOCK command, software can use this function to accelerate data transfer and improve performance. Don't fill 0x0 to this field.
Note: For READ_MULTIPLE_BLOCK and WRITE_MULTIPLE_BLOCK command, the actual total length is BLKCNT * (BLKLEN +1).

BitField.name: SDNWR
BitField.description:
NWR Parameter for Block Write Operation
This value indicates the NWR parameter for data block write operation in SD clock counts. The actual clock cycle will be SDNWR+1.

BitField.name: ARGUMENT
BitField.description:
SD Command Argument
This register contains a 32-bit value specifies the argument of SD command from host controller to SD card. Before trigger COEN (SDH_CTL [0]), software should fill argument in this field.

BitField.name: BLKDIEN
BitField.description: Block Transfer Done Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: BLKDIF (SDH_INTEN[0]) trigger interrupt Disable
BLKDIF (SDH_INTEN[0]) trigger interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: CRCIEN
BitField.description: CRC7, CRC16 and CRC Status Error Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: CRCIF (SDH_INTEN[1]) trigger interrupt Disable
CRCIF (SDH_INTEN[1]) trigger interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: CDIEN
BitField.description:
SD Card Detection Interrupt Enable Bit
Enable/Disable interrupts generation of SD controller when card is inserted or removed.

Enum.description: CDIF (SDH_INTEN[8]) trigger interrupt Disable
CDIF (SDH_INTEN[8]) trigger interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: RTOIEN
BitField.description:
Response Time-out Interrupt Enable Bit
Enable/Disable interrupts generation of SD controller when receiving response or R2 time-out. Time-out value is specified at TOUT register.

Enum.description: RTOIF (SDH_INTEN[12]) trigger interrupt Disabled
RTOIF (SDH_INTEN[12]) trigger interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: DITOIEN
BitField.description:
Data Input Time-out Interrupt Enable Bit
Enable/Disable interrupts generation of SD controller when data input time-out. Time-out value is specified at TOUT register.

Enum.description: DITOIF (SDH_INTEN[13]) trigger interrupt Disabled
DITOIF (SDH_INTEN[13]) trigger interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: WKIEN
BitField.description:
Wake-up Signal Generating Enable Bit
Enable/Disable wake-up signal generating of SD controller when card is inserted or removed.

Enum.description: SD Card interrupt to wake-up chip Disabled
SD Card interrupt to wake-up chip Enabled

BitField.name: CDSRC
BitField.description: SD Card Detect Source Selection

Enum.description: From SD card's DAT3 pin
From GPIO pin

BitField.name: BLKDIF
BitField.description:
Block Transfer Done Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
This bit indicates that SD host has finished all data-in or data-out block transfer. If there is a CRC16 error or incorrect CRC status during multiple block data transfer, the transfer will be broken and this bit will also be set.
Note: This bit is read only, but can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: Not finished yet

BitField.name: CRCIF
BitField.description:
CRC7, CRC16 and CRC Status Error Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
This bit indicates that SD host has occurred CRC error during response in, data-in or data-out (CRC status error) transfer. When CRC error is occurred, software should reset SD engine. Some response (ex. R3) doesn't have CRC7 information with it; SD host will still calculate CRC7, get CRC error and set this flag. In this condition, software should ignore CRC error and clears this bit manually.
Note: This bit is read only, but can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: No CRC error is occurred
CRC error is occurred

BitField.name: CRC7
BitField.description:
CRC7 Check Status (Read Only)
SD host will check CRC7 correctness during each response in. If that response does not contain CRC7 information (ex. R3), then software should turn off CRCIEN (SDH_INTEN[1]) and ignore this bit.

BitField.name: CRC16
BitField.description:
CRC16 Check Status of Data-in Transfer (Read Only)
SD host will check CRC16 correctness after data-in transfer.

BitField.name: CRCSTS
BitField.description:
CRC Status Value of Data-out Transfer (Read Only)
SD host will record CRC status of data-out transfer. Software could use this value to identify what type of error is during data-out transfer.

Enum.description: Positive CRC status
Negative CRC status
SD card programming error occurs

BitField.name: DAT0STS
BitField.description:
DAT0 Pin Status of Current Selected SD Port (Read Only)
This bit is the DAT0 pin status of current selected SD port.

BitField.name: CDIF
BitField.description:
SD Card Detection Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
This bit indicates that SD card is inserted or removed. Only when CDIEN (SDH_INTEN[8]) is set to 1, this bit is active.
Note: This bit is read only, but can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: No card is inserted or removed
There is a card inserted in or removed from SD

BitField.name: RTOIF
BitField.description:
Response Time-out Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
This bit indicates that SD host counts to time-out value when receiving response or R2 (waiting start bit).
Note: This bit is read only, but can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: Not time-out
Response time-out

BitField.name: DITOIF
BitField.description:
Data Input Time-out Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
This bit indicates that SD host counts to time-out value when receiving data (waiting start bit).
Note: This bit is read only, but can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: Not time-out
Data input time-out

BitField.name: CDSTS
BitField.description:
Card Detect Status of SD (Read Only)
This bit indicates the card detect pin status of SD, and is used for card detection. When there is a card inserted in or removed from SD, software should check this bit to confirm if there is really a card insertion or removal.

Enum.description:
Card removed.
Card inserted

Card inserted.
Card removed

BitField.name: DAT1STS
BitField.description:
DAT1 Pin Status of SD Card (Read Only)
This bit indicates the DAT1 pin status of SD card.

BitField.name: RESPTK0
BitField.description:
SD Receiving Response Token 0
SD host controller will receive a response token for getting a reply from SD card when RIEN (SDH_CTL[1]) is set. This field contains response bit 47-16 of the response token.

BitField.name: RESPTK1
BitField.description:
SD Receiving Response Token 1
The SD host controller will receive a response token for getting a reply from SD card when RIEN (SDH_CTL[1]) is set. This register contains the bit 15-8 of the response token.

BitField.name: BLKLEN
BitField.description:
SD BLOCK LENGTH in Byte Unit
An 11-bit value specifies the SD transfer byte count of a block. The actual byte count is equal to BLKLEN+1.
Note: The default SD block length is 512 bytes

BitField.name: TOUT
BitField.description:
SD Response/Data-in Time-out Value
A 24-bit value specifies the time-out counts of response and data input. SD host controller will wait start bit of response or data-in until this value reached. The time period depends on SD engine clock frequency. Do not write a small number into this field, or you may never get response or data due to time-out.
Note: Filling 0x0 into this field will disable hardware time-out function.
