BitField.name: DMASA
BitField.description:
DMA Transfer Starting Address
This field pads 0 as least significant bit indicates a 32-bit starting address of system memory (SRAM) for DMA to retrieve or fill in data.
If DMA is not in normal mode, this field will be interpreted as a starting address of Physical Address Descriptor (PAD) table.
Note: Starting address of the SRAM must be word aligned, for example, 0x0000_0000, 0x0000_0004.

BitField.name: BCNT
BitField.description:
DMA Transfer Byte Count (Read Only)
This field indicates the remained byte count of DMA transfer. The value of this field is valid only when DMA is busy; otherwise, it is 0.

BitField.name: ABORTIEN
BitField.description: DMA Read/Write Target Abort Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: Target abort interrupt generation Disabled during DMA transfer
Target abort interrupt generation Enabled during DMA transfer

BitField.name: WEOTIEN
BitField.description: Wrong EOT Encountered Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: Interrupt generation Disabled when wrong EOT is encountered
Interrupt generation Enabled when wrong EOT is encountered

BitField.name: ABORTIF
BitField.description:
DMA Read/Write Target Abort Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
Note 1: This bit is read only, but can be cleared by writing '1' to it.
Note 2: When DMA's bus master received ERROR response, it means that target abort is happened. DMA will stop transfer and respond this event and then go to IDLE state. When target abort occurred or WEOTIF is set, software must reset DMA and SD host, and then transfer those data again.

Enum.description: No bus ERROR response received
Bus ERROR response received

BitField.name: WEOTIF
BitField.description:
Wrong EOT Encountered Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
When DMA Scatter-Gather function is enabled, and EOT of the descriptor is encountered before DMA transfer finished (that means the total sector count of all PAD is less than the sector count of SD host), this bit will be set.
Note: This bit is read only, but can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: No EOT encountered before DMA transfer finished
EOT encountered before DMA transfer finished

BitField.name: GCTLRST
BitField.description: Software Engine Reset

Enum.description: No effect
Reset SD host. The contents of control register will not be cleared. This bit will auto cleared after reset complete

BitField.name: SDEN
BitField.description: Secure Digital Functionality Enable Bit

Enum.description: SD functionality Disabled
SD functionality Enabled

BitField.name: DTAIEN
BitField.description: DMA READ/WRITE Target Abort Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: DMA READ/WRITE target abort interrupt generation Disabled
DMA READ/WRITE target abort interrupt generation Enabled

BitField.name: DTAIF
BitField.description:
DMA READ/WRITE Target Abort Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
This bit indicates DMA received an ERROR response from internal AHB bus during DMA read/write operation. When Target Abort is occurred, please reset all engine.
Note: This bit is read only, but can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: No bus ERROR response received
Bus ERROR response received

BitField.name: COEN
BitField.description:
Command Output Enable Bit
Note: When operation is finished, this bit will be cleared automatically, so don't write 0 to this bit (the controller will be abnormal).

Enum.description: No effect. (Please use DMARST (SDH_CTL [0]) to clear this bit.)
Enabled. The SD host will output a command to SD card

BitField.name: RIEN
BitField.description:
Response Input Enable Bit
Note: When operation is finished, this bit will be cleared automatically, so don't write 0 to this bit (the controller will be abnormal).

Enum.description: No effect. (Please use DMARST (SDH_CTL [0]) to clear this bit.)
Enabled. The SD host will wait to receive a response from SD card

BitField.name: DIEN
BitField.description:
Data Input Enable Bit
Note: When operation is finished, this bit will be cleared automatically, so don't write 0 to this bit (the controller will be abnormal).

Enum.description: No effect. (Please use DMARST (SDH_CTL [0]) to clear this bit.)
Enabled. The SD host will wait to receive block data and the CRC16 value from SD card

BitField.name: DOEN
BitField.description:
Data Output Enable Bit
Note: When operation is finished, this bit will be cleared automatically, so don't write 0 to this bit (the controller will be abnormal).

Enum.description: No effect. (Please use DMARST (SDH_CTL [0]) to clear this bit.)
Enabled. The SD host will transfer block data and the CRC16 value to SD card

BitField.name: R2EN
BitField.description:
Response R2 Input Enable Bit
Note: When operation is finished, this bit will be cleared automatically, so don't write 0 to this bit (the controller will be abnormal).

Enum.description: No effect. (Please use DMARST (SDH_CTL [0]) to clear this bit.)
Enabled. The SD host will wait to receive a response R2 from SD card and store the response data into DMC's Flash buffer (exclude CRC7)

BitField.name: CLK74OEN
BitField.description:
Initial 74 Clock Cycles Output Enable Bit
Note: When operation is finished, this bit will be cleared automatically, so don't write 0 to this bit (the controller will be abnormal).

Enum.description: No effect. (Please use DMARST (SDH_CTL [0]) to clear this bit.)
Enabled. The SD host will output 74 clock cycles to SD card

BitField.name: CLK8OEN
BitField.description:
Generating 8 Clock Cycles Output Enable Bit
Note: When operation is finished, this bit will be cleared automatically, so don't write 0 to this bit (the controller will be abnormal).

Enum.description: No effect. (Please use DMARST (SDH_CTL [0]) to clear this bit.)
Enabled. The SD host will output 8 clock cycles

BitField.name: CLKKEEP
BitField.description: SD Clock Enable Control

Enum.description: SD host decided when to output clock and when to disable clock output automatically
SD clock always keeps free running

BitField.name: CMDCODE
BitField.description:
SD Command Code
The bits contain the SD command code (0x00 - 0x3F).

BitField.name: CTLRST
BitField.description: Software Engine Reset

Enum.description: No effect

Reset the internal state machine and counters. The contents of control register will not be cleared (but RIEN, DIEN, DOEN and R2_EN will be cleared). This bit will be auto cleared after few clock cycles

BitField.name: DBW
BitField.description: SD Data Bus Width (for 1-bit / 4-bit Selection)

Enum.description: Data bus width is 1-bit
Data bus width is 4-bit

BitField.name: BLKCNT
BitField.description:
Block Counts to Be Transferred or Received
This field contains the block counts for data-in and data-out transfer. For READ_MULTIPLE_BLOCK and WRITE_MULTIPLE_BLOCK command, software can use this function to accelerate data transfer and improve performance. Don't fill 0x0 to this field.
Note: For READ_MULTIPLE_BLOCK and WRITE_MULTIPLE_BLOCK command, the actual total length is BLKCNT * (BLKLEN +1).

BitField.name: SDNWR
BitField.description:
NWR Parameter for Block Write Operation
This value indicates the NWR parameter for data block write operation in SD clock counts. The actual clock cycle will be SDNWR+1.

BitField.name: ARGUMENT
BitField.description:
SD Command Argument
This register contains a 32-bit value specifies the argument of SD command from host controller to SD card. Before trigger COEN (SDH_CTL [0]), software should fill argument in this field.

BitField.name: BLKDIEN
BitField.description: Block Transfer Done Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: BLKDIF (SDH_INTEN[0]) trigger interrupt Disable
BLKDIF (SDH_INTEN[0]) trigger interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: CRCIEN
BitField.description: CRC7, CRC16 and CRC Status Error Interrupt Enable Bit

Enum.description: CRCIF (SDH_INTEN[1]) trigger interrupt Disable
CRCIF (SDH_INTEN[1]) trigger interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: CDIEN
BitField.description:
SD Card Detection Interrupt Enable Bit
Enable/Disable interrupts generation of SD controller when card is inserted or removed.

Enum.description: CDIF (SDH_INTEN[8]) trigger interrupt Disable
CDIF (SDH_INTEN[8]) trigger interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: RTOIEN
BitField.description:
Response Time-out Interrupt Enable Bit
Enable/Disable interrupts generation of SD controller when receiving response or R2 time-out. Time-out value is specified at TOUT register.

Enum.description: RTOIF (SDH_INTEN[12]) trigger interrupt Disabled
RTOIF (SDH_INTEN[12]) trigger interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: DITOIEN
BitField.description:
Data Input Time-out Interrupt Enable Bit
Enable/Disable interrupts generation of SD controller when data input time-out. Time-out value is specified at TOUT register.

Enum.description: DITOIF (SDH_INTEN[13]) trigger interrupt Disabled
DITOIF (SDH_INTEN[13]) trigger interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: WKIEN
BitField.description:
Wake-up Signal Generating Enable Bit
Enable/Disable wake-up signal generating of SD controller when card is inserted or removed.

Enum.description: SD Card interrupt to wake-up chip Disabled
SD Card interrupt to wake-up chip Enabled

BitField.name: CDSRC
BitField.description: SD Card Detect Source Selection

Enum.description: From SD card's DAT3 pin
From GPIO pin

BitField.name: BLKDIF
BitField.description:
Block Transfer Done Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
This bit indicates that SD host has finished all data-in or data-out block transfer. If there is a CRC16 error or incorrect CRC status during multiple block data transfer, the transfer will be broken and this bit will also be set.
Note: This bit is read only, but can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: Not finished yet

BitField.name: CRCIF
BitField.description:
CRC7, CRC16 and CRC Status Error Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
This bit indicates that SD host has occurred CRC error during response in, data-in or data-out (CRC status error) transfer. When CRC error is occurred, software should reset SD engine. Some response (ex. R3) doesn't have CRC7 information with it; SD host will still calculate CRC7, get CRC error and set this flag. In this condition, software should ignore CRC error and clears this bit manually.
Note: This bit is read only, but can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: No CRC error is occurred
CRC error is occurred

BitField.name: CRC7
BitField.description:
CRC7 Check Status (Read Only)
SD host will check CRC7 correctness during each response in. If that response does not contain CRC7 information (ex. R3), then software should turn off CRCIEN (SDH_INTEN[1]) and ignore this bit.

BitField.name: CRC16
BitField.description:
CRC16 Check Status of Data-in Transfer (Read Only)
SD host will check CRC16 correctness after data-in transfer.

BitField.name: CRCSTS
BitField.description:
CRC Status Value of Data-out Transfer (Read Only)
SD host will record CRC status of data-out transfer. Software could use this value to identify what type of error is during data-out transfer.

Enum.description: Positive CRC status
Negative CRC status
SD card programming error occurs

BitField.name: DAT0STS
BitField.description:
DAT0 Pin Status of Current Selected SD Port (Read Only)
This bit is the DAT0 pin status of current selected SD port.

BitField.name: CDIF
BitField.description:
SD Card Detection Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
This bit indicates that SD card is inserted or removed. Only when CDIEN (SDH_INTEN[8]) is set to 1, this bit is active.
Note: This bit is read only, but can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: No card is inserted or removed
There is a card inserted in or removed from SD

BitField.name: RTOIF
BitField.description:
Response Time-out Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
This bit indicates that SD host counts to time-out value when receiving response or R2 (waiting start bit).
Note: This bit is read only, but can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: Not time-out
Response time-out

BitField.name: DITOIF
BitField.description:
Data Input Time-out Interrupt Flag (Read Only)
This bit indicates that SD host counts to time-out value when receiving data (waiting start bit).
Note: This bit is read only, but can be cleared by writing '1' to it.

Enum.description: Not time-out
Data input time-out

BitField.name: CDSTS
BitField.description:
Card Detect Status of SD (Read Only)
This bit indicates the card detect pin status of SD, and is used for card detection. When there is a card inserted in or removed from SD, software should check this bit to confirm if there is really a card insertion or removal.

Enum.description:
Card removed.
Card inserted

Card inserted.
Card removed

BitField.name: DAT1STS
BitField.description:
DAT1 Pin Status of SD Card (Read Only)
This bit indicates the DAT1 pin status of SD card.

BitField.name: RESPTK0
BitField.description:
SD Receiving Response Token 0
SD host controller will receive a response token for getting a reply from SD card when RIEN (SDH_CTL[1]) is set. This field contains response bit 47-16 of the response token.

BitField.name: RESPTK1
BitField.description:
SD Receiving Response Token 1
The SD host controller will receive a response token for getting a reply from SD card when RIEN (SDH_CTL[1]) is set. This register contains the bit 15-8 of the response token.

BitField.name: BLKLEN
BitField.description:
SD BLOCK LENGTH in Byte Unit
An 11-bit value specifies the SD transfer byte count of a block. The actual byte count is equal to BLKLEN+1.
Note: The default SD block length is 512 bytes

BitField.name: TOUT
BitField.description:
SD Response/Data-in Time-out Value
A 24-bit value specifies the time-out counts of response and data input. SD host controller will wait start bit of response or data-in until this value reached. The time period depends on SD engine clock frequency. Do not write a small number into this field, or you may never get response or data due to time-out.
Note: Filling 0x0 into this field will disable hardware time-out function.

Enum.description: No event occurred in endpoint 9
USB event occurred on Endpoint 9, check USBD_EPSTS1[7 :4] to know which kind of USB event was occurred, cleared by write 1 to USBD_INTSTS[25] or USBD_INTSTS[1]

BitField.name: EPEVT10
BitField.description: Endpoint 10's USB Event Status

Enum.description: No event occurred in endpoint 10
USB event occurred on Endpoint 10, check USBD_EPSTS1[11 :8] to know which kind of USB event was occurred, cleared by write 1 to USBD_INTSTS[26] or USBD_INTSTS[1]

BitField.name: EPEVT11
BitField.description: Endpoint 11's USB Event Status

Enum.description: No event occurred in endpoint 11
USB event occurred on Endpoint 11, check USBD_EPSTS1[ 15:12] to know which kind of USB event was occurred, cleared by write 1 to USBD_INTSTS[27] or USBD_INTSTS[1]

BitField.name: SETUP
BitField.description: Setup Event Status

Enum.description: No Setup event
Setup event occurred, cleared by write 1 to USBD_INTSTS[31]

BitField.name: FADDR
BitField.description: USB Device Function Address

BitField.name: OV
BitField.description:
Overrun
It indicates that the received data is over the maximum payload number or not.

Enum.description: No overrun
Out Data is more than the Max Payload in MXPLD register or the Setup Data is more than 8 Bytes

Register.name: USBD_ATTR
Register.description: USB Device Bus Status and Attribution Register

BitField.name: USBRST
BitField.description: USB Reset Status (Read Only)

Enum.description: Bus no reset
Bus reset when SE0 (single-ended 0) more than 2.5us

BitField.name: SUSPEND
BitField.description: Suspend Status (Read Only)

Enum.description: Bus no suspend
Bus idle more than 3ms, either cable is plugged off or host is sleeping

BitField.name: RESUME
BitField.description: Resume Status (Read Only)

Enum.description: No bus resume
Resume from suspend

BitField.name: TOUT
BitField.description: Time-out Status (Read Only)

Enum.description: No time-out
No Bus response more than 18 bits time

BitField.name: PHYEN
BitField.description: PHY Transceiver Function Enable Bit

Enum.description: PHY transceiver function Disabled
PHY transceiver function Enabled

BitField.name: RWAKEUP
BitField.description: Remote Wake-up

Enum.description: Release the USB bus from K state
Force USB bus to K (USB_D+ low, USB_D-: high) state, used for remote wake-up

BitField.name: USBEN
BitField.description: USB Controller Enable Bit

Enum.description: USB Controller Disabled
USB Controller Enabled

BitField.name: DPPUEN
BitField.description: Pull-up Resistor on USB_DP Enable Bit

Enum.description: Pull-up resistor in USB_D+ bus Disabled
Pull-up resistor in USB_D+ bus Active

BitField.name: PWRDN
BitField.description: Power-down PHY Transceiver, Low Active

Enum.description: Power-down related circuit of PHY transceiver
Turn-on related circuit of PHY transceiver

BitField.name: BYTEM
BitField.description: CPU Access USB SRAM Size Mode Selection

Enum.description: Word mode: The size of the transfer from CPU to USB SRAM can be Word only
Byte mode: The size of the transfer from CPU to USB SRAM can be Byte only

BitField.name: LPMACK
BitField.description: LPM Token Acknowledge Enable Bit

Enum.description: the valid LPM Token will be NYET
the valid LPM Token will be ACK

BitField.name: L1SUSPEND
BitField.description: LPM L1 Suspend (Read Only)

Enum.description: Bus no L1 state suspend
This bit is set by the hardware when LPM command to enter the L1 state is successfully received and acknowledged

BitField.name: L1RESUME
BitField.description: LPM L1 Resume (Read Only)

Enum.description: Bus no LPM L1 state resume
LPM L1 state Resume from LPM L1 state suspend

BitField.name: VBUSDET
BitField.description: Device VBUS Detection

Enum.description: Controller is not attached to the USB host
Controller is attached to the USB host

It is used to indicate the offset address for the SETUP token with the USB Device SRAM starting address The effective starting address is
USBD_SRAM address + {STBUFSEG, 3'b000}

Register.name: USBD_SE0
Register.description: USB Device Drive SE0 Control Register

BitField.name: SE0
BitField.description:
Drive Single Ended Zero in USB Bus
The Single Ended Zero (SE0) is when both lines (USB_D+ and USB_D-) are being pulled low.

Enum.description: Normal operation
Force USB PHY transceiver to drive SE0

BitField.name: BUFSEG
BitField.description:
Endpoint Buffer Segmentation
It is used to indicate the offset address for each endpoint with the USB SRAM starting address The effective starting address of the endpoint is
USBD_SRAM address + { BUFSEG, 3'b000}
Refer to the section 6.31.6.7 for the endpoint SRAM structure and its description.

BitField.name: MXPLD
BitField.description:
Maximal Payload
Define the data length which is transmitted to host (IN token) or the actual data length which is received from the host (OUT token). It also used to indicate that the endpoint is ready to be transmitted in IN token or received in OUT token.
(1) When the register is written by CPU,
For IN token, the value of MXPLD is used to define the data length to be transmitted and indicate the data buffer is ready.
For OUT token, it means that the controller is ready to receive data from the host and the value of MXPLD is the maximal data length comes from host.
(2) When the register is read by CPU,
For IN token, the value of MXPLD is indicated by the data length be transmitted to host
For OUT token, the value of MXPLD is indicated the actual data length receiving from host.
Note: Once MXPLD is written, the data packets will be transmitted/received immediately after IN/OUT token arrived.

BitField.name: EPNUM
BitField.description:
Endpoint Number
These bits are used to define the endpoint number of the current endpoint

BitField.name: ISOCH
BitField.description:
Isochronous Endpoint
This bit is used to set the endpoint as Isochronous endpoint, no handshake.

Enum.description: No Isochronous endpoint
Isochronous endpoint

BitField.name: STATE
BitField.description: Endpoint STATE

Enum.description: Endpoint is Disabled
Out endpoint
IN endpoint

BitField.name: DSQSYNC
BitField.description:
Data Sequence Synchronization
Note: It is used to specify the DATA0 or DATA1 PID in the following IN token transaction. hardware will toggle automatically in IN token base on the bit.

Enum.description: DATA0 PID
DATA1 PID

BitField.name: CSTALL
BitField.description: Clear STALL Response

Enum.description: Disable the device to clear the STALL handshake in setup stage
Clear the device to response STALL handshake in setup stage

Register.name: USBD_CFGP0
Register.description: Endpoint 0 Set Stall and Clear In/Out Ready Control Register

BitField.name: CLRRDY
BitField.description:
Clear Ready
When the USBD_MXPLDx register is set by user, it means that the endpoint is ready to transmit or receive data. If the user wants to disable this transaction before the transaction start, users can set this bit to 1 to disable it and it is auto clear to 0.
For IN token, write '1' to clear the IN token had ready to transmit the data to USB.
For OUT token, write '1' to clear the OUT token had ready to receive the data from USB.
This bit is write 1 only and is always 0 when it is read back.

BitField.name: SSTALL
BitField.description: Set STALL

Enum.description: Disable the device to response STALL
Set the device to respond STALL automatically

Register.name: USBD_CFGP7
Register.description: Endpoint 7 Set Stall and Clear In/Out Ready Control Register

BitField.name: CLRRDY
BitField.description:
Clear Ready
When the USBD_MXPLDx register is set by user, it means that the endpoint is ready to transmit or receive data. If the user wants to disable this transaction before the transaction start, users can set this bit to 1 to disable it and it is auto clear to 0.
For IN token, write '1' to clear the IN token had ready to transmit the data to USB.
For OUT token, write '1' to clear the OUT token had ready to receive the data from USB.
This bit is write 1 only and is always 0 when it is read back.

BitField.name: SSTALL
BitField.description: Set STALL

Enum.description: Disable the device to response STALL
Set the device to respond STALL automatically

BitField.name: BUFSEG
BitField.description:
Endpoint Buffer Segmentation
It is used to indicate the offset address for each endpoint with the USB SRAM starting address The effective starting address of the endpoint is
USBD_SRAM address + { BUFSEG, 3'b000}
Refer to the section 6.31.6.7 for the endpoint SRAM structure and its description.

BitField.name: MXPLD
BitField.description:
Maximal Payload
Define the data length which is transmitted to host (IN token) or the actual data length which is received from the host (OUT token). It also used to indicate that the endpoint is ready to be transmitted in IN token or received in OUT token.
(1) When the register is written by CPU,
For IN token, the value of MXPLD is used to define the data length to be transmitted and indicate the data buffer is ready.
For OUT token, it means that the controller is ready to receive data from the host and the value of MXPLD is the maximal data length comes from host.
(2) When the register is read by CPU,
For IN token, the value of MXPLD is indicated by the data length be transmitted to host
For OUT token, the value of MXPLD is indicated the actual data length receiving from host.
Note: Once MXPLD is written, the data packets will be transmitted/received immediately after IN/OUT token arrived.

Enum.description: Normal Operation

BitField.name: DAT
BitField.description:
Control-endpoint Data Buffer
Control endpoint data buffer for the buffer transaction (read or write).
Note: Only word or byte access are supported.

BitField.name: NAKCLR
BitField.description:
No Acknowledge Control
This bit plays a crucial role in any control transfer.
Note: Only when CPU writes data[1:0] is 2'b10 or 2'b00, this bit can be updated.

Enum.description: The bit is being cleared by the local CPU by writing zero, the USB device controller will be responding with NAKs for the subsequent status phase. This mechanism holds the host from moving to the next request, until the local CPU is also ready to process the next request

This bit is set to one by the USB device controller, whenever a setup token is received. The local CPU can take its own time to finish off any house-keeping work based on the request and then clear this bit

BitField.name: STALLEN
BitField.description:
Stall Enable Bit
When this stall bit is set, the control endpoint sends a stall handshake in response to any in or out token thereafter. This is typically used for response to invalid/unsupported requests. When this bit is being set the NAK clear bit has to be cleared at the same time since the NAK clear bit has highest priority than STALL. It is automatically cleared on receipt of a next setup-token. So, the local CPU need not write again to clear this bit.
Note: Only when CPU writes data[1:0] is 2'b10 or 2'b00, this bit can be updated.

Enum.description: No sends a stall handshake in response to any in or out token thereafter
The control endpoint sends a stall handshake in response to any in or out token thereafter

BitField.name: ZEROLEN
BitField.description:
Zero Packet Length
This bit is valid for Auto Validation mode only.

Enum.description: No zero length packet to the host during Data stage to an IN token

USB device controller can send a zero length packet to the host during Data stage to an IN token. This bit gets cleared once the zero length data packet is sent. So, the local CPU need not write again to clear this bit

BitField.name: FLUSH
BitField.description: CEP-flush Bit

Enum.description: No the packet buffer and its corresponding HSUSBD_CEPDATCNT register to be cleared
The packet buffer and its corresponding HSUSBD_CEPDATCNT register to be cleared. This bit is self-cleaning

BitField.name: TXCNT
BitField.description:
In-transfer Data Count
There is no mode selection for the control endpoint (but it operates like manual mode).The local-CPU has to fill the control-endpoint buffer with the data to be sent for an in-token and to write the count of bytes in this register. When zero is written into this field, a zero length packet is sent to the host. When the count written in the register is more than the MPS, the data sent will be of only MPS.

BitField.name: RXCNT
BitField.description:
Out-transfer Data Count
The USB device controller maintains the count of the data received in case of an out transfer, during the control transfer.

BitField.name: DATCNT
BitField.description:
Control-endpoint Data Count
The USB device controller maintains the count of the data of control-endpoint.

BitField.name: SETUP0
BitField.description:
Setup Byte 0[7:0]
This register provides byte 0 of the last setup packet received. For a Standard Device Request, the following bmRequestType information is returned.
Bit 7(Direction):
0: Host to device
1: Device to host
Bit 6-5 (Type):
00: Standard
01: Class
10: Vendor
11: Reserved
Bit 4-0 (Recipient)
00000: Device
00001: Interface
00010: Endpoint
00011: Other
Others: Reserved

BitField.name: SETUP1
BitField.description:
Setup Byte 1[15:8]
This register provides byte 1 of the last setup packet received. For a Standard Device Request, the following bRequest Code information is returned.

Enum.description: Get Status
Clear Feature
Set Feature
Set Address
Get Descriptor
Set Descriptor
Get Configuration
Set Configuration
Get Interface
Set Interface
Sync Frame

BitField.name: SETUP2
BitField.description:
Setup Byte 2 [7:0]
This register provides byte 2 of the last setup packet received. For a Standard Device Request, the least significant byte of the wValue field is returned.

BitField.name: SETUP3
BitField.description:
Setup Byte 3 [15:8]
This register provides byte 3 of the last setup packet received. For a Standard Device Request, the most significant byte of the wValue field is returned.

BitField.name: SETUP4
BitField.description:
Setup Byte 4[7:0]
This register provides byte 4 of the last setup packet received. For a Standard Device Request, the least significant byte of the wIndex is returned.

BitField.name: SETUP5
BitField.description:
Setup Byte 5[15:8]
This register provides byte 5 of the last setup packet received. For a Standard Device Request, the most significant byte of the wIndex field is returned.

BitField.name: SETUP6
BitField.description:
Setup Byte 6[7:0]
This register provides byte 6 of the last setup packet received. For a Standard Device Request, the least significant byte of the wLength field is returned.

BitField.name: SETUP7
BitField.description:
Setup Byte 7[15:8]
This register provides byte 7 of the last setup packet received. For a Standard Device Request, the most significant byte of the wLength field is returned.

BitField.name: BUFFULLIF
BitField.description:
Buffer Full
For an IN endpoint, the currently selected buffer is full, or no buffer is available to the local side for writing (no space to write). For an OUT endpoint, there is a buffer available on the local side, and there are FIFO full of bytes available to be read (entire packet is available for reading).

The endpoint packet buffer is full

BitField.name: BUFEMPTYIF

The endpoint buffer is empty.
The currently selected buffer has a count of 0, or no buffer is available on the local side (nothing to read)

Register.name: HSUSBD_EPADATCNT
Register.description: Endpoint A Data Available Count Register

BitField.name: DATCNT
BitField.description:
Data Count
For an IN endpoint (EPDIR(HSUSBD_EPxCFG[3] is high.), this register returns the number of valid bytes in the IN endpoint packet buffer.
For an OUT endpoint (EPDIR(HSUSBD_EPxCFG[3] is low.), this register returns the number of received valid bytes in the Host OUT transfer.

BitField.name: DMALOOP
BitField.description:
DMA Loop
This register is the remaining DMA loop to complete. Each loop means 32-byte transfer.

BitField.name: FLUSH
BitField.description:
Buffer Flush
Writing 1 to this bit causes the packet buffer to be flushed and the corresponding EP_AVAIL register to be cleared. This bit is self-clearing. This bit should always be written after an configuration event.

Enum.description: The packet buffer is not flushed
The packet buffer is flushed by user

BitField.name: MODE
BitField.description:
Mode Control
The two bits decide the operation mode of the in-endpoint.
These bits are not valid for an out-endpoint. The auto validate mode will be activated when the reserved mode is selected.

Enum.description: Auto-Validate Mode
Manual-Validate Mode
Fly Mode

BitField.name: TOGGLE
BitField.description:
Endpoint Toggle
This bit is used to clear the endpoint data toggle bit. Reading this bit returns the current state of the endpoint data toggle bit.
The local CPU may use this bit to initialize the end-point's toggle in case of reception of a Set Interface request or a Clear Feature (ep_halt) request from the host. Only when toggle bit is '1', this bit can be written into the inversed write data bit[3].

Enum.description: Not clear the endpoint data toggle bit
Clear the endpoint data toggle bit

BitField.name: HALT
BitField.description:
Endpoint Halt
This bit is used to send a STALL handshake as response to the token from the host. When an Endpoint Set Feature (ep_halt) is detected by the local CPU, it must write a '1' to this bit.

Enum.description: Not send a STALL handshake as response to the token from the host
Send a STALL handshake as response to the token from the host

BitField.name: ZEROLEN
BitField.description:
Zero Length
This bit is used to send a zero-length packet response to an IN-token. When this bit is set, a zero packet is sent to the host on reception of an IN-token. This bit gets cleared once the zero length data packet is sent.

Enum.description: A zero packet is not sent to the host on reception of an IN-token
A zero packet is sent to the host on reception of an IN-token

BitField.name: SHORTTXEN
BitField.description:
Short Packet Transfer Enable
This bit is applicable only in case of Auto-Validate Method. This bit is set to validate any remaining data in the buffer which is not equal to the MPS of the endpoint, and happens to be the last transfer. This bit gets cleared once the data packet is sent.

Enum.description: Not validate any remaining data in the buffer which is not equal to the MPS of the endpoint
Validate any remaining data in the buffer which is not equal to the MPS of the endpoint

BitField.name: DISBUF
BitField.description:
Buffer Disable Bit
This bit is used to receive unknown size OUT short packet. The received packet size is reference HSUSBD_EPxDATCNT register.

Enum.description: Buffer Not Disabled when Bulk-OUT short packet is received
Buffer Disabled when Bulk-OUT short packet is received

For OUT endpoints, this field has no effect.

BitField.name: EPEN
BitField.description:

When set, this bit enables this endpoint. This bit has no effect on Endpoint 0, which is always enabled.

The endpoint Enabled

BitField.name: EPTYPE
BitField.description:
Endpoint Type
This field selects the type of this endpoint. Endpoint 0 is forced to a Control type.

BitField.name: EPDIR
BitField.description:
Endpoint Direction
Note: A maximum of one OUT and IN endpoint is allowed for each endpoint number.

in-endpoint (Host IN to Device)

BitField.name: EPNUM
BitField.description:
Endpoint Number
This field selects the number of the endpoint. Valid numbers 1 to 15.
Note: Do not support two endpoints have same endpoint number.

BitField.name: TOGGLE
BitField.description:
Endpoint Toggle
This bit is used to clear the endpoint data toggle bit. Reading this bit returns the current state of the endpoint data toggle bit.
The local CPU may use this bit to initialize the end-point's toggle in case of reception of a Set Interface request or a Clear Feature (ep_halt) request from the host. Only when toggle bit is '1', this bit can be written into the inversed write data bit[3].

Enum.description: Not clear the endpoint data toggle bit
Clear the endpoint data toggle bit

BitField.name: HALT
BitField.description:
Endpoint Halt
This bit is used to send a STALL handshake as response to the token from the host. When an Endpoint Set Feature (ep_halt) is detected by the local CPU, it must write a '1' to this bit.

Enum.description: Not send a STALL handshake as response to the token from the host
Send a STALL handshake as response to the token from the host

BitField.name: ZEROLEN
BitField.description:
Zero Length
This bit is used to send a zero-length packet response to an IN-token. When this bit is set, a zero packet is sent to the host on reception of an IN-token. This bit gets cleared once the zero length data packet is sent.

Enum.description: A zero packet is not sent to the host on reception of an IN-token
A zero packet is sent to the host on reception of an IN-token

BitField.name: SHORTTXEN
BitField.description:
Short Packet Transfer Enable
This bit is applicable only in case of Auto-Validate Method. This bit is set to validate any remaining data in the buffer which is not equal to the MPS of the endpoint, and happens to be the last transfer. This bit gets cleared once the data packet is sent.

Enum.description: Not validate any remaining data in the buffer which is not equal to the MPS of the endpoint
Validate any remaining data in the buffer which is not equal to the MPS of the endpoint

BitField.name: DISBUF
BitField.description:
Buffer Disable Bit
This bit is used to receive unknown size OUT short packet. The received packet size is reference HSUSBD_EPxDATCNT register.

Enum.description: Buffer Not Disabled when Bulk-OUT short packet is received
Buffer Disabled when Bulk-OUT short packet is received

Register.name: HSUSBD_EPBMPS
Register.description: Endpoint B Maximum Packet Size Register

BitField.name: EPMPS
BitField.description:
Endpoint Maximum Packet Size
This field determines the Maximum Packet Size of the Endpoint.

BitField.name: TXCNT
BitField.description:
Endpoint Transfer Count
For IN endpoints, this field determines the total number of bytes to be sent to the host in case of manual validation method.
For OUT endpoints, this field has no effect.

BitField.name: EPEN
BitField.description:
Endpoint Valid
When set, this bit enables this endpoint. This bit has no effect on Endpoint 0, which is always enabled.

Enum.description: The endpoint Disabled
The endpoint Enabled

BitField.name: EPTYPE
BitField.description:
Endpoint Type
This field selects the type of this endpoint. Endpoint 0 is forced to a Control type.

BitField.name: EPDIR
BitField.description:
Endpoint Direction
Note: A maximum of one OUT and IN endpoint is allowed for each endpoint number.

Enum.description: out-endpoint (Host OUT to Device)
in-endpoint (Host IN to Device)

BitField.name: EPNUM
BitField.description:
Endpoint Number
This field selects the number of the endpoint. Valid numbers 1 to 15.
Note: Do not support two endpoints have same endpoint number.

Register.name: HSUSBD_EPBBUFSTART
Register.description: Endpoint B RAM Start Address Register

BitField.name: SADDR
BitField.description:
Endpoint Start Address
This is the start-address of the RAM space allocated for the endpoint A~L.

Register.name: HSUSBD_EPBBUFEND
Register.description: Endpoint B RAM End Address Register

BitField.name: EADDR
BitField.description:
Endpoint End Address
This is the end-address of the RAM space allocated for the endpoint A~L.

BitField.name: EPDAT
BitField.description:
Endpoint A~L Data Register
Endpoint A~L data buffer for the buffer transaction (read or write).
Note: Only word or byte access are supported.

BitField.name: BUFFULLIF
BitField.description:
Buffer Full
For an IN endpoint, the currently selected buffer is full, or no buffer is available to the local side for writing (no space to write). For an OUT endpoint, there is a buffer available on the local side, and there are FIFO full of bytes available to be read (entire packet is available for reading).
Note: This bit is read-only.

Enum.description: The endpoint packet buffer is not full
The endpoint packet buffer is full

BitField.name: BUFEMPTYIF
BitField.description:
Buffer Empty
For an IN endpoint, a buffer is available to the local side for writing up to FIFO full of bytes.
Note: This bit is read-only.

Enum.description:
The endpoint buffer is not empty.
The currently selected buffer has not a count of 0

The endpoint buffer is empty.
The currently selected buffer has a count of 0, or no buffer is available on the local side (nothing to read)

BitField.name: SHORTTXIF
BitField.description:
Short Packet Transferred Interrupt
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: The length of the last packet was not less than the Maximum Packet Size (EPMPS)
The length of the last packet was less than the Maximum Packet Size (EPMPS)

BitField.name: TXPKIF
BitField.description:
Data Packet Transmitted Interrupt
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: Not a data packet is transmitted from the endpoint to the host
A data packet is transmitted from the endpoint to the host

BitField.name: RXPKIF
BitField.description:
Data Packet Received Interrupt
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: No data packet is received from the host by the endpoint
A data packet is received from the host by the endpoint

BitField.name: OUTTKIF
BitField.description:
Data OUT Token Interrupt
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: A Data OUT token has not been received from the host
A Data OUT token has been received from the host. This bit also set by PING token (in high-speed only)

BitField.name: INTKIF
BitField.description:
Data IN Token Interrupt
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: Not Data IN token has been received from the host
A Data IN token has been received from the host

BitField.name: PINGIF
BitField.description:
PING Token Interrupt
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: A Data PING token has not been received from the host
A Data PING token has been received from the host

BitField.name: NAKIF
BitField.description:
USB NAK Sent
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: The last USB IN packet could be provided, and was acknowledged with an ACK
The last USB IN packet could not be provided, and was acknowledged with a NAK

BitField.name: STALLIF
BitField.description:
USB STALL Sent
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: The last USB packet could be accepted or provided because the endpoint was stalled, and was acknowledged with a STALL
The last USB packet could not be accepted or provided because the endpoint was stalled, and was acknowledged with a STALL

BitField.name: NYETIF
BitField.description:
NYET Sent
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: The space available in the RAM is sufficient to accommodate the next on coming data packet
The space available in the RAM is not sufficient to accommodate the next on coming data packet

BitField.name: ERRIF
BitField.description:
ERR Sent
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: No any error in the transaction
There occurs any error in the transaction

BitField.name: SHORTRXIF
BitField.description:
Bulk Out Short Packet Received
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: No bulk out short packet is received
Received bulk out short packet (including zero length packet)

BitField.name: BUFFULLIEN
BitField.description:
Buffer Full Interrupt
When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set when a buffer full condition is detected on the bus.

Enum.description: Buffer full interrupt Disabled
Buffer full interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: BUFEMPTYIEN
BitField.description:
Buffer Empty Interrupt
When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set when a buffer empty condition is detected on the bus.

Enum.description: Buffer empty interrupt Disabled
Buffer empty interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: SHORTTXIEN
BitField.description:
Short Packet Transferred Interrupt Enable Bit
When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set when a short data packet has been transferred to/from the host.

Enum.description: Short data packet interrupt Disabled
Short data packet interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: TXPKIEN
BitField.description:
Data Packet Transmitted Interrupt Enable Bit
When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set when a data packet has been transmitted to the host.

Enum.description: Data packet has been transmitted to the host interrupt Disabled
Data packet has been transmitted to the host interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: RXPKIEN
BitField.description:
Data Packet Received Interrupt Enable Bit
When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set when a data packet has been received from the host.

Enum.description: Data packet has been received from the host interrupt Disabled
Data packet has been received from the host interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: OUTTKIEN
BitField.description:
Data OUT Token Interrupt Enable Bit
When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set when a Data OUT token has been received from the host.

Enum.description: Data OUT token interrupt Disabled
Data OUT token interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: INTKIEN
BitField.description:
Data IN Token Interrupt Enable Bit
When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set when a Data IN token has been received from the host.

Enum.description: Data IN token interrupt Disabled
Data IN token interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: PINGIEN
BitField.description:
PING Token Interrupt Enable Bit
When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set when a PING token has been received from the host.

Enum.description: PING token interrupt Disabled
PING token interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: NAKIEN
BitField.description:
USB NAK Sent Interrupt Enable Bit
When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set when a NAK token is sent to the host.

Enum.description: NAK token interrupt Disabled
NAK token interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: STALLIEN
BitField.description:
USB STALL Sent Interrupt Enable Bit
When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set when a stall token is sent to the host.

Enum.description: STALL token interrupt Disabled
STALL token interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: NYETIEN
BitField.description:
NYET Interrupt Enable Bit
When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set whenever NYET condition occurs on the bus for this endpoint.

Enum.description: NYET condition interrupt Disabled
NYET condition interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: ERRIEN
BitField.description:
ERR Interrupt Enable Bit
When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set whenever ERR condition occurs on the bus for this endpoint.

Enum.description: Error event interrupt Disabled
Error event interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: SHORTRXIEN
BitField.description:
Bulk Out Short Packet Interrupt Enable Bit
When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set whenever bulk out short packet occurs on the bus for this endpoint.

Enum.description: Bulk out interrupt Disabled
Bulk out interrupt Enabled

Register.name: HSUSBD_EPCDATCNT
Register.description: Endpoint C Data Available Count Register

BitField.name: DATCNT
BitField.description:
Data Count
For an IN endpoint (EPDIR(HSUSBD_EPxCFG[3] is high.), this register returns the number of valid bytes in the IN endpoint packet buffer.
For an OUT endpoint (EPDIR(HSUSBD_EPxCFG[3] is low.), this register returns the number of received valid bytes in the Host OUT transfer.

BitField.name: DMALOOP
BitField.description:
DMA Loop
This register is the remaining DMA loop to complete. Each loop means 32-byte transfer.

BitField.name: FLUSH
BitField.description:
Buffer Flush
Writing 1 to this bit causes the packet buffer to be flushed and the corresponding EP_AVAIL register to be cleared. This bit is self-clearing. This bit should always be written after an configuration event.

Enum.description: The packet buffer is not flushed
The packet buffer is flushed by user

BitField.name: MODE
BitField.description:
Mode Control
The two bits decide the operation mode of the in-endpoint.
These bits are not valid for an out-endpoint. The auto validate mode will be activated when the reserved mode is selected.

Enum.description: Auto-Validate Mode
Manual-Validate Mode
Fly Mode

BitField.name: DATCNT
BitField.description:
Data Count
For an IN endpoint (EPDIR(HSUSBD_EPxCFG[3] is high.), this register returns the number of valid bytes in the IN endpoint packet buffer.
For an OUT endpoint (EPDIR(HSUSBD_EPxCFG[3] is low.), this register returns the number of received valid bytes in the Host OUT transfer.

BitField.name: DMALOOP
BitField.description:
DMA Loop
This register is the remaining DMA loop to complete. Each loop means 32-byte transfer.

BitField.name: FLUSH
BitField.description:
Buffer Flush
Writing 1 to this bit causes the packet buffer to be flushed and the corresponding EP_AVAIL register to be cleared. This bit is self-clearing. This bit should always be written after an configuration event.

Enum.description: The packet buffer is not flushed
The packet buffer is flushed by user

BitField.name: MODE
BitField.description:
Mode Control
The two bits decide the operation mode of the in-endpoint.
These bits are not valid for an out-endpoint. The auto validate mode will be activated when the reserved mode is selected.

Enum.description: Auto-Validate Mode
Manual-Validate Mode
Fly Mode

BitField.name: TOGGLE
BitField.description:
Endpoint Toggle
This bit is used to clear the endpoint data toggle bit. Reading this bit returns the current state of the endpoint data toggle bit.
The local CPU may use this bit to initialize the end-point's toggle in case of reception of a Set Interface request or a Clear Feature (ep_halt) request from the host. Only when toggle bit is '1', this bit can be written into the inversed write data bit[3].

Enum.description: Not clear the endpoint data toggle bit
Clear the endpoint data toggle bit

BitField.name: HALT
BitField.description:
Endpoint Halt
This bit is used to send a STALL handshake as response to the token from the host. When an Endpoint Set Feature (ep_halt) is detected by the local CPU, it must write a '1' to this bit.

Enum.description: Not send a STALL handshake as response to the token from the host
Send a STALL handshake as response to the token from the host

BitField.name: ZEROLEN
BitField.description:
Zero Length

Enum.description: A zero packet is not sent to the host on reception of an IN-token
A zero packet is sent to the host on reception of an IN-token

BitField.name: SHORTTXEN

Enum.description: Not validate any remaining data in the buffer which is not equal to the MPS of the endpoint
Validate any remaining data in the buffer which is not equal to the MPS of the endpoint

When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set when a Data IN token has been received from the host.

Enum.description: Data IN token interrupt Disabled
Data IN token interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: PINGIEN
BitField.description:
PING Token Interrupt Enable Bit
When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set when a PING token has been received from the host.

Enum.description: PING token interrupt Disabled
PING token interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: NAKIEN
BitField.description:
USB NAK Sent Interrupt Enable Bit
When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set when a NAK token is sent to the host.

Enum.description: NAK token interrupt Disabled
NAK token interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: STALLIEN
BitField.description:
USB STALL Sent Interrupt Enable Bit
When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set when a stall token is sent to the host.

Enum.description: STALL token interrupt Disabled
STALL token interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: NYETIEN
BitField.description:
NYET Interrupt Enable Bit
When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set whenever NYET condition occurs on the bus for this endpoint.

Enum.description: NYET condition interrupt Disabled
NYET condition interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: ERRIEN
BitField.description:
ERR Interrupt Enable Bit
When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set whenever ERR condition occurs on the bus for this endpoint.

Enum.description: Error event interrupt Disabled
Error event interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: SHORTRXIEN
BitField.description:
Bulk Out Short Packet Interrupt Enable Bit
When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set whenever bulk out short packet occurs on the bus for this endpoint.

Enum.description: Bulk out interrupt Disabled
Bulk out interrupt Enabled

Register.name: HSUSBD_EPGDATCNT
Register.description: Endpoint G Data Available Count Register

BitField.name: DATCNT
BitField.description:
Data Count
For an IN endpoint (EPDIR(HSUSBD_EPxCFG[3] is high.), this register returns the number of valid bytes in the IN endpoint packet buffer.
For an OUT endpoint (EPDIR(HSUSBD_EPxCFG[3] is low.), this register returns the number of received valid bytes in the Host OUT transfer.

BitField.name: DMALOOP
BitField.description:
DMA Loop
This register is the remaining DMA loop to complete. Each loop means 32-byte transfer.

BitField.name: FLUSH
BitField.description:
Buffer Flush
Writing 1 to this bit causes the packet buffer to be flushed and the corresponding EP_AVAIL register to be cleared. This bit is self-clearing. This bit should always be written after an configuration event.

Enum.description: The packet buffer is not flushed
The packet buffer is flushed by user

BitField.name: MODE
BitField.description:
Mode Control
The two bits decide the operation mode of the in-endpoint.
These bits are not valid for an out-endpoint. The auto validate mode will be activated when the reserved mode is selected.

Enum.description: Auto-Validate Mode
Manual-Validate Mode
Fly Mode

BitField.name: TOGGLE
BitField.description:
Endpoint Toggle
This bit is used to clear the endpoint data toggle bit. Reading this bit returns the current state of the endpoint data toggle bit.
The local CPU may use this bit to initialize the end-point's toggle in case of reception of a Set Interface request or a Clear Feature (ep_halt) request from the host. Only when toggle bit is '1', this bit can be written into the inversed write data bit[3].

Enum.description: Not clear the endpoint data toggle bit
Clear the endpoint data toggle bit

BitField.name: HALT
BitField.description:
Endpoint Halt
This bit is used to send a STALL handshake as response to the token from the host. When an Endpoint Set Feature (ep_halt) is detected by the local CPU, it must write a '1' to this bit.

Enum.description: Not send a STALL handshake as response to the token from the host
Send a STALL handshake as response to the token from the host

BitField.name: ZEROLEN
BitField.description:
Zero Length
This bit is used to send a zero-length packet response to an IN-token. When this bit is set, a zero packet is sent to the host on reception of an IN-token. This bit gets cleared once the zero length data packet is sent.

Enum.description: A zero packet is not sent to the host on reception of an IN-token
A zero packet is sent to the host on reception of an IN-token

BitField.name: SHORTTXEN
BitField.description:
Short Packet Transfer Enable
This bit is applicable only in case of Auto-Validate Method. This bit is set to validate any remaining data in the buffer which is not equal to the MPS of the endpoint, and happens to be the last transfer. This bit gets cleared once the data packet is sent.

Enum.description: Not validate any remaining data in the buffer which is not equal to the MPS of the endpoint
Validate any remaining data in the buffer which is not equal to the MPS of the endpoint

BitField.name: DISBUF
BitField.description:
Buffer Disable Bit
This bit is used to receive unknown size OUT short packet. The received packet size is reference HSUSBD_EPxDATCNT register.

Enum.description: Buffer Not Disabled when Bulk-OUT short packet is received
Buffer Disabled when Bulk-OUT short packet is received

Register.name: HSUSBD_EPGMPS
Register.description: Endpoint G Maximum Packet Size Register

BitField.name: EPMPS
BitField.description:
Endpoint Maximum Packet Size
This field determines the Maximum Packet Size of the Endpoint.

BitField.name: TXCNT
BitField.description:
Endpoint Transfer Count
For IN endpoints, this field determines the total number of bytes to be sent to the host in case of manual validation method.
For OUT endpoints, this field has no effect.

BitField.name: EPEN
BitField.description:
Endpoint Valid
When set, this bit enables this endpoint. This bit has no effect on Endpoint 0, which is always enabled.

Enum.description: The endpoint Disabled
The endpoint Enabled

BitField.name: EPTYPE
BitField.description:
Endpoint Type
This field selects the type of this endpoint. Endpoint 0 is forced to a Control type.

BitField.name: EPDIR
BitField.description:
Endpoint Direction
Note: A maximum of one OUT and IN endpoint is allowed for each endpoint number.

Enum.description: out-endpoint (Host OUT to Device)
in-endpoint (Host IN to Device)

BitField.name: EPNUM
BitField.description:
Endpoint Number
This field selects the number of the endpoint. Valid numbers 1 to 15.
Note: Do not support two endpoints have same endpoint number.

Register.name: HSUSBD_EPGBUFSTART
Register.description: Endpoint G RAM Start Address Register

BitField.name: SADDR
BitField.description:
Endpoint Start Address
This is the start-address of the RAM space allocated for the endpoint A~L.

Register.name: HSUSBD_EPGBUFEND
Register.description: Endpoint G RAM End Address Register

BitField.name: EADDR
BitField.description:
Endpoint End Address
This is the end-address of the RAM space allocated for the endpoint A~L.

BitField.name: EPDAT
BitField.description:
Endpoint A~L Data Register
Endpoint A~L data buffer for the buffer transaction (read or write).
Note: Only word or byte access are supported.

BitField.name: BUFFULLIF
BitField.description:
Buffer Full
For an IN endpoint, the currently selected buffer is full, or no buffer is available to the local side for writing (no space to write). For an OUT endpoint, there is a buffer available on the local side, and there are FIFO full of bytes available to be read (entire packet is available for reading).
Note: This bit is read-only.

Enum.description: The endpoint packet buffer is not full
The endpoint packet buffer is full

BitField.name: BUFEMPTYIF
BitField.description:
Buffer Empty
For an IN endpoint, a buffer is available to the local side for writing up to FIFO full of bytes.
Note: This bit is read-only.

Enum.description:
The endpoint buffer is not empty.
The currently selected buffer has not a count of 0

The endpoint buffer is empty.
The currently selected buffer has a count of 0, or no buffer is available on the local side (nothing to read)

BitField.name: SHORTTXIF
BitField.description:
Short Packet Transferred Interrupt
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: The length of the last packet was not less than the Maximum Packet Size (EPMPS)
The length of the last packet was less than the Maximum Packet Size (EPMPS)

BitField.name: TXPKIF
BitField.description:
Data Packet Transmitted Interrupt
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: Not a data packet is transmitted from the endpoint to the host
A data packet is transmitted from the endpoint to the host

BitField.name: RXPKIF
BitField.description:
Data Packet Received Interrupt
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: No data packet is received from the host by the endpoint
A data packet is received from the host by the endpoint

BitField.name: OUTTKIF
BitField.description:
Data OUT Token Interrupt
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: A Data OUT token has not been received from the host
A Data OUT token has been received from the host. This bit also set by PING token (in high-speed only)

BitField.name: INTKIF
BitField.description:
Data IN Token Interrupt
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: Not Data IN token has been received from the host
A Data IN token has been received from the host

BitField.name: PINGIF
BitField.description:
PING Token Interrupt
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: A Data PING token has not been received from the host
A Data PING token has been received from the host

BitField.name: NAKIF
BitField.description:
USB NAK Sent
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: The last USB IN packet could be provided, and was acknowledged with an ACK
The last USB IN packet could not be provided, and was acknowledged with a NAK

BitField.name: STALLIF
BitField.description:
USB STALL Sent
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: The last USB packet could be accepted or provided because the endpoint was stalled, and was acknowledged with a STALL
The last USB packet could not be accepted or provided because the endpoint was stalled, and was acknowledged with a STALL

BitField.name: NYETIF
BitField.description:
NYET Sent
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: The space available in the RAM is sufficient to accommodate the next on coming data packet
The space available in the RAM is not sufficient to accommodate the next on coming data packet

BitField.name: ERRIF
BitField.description:
ERR Sent
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: No any error in the transaction
There occurs any error in the transaction

BitField.name: SHORTRXIF
BitField.description:
Bulk Out Short Packet Received
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: No bulk out short packet is received
Received bulk out short packet (including zero length packet)

Buffer Disable Bit
This bit is used to receive unknown size OUT short packet. The received packet size is reference HSUSBD_EPxDATCNT register.

Enum.description: Buffer Not Disabled when Bulk-OUT short packet is received
Buffer Disabled when Bulk-OUT short packet is received

Register.name: HSUSBD_EPIMPS
Register.description: Endpoint I Maximum Packet Size Register

BitField.name: EPMPS
BitField.description:
Endpoint Maximum Packet Size
This field determines the Maximum Packet Size of the Endpoint.

BitField.name: TXCNT
BitField.description:
Endpoint Transfer Count
For IN endpoints, this field determines the total number of bytes to be sent to the host in case of manual validation method.
For OUT endpoints, this field has no effect.

BitField.name: EPEN
BitField.description:
Endpoint Valid
When set, this bit enables this endpoint. This bit has no effect on Endpoint 0, which is always enabled.

Enum.description: The endpoint Disabled
The endpoint Enabled

BitField.name: EPTYPE
BitField.description:
Endpoint Type
This field selects the type of this endpoint. Endpoint 0 is forced to a Control type.

BitField.name: EPDIR
BitField.description:
Endpoint Direction
Note: A maximum of one OUT and IN endpoint is allowed for each endpoint number.

Enum.description: out-endpoint (Host OUT to Device)
in-endpoint (Host IN to Device)

BitField.name: EPNUM
BitField.description:
Endpoint Number
This field selects the number of the endpoint. Valid numbers 1 to 15.
Note: Do not support two endpoints have same endpoint number.

Register.name: HSUSBD_EPIBUFSTART
Register.description: Endpoint I RAM Start Address Register

BitField.name: SADDR
BitField.description:
Endpoint Start Address
This is the start-address of the RAM space allocated for the endpoint A~L.

Register.name: HSUSBD_EPIBUFEND
Register.description: Endpoint I RAM End Address Register

BitField.name: EADDR
BitField.description:
Endpoint End Address
This is the end-address of the RAM space allocated for the endpoint A~L.

BitField.name: EPDAT
BitField.description:
Endpoint A~L Data Register
Endpoint A~L data buffer for the buffer transaction (read or write).
Note: Only word or byte access are supported.

BitField.name: BUFFULLIF
BitField.description:
Buffer Full
For an IN endpoint, the currently selected buffer is full, or no buffer is available to the local side for writing (no space to write). For an OUT endpoint, there is a buffer available on the local side, and there are FIFO full of bytes available to be read (entire packet is available for reading).
Note: This bit is read-only.

Enum.description: The endpoint packet buffer is not full
The endpoint packet buffer is full

BitField.name: BUFEMPTYIF
BitField.description:
Buffer Empty
For an IN endpoint, a buffer is available to the local side for writing up to FIFO full of bytes.
Note: This bit is read-only.

Enum.description:
The endpoint buffer is not empty.
The currently selected buffer has not a count of 0

The endpoint buffer is empty.
The currently selected buffer has a count of 0, or no buffer is available on the local side (nothing to read)

BitField.name: SHORTTXIF
BitField.description:
Short Packet Transferred Interrupt
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: The length of the last packet was not less than the Maximum Packet Size (EPMPS)
The length of the last packet was less than the Maximum Packet Size (EPMPS)

BitField.name: TXPKIF
BitField.description:
Data Packet Transmitted Interrupt
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: Not a data packet is transmitted from the endpoint to the host
A data packet is transmitted from the endpoint to the host

BitField.name: RXPKIF
BitField.description:
Data Packet Received Interrupt
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: No data packet is received from the host by the endpoint
A data packet is received from the host by the endpoint

BitField.name: OUTTKIF
BitField.description:
Data OUT Token Interrupt
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: A Data OUT token has not been received from the host
A Data OUT token has been received from the host. This bit also set by PING token (in high-speed only)

BitField.name: INTKIF
BitField.description:
Data IN Token Interrupt
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: Not Data IN token has been received from the host
A Data IN token has been received from the host

BitField.name: PINGIF
BitField.description:
PING Token Interrupt
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: A Data PING token has not been received from the host
A Data PING token has been received from the host

BitField.name: NAKIF
BitField.description:
USB NAK Sent
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: The last USB IN packet could be provided, and was acknowledged with an ACK
The last USB IN packet could not be provided, and was acknowledged with a NAK

BitField.name: STALLIF
BitField.description:
USB STALL Sent
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: The last USB packet could be accepted or provided because the endpoint was stalled, and was acknowledged with a STALL
The last USB packet could not be accepted or provided because the endpoint was stalled, and was acknowledged with a STALL

BitField.name: NYETIF
BitField.description:
NYET Sent
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: The space available in the RAM is sufficient to accommodate the next on coming data packet
The space available in the RAM is not sufficient to accommodate the next on coming data packet

BitField.name: ERRIF
BitField.description:
ERR Sent
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: No any error in the transaction
There occurs any error in the transaction

BitField.name: SHORTRXIF
BitField.description:
Bulk Out Short Packet Received
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

Enum.description: No bulk out short packet is received
Received bulk out short packet (including zero length packet)

BitField.name: BUFFULLIEN
BitField.description:
Buffer Full Interrupt
When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set when a buffer full condition is detected on the bus.

Enum.description: Buffer full interrupt Disabled
Buffer full interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: BUFEMPTYIEN
BitField.description:
Buffer Empty Interrupt
When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set when a buffer empty condition is detected on the bus.

Enum.description: Buffer empty interrupt Disabled
Buffer empty interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: SHORTTXIEN
BitField.description:
Short Packet Transferred Interrupt Enable Bit
When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set when a short data packet has been transferred to/from the host.

Enum.description: Short data packet interrupt Disabled
Short data packet interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: TXPKIEN
BitField.description:
Data Packet Transmitted Interrupt Enable Bit
When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set when a data packet has been transmitted to the host.

Enum.description: Data packet has been transmitted to the host interrupt Disabled
Data packet has been transmitted to the host interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: RXPKIEN
BitField.description:
Data Packet Received Interrupt Enable Bit
When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set when a data packet has been received from the host.

Enum.description: Data packet has been received from the host interrupt Disabled
Data packet has been received from the host interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: OUTTKIEN
BitField.description:
Data OUT Token Interrupt Enable Bit
When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set when a Data OUT token has been received from the host.

Enum.description: Data OUT token interrupt Disabled
Data OUT token interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: INTKIEN
BitField.description:
Data IN Token Interrupt Enable Bit
When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set when a Data IN token has been received from the host.

Enum.description: Data IN token interrupt Disabled
Data IN token interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: PINGIEN
BitField.description:
PING Token Interrupt Enable Bit
When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set when a PING token has been received from the host.

Enum.description: PING token interrupt Disabled
PING token interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: NAKIEN
BitField.description:
USB NAK Sent Interrupt Enable Bit
When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set when a NAK token is sent to the host.

Enum.description: NAK token interrupt Disabled
NAK token interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: STALLIEN
BitField.description:
USB STALL Sent Interrupt Enable Bit
When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set when a stall token is sent to the host.

Enum.description: STALL token interrupt Disabled
STALL token interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: NYETIEN
BitField.description:
NYET Interrupt Enable Bit
When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set whenever NYET condition occurs on the bus for this endpoint.

Enum.description: NYET condition interrupt Disabled
NYET condition interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: ERRIEN
BitField.description:
ERR Interrupt Enable Bit
When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set whenever ERR condition occurs on the bus for this endpoint.

Enum.description: Error event interrupt Disabled
Error event interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: SHORTRXIEN
BitField.description:
Bulk Out Short Packet Interrupt Enable Bit
When set, this bit enables a local interrupt to be set whenever bulk out short packet occurs on the bus for this endpoint.

Enum.description: Bulk out interrupt Disabled
Bulk out interrupt Enabled

Register.name: HSUSBD_EPJDATCNT
Register.description: Endpoint J Data Available Count Register

BitField.name: DATCNT
BitField.description:
Data Count
For an IN endpoint (EPDIR(HSUSBD_EPxCFG[3] is high.), this register returns the number of valid bytes in the IN endpoint packet buffer.
For an OUT endpoint (EPDIR(HSUSBD_EPxCFG[3] is low.), this register returns the number of received valid bytes in the Host OUT transfer.

BitField.name: DMALOOP
BitField.description:
DMA Loop
This register is the remaining DMA loop to complete. Each loop means 32-byte transfer.

BitField.name: FLUSH
BitField.description:
Buffer Flush
Writing 1 to this bit causes the packet buffer to be flushed and the corresponding EP_AVAIL register to be cleared. This bit is self-clearing. This bit should always be written after an configuration event.

Enum.description: The packet buffer is not flushed
The packet buffer is flushed by user

BitField.name: MODE
BitField.description:
Mode Control
The two bits decide the operation mode of the in-endpoint.
These bits are not valid for an out-endpoint. The auto validate mode will be activated when the reserved mode is selected.

Enum.description: Auto-Validate Mode
Manual-Validate Mode
Fly Mode

BitField.name: TOGGLE
BitField.description:
Endpoint Toggle
This bit is used to clear the endpoint data toggle bit. Reading this bit returns the current state of the endpoint data toggle bit.
The local CPU may use this bit to initialize the end-point's toggle in case of reception of a Set Interface request or a Clear Feature (ep_halt) request from the host. Only when toggle bit is '1', this bit can be written into the inversed write data bit[3].

Enum.description: Not clear the endpoint data toggle bit
Clear the endpoint data toggle bit

BitField.name: HALT
BitField.description:
Endpoint Halt
This bit is used to send a STALL handshake as response to the token from the host. When an Endpoint Set Feature (ep_halt) is detected by the local CPU, it must write a '1' to this bit.

Enum.description: Not send a STALL handshake as response to the token from the host
Send a STALL handshake as response to the token from the host

BitField.name: ZEROLEN
BitField.description:
Zero Length
This bit is used to send a zero-length packet response to an IN-token. When this bit is set, a zero packet is sent to the host on reception of an IN-token. This bit gets cleared once the zero length data packet is sent.

Enum.description: A zero packet is not sent to the host on reception of an IN-token
A zero packet is sent to the host on reception of an IN-token

BitField.name: SHORTTXEN
BitField.description:
Short Packet Transfer Enable
This bit is applicable only in case of Auto-Validate Method. This bit is set to validate any remaining data in the buffer which is not equal to the MPS of the endpoint, and happens to be the last transfer. This bit gets cleared once the data packet is sent.

Enum.description: Not validate any remaining data in the buffer which is not equal to the MPS of the endpoint
Validate any remaining data in the buffer which is not equal to the MPS of the endpoint

BitField.name: DISBUF
BitField.description:
Buffer Disable Bit
This bit is used to receive unknown size OUT short packet. The received packet size is reference HSUSBD_EPxDATCNT register.

Enum.description: Buffer Not Disabled when Bulk-OUT short packet is received
Buffer Disabled when Bulk-OUT short packet is received
