BitField.name: EXTSMPT
BitField.description:
EADC Sampling Time Extend
When EADC converting at high conversion rate, the sampling time of analog input voltage may not enough if input channel loading is heavy, SW can extend EADC sampling time after trigger source is coming to get enough sampling time.
The range of start delay time is from 0~255 EADC clock.

BitField.name: ADCMPIE

Enum.description: Compare function interrupt Disabled
Compare function interrupt Enabled

BitField.name: CMPCOND
BitField.description: Compare Condition

Enum.description: Set the compare condition as that when a 12-bit EADC conversion result is less than the 12-bit CMPDAT (EADC_CMPn [27:16]), the internal match counter will increase one
Set the compare condition as that when a 12-bit EADC conversion result is greater or equal to the 12-bit CMPDAT (EADC_CMPn [27:16]), the internal match counter will increase one

BitField.name: CMPMCNT

BitField.name: CMPWEN
BitField.description:
Compare Window Mode Enable Bit
Note: This bit is only present in EADC_CMP0 and EADC_CMP2 register.

Enum.description: EADCMPF0 (EADC_STATUS2[4]) will be set when EADC_CMP0 compared condition matched. EADCMPF2 (EADC_STATUS2[6]) will be set when EADC_CMP2 compared condition matched

EADCMPF0 (EADC_STATUS2[4]) will be set when both EADC_CMP0 and EADC_CMP1 compared condition matched. EADCMPF2 (EADC_STATUS2[6]) will be set when both EADC_CMP2 and EADC_CMP3 compared condition matched

BitField.name: CMPDAT
BitField.description:
Comparison Data
The 12 bits data is used to compare with conversion result of specified sample module. User can use it to monitor the external analog input pin voltage transition without imposing a load on software.

Register.name: EADC0_DDAT0
Register.description: EADC Double Data Register 0 for Sample Module 0

BitField.name: RESULT
BitField.description:
EADC Conversion Results
This field contains 12 bits conversion results.
When the DMOF (EADC_CTL[9]) is set to 0, 12-bit EADC conversion result with unsigned format will be filled in RESULT [11:0] and zero will be filled in RESULT [15:12].
When DMOF (EADC_CTL[9]) is set to 1, 12-bit EADC conversion result with 2'complement format will be filled in RESULT [11:0] and signed bits to will be filled in RESULT [15:12].

BitField.name: OV

BitField.name: PWUPRDY
BitField.description: EADC Power-up Sequence Completed and Ready for Conversion (Read Only)

Enum.description: EADC is not ready for conversion may be in power down state or in the progress of start up
EADC is ready for conversion

BitField.name: PWUCALEN
BitField.description:
Power Up Calibration Function Enable Bit
Note: This bit work together with CALSEL (EADC_CALCTL [3]), see the following
{PWUCALEN, CALSEL } Description:
PWUCALEN is 0 and CALSEL is 0: No need to calibrate.
PWUCALEN is 0 and CALSEL is 1: No need to calibrate.
PWUCALEN is 1 and CALSEL is 0: Load calibration word when power up.
PWUCALEN is 1 and CALSEL is 1: Calibrate when power up.

Enum.description: Calibration function Disabled at power up
Calibration function Enabled at power up

BitField.name: PWDMOD
BitField.description:
EADC Power-down Mode
Set this bit field to select EADC Power-down mode when system power-down.
Note: Different PWDMOD has different power down/up sequence, in order to avoid EADC powering up with wrong sequence; user must keep PWDMOD consistent each time in power down and start up.

Enum.description: EADC Deep Power-down mode
EADC Power down
EADC Standby mode
EADC Deep Power-down mode

BitField.name: LDOSUT
BitField.description: EADC Internal LDO Start-up Time

BitField.name: CALSTART
BitField.description:
Calibration Functional Block Start
Note 1: This bit is set by SW and clear by HW after re-calibration finish.
Note 2: Before set CALSTART (EADC_CALCTL[1]) as 1 to start calibration again, EADCDIV (CKL_CLKDIV0[23:16]) must be 0.

Enum.description: Stop calibration functional block
Start calibration functional block

BitField.name: CALDONE
BitField.description: Calibration Functional Block Complete (Read Only)

Enum.description: During a calibration
Calibration is completed

BitField.name: CALSEL
BitField.description: Select Calibration Functional Block

Enum.description: Load calibration word when calibration functional block is active
Execute calibration when calibration functional block is active

Enum.description: Stop calibration functional block
Start calibration functional block

BitField.name: CALDONE

Enum.description: During a calibration
Calibration is completed

BitField.name: CALSEL
BitField.description: Select Calibration Functional Block

Enum.description: Load calibration word when calibration functional block is active
Execute calibration when calibration functional block is active

BitField.name: CALWORD
BitField.description:
Calibration Word Bits
Write to this register with the previous calibration word before load calibration action.
Read this register after calibration done.
Note: The calibration block contains two parts 'CALIBRATION' and 'LOAD CALIBRATION'; if the calibration block configure as 'CALIBRATION'; then this register represent the result of calibration when calibration is completed; if configure as 'LOAD CALIBRATION' ; configure this register before loading calibration action, after loading calibration complete, the laoded calibration word will apply to the EADC; while in loading calibration function the loaded value will not be equal to the original CALWORD until calibration is done.

BitField.name: CALWORD
BitField.description:
Calibration Word Bits
Write to this register with the previous calibration word before load calibration action.
Read this register after calibration done.
Note: The calibration block contains two parts 'CALIBRATION' and 'LOAD CALIBRATION'; if the calibration block configure as 'CALIBRATION'; then this register represent the result of calibration when calibration is completed; if configure as 'LOAD CALIBRATION' ; configure this register before loading calibration action, after loading calibration complete, the laoded calibration word will apply to the EADC; while in loading calibration function the loaded value will not be equal to the original CALWORD until calibration is done.

BitField.name: PDMATEN
BitField.description:
PDMA Transfer Enable Bit
When EADC conversion is completed, the converted data is loaded into EADC_DATn (n: 0 ~ 18) register, user can enable this bit to generate a PDMA data transfer request.

Enum.description: PDMA data transfer Disabled
PDMA data transfer Enabled

When DMOF (EADC_CTL[9]) set to 1, 12-bit EADC conversion result with 2'complement format will be filled in RESULT[11:0] and signed bits to will be filled in RESULT[15:12].

BitField.name: OV
BitField.description:
Overrun Flag
If converted data in RESULT[11:0] has not been read before new conversion result is loaded to this register, OV is set to 1.
Note: It is cleared by hardware after EADC_DAT register is read.

Enum.description: Data in RESULT[11:0] is recent conversion result
Data in RESULT[11:0] is overwrite

BitField.name: VALID
BitField.description:
Valid Flag
This bit is set to 1 when corresponding sample module channel analog input conversion is completed and cleared by hardware after EADC_DAT register is read.

Enum.description: Data in RESULT[11:0] bits is not valid
Data in RESULT[11:0] bits is valid

EADC Converter Enable Bit

Enum.description: Disabled EADC
Enabled EADC

BitField.name: ADCRST
BitField.description:
EADC Converter Control Circuits Reset
Note: EADCRST bit remains 1 during EADC reset, when EADC reset end, the EADCRST bit is automatically cleared to 0.

Enum.description: No effect
Cause EADC control circuits reset to initial state, but not change the EADC registers value

BitField.name: EXTSMPT
BitField.description:
EADC Sampling Time Extend
When EADC converting at high conversion rate, the sampling time of analog input voltage may not enough if input channel loading is heavy, SW can extend EADC sampling time after trigger source is coming to get enough sampling time.
The range of start delay time is from 0~255 EADC clock.

Register.name: EADC0_DDAT0
Register.description: EADC Double Data Register 0 for Sample Module 0

BitField.name: RESULT
BitField.description:
EADC Conversion Results
This field contains 12 bits conversion results.
When the DMOF (EADC_CTL[9]) is set to 0, 12-bit EADC conversion result with unsigned format will be filled in RESULT [11:0] and zero will be filled in RESULT [15:12].
When DMOF (EADC_CTL[9]) is set to 1, 12-bit EADC conversion result with 2'complement format will be filled in RESULT [11:0] and signed bits to will be filled in RESULT [15:12].

BitField.name: OV
BitField.description:
Overrun Flag
If converted data in RESULT[15:0] has not been read before new conversion result is loaded to this register, OV is set to 1. It is cleared by hardware after EADC_DDAT register is read.

Enum.description: Data in RESULT (EADC_DATn[15:0], n=0~3) is recent conversion result
Data in RESULT (EADC_DATn[15:0], n=0~3) is overwrite

BitField.name: VALID
BitField.description: Valid Flag

Enum.description: Double data in RESULT (EADC_DDATn[15:0]) is not valid
Double data in RESULT (EADC_DDATn[15:0]) is valid

BitField.name: PWUPRDY
BitField.description: EADC Power-up Sequence Completed and Ready for Conversion (Read Only)

Enum.description: EADC is not ready for conversion may be in power down state or in the progress of start up
EADC is ready for conversion

BitField.name: PWUCALEN
BitField.description:
Power Up Calibration Function Enable Bit
Note: This bit work together with CALSEL (EADC_CALCTL [3]), see the following
{PWUCALEN, CALSEL } Description:
PWUCALEN is 0 and CALSEL is 0: No need to calibrate.
PWUCALEN is 0 and CALSEL is 1: No need to calibrate.
PWUCALEN is 1 and CALSEL is 0: Load calibration word when power up.
PWUCALEN is 1 and CALSEL is 1: Calibrate when power up.

Enum.description: Calibration function Disabled at power up
Calibration function Enabled at power up

BitField.name: PWDMOD
BitField.description:
EADC Power-down Mode
Set this bit field to select EADC Power-down mode when system power-down.
Note: Different PWDMOD has different power down/up sequence, in order to avoid EADC powering up with wrong sequence; user must keep PWDMOD consistent each time in power down and start up.

Enum.description: EADC Deep Power-down mode
EADC Power down
EADC Standby mode
EADC Deep Power-down mode

BitField.name: CALSTART
BitField.description:
Calibration Functional Block Start
Note 1: This bit is set by SW and clear by HW after re-calibration finish.
Note 2: Before set CALSTART (EADC_CALCTL[1]) as 1 to start calibration again, EADCDIV (CKL_CLKDIV0[23:16]) must be 0.

Start calibration functional block

BitField.name: CALWORD
BitField.description:
Calibration Word Bits
Write to this register with the previous calibration word before load calibration action.
Read this register after calibration done.
Note: The calibration block contains two parts 'CALIBRATION' and 'LOAD CALIBRATION'; if the calibration block configure as 'CALIBRATION'; then this register represent the result of calibration when calibration is completed; if configure as 'LOAD CALIBRATION' ; configure this register before loading calibration action, after loading calibration complete, the laoded calibration word will apply to the EADC; while in loading calibration function the loaded value will not be equal to the original CALWORD until calibration is done.

BitField.name: DACDAT
BitField.description:
DAC 12-bit Holding Data
These bits are written by user software which specifies 12-bit conversion data for DAC output. The unused bits (DAC_DAT[3:0] in left-alignment mode and DAC_DAT[15:12] in right alignment mode) are ignored by DAC controller hardware.
12 bit left alignment: user has to load data into DAC_DAT[15:4] bits.
12 bit right alignment: user has to load data into DAC_DAT[11:0] bits.

BitField.name: DATOUT
BitField.description:

BitField.name: FINISH
BitField.description:

DAC conversion finish

BitField.name: SETTLET
BitField.description:

User software needs to write appropriate value to these bits to meet DAC conversion settling time base on PCLK (APB clock) speed.
For example, DAC controller clock speed is 80 MHz and DAC conversion settling time is 1 us, SETTLETvalue must be greater than 0x50.

BitField.name: ACMPIF0

This bit is set by hardware when the edge condition defined by INTPOL (ACMP_CTL0[9:8]) is detected on comparator 0 output. This will generate an interrupt if ACMPIE (ACMP_CTL0[1]) is set to 1.
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.

BitField.name: ACMPIF1
BitField.description:
Comparator 1 Interrupt Flag
This bit is set by hardware when the edge condition defined by INTPOL (ACMP_CTL1[9:8]) is detected on comparator 1 output. This will cause an interrupt if ACMPIE (ACMP_CTL1[1]) is set to 1.
Note: Write 1 to clear this bit to 0.
